2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature aggregation within objects in point cloud 3D detection. It proposes RBGNet, a ray-based grouping method that emits rays from object centers, grouping points along rays for feature aggregation, better capturing object structure. Compared to sphere- or pillar-based grouping, ray grouping aligns with object geometry, enhancing local features. On ScanNet and SUN RGB-D, it achieves leading performance in 3D detection and segmentation.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组是点云特征聚合的创新思路，对室内场景检测有显著提升。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线的点云组群方法用于3D目标检测。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 利用射线方向性聚合点特征，适应物体几何结构。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得领先性能。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D目标检测中标签噪声和定位不准确的问题。②提出Back to Reality方法，利用形状引导的标签增强，通过生成更精确的3D框标签来改善训练。③相比直接使用粗糙的弱标签，该方法结合形状先验和几何约束，提升了标签质量。④在KITTI和SUN RGB-D上，该方法在弱监督设置下显著提升了3D检测精度，接近全监督性能。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy and inaccurate labels in weakly-supervised 3D detection. It proposes Back to Reality, which uses shape-guided label enhancement to generate more precise 3D boxes for training. Compared to using raw weak labels, it incorporates shape priors and geometric constraints to improve label quality. On KITTI and SUN RGB-D, it significantly boosts 3D AP under weak supervision, approaching full-supervision performance.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 弱监督标签增强是降低标注成本的重要技术，该工作具有实际应用潜力。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法用于弱监督3D检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用形状先验优化弱标签，提升训练质量。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在弱监督下接近全监督性能。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中路边感知（roadside perception）缺乏大规模、高多样性数据集的问题，现有数据集多聚焦于车载视角，难以支持路边单目3D检测的研究。②该论文构建了Rope3D数据集，包含从路边摄像头采集的50,000帧图像，并提供了丰富的3D标注（包括3D框、遮挡、截断等），同时提出了一种基于几何约束的自动标注优化方法。③相比已有数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D专门针对路边视角，具有更远的感知距离、更大的视角变化和更复杂的遮挡场景，并提供了基准测试。④实验表明，在Rope3D上，现有单目3D检测方法（如MonoFlex、SMOKE）性能显著下降，而提出的优化标注方法能提升约5%的AP，验证了数据集的挑战性和价值。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale, diverse roadside perception datasets for autonomous driving, which hinders monocular 3D detection research from roadside perspectives. It introduces Rope3D, a dataset with 50,000 frames from roadside cameras, rich 3D annotations, and an automatic annotation refinement method based on geometric constraints. Compared to existing datasets, Rope3D features longer perception ranges, larger viewpoint variations, and more complex occlusions, and benchmarks show that current methods degrade significantly, while the proposed refinement improves AP by about 5%.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该数据集填补了路边感知方向的空白，对自动驾驶多视角感知研究具有重要推动作用，尤其适合关注3D检测和BEV感知的研究者。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了首个大规模路边单目3D检测数据集Rope3D，并提供基准和标注优化方法。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 提出基于几何约束的自动标注优化，针对路边视角的远距离和遮挡挑战。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 在Rope3D上验证了现有方法的不足，标注优化提升约5% AP。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉中心感知方法在实际部署中延迟过高（如多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）的问题，提出了ASAP基准，这是首个评估自动驾驶视觉中心感知在线性能的基准。作者基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，提出标注扩展流程生成12Hz高帧率标签，并构建了SPUR评估协议，利用12Hz输入进行流式评估。相比传统离线评估，该工作量化了性能与效率的权衡，填补了理想研究与实际应用之间的空白。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high latency of vision-centric perception methods in real-world deployment by proposing the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online performance of vision-centric perception in autonomous driving. It introduces an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels from the 2Hz nuScenes dataset and a SPUR evaluation protocol for streaming assessment, quantifying the performance-efficiency trade-off.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要指导意义，推动领域关注实时性能，值得关注。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知的基准ASAP及SPUR协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展和高帧率评估，首次将在线性能纳入自动驾驶感知基准。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知的实时部署提供了量化评估工具。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文是一篇综述，系统回顾了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体内容，但根据标题推断，它涵盖了该领域的主要方法、挑战和未来方向。相比已有综述，可能更专注于环视视觉设置。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This survey reviews surround-view vision-based 3D detection methods for autonomous driving, covering key approaches, challenges, and future directions. It likely provides a comprehensive overview of this specific subfield.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 作为综述，对领域入门和方向梳理有参考价值，但创新性有限。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统总结了环视视觉3D检测的研究进展。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 聚焦于环视视觉这一特定视角。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供了该领域的全面概览。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D检测中缺乏多视图一致性问题，提出了VEDet框架，利用3D多视图几何提升定位精度。VEDet采用查询式transformer架构，通过3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出层设计视图条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以学习视图等变性。相比已有方法，该方法在输入和损失层面注入多视图几何，提供了丰富的几何线索，在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces VEDet, a 3D object detection framework exploiting multi-view geometry for viewpoint awareness and equivariance. It uses query-based transformers with 3D positional encodings and view-conditioned queries, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地将视图等变性引入3D检测，具有较高学术价值。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视图等变性的VEDet框架，提升多视图3D检测精度。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入和损失层面注入多视图几何，实现视图等变学习。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR和Radar融合中Radar数据稀疏且缺乏高度信息的问题，提出了双向融合框架Bi-LRFusion。首先，通过从LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，缓解高度缺失和稀疏性问题；然后，在统一的BEV表示中结合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上，该方法在动态目标检测上达到最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework for 3D dynamic object detection. It enriches Radar features using LiDAR details and combines them in BEV, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and ORR datasets.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 该融合策略有效解决了多传感器融合中的关键挑战，具有实用价值。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架，提升动态目标检测性能。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 通过双向信息流增强Radar特征，解决稀疏和高度缺失问题。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出了VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D检测和跟踪。由于摘要为空，具体细节未知，但根据标题，它可能通过全稀疏卷积网络避免密集特征图，提升效率和精度。相比已有方法，可能更高效。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper presents VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. It likely uses sparse convolutions to improve efficiency and accuracy.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏设计是3D检测的重要趋势，该工作可能具有较高影响力。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏VoxelNet架构，用于高效3D检测和跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 全稀疏卷积设计，避免密集计算。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 可能提升检测效率和精度。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云和RGB图像多模态掩码自编码器交互不足的问题，提出了PiMAE框架，通过三个方面促进3D和2D交互：投影模块对齐掩码和可见token、双分支MAE管道和共享解码器、跨模态重建模块。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上，该方法显著提升了3D检测性能，证明了多模态交互学习的有效性。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework for point cloud and image interaction. It uses projection alignment, shared decoder, and cross-modal reconstruction, achieving strong results on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了多模态MAE的交互机制，对自监督学习有重要贡献。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了点云和图像交互的掩码自编码器框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐和共享解码器促进跨模态交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在RGB-D基准上显著提升3D检测性能。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: ①针对BEV 3D检测中沿高度维度展平BEV空间导致不同高度物体（如低矮的障碍物和高大的卡车）特征信息丢失的问题。②提出BEV切片注意力网络（BEV-SAN），沿高度维度采样构建全局和局部BEV切片，从相机特征聚合切片特征并通过注意力机制融合，最后用Transformer融合局部和全局BEV特征。③相比现有方法直接展平BEV空间，该方法显式建模高度维度的差异性，增强了对不同高度物体的特征表达。④在nuScenes等数据集上验证了有效性，显著提升了检测精度，尤其对高度差异大的物体。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of losing height-specific information in BEV 3D detection by flattening the BEV space. It proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to construct global and local BEV slices, aggregates features via attention, and fuses them with a transformer. This approach improves detection accuracy, especially for objects with distinct heights.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 该论文针对BEV检测中高度维度信息丢失的问题提出了新颖的切片注意力机制，具有较高的实用价值和创新性，值得关注。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出BEV切片注意力网络，通过高度维度切片和注意力融合提升BEV 3D检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 首次在BEV特征构建中显式建模高度维度，利用切片和注意力机制保留不同高度的特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes等数据集上显著提升了检测精度，尤其对高度差异大的物体。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测模型计算效率低、难以部署的问题。②提出基于互换传递的知识蒸馏框架（itKD），使用共享自编码器对教师和学生网络的特征进行通道压缩和解压缩，通过压缩表示损失绑定两者知识，并利用互换重建减少差距，同时引入头部注意力损失匹配检测信息。③相比传统知识蒸馏，该方法通过通道级压缩和互换传递更有效地迁移教师特征。④在KITTI等数据集上验证了轻量模型的有效性，在保持精度的同时提升了计算效率。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of point-cloud 3D detectors. It proposes an interchange transfer-based knowledge distillation framework (itKD) with a shared autoencoder for channel-wise compression and decompression, along with a head attention loss. This method effectively transfers teacher knowledge to a lightweight student model, improving efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测模型部署问题提出了有效的知识蒸馏方法，具有实际应用价值，但创新性中等。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出互换传递知识蒸馏框架，通过通道压缩和互换重建提升轻量3D检测模型的性能。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 利用共享自编码器进行通道级知识绑定和互换传递，结合头部注意力损失。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上验证了轻量模型的有效性，提升了计算效率。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D检测器对真实世界干扰（如恶劣天气、传感器噪声）鲁棒性不足的问题。②设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机输入的常见干扰，并在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上建立了三个鲁棒性基准（KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C），对24种3D检测模型进行了大规模评估。③相比现有评估，该工作系统性地覆盖了多种干扰类型和数据集，提供了全面的鲁棒性分析。④发现运动级干扰最具威胁性，LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好，相机-only模型对图像干扰极其脆弱。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in 3D detectors to real-world corruptions in autonomous driving. It designs 27 types of corruptions for LiDAR and camera inputs, establishes three benchmarks (KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, Waymo-C), and evaluates 24 models. Key findings include motion-level corruptions being most threatening and fusion models being more robust.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了全面的3D检测鲁棒性基准和深入分析，对自动驾驶安全研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 建立了3D检测鲁棒性基准并系统评估了24种模型，揭示了关键鲁棒性挑战。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计了27种针对LiDAR和相机的常见干扰，覆盖多数据集和多模型。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级干扰最威胁，融合模型更鲁棒，相机-only模型脆弱。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LSS-based多视图3D检测中卷积忽略BEV特征径向对称性、增加优化难度的问题。②提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）和方位角等变锚点，AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向方向，学习方位角不变的BEV特征；锚点使检测头预测方位角无关的目标。同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同相机内参的深度预测。③相比现有方法，该方法保留了BEV特征的固有属性，简化了检测器优化。④在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2和BEVDepth等近期方法。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of convolution ignoring the radial symmetry of BEV features in multi-view 3D detection. It proposes azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and anchors, along with camera-decoupled virtual depth. This approach preserves BEV feature properties and eases optimization, achieving 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing recent methods.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了创新的方位角等变设计，显著提升了BEV检测性能，具有高影响力和实用价值。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积和锚点，结合相机解耦虚拟深度，提升多视图3D检测精度。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用径向对称性设计等变卷积和锚点，简化检测器优化。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越现有方法。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多帧点云3D检测中Detect-and-Fuse框架的冗余计算问题。②提出运动引导的序列融合（MSF）方法，利用物体运动连续性挖掘序列上下文：在当前帧生成3D提议，基于估计速度传播到前帧，池化感兴趣点并编码为提议特征，通过双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧交互，并用体素采样优化点云池化。③相比现有方法，该方法避免了逐帧特征提取的冗余，提高了效率。④在多个数据集上实现了更好的效率和精度平衡。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundant computation in multi-frame point-cloud 3D detection. It proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which propagates 3D proposals to preceding frames based on velocities, pools points-of-interest, and uses a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module. This method improves efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多帧检测的效率问题提出了实用的运动引导融合方法，具有较好的应用前景。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合方法，通过提议传播和双向特征聚合提升多帧3D检测效率。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用运动连续性挖掘序列上下文，并优化点云池化。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现了更好的效率和精度平衡。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NeRF场景中直接进行物体检测的问题，现有方法需要渲染视图。②提出NeRF-RPN框架，直接操作预训练的NeRF，利用多尺度3D神经体素特征回归3D边界框，无需渲染任何视角。该框架是通用的，可检测无类别标签的物体。③相比现有方法，这是首个直接在NeRF上运行的检测框架，避免了渲染开销。④在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性，并发布了基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection directly in NeRF scenes without rendering. It proposes NeRF-RPN, which operates on pre-trained NeRF using multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes. This is the first general detection framework for NeRF, avoiding rendering costs and enabling class-agnostic detection.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 该论文开创了NeRF中直接检测的新方向，具有新颖性和广泛的应用潜力，值得关注。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接操作NeRF的通用物体检测框架NeRF-RPN，并发布基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D体素特征在NeRF中直接回归3D边界框，无需渲染。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性，支持无类别标签检测。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应对点云密度差异敏感的问题，本文提出了一种密度不敏感的域适应方法。方法通过设计密度感知的特征对齐和样本重加权策略，减少源域与目标域间点云密度分布差异带来的负面影响。相比现有域适应方法，该方法在密度变化剧烈的场景下具有更强的鲁棒性。实验表明，在多个基准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the density sensitivity issue in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection. It proposes a density-insensitive method with density-aware feature alignment and sample reweighting to mitigate distribution shifts caused by point cloud density variations. Compared to existing methods, it shows improved robustness in scenarios with drastic density changes, achieving significant performance gains on multiple benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该论文针对域适应中的密度差异问题提出了实用解决方案，对实际部署中的传感器差异具有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的域适应框架，提升3D检测器在跨域场景下的泛化能力。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 引入密度感知的对齐与重加权机制，有效缓解点云密度分布不匹配。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个基准上显著提升跨域检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达与相机融合中深度信息利用不足和跨模态交互粒度不够的问题，本文提出MSMDFusion框架。方法包含多深度反投影（MDU）模块，通过深度感知设计将2D语义种子提升到3D空间，并采用多尺度融合策略实现细粒度的跨模态交互。相比现有基于拼接或注意力的融合方法，该方法更有效地结合了2D和3D信息。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上取得了领先的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth utilization and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion with a Multi-Depth Unprojection module and multi-scale fusion to enable fine-grained interactions. Compared to concatenation or attention-based fusion, it better integrates 2D semantics with 3D geometry, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该论文在融合深度信息与多尺度交互上设计精巧，对多模态3D检测有重要推进。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多深度种子反投影与多尺度融合框架，显著提升跨模态3D检测精度。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的种子提升和细粒度多尺度融合机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在主流基准上达到领先性能。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D检测中跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段知识迁移不足的问题，本文提出X3KD框架。方法通过统一的知识蒸馏框架，将激光雷达模态的知识迁移到相机模型，并联合优化检测与分割任务，同时在不同训练阶段进行蒸馏。相比单模态或单任务蒸馏，该方法更全面地利用了多源监督信息。在nuScenes等数据集上显著提升了多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal, cross-task, and cross-stage knowledge transfer in multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes X3KD, a unified distillation framework that transfers LiDAR knowledge to camera models, jointly optimizes detection and segmentation, and applies distillation across training stages. Compared to single-modal or single-task distillation, it leverages multi-source supervision more comprehensively, significantly boosting multi-camera 3D detection on nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该论文系统性地设计了多维度蒸馏，对无激光雷达的视觉方案有重要价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、任务和阶段的统一蒸馏框架，提升多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对现有跨模态融合方法难以同时捕捉局部细节和全局上下文的问题，本文提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。方法通过局部融合模块精细对齐点云与图像特征，并通过全局融合模块捕获长距离依赖。相比仅局部或仅全局的融合策略，该方法在复杂场景下更具鲁棒性。在KITTI和nuScenes上取得了先进的检测结果。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of capturing both local details and global context in cross-modal fusion for 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet with local fusion for fine-grained alignment and global fusion for long-range dependencies. Compared to local-only or global-only strategies, it is more robust in complex scenes, achieving advanced results on KITTI and nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该论文的局部-全局融合设计平衡了精度与上下文感知，具有较强实用性。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合网络，提升3D检测的精度与鲁棒性。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 双阶段融合机制结合局部细节与全局语义。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云检测中复杂局部聚合器设计过度的问题，本文提出PillarNeXt，重新思考网络设计。方法发现基于柱状体的简单模型在精度和延迟上表现优异，并通过借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野）进一步提升性能。相比依赖精细几何建模的方法，该工作挑战了传统直觉，证明了简洁设计的有效性。在Waymo和nuScenes上达到了最先进水平。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper challenges the overemphasis on complex local aggregators in LiDAR-based 3D detection. It proposes PillarNeXt, showing that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well, and that minimal adaptations from 2D detection, such as enlarging receptive fields, significantly boost performance. Compared to geometry-heavy methods, it demonstrates the effectiveness of modernized simple designs, achieving state-of-the-art on Waymo and nuScenes.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该论文以简洁设计实现高性能，对工业部署和后续研究具有启发意义。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 重新设计基于柱状体的检测网络，证明简单架构的优越性。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 借鉴2D检测经验简化3D网络设计。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上达到最先进性能。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对遮挡和远距离物体检测困难的问题，本文提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云。方法将时序上下文中的物体信息传播到目标帧，表示为虚拟点，并与原始点云融合后输入任意检测器。相比仅使用原始点云或短时序的方法，该方法有效利用超长序列（如18秒）提升检测性能。在Waymo数据集上显著改进现有检测器，达到新最先进水平，且计算开销低。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. It propagates object information from temporal contexts to a target frame as virtual points, fused with raw points for any off-the-shelf detector. Compared to raw-only or short-sequence methods, it effectively leverages extra-long sequences (e.g., 18s), significantly improving detectors on Waymo and achieving new state-of-the-art with low overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将运动预测融入检测，对时序信息利用具有突破性，实用价值高。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出虚拟模态MoDAR，利用运动预测增强点云检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将预测轨迹转化为虚拟点，实现长时序信息的高效编码。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上显著提升检测精度并达到最先进水平。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督与梯度优化不匹配的问题，即标准IoU损失在梯度传播时可能产生次优更新，影响检测精度。②提出了一种梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析损失函数的梯度特性，设计修正项以引导优化方向更准确。③相比现有IoU损失，该方法在训练过程中动态调整梯度，提升模型收敛性和定位精度。④在KITTI等数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提高了3D检测的精度，尤其在重叠度较高的目标上表现更优。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between IoU supervision and gradient optimization in 3D object detection, where standard IoU loss can lead to suboptimal updates. It proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method that adjusts gradients during training to improve convergence and localization accuracy. Experiments on KITTI show significant improvements in detection precision, especially for highly overlapped objects.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该论文聚焦于损失函数优化这一基础但关键的问题，对提升3D检测性能有直接价值，值得关注。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督机制，优化3D检测训练过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 动态调整IoU损失梯度以匹配优化目标。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在KITTI数据集上显著提升3D检测精度。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D目标检测依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出仅使用2D标签的弱监督训练方法。②利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性三种约束，设计弱监督架构，并引入新的2D方向标注方法以提升旋转预测精度。③相比现有弱监督方法，该方法无需任何3D标注，降低了数据收集成本，并利用多视图信息增强几何约束。④实验表明，该方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，且作为预训练时能显著超越对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inconsistency between training and inference in monocular 3D detection by proposing a weakly supervised method that only requires 2D labels. It leverages projection, multi-view, and direction consistency constraints, along with a novel 2D direction labeling scheme, to train the model without 3D annotations. Experiments show comparable performance to fully supervised methods and significant gains when used as pretraining.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了自动驾驶中数据标注成本高的痛点，具有实际应用潜力，方法设计合理，实验充分。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测框架，消除对LiDAR标注的依赖。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 结合多视图投影与方向一致性约束，并引入2D方向标注方法。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能接近全监督方法，预训练时显著提升基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）因截断和遮挡导致定位精度差的问题。②提出SeaBird方法，在鸟瞰图（BEV）分割任务中使用Dice损失，并设计专门的网络结构来优化大型物体的中心点预测。③相比传统L1损失或交叉熵损失，Dice损失能更好地处理类别不平衡和形状不规则，提升大型物体的分割质量。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，对大型物体的3D检测精度显著提升，尤其在IoU阈值较高时表现突出。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of monocular 3D detection for large objects, which suffer from truncation and occlusion. It proposes SeaBird, a method that applies Dice loss to bird's eye view segmentation, improving center point prediction for large objects. Compared to L1 or cross-entropy losses, Dice loss better handles class imbalance and irregular shapes, leading to significant accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes, especially at high IoU thresholds.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该论文针对单目3D检测中的特定难点（大型物体）提出有效解决方案，Dice损失的引入具有理论依据和实验验证，对实际自动驾驶场景有重要价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出将Dice损失应用于BEV分割，显著提升单目3D检测中大型物体的精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 利用Dice损失对形状和尺度的鲁棒性，优化BEV分割中的中心点预测。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大型物体检测精度显著提升。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: ①针对时序3D目标检测中计算开销大和长程依赖建模不足的问题。②提出PTT（Point-Trajectory Transformer），利用点轨迹（point trajectories）作为时序特征，通过Transformer高效聚合多帧信息。③相比基于体素或BEV的时序融合方法，PTT直接操作原始点云轨迹，减少信息丢失并降低计算复杂度。④在nuScenes数据集上，PTT在保持高精度的同时，推理速度显著提升，尤其在长时序场景下表现优异。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost and insufficient long-range dependency modeling in temporal 3D object detection. It proposes PTT, a point-trajectory transformer that aggregates multi-frame information via point trajectories, reducing information loss and computation compared to voxel or BEV-based fusion. On nuScenes, PTT achieves high accuracy with significantly improved inference speed, especially in long-sequence scenarios.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的时序建模思路，点轨迹Transformer在效率和精度间取得良好平衡，对实时自动驾驶系统有吸引力。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出基于点轨迹的Transformer架构，实现高效时序3D检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 利用点轨迹而非体素或BEV进行时序特征聚合，降低计算并增强长程依赖。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上实现高精度和快速推理。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR和相机融合中模态对齐和特征互补不足的问题。②提出GAFusion，通过多种引导机制（如深度引导、语义引导）自适应融合LiDAR和相机特征。③相比简单拼接或注意力融合，GAFusion利用多级引导信息，增强跨模态特征的对齐和互补。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，GAFusion在3D检测精度上达到SOTA，尤其在远距离和小物体场景下提升明显。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient modality alignment and complementarity in LiDAR-camera fusion. It proposes GAFusion, which adaptively fuses LiDAR and camera features using multiple guidance mechanisms (e.g., depth and semantic guidance). Compared to simple concatenation or attention fusion, GAFusion enhances cross-modal alignment and complementarity, achieving SOTA 3D detection accuracy on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该论文的融合策略设计精细，多引导机制有效提升跨模态性能，是传感器融合领域的重要进展。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架，显著提升LiDAR-相机3D检测精度。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入深度和语义等多级引导，实现更有效的跨模态特征融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: ①针对当前稀疏BEV框架在3D检测中信息丢失和性能瓶颈的问题。②提出BEVNeXt，复兴密集BEV框架，通过改进特征提取和编码器设计，提升BEV表示的丰富性。③相比稀疏方法（如DETR3D），BEVNeXt保留完整空间信息，并引入高效计算策略，兼顾精度和速度。④在nuScenes和Waymo上，BEVNeXt在3D检测和分割任务上均达到SOTA，证明密集BEV框架的潜力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss and performance bottleneck of sparse BEV frameworks in 3D detection. It proposes BEVNeXt, which revives dense BEV frameworks by improving feature extraction and encoder design, preserving complete spatial information. Compared to sparse methods, BEVNeXt achieves SOTA on nuScenes and Waymo for both detection and segmentation, demonstrating the potential of dense BEV approaches.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该论文挑战主流稀疏范式，重新证明密集BEV框架的价值，对BEV感知研究具有重要指导意义。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 复兴并优化密集BEV框架，实现3D检测和分割的SOTA性能。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 通过改进编码器和计算策略，使密集BEV框架在精度和效率上超越稀疏方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中不同物体尺度差异大和深度估计不准的问题。②提出UniMODE，统一处理单目3D检测任务，通过多尺度特征和自适应深度预测模块提升泛化能力。③相比专用模型，UniMODE在多种数据集上无需微调即可适应，减少领域差距。④在KITTI和nuScenes上，UniMODE在单目3D检测精度上达到SOTA，尤其在跨数据集迁移时表现稳健。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of scale variation and inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection. It proposes UniMODE, which unifies the task with multi-scale features and adaptive depth prediction, improving generalization. Compared to specialized models, UniMODE adapts across datasets without fine-tuning, achieving SOTA accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes, with robust cross-dataset performance.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该论文强调统一性和泛化性，对实际部署中多场景适应有重要意义，方法设计合理。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架，提升跨数据集泛化能力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 结合多尺度特征和自适应深度预测，实现任务统一。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上达到SOTA并稳健迁移。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合在BEV表示中特征对齐和噪声处理不足的问题。②提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间融合雷达和相机特征，设计专门的编码器处理雷达稀疏性和噪声。③相比早期融合或后期融合，RCBEVDet在BEV层面实现更精细的融合，提升检测鲁棒性。④在nuScenes数据集上，RCBEVDet在3D检测精度上显著优于单传感器和现有融合方法，尤其在恶劣天气下表现稳定。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient feature alignment and noise handling in radar-camera fusion within BEV representation. It proposes RCBEVDet, which fuses radar and camera features in BEV space with a dedicated encoder for radar sparsity and noise. Compared to early or late fusion, RCBEVDet achieves finer fusion, improving detection robustness, with significant accuracy gains on nuScenes, especially in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该论文聚焦雷达-相机融合这一实用方向，BEV融合策略有效提升性能，对低成本自动驾驶方案有参考价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出BEV空间雷达-相机融合框架，提升3D检测精度和鲁棒性。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计针对雷达噪声的BEV编码器，实现高效跨模态融合。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上显著优于现有方法，恶劣天气下稳定。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D物体检测中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出VSRD方法，利用实例感知的体积轮廓渲染技术，仅需2D框标注即可训练3D检测器。该方法通过可微渲染将3D提案投影为体积轮廓，并与2D实例分割掩码对齐，从而提供监督信号。相比现有弱监督方法，VSRD更精确地利用实例级几何信息，减少了对3D标注的依赖。实验表明，在KITTI等数据集上，该方法显著提升了弱监督3D检测的精度。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: Addressing the high cost of 3D annotations in weakly supervised 3D object detection, VSRD introduces instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering to train detectors using only 2D box labels. It aligns rendered volumetric silhouettes with 2D instance masks via differentiable rendering, providing richer geometric supervision. Compared to prior weakly supervised methods, VSRD leverages instance-level cues more effectively, achieving notable accuracy improvements on KITTI and other benchmarks.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该论文为弱监督3D检测提供了新颖的渲染-based监督范式，对降低标注成本具有重要价值。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出基于体积轮廓渲染的弱监督3D检测框架，仅需2D标注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将实例感知的体积渲染引入弱监督3D检测，实现几何级监督。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI等数据集上显著提升弱监督3D检测精度。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D物体检测中跨相机信息融合不充分的问题，提出多视角注意力上下文模块，通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制增强各视角特征间的交互。该方法在BEV特征生成前进行上下文建模，使网络能更好地利用全局视角信息。相比现有基于Transformer的方法，该模块更轻量且能灵活集成到多种检测框架中。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在mAP和NDS指标上均取得显著提升。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: To improve cross-camera information fusion in multi-view 3D detection, this work proposes a multi-view attentive contextualization module that enhances inter-view feature interaction via self- and cross-attention. It performs contextual modeling before BEV generation, enabling better use of global view information. Compared to existing Transformer-based methods, the module is lightweight and can be flexibly integrated into various frameworks, yielding significant mAP and NDS improvements on nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 该论文提出的注意力模块简洁有效，对多相机感知系统有直接实用价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 设计多视角注意力上下文模块，提升跨相机特征融合。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 在BEV生成前引入轻量级交叉注意力进行全局上下文建模。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D物体检测中深度估计不准确导致定位精度低的问题，提出学习占用场作为中间表示的方法。该方法将3D空间划分为占用网格，并预测每个网格的占用概率，从而提供更丰富的几何先验。相比直接回归3D框，占用学习能更好地处理遮挡和截断。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，该方法显著提升了单目3D检测的定位精度和召回率。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: Addressing inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection, this method learns an occupancy field as an intermediate representation, predicting occupancy probabilities for 3D voxels to provide richer geometric priors. Compared to direct 3D box regression, occupancy learning better handles occlusion and truncation. It achieves significant improvements in localization accuracy and recall on KITTI and nuScenes.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 该论文将占用学习引入单目3D检测，为几何建模提供了新思路，具有较强启发性。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出基于占用场学习的单目3D检测框架。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 利用3D占用预测作为中间监督，增强几何理解。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上定位精度和召回率显著提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D物体检测和姿态估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型生成3D框和姿态。该方法将检测任务视为条件生成过程，通过去噪网络逐步细化预测。相比确定性回归方法，扩散模型能更好地捕捉多模态分布。在KITTI数据集上，该方法在3D检测和姿态估计任务上取得了有竞争力的结果。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: To address insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation, MonoDiff employs diffusion models to generate 3D boxes and poses as a conditional generation process with iterative denoising. Compared to deterministic regression, diffusion models better capture multimodal distributions. It achieves competitive results on KITTI for both 3D detection and pose estimation.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 该论文探索了扩散模型在3D检测中的应用，虽非最优但具有创新性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 首次将扩散模型应用于单目3D检测与姿态估计。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将检测任务重构为条件生成过程。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的检测和姿态估计性能。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角3D物体检测中BEV特征构建效率低的问题，提出BEVSpread，通过扩展体素池化操作，将2D图像特征更高效地投影到BEV空间。该方法在体素池化过程中引入空间扩展机制，减少信息丢失并加速计算。相比传统LSS方法，BEVSpread在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算开销。在路侧数据集上，该方法在检测精度和速度上均优于现有方法。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: For efficient BEV construction in roadside 3D detection, BEVSpread enhances voxel pooling by introducing a spatial spread mechanism that reduces information loss and accelerates computation. Compared to standard LSS-based methods, it achieves comparable or better accuracy with significantly lower computational cost. On roadside benchmarks, it outperforms existing methods in both detection accuracy and speed.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 该论文针对路侧感知场景优化BEV生成，工程价值高，实用性强。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出扩展体素池化方法，提升路侧BEV构建效率。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 在体素池化中引入空间扩展机制。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧数据集上精度和速度均优于现有方法。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D物体检测中缺乏语义指导的问题，提出利用常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）作为辅助监督。该方法从大规模预训练模型中提取常识知识，生成类别原型，并用于约束无监督检测器的特征学习。相比纯自监督方法，常识原型提供了更强的语义先验。在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上，该方法在无监督3D检测任务上取得了显著提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: To address the lack of semantic guidance in outdoor unsupervised 3D detection, this work introduces commonsense prototypes derived from large-scale pretrained models as auxiliary supervision. These prototypes constrain feature learning, providing stronger semantic priors than pure self-supervised methods. It achieves significant improvements on Waymo and nuScenes for unsupervised 3D detection.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 该论文将常识知识引入无监督3D检测，思路新颖，但实验规模有限。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出利用常识原型增强无监督3D检测的语义学习。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 将预训练模型中的常识知识转化为检测监督信号。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上无监督检测性能显著提升。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督下3D目标检测中困难实例（如远距离、遮挡、小物体）性能差的问题。②提出HINTED检测器，通过混合密度特征融合模块结合密集与稀疏点云特征，并设计困难实例增强策略。③相比现有稀疏监督方法，首次显式关注困难实例的特征表达，利用密度互补性提升特征鲁棒性。④在KITTI等数据集上显著提升困难类别的AP，尤其对远距离和遮挡目标改善明显。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses poor performance on hard instances (e.g., distant, occluded, small objects) in sparsely-supervised 3D detection. It proposes HINTED, a detector with mixed-density feature fusion and hard-instance enhancement, improving feature robustness via density complementarity. Experiments on KITTI show notable AP gains on hard categories.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 针对稀疏监督这一实际挑战，创新性地结合密度融合与困难实例挖掘，对低成本标注场景有重要参考价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与困难实例增强的稀疏监督3D检测框架。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 首次在稀疏监督3D检测中引入密度互补特征融合以强化困难实例。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在KITTI上困难类别AP显著提升。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: ①针对3D检测中几何信息利用不足、特征判别力弱的问题。②提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散特征（diffusion features）增强点云表示，通过扩散模型生成多尺度几何特征。③相比传统手工特征或纯编码器方法，扩散特征能捕获更丰富的局部几何结构，提升对形状变化的鲁棒性。④在多个基准（如ScanNet、SUN RGB-D）上达到SOTA精度，尤其对复杂场景有显著提升。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient geometric information in 3D detection by introducing geometry-aware diffusion features. It leverages diffusion models to generate multi-scale geometric representations, improving shape robustness over handcrafted or encoder-only features. Achieves SOTA on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D, especially in complex scenes.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型引入3D检测特征学习，思路新颖且实验充分，为几何特征提取提供新范式。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出几何感知扩散特征用于3D目标检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 利用扩散模型生成多尺度几何特征，增强局部结构表达。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上达到SOTA。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差大的问题。②提出MonoCD，通过互补深度模块融合多个深度估计分支（如分类与回归），并设计一致性约束。③相比现有单目方法，利用深度互补性减少歧义，提升深度预测精度。④在KITTI单目3D检测基准上，AP和深度误差指标均有改善，尤其对中等难度目标。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses depth inaccuracy in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depth modules that fuse classification and regression branches under consistency constraints. It reduces depth ambiguity and improves localization. On KITTI, it achieves better AP and depth error, especially for moderate objects.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 方法实用，深度互补思路清晰，对单目3D检测有增量贡献，但创新性一般。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度融合模块提升单目3D检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 多分支深度互补与一致性约束。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: ①针对远距离3D目标检测中LiDAR点云稀疏、标注成本高的问题。②提出利用2D框监督（无需3D标注）来改进远距离检测，通过2D-3D几何约束和跨模态特征对齐训练检测器。③相比纯3D监督方法，显著降低标注成本，同时利用2D密集信息弥补远距离点云稀疏性。④在nuScenes等数据集上，远距离目标的mAP大幅提升，接近全监督性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper tackles distant 3D detection with sparse LiDAR and high annotation cost by using 2D box supervision. It applies 2D-3D geometric constraints and cross-modal alignment to train detectors without 3D labels. On nuScenes, it substantially improves mAP for distant objects, approaching fully supervised performance.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 针对远距离检测与标注成本痛点，方法实用且效果显著，对自动驾驶落地有高价值。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出仅用2D框监督改进远距离3D检测的框架。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 2D-3D几何约束与跨模态对齐实现弱监督远距离检测。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 远距离目标mAP大幅提升，接近全监督。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: ①针对多模态3D检测中相机与LiDAR特征融合不充分、实例级信息丢失的问题。②提出IS-Fusion，通过实例-场景协同融合模块，在实例级别和场景级别同时融合图像与点云特征，并设计跨模态注意力机制。③相比现有融合方法（如点级或体素级），首次显式建模实例级交互，提升对遮挡和稀疏区域的感知。④在KITTI和nuScenes上达到SOTA，尤其在困难类别和远距离目标上优势明显。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient camera-LiDAR fusion in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion, which collaboratively fuses instance-level and scene-level features with cross-modal attention. Unlike point- or voxel-level methods, it explicitly models instance interactions. Achieves SOTA on KITTI and nuScenes, especially for hard and distant objects.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 融合思路全面且创新性强，实例-场景协同设计显著提升多模态感知性能，是该领域重要进展。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 实例级与场景级跨模态注意力协同融合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: ①针对跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应中伪标签噪声大的问题。②提出Pseudo Label Refinery，通过迭代精炼伪标签，结合置信度校准和一致性过滤，减少域偏移影响。③相比现有域适应方法，更系统地处理伪标签质量，提升目标域训练稳定性。④在多个跨数据集基准（如KITTI→Waymo）上，mAP显著提升，接近有监督性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy pseudo-labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D detection. It proposes a pseudo-label refinery with iterative refinement, confidence calibration, and consistency filtering to mitigate domain shift. On benchmarks like KITTI→Waymo, it significantly improves mAP, approaching supervised performance.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 针对域适应中伪标签质量这一关键问题，方法系统且有效，对实际部署有重要价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼框架提升跨数据集3D检测域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 迭代精炼与置信度校准结合减少伪标签噪声。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D目标检测中特征提取效率低、感受野受限的问题。②提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络，通过设计稀疏卷积模块和特征融合策略来增强稀疏点云的特征表达。③相比现有全稀疏方法，在保持稀疏性的同时提升了检测精度和速度。④在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上取得了领先的检测性能，验证了其有效性。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and limited receptive field in fully sparse 3D object detection. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective network with sparse convolution modules and feature fusion to enhance feature representation. Compared to existing fully sparse methods, it improves detection accuracy and speed, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该论文为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁高效的解决方案，对自动驾驶感知中的实时处理有重要参考价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，平衡了精度与效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 设计了针对稀疏点云的高效特征提取与融合机制。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的检测性能。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: ①针对3D目标检测模型部署时计算量大、内存占用高的问题。②提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知的知识蒸馏和剪枝，在保持精度的同时压缩模型。③通过类别级蒸馏损失和结构化剪枝策略，有效传递教师模型的知识并移除冗余参数。④在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，压缩后的模型在精度损失极小的情况下显著降低了计算量。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This work tackles the high computational cost and memory footprint of 3D object detection models. It proposes CaKDP, a framework combining category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning to compress models while preserving accuracy. Using category-level distillation losses and structured pruning, it effectively transfers knowledge and removes redundancy, achieving significant computation reduction with minimal accuracy loss on KITTI and nuScenes.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该框架为3D检测模型的轻量化提供了实用方案，对自动驾驶边缘部署有直接帮助。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，实现高效模型压缩。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 将类别信息融入蒸馏和剪枝过程，提升压缩后模型的性能保持。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上实现高压缩比且精度损失极小。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: ①针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签噪声大、训练不稳定的问题。②提出解耦伪标签方法，分别处理分类和回归任务的伪标签生成，减少噪声传播。③通过独立优化分类和回归的置信度阈值，提高了伪标签质量。④在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，使用少量标注数据时显著提升了检测精度，优于现有半监督方法。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the noisy pseudo-labels and unstable training in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method that separately handles classification and regression tasks to reduce noise propagation. By independently optimizing confidence thresholds, it improves pseudo-label quality, achieving significant accuracy gains over existing methods on KITTI and nuScenes with limited labeled data.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该研究为半监督单目3D检测提供了稳健的伪标签策略，对降低标注成本有重要意义。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了解耦伪标签框架，提升半监督单目3D检测的精度和稳定性。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将分类和回归伪标签生成解耦，独立优化阈值。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上以少量标注数据取得显著性能提升。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督3D目标检测中依赖大量人工标注、泛化能力差的问题。②提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督学习，通过提示引导网络关注关键区域。③相比传统弱监督方法，引入提示机制增强了特征学习，减少了对精确标注的依赖。④在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，在低标注比例下仍能保持较好的检测性能。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance on manual annotations and poor generalization in weakly-supervised 3D object detection. It proposes Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to guide the network to focus on key regions, enhancing feature learning. Compared to traditional methods, it reduces annotation dependence and improves performance under low annotation ratios across multiple datasets.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该论文探索了提示机制在弱监督3D检测中的应用，思路新颖，但实验充分度一般。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出了基于随机提示的弱监督3D检测框架Prompt3D。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将提示学习引入弱监督3D检测，提升特征学习效率。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在低标注比例下保持较好的检测性能。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题。②提出RaCFormer，基于查询的框架，自适应采样实例相关的BEV和原始图像特征，并优化查询初始化（极坐标自适应圆分布）和增强BEV表示（雷达引导深度头、利用多普勒效应的隐式动态捕捉器）。③相比朴素BEV融合，通过查询机制避免了对齐误差，并利用雷达物理特性提升时序建模。④在nuScenes上进行了大量实验，显著提升了3D检测精度（摘要未给出具体数值，但声称有效）。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate depth estimation in image-to-BEV transformation. It proposes RaCFormer, a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views, with improved query initialization via polar-coordinate circular distribution and enhanced BEV representation using a radar-guided depth head and Doppler-based dynamic catcher. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate significant accuracy improvements.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作针对雷达-相机融合的核心痛点提出创新性查询机制，结合雷达物理特性，具有较高实用价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出查询式雷达-相机融合框架，有效缓解BEV变换中的特征错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 利用极坐标自适应查询初始化和雷达多普勒效应增强时序建模。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升3D检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_cn: ①针对车联网（V2X）场景下LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测问题。②提出基于去噪扩散的协同融合方法，利用扩散模型生成或增强特征表示，以处理异构传感器数据。③相比传统融合方法，扩散模型能更好地建模数据分布和不确定性。④摘要不完整，未提供具体实验数据，但方法具有新颖性。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper tackles cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion for 3D detection in V2X scenarios. It proposes a denoising diffusion-based fusion method to generate or enhance features, handling heterogeneous sensor data. The approach leverages diffusion models to model data distribution and uncertainty, offering a novel alternative to conventional fusion. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 扩散模型在传感器融合中的应用具有创新性，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证效果。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 首次将去噪扩散应用于V2X LiDAR-4D雷达协同融合。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 利用扩散模型处理异构传感器数据的不确定性。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.result: 未提供具体数据，但方法新颖。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: ①针对室内3D检测数据集规模小、标注精度低、物体多样性不足的问题。②引入CA-1M数据集，包含40万+3D物体标注和3500+手持捕获，并提出CuTR，一种纯Transformer检测器，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框。③相比基于点的方法，CuTR无需3D归纳偏置，但通过大规模数据训练达到更优性能，且对噪声深度鲁棒。④在CA-1M上，CuTR的3D召回率超过62%，并支持仅RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and diversity. It introduces CA-1M with over 400K annotated objects and 3.5K captures, and proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline predicting 3D boxes from 2D features. CuTR outperforms point-based methods with 62% recall, showing robustness to noisy depth and promising RGB-only performance.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 大规模数据集和纯Transformer架构为室内检测提供了新基准，具有重要数据贡献。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出纯Transformer检测器CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 无需3D归纳偏置，直接从2D特征预测3D框。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: ①针对全稀疏3D检测中特征提取和计算效率问题。②提出FSHNet，一种全稀疏混合网络，结合稀疏卷积和Transformer的优势。③相比传统密集或半稀疏方法，全稀疏设计降低计算量并保持高精度。④摘要不完整，未提供具体实验数据。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency and feature extraction in fully sparse 3D detection. It proposes FSHNet, a hybrid network combining sparse convolution and Transformer. The fully sparse design reduces computation while maintaining accuracy. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 全稀疏混合架构具有效率优势，但摘要信息有限，需关注具体性能。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.contribution: 提出全稀疏混合网络用于3D检测。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.innovation: 结合稀疏卷积和Transformer实现高效全稀疏处理。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for._arxiv_id: FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for 3D Object Detection.

MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中知识蒸馏的挑战，特别是教师-学生差距问题。②提出MonoTAKD，引入助教模型进行渐进式蒸馏。③相比直接蒸馏，助教机制缓解了能力差距，提升蒸馏效率。④摘要不完整，未提供具体实验数据。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in knowledge distillation for monocular 3D detection, particularly the teacher-student gap. It proposes MonoTAKD with a teaching assistant model for progressive distillation. This approach mitigates capability mismatch and improves distillation effectiveness. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.assessment: 助教蒸馏机制在单目3D检测中具有潜力，但需更多实验验证。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.contribution: 提出助教知识蒸馏方法用于单目3D检测。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.innovation: 通过助教模型渐进式蒸馏缩小师生差距。
MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D._arxiv_id: MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达点云分布复杂（内外表面反射）导致融合困难的问题。②提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达命中分布，利用单目检测器预测分布作为核，匹配实际雷达点，并融合上下文精炼。③相比黑盒融合，显式分布模型提高了可解释性和匹配精度。④在nuScenes上达到最先进的雷达-相机检测性能。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complex radar hit distribution in radar-camera fusion. It proposes RICCARDO, which explicitly predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties, uses them as kernels to match actual radar points, and refines with context. This explicit modeling improves interpretability and accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式雷达分布建模创新性强，且性能领先，具有重要参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出基于雷达命中分布预测的融合方法，提升检测精度。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 利用预测分布作为核进行点匹配，替代黑盒融合。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法过度依赖全局几何特征（如笛卡尔坐标），导致模型偏向位置信息而忽视局部结构。本文提出GBlobs，通过高斯斑块显式编码点云邻域局部结构，无需额外参数即可集成到现有检测器中。在多个单源域泛化基准上，GBlobs显著超越SOTA，如Waymo->KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI->Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes->KITTI提升12 mAP，且不牺牲域内性能。多源域泛化也分别提升17、12和5 mAP，证明了局部结构先验的有效性。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors by proposing GBlobs, which encode explicit local point cloud structure via Gaussian blobs, overcoming the over-reliance on global geometric features. Integrating GBlobs into existing detectors yields SOTA improvements of over 21 mAP on Waymo->KITTI, 13 mAP on KITTI->Waymo, and 12 mAP on nuScenes->KITTI without sacrificing in-domain performance, also excelling in multi-source DG.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作为3D检测域泛化提供了新视角，通过局部结构编码实现高效且显著的性能提升，值得关注。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种无需额外参数的局部结构编码方法，显著提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 利用高斯斑块显式建模点云邻域局部结构，替代全局几何特征作为输入。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个跨域基准上超越SOTA，最高提升21 mAP。

Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中标注成本高的问题，本文探索利用时间线索进行半监督学习。方法可能通过跨帧一致性或伪标签传播来利用未标注数据，但摘要缺失，具体细节不明。相比纯监督方法，半监督策略有望降低标注需求并提升性能。效果未在摘要中给出，需查阅全文。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in multi-view 3D detection by leveraging temporal cues for semi-supervised learning, likely using cross-frame consistency or pseudo-label propagation. The approach aims to reduce labeling requirements while improving performance, though specific results are unavailable in the abstract.
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.assessment: 半监督多视角3D检测具有实际应用价值，但摘要信息不足，需进一步评估。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.contribution: 探索时间线索在半监督多视角3D检测中的应用。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv.innovation: 利用时间一致性增强未标注数据的利用效率。
Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Superv._arxiv_id: Leveraging Temporal Cues for Semi-Supervised Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影因深度误差导致2D框高度无法准确表示投影中心高度的问题，本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并系统解释几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代。同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并初始化查询，避免3D检测干扰。该方法在KITTI等基准上可能取得SOTA性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: MonoDGP addresses depth errors in monocular 3D detection by introducing perspective-invariant geometry errors to refine the projection formula, offering a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction. It decouples the depth-guided decoder and uses a 2D decoder for priors, potentially achieving SOTA on benchmarks like KITTI, though specific results are not in the abstract.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测的几何建模有深入分析，创新性强，值得关注。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何误差修正的单目3D检测方法，并解耦2D/3D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 利用透视不变几何误差替代多深度预测，简化深度估计。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D检测中主动学习未探索的问题，本文提出首个面向室内场景的主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则选择最有价值的未标注样本。不确定性准则同时考虑误检和漏检，多样性准则通过类感知自适应原型库（CAP）联合优化类别和场景多样性。该方法有效应对室内数据样本少、类别多、类别不平衡等挑战，但摘要未给出具体性能提升数据。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first active learning framework for indoor 3D detection, combining uncertainty and diversity criteria to select informative samples, with a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype bank for joint optimization of class and scene diversity. It addresses indoor-specific challenges like class imbalance, though specific performance gains are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，方法设计全面，具有应用潜力。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 首次提出针对室内3D检测的主动学习框架，整合不确定性和多样性。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 引入类感知自适应原型库以优化样本多样性。

CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中的特征融合问题，本文提出CorrBEV，通过相关学习与多模态原型增强BEV表示。方法可能利用跨视角相关性或原型匹配来提升检测精度，但摘要缺失，具体机制不明。相比传统BEV方法，多模态原型可能提供更丰富的语义信息。效果未在摘要中给出。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.summary_en: CorrBEV enhances multi-view 3D detection by correlation learning with multi-modal prototypes, potentially improving BEV representations, though details are unavailable in the abstract. The approach may leverage cross-view correlations for better feature fusion.
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.assessment: 多模态原型在BEV检测中有创新潜力，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于相关学习和多模态原型的BEV增强方法。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用多模态原型进行相关学习以提升特征表达。
CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: CorrBEV: Multi-View 3D Object Detection by Correlation Learning with Multi-modal Prototypes.

ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_cn: 针对3D检测效率问题，本文提出ViKIENet，通过虚拟关键实例增强网络实现高效检测。方法可能通过关键点或实例级特征增强来提升性能，但摘要缺失，具体设计不明。相比现有方法，可能更注重计算效率与精度平衡。效果未在摘要中给出。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.summary_en: ViKIENet aims for efficient 3D detection via virtual key instance enhancement, likely improving feature representation while maintaining efficiency, though details are unavailable in the abstract. The approach may focus on balancing accuracy and computational cost.
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.assessment: 效率优化是3D检测的重要方向，但摘要信息不足，需查阅全文。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.contribution: 提出虚拟关键实例增强网络以提升3D检测效率。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De.innovation: 利用虚拟关键实例进行特征增强。
ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object De._arxiv_id: ViKIENet: Towards Efficient 3D Object Detection with Virtual Key Instance Enhanced Network.

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测在标注极度稀缺时性能下降的问题，提出SP3D方法，利用大型多模态模型（LMMs）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。具体包括：边界约束中心聚类选择的置信点语义转移（CPST）模块生成精确语义提示，动态聚类伪标签生成（DCPG）模块基于多尺度邻域点几何形状生成伪监督信号，以及分布形状分数（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上的实验验证了该方法在稀疏标注下能有效提升检测性能，接近全监督方法。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: To address performance degradation in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection under extremely scarce annotations, this paper proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from large multimodal models (LMMs) to boost feature discrimination. It introduces a Confident Points Semantic Transfer (CPST) module for accurate prompt generation, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation (DCPG) module for pseudo-supervision, and a Distribution Shape score for quality selection. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo datasets demonstrate improved detection performance under sparse supervision, approaching fully-supervised levels.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将LMMs引入稀疏监督3D检测，通过语义提示弥补标注不足，具有较高实用价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D目标检测的新框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 结合LMMs生成语义提示和动态聚类伪标签生成策略。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上验证了稀疏监督下检测性能的显著提升。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中类别信息利用不足的问题，提出学习类原型的方法，通过统一框架整合类别原型学习，以提升检测器在少量标注下的泛化能力。方法可能涉及原型聚类和特征对齐，但摘要缺失，具体细节不详。预期在标准数据集上能改善稀疏监督检测性能。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of class information in sparsely-supervised 3D object detection by learning class prototypes within a unified framework. The approach likely integrates prototype clustering and feature alignment to enhance generalization under limited annotations, though details are unavailable due to missing abstract. Expected improvements on standard benchmarks for sparse-supervised detection.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题与稀疏监督3D检测相关，具有一定参考价值。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出基于类原型的统一稀疏监督3D检测方法。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 将类原型学习融入稀疏监督框架。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.result: 预期提升稀疏标注下的检测性能，但具体数据未提供。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp._arxiv_id: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中掩码自编码器（MAE）因大面积空区域导致占用信息泄露和高计算复杂度的问题，提出多尺度邻域占用MAE（NOMAE）。该方法仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建，并采用分层掩码生成技术实现多尺度特征捕获，以适应不同尺寸物体。NOMAE可直接用于现有3D架构的SSL预训练，在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上对语义分割和3D检测任务进行了广泛评估，优于判别式和生成式SSL方法。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy leakage and high computational cost in MAE for LiDAR point clouds, this paper proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in neighborhoods of non-masked voxels and uses hierarchical mask generation for multi-scale feature capture. It is flexible for SSL in existing 3D architectures and outperforms discriminative and generative SSL methods on nuScenes and Waymo for semantic segmentation and 3D detection.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决了LiDAR MAE的关键瓶颈，具有强实用性和性能优势。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出多尺度邻域占用MAE，实现高效LiDAR点云自监督学习。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 邻域占用重建和分层掩码生成技术。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在多个数据集和任务上超越现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习（SSL）方法忽略物体姿态和尺度等几何信息的问题，提出PSA-SSL，通过自监督边界框回归预文本任务保留姿态和尺寸信息，并引入LiDAR波束模式增强以学习传感器无关特征。在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，使用单一预训练模型，在有限标注下显著提升了3D语义分割性能，并优于其他SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the neglect of geometric information like pose and scale in 3D point cloud SSL, this paper proposes PSA-SSL, which introduces a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task and LiDAR beam pattern augmentation for sensor-agnostic features. It achieves significant improvements in 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI, outperforming other SSL methods.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 该论文针对SSL中几何信息缺失问题提出有效方案，跨数据集泛化性强。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的SSL方法，增强3D点云特征学习。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 自监督边界框回归和波束模式增强。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上显著提升语义分割性能。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩（LPCC）任务中实时压缩难以实现的问题，提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器，采用轻量级模型实现高性能。RENO跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码以一次性推断体素占用，节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在14位深度下达到10fps的实时编码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To achieve real-time compression for LiDAR point clouds, this paper proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec, using a lightweight model with sparse occupancy codes for one-shot voxel occupancy inference. It achieves 10fps at 14-bit depth, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, respectively, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 该论文在实时性和压缩效率上取得突破，对自动驾驶数据存储和传输有实际意义。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时LiDAR点云神经压缩编解码器。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 稀疏占用码和跳过八叉树构建的设计。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现实时编码速度和显著比特率节省。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机-based 3D占用预测中低分辨率体素查询导致信息丢失的问题，提出ProtoOcc，利用聚类图像段原型在视图变换中增强低分辨率上下文。通过将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高层视觉几何并补充空间信息，同时设计多视角解码策略解耦压缩视觉线索。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上验证了有效性，优于基线方法，并达到竞争性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from low-resolution voxel queries in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes ProtoOcc, which leverages prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance context. It maps 2D prototypes to 3D queries and uses multi-perspective decoding, showing clear improvements over baselines on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI benchmarks.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测中的分辨率瓶颈提出创新方案，与用户研究高度相关。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出基于原型感知视图变换的低分辨率3D占用预测网络。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 利用2D原型编码几何信息以补偿低分辨率损失。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于基线，实现竞争性能。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏视角图像进行3D场景重建时，现有方法依赖中间3D表示（如神经场、体素或3D高斯）导致计算复杂且难以直接生成新视图的问题，本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，可直接从任意数量的输入视图生成新视角的图像和深度图。方法采用raymap条件化增强视觉特征的空间信息，并通过可学习的任务嵌入实现图像和深度图的多任务生成。在超过6000万多样本上训练，并提出增量微调策略以高效训练更大模型。实验表明该方法在新视图合成和深度估计上优于现有方法，并展现出良好的扩展性。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of 3D scene reconstruction from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations that are computationally heavy. MVGD proposes a diffusion-based architecture for direct pixel-level generation of novel view images and depth maps, using raymap conditioning and multi-task learning. Trained on over 60 million samples, it demonstrates superior performance and promising scaling behavior.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该论文将扩散模型直接应用于多视图几何生成，避免了中间表示的开销，对3D重建和自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值，但相关性略低于核心感知任务。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于扩散的零样本新视图与深度合成方法，无需中间3D表示。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用raymap条件化和任务嵌入实现图像与深度图的多任务联合生成。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，并展示了良好的模型扩展性。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对从稀疏多视图图像合成未见人体的新视图时，现有方法在视角重叠少和复杂几何重建上效果不佳的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，一种无需逐主体优化的鲁棒泛化人体高斯泼溅方法。核心思想是利用SMPL顶点生成密集可靠的3D先验点，并基于这些点回归人体高斯参数；同时结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的先验点，并通过渲染深度图增强高频细节。在多个基准数据集上，该方法在新视图合成和跨数据集泛化上优于现有最先进方法。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of novel view synthesis for unseen humans from sparse multi-view images, where existing methods struggle with limited overlap and complex geometry. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D priors and regresses Gaussian parameters, using pixel and voxel features for alignment and depth rendering for detail. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 该方法在人体重建领域有较强创新性，但对自动驾驶感知的相关性较低，主要面向图形学应用。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于SMPL先验的鲁棒泛化人体高斯泼溅方法，无需逐主体优化。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 结合像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并利用深度图增强细节。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法中，现有预训练方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督，效率低且泛化受限的问题，本文提出VisionPAD，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的自监督预训练范式，仅使用图像作为监督。方法引入体素速度估计的自监督学习，通过将体素扭曲到相邻帧并监督渲染输出来学习运动线索；同时采用多帧光度一致性增强几何感知，通过纯图像监督提升3D几何表示。在多个自动驾驶数据集上，该方法在3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割任务上显著优于现有预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and limited generalization of existing pre-training methods for vision-centric autonomous driving, which rely on neural rendering and explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD proposes a self-supervised paradigm using 3D Gaussian Splatting with image-only supervision, incorporating voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency. It significantly improves performance on 3D detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation across datasets.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶感知核心任务，创新性地将3D高斯泼溅用于自监督预训练，实验充分且效果显著，具有很高的实用价值。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的视觉中心自监督预训练范式，仅用图像监督。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 引入体素速度估计和多帧光度一致性，增强运动与几何学习。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占用预测和地图分割上大幅超越现有预训练方法。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中，现有动态高斯泼溅方法依赖昂贵的3D框标注，限制可扩展性的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场中的自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，无需跟踪3D边界框即可学习4D时空表示。方法设计统一框架，将时间相关的4D高斯表示与神经运动流场集成，建模LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动，并分解静态背景和动态物体。通过从2D基础模型蒸馏特征增强动态物体识别，实现准确的动态场景重建和新视图RGB/深度/光流合成。实验表明该方法在动态场景重建和合成上表现优异。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive 3D bounding box annotations in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban scenes. SplatFlow introduces a self-supervised approach within neural motion flow fields, modeling 4D Gaussians without tracked boxes, and decomposing static and dynamic elements. It enhances dynamic object identification via feature distillation from 2D foundation models, achieving accurate reconstruction and synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶动态场景重建提出自监督方案，减少标注依赖，具有较强创新性和应用潜力，但实验细节未完全展示。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出了一种自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，在神经运动流场中学习4D表示，无需3D框标注。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 将4D高斯与神经运动流场统一，并利用2D基础模型特征蒸馏增强动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在动态场景重建和新视图合成上取得了优异效果。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工且效率低的问题。②提出SP-NAS，通过串行到并行的搜索策略，自动搜索目标检测的骨干网络结构。③相比传统NAS方法，该方法考虑了检测任务特性，设计了更高效的搜索空间和搜索算法。④在目标检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search strategy for automatic backbone discovery. It improves upon traditional NAS by tailoring the search space and algorithm for detection tasks. The method achieves competitive performance on detection benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该论文针对检测任务定制NAS，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的串行到并行骨干网络搜索方法。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 设计了检测任务专用的NAS搜索策略。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在检测基准上取得有竞争力性能，但具体数据未给出。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS方法计算资源消耗大、搜索效率低的问题。②提出NAS-FCOS，在无锚检测器FCOS上搜索特征金字塔网络和预测头结构，采用强化学习范式。③通过精心设计的搜索空间、搜索算法和评估策略，显著提升了搜索效率。④在8块V100 GPU上仅用4天完成搜索，发现的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free FCOS detector using reinforcement learning. It enhances search efficiency through carefully designed search space, algorithms, and evaluation strategies. The searched architecture surpasses SOTA detectors like Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points, with search completed in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该论文显著提升了检测NAS的效率，并取得了实质性性能提升，具有较高实用价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出高效搜索目标检测解码器结构的NAS方法。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 将NAS应用于无锚检测器的FPN和预测头搜索。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索架构在AP上超越SOTA模型1.5-3.5点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有NAS方法中块数量和宽度需手动设置，限制网络规模搜索灵活性的问题。②提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，通过路由块构建超级网络，并搜索块间最优路径。③引入链式成本估计算法，在搜索中同时优化精度和模型成本。④在ImageNet上，基于MobileNetV2的搜索空间达到75.3% top-1精度，仅需361MB FLOPs和17.9ms延迟；更大模型达到76.1%精度，仅需479M FLOPs。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS by proposing DenseNAS, which designs a densely connected search space with routing blocks and searches for optimal paths. It introduces a chained cost estimation algorithm to optimize both accuracy and model cost. DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs for a larger model.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该论文通过密集连接搜索空间提升了NAS的灵活性，并在效率和精度上取得平衡，值得关注。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间以搜索网络深度和宽度。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 设计路由块和链式成本估计实现灵活搜索。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①针对权重共享NAS方法是否优于随机搜索的争议问题。②通过TuNAS在多个逐步增大的搜索空间上进行图像分类和检测任务的系统比较，并提出了改进搜索架构质量和减少手动调参的技术。③实验表明，在大型现实任务中，高效搜索方法相比随机搜索有显著优势。④在ImageNet和COCO上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether weight-sharing NAS outperforms random search by conducting thorough comparisons on progressively larger search spaces for image classification and detection. It proposes techniques to improve searched architecture quality and reduce manual tuning. Experiments show substantial gains of efficient search over random search on large realistic tasks, validated on ImageNet and COCO.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该论文为NAS与随机搜索的对比提供了实证，澄清了领域争议，具有方法论价值。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较了权重共享NAS与随机搜索的性能。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 提出改进搜索质量和减少调参的技术。
2008.06120|v2.result: 在大型任务上证明高效搜索优于随机搜索。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: ①针对通用多任务学习中NAS搜索空间任务特定、难以适应不同任务组合的问题。②提出MTL-NAS，将多任务网络解耦为单任务骨干，并设计层级特征共享/融合方案，构建任务无关的搜索空间。③提出单次梯度搜索算法，通过最小熵正则化使架构权重收敛到近离散值，消除搜索与评估的性能差距。④实验表明搜索模型可直接用于评估，无需从头训练，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific search spaces in NAS for general-purpose multi-task learning by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles networks into single-task backbones and designs a task-agnostic search space with hierarchical feature sharing. It introduces a single-shot gradient search with minimum entropy regularization to close the gap between searched and evaluated architectures. The searched model can be directly evaluated without retraining, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NAS扩展到通用多任务学习，解决了搜索空间通用性问题，具有较高研究价值。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的NAS方法用于通用多任务学习。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 设计层级共享搜索空间和单次梯度搜索算法。
2003.14058|v2.result: 搜索模型可直接评估，无需重训练。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: ①针对GAN架构设计依赖人工且生成器与判别器搜索不平衡的问题。②提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构，无需额外评估指标。③搜索算法考虑两网络相关性并改善相互平衡，效率极高。④在CIFAR-10上仅用1 GPU天完成搜索，发现模型FID达10.87，Inception Score达8.74，创SOTA。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses manual GAN architecture design and imbalance in generator-discriminator search by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to search both architectures simultaneously in a differentiable manner without extra metrics. It considers network relevance and improves mutual balance, achieving high efficiency. The searched model sets SOTA FID of 10.87 and Inception Score of 8.74 on CIFAR-10 with only 1 GPU day.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS成功应用于GAN，实现高效联合搜索，创新性强，结果显著。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出可微分联合搜索GAN生成器和判别器架构的方法。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 无需额外指标，考虑网络相关性进行联合搜索。
1912.02037|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上以1 GPU天达到SOTA FID和IS。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出了在NAS搜索过程中引入对抗鲁棒性约束，通过联合优化精度和鲁棒性来搜索架构。③相比传统NAS仅关注精度，该方法将鲁棒性作为搜索目标之一。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下表现更优。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of architectures found by NAS lacking robustness against adversarial attacks. It proposes incorporating adversarial robustness constraints into the NAS search process, jointly optimizing accuracy and robustness. Compared to traditional NAS that only focuses on accuracy, this method includes robustness as a search objective. The abstract does not provide specific data but emphasizes improved robustness of searched architectures.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，具有新颖性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出在NAS中联合优化精度与对抗鲁棒性的搜索框架。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将鲁棒性作为NAS搜索目标之一。
1911.10695|v2.result: 搜索出的架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性提升。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中双层优化近似导致梯度误差和次优解的问题。②提出了混合层级重构（Mixed-Level Reformulation）的NAS方法MiLeNAS，使用简单一阶方法即可高效优化。③相比DARTS等双层优化方法，MiLeNAS避免了二阶近似误差，并引入模型大小搜索和早停策略。④在卷积搜索空间上，MiLeNAS在约5小时内完成搜索，且架构精度一致优于双层优化方法。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of gradient errors and suboptimality caused by second-order approximations in bilevel optimization for NAS. It proposes MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that can be efficiently optimized with simple first-order methods. Compared to bilevel optimization methods like DARTS, MiLeNAS avoids approximation errors and incorporates model size-based search and early stopping. It completes search in about 5 hours and consistently achieves higher accuracies than bilevel optimization.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: MiLeNAS提出了一种更高效可靠的NAS优化框架，对NAS领域有实质贡献。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层级重构的NAS优化方法，避免二阶近似误差。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 混合层级公式化结合一阶优化和早停策略。
2003.12238|v2.result: 5小时内完成搜索，精度优于双层优化方法。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS两阶段参数优化导致搜索与评估性能相关性差的问题。②提出了DSNAS，一个端到端可微NAS框架，通过低偏置蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，无需参数重训练。③相比两阶段方法，DSNAS直接解决任务特定端到端问题，减少总计算消耗。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，仅需420 GPU小时，比两阶段方法减少34%以上时间。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correlation between search and evaluation performance in two-stage NAS methods. It proposes DSNAS, an end-to-end differentiable NAS framework that simultaneously optimizes architecture and parameters using a low-biased Monte Carlo estimate, eliminating the need for parameter retraining. Compared to two-stage methods, DSNAS directly solves the task-specific end-to-end problem and reduces total computation. It achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing time by over 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: DSNAS提出了端到端NAS的新范式，显著提升效率，对实际应用有价值。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出无需参数重训练的端到端可微NAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 低偏置蒙特卡洛估计实现架构和参数联合优化。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大且难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出了AutoNL，包含轻量级Non-Local（LightNL）块和端到端NAS算法，自动学习NL块的最优配置。③LightNL块通过压缩变换和紧凑特征，计算成本比传统NL块降低400倍而不损失性能。④在ImageNet上，AutoNL在350M FLOPs的移动设置下达到77.7% top-1精度，仅需32 GPU小时搜索。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation cost of Non-Local (NL) blocks and the difficulty of embedding them in mobile networks. It proposes AutoNL, consisting of a Lightweight Non-Local (LightNL) block and an end-to-end NAS algorithm to learn optimal configurations. The LightNL block is 400x computationally cheaper than conventional NL blocks without sacrificing performance. On ImageNet, AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy under a mobile setting (350M FLOPs) with only 32 GPU hours of search.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: AutoNL有效解决了NL块在移动端的应用问题，兼具高效性和性能，值得关注。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级NL块和自动配置搜索方法。
2004.01961|v2.result: ImageNet 77.7%精度，搜索仅需32 GPU小时。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索过程中监督信号不足导致架构泛化性差的问题。②提出了块级监督的NAS方法，结合知识蒸馏，在搜索过程中对每个块提供监督信号。③相比传统NAS仅使用最终验证损失，该方法通过块级蒸馏增强训练稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调提升搜索架构的泛化能力。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient supervision during NAS search, leading to poor generalization of discovered architectures. It proposes a block-wise supervised NAS method with knowledge distillation, providing supervision signals for each block during search. Compared to traditional NAS using only final validation loss, this method enhances training stability via block-level distillation. The abstract does not provide specific data but emphasizes improved generalization.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 该论文结合知识蒸馏与块级监督，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出块级监督和知识蒸馏结合的NAS方法。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 在搜索过程中对每个块进行监督。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 提升搜索架构的泛化能力。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索阶段验证精度高但最终评估性能差的问题。②提出了SGAS（Sequential Greedy Architecture Search），将搜索过程分解为子问题，通过贪心策略选择和剪枝候选操作。③相比传统NAS，SGAS通过逐步贪心选择减少搜索空间，提高泛化性。④在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质互作图节点分类等任务上，SGAS以最小计算成本找到最先进架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of architectures with high validation accuracy during search performing worse in final evaluation. It proposes SGAS (Sequential Greedy Architecture Search), which divides the search into sub-problems and greedily selects and prunes candidate operations. Compared to traditional NAS, SGAS reduces search space and improves generalization. It finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: SGAS通过贪心策略有效缓解搜索与评估不一致问题，方法简洁高效，适用性广。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出顺序贪心架构搜索方法，提升泛化性。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索分解为子问题并贪心剪枝。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在多个任务上以最小成本达到最先进性能。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度权衡依赖人工经验的问题。②提出了图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间，通过细胞独立方式实现细胞级多样性，并集成图卷积网络（GCN）作为细胞间通信机制，同时加入延迟导向约束。③相比以往工作，GAS消除了细胞共享约束，实现了更有效的轻量模型探索。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS取得了精度与速度的新最优权衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the empirical trade-off between performance and speed in designing lightweight semantic segmentation networks. It proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) with a novel search space, cell-independent diversity, and GCN-based communication, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 该方法在实时语义分割NAS领域具有创新性，实验充分，值得关注。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出了图引导的架构搜索方法，实现实时语义分割网络的自动设计。

1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新最优权衡。
