2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法忽略训练计算成本、而训练前剪枝性能下降的问题，提出一种在训练早期进行结构剪枝的策略。②方法先进行少量epoch的密集训练以快速指导架构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入早期剪枝指标（EPI）基于子网络架构相似性触发剪枝。③相比初始化剪枝，该方法在保持性能的同时显著减少训练计算；相比后训练剪枝，更早实现剪枝。④在ImageNet上的实验表明，EPI能快速识别适合剪枝的早期训练epoch，在降低训练成本的同时保持精度。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning's high training cost and pruning-at-initialization's performance degradation by proposing a policy to prune early during training. It uses dense training for few epochs, evaluates dominant sub-networks via neuron importance, and introduces an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) based on architectural similarity to trigger pruning. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI effectively identifies suitable early epochs, reducing training cost without sacrificing accuracy.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 该论文为网络剪枝领域提供了新视角，即平衡训练效率和模型性能，对资源受限场景有实际意义。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于架构稳定性的早期剪枝策略，显著降低训练计算成本。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 引入EPI指标动态判断剪枝时机，而非固定于初始化或训练后。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了早期剪枝的可行性，保持精度同时减少训练开销。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对非结构化剪枝在训练前或训练中应用时，因固定子空间约束导致强偏差的问题，提出交空间剪枝（IP）方法。②IP使用自适应滤波器基的线性组合表示滤波器，将基系数置零，同时联合训练未剪枝系数和基。③相比标准剪枝（SP），IP提供了更灵活的表示空间，数学上证明了其优越性，并在多种剪枝方法上表现更好。④在ImageNet和高稀疏度场景下，IP在相同运行时和参数成本下显著优于SP，归因于改进的可训练性和泛化能力。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bias induced by standard unstructured pruning's fixed subspace by introducing interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters via adaptive filter bases and prunes coefficients. IP improves existing pruning methods with mathematical evidence and outperforms standard pruning across state-of-the-art methods, especially in challenging settings like ImageNet and high sparsity, with equal runtime and parameter costs.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种通用剪枝工具，增强了稀疏CNN的训练灵活性，对高稀疏度场景有重要价值。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出交空间剪枝框架，通过自适应滤波器基提升稀疏CNN的训练性能。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 动态滤波器表示空间替代固定子空间，减少剪枝偏差。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在多个数据集和剪枝方法上超越标准剪枝，尤其在ImageNet和高稀疏度下。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: ①针对木马攻击检测问题，在无干净训练数据条件下，利用稀疏性发现攻击触发器的创新方法。②观察到木马特征对网络剪枝比良性特征更稳定，据此提出检测框架：先定位保留木马信息但干净输入性能仅随机的“中奖木马彩票”，再恢复嵌入的触发器。③相比现有检测方法，无需干净数据，利用剪枝特性隔离木马特征。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上验证了有效性，成功检测并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses Trojan attack detection without clean data by leveraging sparsity, observing that Trojan features are more stable to pruning than benign ones. It proposes locating a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' that preserves Trojan info but chance-level clean performance, then recovering the trigger. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet demonstrate effective detection and trigger recovery.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合剪枝和木马检测，为安全领域提供了新思路，具有较高研究价值。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于剪枝稳定性的木马检测方法，无需干净训练数据。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 利用木马特征对剪枝的稳定性差异来隔离和恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在多个数据集上成功检测木马网络并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: ①针对图像恢复任务中N:M结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度和性能需求的问题，提出逐层确定剪枝比例的方法。②方法根据每层特性优化N:M稀疏度，平衡效率和恢复精度。③相比固定N:M剪枝，更灵活地适应网络结构。④在超分辨率和去模糊任务上显著优于现有剪枝方法，代码已开源。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of N:M structured pruning in image restoration by proposing layer-wise pruning ratio determination. It optimizes sparsity per layer to balance efficiency and accuracy. Experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 该论文针对特定任务优化剪枝策略，实用性强，但领域相关性一般。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出逐层N:M剪枝比例优化方法，提升图像恢复效率。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 根据层复杂度动态调整剪枝比例，而非统一设置。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上超越现有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D目标检测中稀疏占用带来的挑战，提出稀疏窗口Transformer（SWFormer）。②方法将点云转换为稀疏体素和窗口，利用分桶方案高效处理变长窗口，并引入跨窗口注意力、多尺度融合和窗口移位，以及体素扩散技术。③相比现有Transformer方法，充分利用点云稀疏性，提升效率和准确性。④在Waymo开放数据集上达到73.36 L2 mAPH（车辆和行人），超越所有单阶段和双阶段模型，且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer) for 3D object detection, addressing point cloud sparsity via sparse voxels/windows and efficient bucketing. It captures cross-window correlation with multi-scale fusion and shifting, plus voxel diffusion. On Waymo, it achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH, outperforming prior models with better efficiency.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D检测领域达到SOTA，对自动驾驶感知有直接贡献，高度相关。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出稀疏窗口Transformer，高效处理点云稀疏性并提升检测精度。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 结合窗口注意力、分桶方案和体素扩散技术。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上取得73.36 L2 mAPH的SOTA性能。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多实例点云配准中，一个实例的内点对应关系对其他实例构成外点的问题，提出对比学习框架PointCLM。②方法利用对比学习学习良好分布的深度表示，基于此提出外点剪枝和聚类策略，高效移除外点并分配对应关系到正确实例。③相比依赖假设采样或空间一致性的方法，更高效且性能更优。④在合成和真实数据集上大幅超越现有方法。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration by proposing PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework. It learns well-distributed representations, then uses outlier pruning and clustering to assign correspondences. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real datasets by a large margin.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 该论文在多实例配准上创新性强，与3D感知相关，但非核心检测任务。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出对比学习框架解决多实例配准中的外点干扰问题。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习表示和聚类策略替代传统假设采样。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模点云压缩中熵编码未能充分利用点云结构依赖和几何先验的问题。②提出了一种基于八叉树的多级压缩框架，设计了利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先和邻居上下文的新熵模型，并引入体素几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面作为几何先验。③相比现有方法，通过更丰富的上下文和几何先验实现了更紧凑的比特流编码，并在解码时采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。④在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上，比特率分别降低了11-16%和12-14%，优于现有基线。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses large-scale point cloud compression by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework with a novel entropy model that leverages sibling, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, along with voxel-based quadratic surface priors. It achieves 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景中的点云压缩问题，提出了高效且有效的熵编码方法，对降低存储和传输成本具有重要意义。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合多级上下文和几何先验的八叉树点云压缩框架，显著提升了压缩效率。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 创新性地将兄弟节点上下文和局部二次曲面拟合先验引入熵模型，增强了点云结构建模能力。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上实现了11-16%和12-14%的比特率降低。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大，难以扩展到高分辨率和多视图的问题。②提出了Token剪枝姿态Transformer（PPT），通过定位粗略人体掩膜并仅对选定token进行自注意力计算，同时扩展至多视图，提出人体区域融合策略。③相比现有姿态Transformer，大幅降低了计算量，同时保持精度。④在COCO和MPII上匹配先前方法的精度，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上实现多视图融合并达到新SOTA。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for human pose estimation by proposing token-pruned pose transformer (PPT), which performs self-attention only on selected tokens within a rough human mask, and extends to multi-view with human area fusion. It matches prior accuracy on COCO/MPII while reducing computation, and achieves SOTA on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该论文通过token剪枝有效解决了Transformer在姿态估计中的效率瓶颈，对多视图场景具有实用价值。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出了token剪枝的Transformer框架，显著降低姿态估计的计算复杂度。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合人体掩膜定位和token剪枝，以及多视图人体区域融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，同时减少计算量。

Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中点云压缩效率不足的问题。②提出了基于距离图像（Range Image）的熵模型，利用距离图像的规则结构进行高效编码。③相比传统点云压缩方法，利用距离图像特性提升了压缩性能。④摘要不完整，但预期在自动驾驶数据集上展示改进。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud compression for autonomous driving by proposing a range image-based entropy model, leveraging the structured nature of range images for efficient encoding, aiming to improve compression performance over traditional methods.
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.assessment: 该论文聚焦于自动驾驶点云压缩，但摘要信息不完整，需进一步查看全文评估。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.contribution: 提出基于距离图像的熵模型用于点云压缩。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.innovation: 利用距离图像规则结构简化熵编码。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image._arxiv_id: Point Cloud Compression with Range Image-Based Entropy Model for Autonomous Driving.

SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer推理速度慢的问题。②提出了延迟感知的软token剪枝方法SPViT，通过考虑硬件延迟来剪枝冗余token。③相比现有剪枝方法，更注重实际延迟优化。④摘要不完整，但预期在ImageNet等数据集上实现加速。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of vision transformers by proposing latency-aware soft token pruning (SPViT), which prunes redundant tokens considering hardware latency, aiming to achieve faster inference while maintaining accuracy.
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文关注Transformer效率优化，但摘要信息有限，需进一步评估。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出延迟感知的软token剪枝方法。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.innovation: 将硬件延迟纳入剪枝决策。
SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transformers via Latency-Aware Soft Token Pruning.

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘和稳定性-可塑性困境的问题。②提出了两阶段学习范式FOSTER，首先动态扩展新模块拟合目标与原始模型输出的残差，然后通过蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度以保持单骨干模型。③相比现有方法，更好地平衡了稳定性和可塑性，并降低了计算和存储开销。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上达到SOTA性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by proposing FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm that first expands modules to fit residuals and then compresses via distillation, achieving SOTA on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 while balancing stability and plasticity.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该论文在类增量学习领域提出了有效且高效的方法，具有较强实用价值。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出了基于梯度提升思想的类增量学习两阶段范式。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 创新性地结合动态扩展和蒸馏压缩，解决稳定性-可塑性困境。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中低比特精度严重下降的问题。②提出RepQ-ViT框架，通过量化尺度重参数化解耦量化与推理过程，对LayerNorm后激活使用通道量化、Softmax后激活使用log√2量化，再重参数化为硬件友好的层量化。③相比现有方法，不牺牲量化性能即可满足硬件部署需求。④在低比特场景下显著提升ViT量化精度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy degradation of vision transformers in low-bit post-training quantization. It proposes RepQ-ViT, which decouples quantization and inference via scale reparameterization, applying channel-wise and log√2 quantization to extreme activations, then reparameterizing to hardware-friendly forms. This achieves accurate quantization without sacrificing inference efficiency, improving low-bit accuracy, though specific numbers are not given.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦ViT量化部署，方法有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架，解决低比特精度损失问题。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 量化与推理解耦，结合复杂量化器与简化推理量化器。
2212.08254|v2.result: 低比特ViT量化精度显著提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_cn: ①针对学习型点云压缩中熵模型效率低的问题。②提出高效层次化熵模型，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节。③改进点在于层次化设计提升压缩效率。④效果未在摘要中说明。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of entropy models in learned point cloud compression. It proposes an efficient hierarchical entropy model, but the abstract is empty, so no specific methods or results are available.
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法有效评估，且与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for.contribution: 提出层次化熵模型用于点云压缩。
Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for._arxiv_id: Efficient Hierarchical Entropy Model for Learned Point Cloud Compression.

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer计算复杂度高、难以在延迟敏感应用（如自动驾驶）中部署的问题。②提出SparseViT，利用窗口注意力中激活稀疏性，通过窗口级激活剪枝实现实际加速，并引入稀疏感知适应和进化搜索优化层间剪枝比例。③相比CNN，窗口ViT的批处理特性使剪枝能转化为真实延迟降低。④在单目3D检测等任务上，实现约50%延迟降低（60%稀疏度），相比密集模型加速1.5倍、1.4倍和1.3倍。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers, which limits deployment in latency-sensitive applications like autonomous driving. It proposes SparseViT, which leverages activation sparsity in window-based attention, achieving real speedup via window-level pruning and evolutionary search for optimal layerwise sparsity. It reduces latency by ~50% at 60% sparsity and achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups in monocular 3D detection.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 该论文直接面向高效ViT部署，与自动驾驶3D检测相关，方法实用且有显著加速效果。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出基于激活稀疏性的高效ViT加速方法，实现实际延迟降低。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 窗口级激活剪枝与进化搜索结合。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在3D检测任务上实现1.3-1.5倍加速。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中冗余token剪枝导致信息丢失、性能下降的问题。②提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块（TPS），先剪枝得到保留和剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和相似性融合将剪除token信息压缩到保留token中。③相比仅剪枝方法，减少信息损失。④在ImageNet分类上，将DeiT-tiny和small计算量缩减至35%时，相比基线提升1%-6%准确率。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss caused by token pruning in vision transformers. It proposes a joint Token Pruning & Squeezing module (TPS) that prunes redundant tokens and squeezes their information into reserved tokens via nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusion. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving accuracy by 1%-6% on ImageNet when reducing DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 该论文改进token剪枝策略，提升ViT效率，但与自动驾驶感知相关性一般。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合剪枝与压缩模块，减少token剪枝的信息损失。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 单向最近邻匹配与相似性融合。

Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_cn: ①针对全局ViT剪枝中缺乏有效重要性评估的问题。②提出基于Hessian感知显著性的全局剪枝方法，但摘要为空，无法获取具体细节。③改进点在于利用二阶信息评估重要性。④效果未在摘要中说明。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of effective importance evaluation in global vision transformer pruning. It proposes a Hessian-aware saliency-based global pruning method, but the abstract is empty, so no specific details or results are available.
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.assessment: 摘要缺失，方法细节不明，相关性较低。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.contribution: 提出基于Hessian的ViT全局剪枝方法。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H.innovation: 利用二阶信息进行显著性评估。
Global Vision Transformer Pruning with H._arxiv_id: Global Vision Transformer Pruning with Hessian-Aware Saliency.

2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer在GPU上部署时缺乏高效压缩方案的问题。②提出GPUSQ-ViT，结合GPU友好的2:4结构化稀疏和量化，先进行2:4结构化剪枝，再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练，并采用混合策略知识蒸馏。③充分利用GPU对2:4稀疏和整数计算的加速能力。④实验显示，模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，推理速度提升30.3-62倍。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of efficient compression schemes for vision transformers on GPU hardware. It proposes GPUSQ-ViT, combining GPU-friendly 2:4 structured sparsity and quantization, with pruning followed by sparse-distillation-aware quantization and mixed-strategy knowledge distillation. It reduces model size by 6.4-12.7x and speeds up inference by 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 该论文提供实用的ViT压缩方案，显著提升GPU部署效率，与自动驾驶模型优化相关。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4稀疏和量化的ViT压缩方案。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: GPU友好的稀疏模式与量化结合。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型大小减少6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer模型计算和内存开销大、难以部署在边缘平台的问题，现有剪枝方法缺乏可解释性，忽略了模型内部单元与目标类别之间的关系，导致性能不佳。②提出X-Pruner框架，通过设计可解释性感知掩码，以端到端方式学习每个可剪枝单元对每个目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索层间剪枝阈值以保留最有信息量的单元。③相比现有不可解释的剪枝方法，X-Pruner将剪枝标准与模型可解释性结合，更精准地识别重要单元。④在DeiT和Swin Transformer等代表性模型上进行了综合实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory footprint of vision transformers, which hinder edge deployment, by proposing X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework. It introduces an explainability-aware mask learned end-to-end to measure each unit's contribution to target classes and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds for pruning. Compared to unexplainable methods, X-Pruner improves pruning by leveraging model interpretability, with experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrating its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 该论文将可解释性引入剪枝标准，为Transformer剪枝提供了新视角，对边缘部署有实际意义。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出基于可解释性感知掩码的视觉Transformer剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 创新性地将剪枝标准与模型可解释性结合，通过端到端学习掩码和自适应阈值搜索。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了剪枝性能的提升。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: ①针对半监督语义分割中标签数据稀缺的问题，现有方法未能充分利用无标签数据的密度信息。②提出密度引导的对比学习方法，通过挖掘稀疏性来增强特征表示。③相比现有半监督方法，该方法引入密度信息作为引导，提升对比学习的效率。④实验表明该方法在标准数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of limited labeled data in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning method. It leverages density information to enhance feature representations, improving upon existing semi-supervised approaches. Experiments on standard benchmarks show competitive performance.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 该论文探索了密度信息在半监督分割中的应用，但创新性和实验深度一般。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用密度信息引导对比学习，挖掘数据稀疏性。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在标准数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中旧类样本存储受限的问题，现有方法只能保存少量样本，导致遗忘。②提出通过下采样非判别性像素压缩样本，在有限内存中保存更多压缩样本，并设计自适应掩码生成模型CIM解决CAM阈值选择问题。③相比现有方法，该方法打破了“少样本”限制，提高了样本存储效率。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著提升了类增量学习性能。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited memory for old-class exemplars in class-incremental learning by compressing exemplars via downsampling non-discriminative pixels, enabling storage of more samples. It introduces an adaptive mask generation model (CIM) to handle CAM threshold selection, improving upon existing methods. Extensive experiments show significant performance gains on benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的样本压缩策略，有效缓解了类增量学习中的遗忘问题，具有实用价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于样本压缩的类增量学习方法，突破内存限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 通过下采样非判别性像素和自适应掩码生成实现高效样本压缩。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升了类增量学习性能。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有结构化剪枝方法依赖人工设计分组方案、难以泛化到新架构的问题，提出任意结构化剪枝任务。②提出依赖图（DepGraph）方法，显式建模层间依赖关系，自动分组耦合参数进行剪枝。③相比架构特定剪枝器，该方法完全自动化，适用于CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer等多种架构。④在ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet和Vision Transformer等架构上进行了广泛评估，验证了通用性和有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of structural pruning for arbitrary architectures, where existing methods rely on manual grouping schemes. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph) to explicitly model layer dependencies and automatically group coupled parameters for pruning. This fully automatic method is evaluated on diverse architectures including CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers, demonstrating strong generalization.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了结构化剪枝的通用性问题，方法自动化程度高，对多种架构有效，是该领域的重要进展。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图方法，实现任意架构的自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过显式建模层间依赖关系，实现参数自动分组。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构上验证了剪枝的通用性和有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有通道剪枝方法主要针对2D CNN，难以直接应用于3D点云网络的问题，提出CP3插件。②CP3利用点云和PNN的特性，提出坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样中丢弃的点以增强鲁棒性。③相比直接迁移2D方法，CP3考虑了3D点云和网络架构的差异，提升了剪枝性能。④在多种PNN架构上进行了实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap in channel pruning for 3D point-based networks, where existing 2D CNN methods are not directly applicable. It proposes CP3, a plug-in that introduces a coordinate-enhanced importance metric and recycles discarded points to improve pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了3D点云网络剪枝的空白，方法设计针对性强，对点云应用有实际意义。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出适用于3D点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 结合点云坐标信息和点回收策略，增强剪枝重要性度量。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了剪枝性能的提升。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: ①针对对应关系剪枝中现有方法忽略邻居一致性信息的问题，提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法。②该方法通过逐步挖掘邻居关系，提升对应关系剪枝的准确性。③相比现有方法，该方法更充分利用局部结构信息。④实验表明在标准基准上取得了改进。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of ignoring neighbor consistency in correspondence pruning by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. It leverages local structure information to improve pruning accuracy, outperforming existing methods on benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 该论文方法思路清晰，但创新性和影响力有限。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻居一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过渐进式挖掘邻居一致性增强剪枝准确性。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准基准上取得了改进。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: ①针对传统剪枝方法在数据偏差下导致子网络性能退化的问题。②提出对比权重剪枝（Contrastive Weight Pruning），通过对比学习损失引导剪枝过程，保留具有判别性的子网络。③相比现有剪枝方法，引入对比信号以缓解偏差影响，提升泛化性。④实验表明在多个基准上，剪枝后的子网络在准确率和鲁棒性上优于基线方法。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of pruned subnetworks under biased data. It proposes contrastive weight pruning that uses contrastive loss to guide pruning, preserving discriminative features. Compared to existing methods, it improves generalization and robustness, with experiments showing superior accuracy on benchmarks.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该论文将对比学习与剪枝结合，思路新颖，对鲁棒剪枝研究有参考价值。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝框架，提升剪枝子网络的判别性和鲁棒性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 在剪枝中引入对比学习损失作为引导信号。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个基准上准确率和鲁棒性优于现有剪枝方法。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: ①针对半监督学习中分布外数据导致伪标签噪声和模型性能下降的问题。②提出分布外语义剪枝（OOD Semantic Pruning），在训练过程中动态识别并剪除OOD样本对模型的影响。③相比传统半监督方法，显式处理OOD样本，提升模型在干净数据上的泛化能力。④实验显示在多个半监督基准上，该方法显著降低错误率并提高鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of out-of-distribution data causing noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised learning. It proposes OOD semantic pruning to dynamically identify and remove OOD influence during training. Compared to standard methods, it improves generalization on clean data, with experiments showing reduced error rates and enhanced robustness.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝思想用于半监督学习中的OOD处理，具有实际应用价值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出OOD语义剪枝方法，提升半监督学习的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 将剪枝应用于伪标签样本的语义过滤。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个半监督基准上错误率显著降低。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: ①针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大、内存占用高的问题。②提出基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，联合优化剪枝结构和网络权重，实现高效分割。③相比固定剪枝策略，该方法自适应学习每层稀疏度，在保持精度的同时大幅降低FLOPs。④实验表明在Cityscapes等数据集上，模型压缩率显著，精度损失极小，适合边缘部署。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices. It proposes a bi-level optimization-based pruning parameterization that jointly optimizes pruning structure and weights. Compared to fixed strategies, it adaptively learns layer-wise sparsity, significantly reducing FLOPs with minimal accuracy loss on datasets like Cityscapes.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 方法实用性强，针对边缘部署场景，具有较高工程价值。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，实现高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝结构学习建模为双层优化问题。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes上大幅降低FLOPs，精度损失极小。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: ①针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算开销巨大的问题。②提出时空稀疏性方法，利用帧间和空间冗余，仅处理关键区域，实现高效抠图。③相比全分辨率处理方法，显著减少计算量，同时保持高质量alpha matte。④实验表明在超高分辨率数据集上，速度提升数倍，精度与全分辨率方法相当。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of ultrahigh resolution image/video matting. It proposes spatio-temporal sparsity to process only key regions, leveraging inter-frame and spatial redundancy. Compared to full-resolution methods, it greatly reduces computation while maintaining high-quality alpha mattes, with experiments showing several-fold speedup and comparable accuracy.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 针对超高分辨率场景的稀疏计算设计，具有高效性和实用性。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性抠图方法，降低超高分辨率处理成本。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用时空冗余实现稀疏计算。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 速度提升数倍，精度与全分辨率方法相当。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习中客户端系统异构导致训练效率低下的问题。②提出自适应通道稀疏方法，根据客户端计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度，实现高效联邦训练。③相比固定稀疏策略，该方法适应异构环境，减少通信和计算开销。④实验表明在异构设置下，训练速度提升，模型精度保持稳定。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses low training efficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity. It proposes adaptive channel sparsity that adjusts sparsity based on client capabilities. Compared to fixed strategies, it reduces communication and computation overhead, with experiments showing faster training and stable accuracy in heterogeneous settings.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 针对联邦学习实际痛点，方法具有部署潜力。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏方法，提升异构联邦学习效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端能力动态调整稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 训练速度提升，精度保持稳定。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: ①针对视频超分辨率中计算冗余和效率低下的问题。②提出结构化稀疏学习框架，在时空维度上学习稀疏模式，减少冗余计算。③相比非结构化剪枝，该方法保持硬件友好性，同时提升推理速度。④实验表明在多个视频超分基准上，FLOPs显著降低，PSNR指标与全模型相当。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses computational redundancy in video super-resolution. It proposes a structured sparsity learning framework that learns spatio-temporal sparse patterns. Compared to unstructured pruning, it maintains hardware friendliness and improves inference speed, with experiments showing significant FLOPs reduction and comparable PSNR on benchmarks.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏设计兼顾效率与性能，对视频任务有参考价值。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习框架，提升视频超分效率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 在时空维度上学习结构化稀疏模式。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: FLOPs显著降低，PSNR与全模型相当。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: ①该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效率低的问题。②提出了一种判别器协作的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器的信息来指导蒸馏过程。③相比传统蒸馏方法，该方法能更好地保留生成图像的细节和多样性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个GAN压缩任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low efficiency in feature map distillation for GAN compression. It proposes a discriminator-cooperated distillation method that leverages discriminator information to guide the distillation process. Compared to traditional distillation methods, it better preserves image details and diversity. The abstract claims superior performance on several GAN compression tasks without specific numbers.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶3D感知领域相关性较低，主要面向GAN压缩，但知识蒸馏技术本身有一定参考价值。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协作的特征图蒸馏方法，提升GAN压缩效率。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 将判别器信息引入蒸馏过程，增强特征保留能力。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在GAN压缩任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D目标检测中知识蒸馏在极端紧凑模型下效果不佳的问题，原因是教师和学生模型中间特征表示存在显著差异。②提出了一种表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）角度出发，最小化学生和教师模型在提议区域对上的特征和logits差异。③相比现有KD方法，RDD能有效处理点云稀疏性和不规则性导致的表示差异。④在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超过教师模型性能，且仅占用42%的FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ineffectiveness of knowledge distillation (KD) for extreme-compact 3D detectors due to significant representation disparity between teacher and student models. It proposes a representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizing feature and logit disparities for proposal region pairs. RDD effectively handles sparsity and irregularity in point clouds. On nuScenes, RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S mAP to 57.1%, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该论文针对3D检测蒸馏中的关键难点提出创新解决方案，实验充分且效果显著，对自动驾驶感知模型压缩有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法，解决3D检测中紧凑模型与教师模型的表示差异问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈视角设计蒸馏目标，有效处理点云稀疏性导致的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mAP达57.1%，超过教师模型且FLOPs降低58%。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计导致3D表示稀疏、信息丢失的问题。②提出了MonoNeRD框架，使用符号距离函数（SDF）建模场景，生成密集3D表示，并采用NeRF式体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。③相比显式深度反投影方法，该方法能推断密集3D几何和占用，减少远距离和遮挡物体的信息损失。④在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性，是首个将体渲染引入单目3D检测的工作。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparsity and information loss in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit depth estimation. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions (SDF) to produce dense 3D representations and employs NeRF-style volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. Compared to explicit back-projection, it infers dense geometry and occupancy, reducing loss for distant and occluded objects. Experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo demonstrate effectiveness, marking the first use of volume rendering for monocular 3D detection.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NeRF思想引入单目3D检测，提供了一种新的密集表示范式，对自动驾驶感知有较大启发意义。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出MonoNeRD框架，利用SDF和体渲染实现密集3D表示的单目检测。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 首次将体渲染技术应用于单目3D检测，实现隐式重建。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D和Waymo数据集上验证了有效性。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有动态剪枝未充分利用多模态对齐信息的问题。②提出MADTP，利用多模态对齐分数引导动态token剪枝，在推理时根据跨模态相关性移除不重要的token。③相比静态剪枝和随机动态剪枝，首次将模态对齐信号引入剪枝决策，实现自适应加速。④在多个VQA和图文检索基准上，在保持精度的同时减少约40%计算量。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: Addresses high inference cost of vision-language transformers by proposing MADTP, a dynamic token pruning method guided by multimodal alignment scores. It leverages cross-modal relevance to prune tokens adaptively, achieving ~40% FLOPs reduction with minimal accuracy loss on VQA and retrieval benchmarks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 针对多模态推理加速提出新颖的对齐引导剪枝思路，对VLM高效部署有实际价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出首个利用多模态对齐分数引导动态token剪枝的框架。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 将跨模态对齐信息作为剪枝决策的核心信号。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个基准上减少约40%计算量且精度几乎无损。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: ①针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法任务特定、泛化性差的问题。②提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的剪枝框架，通过流形学习识别跨任务共享的重要结构。③相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上保持一致性性能，无需重新训练。④在图像分类、检索和VQA等任务上，剪枝后平均性能下降小于2%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: Proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework for vision-language models that identifies shared important structures via manifold learning. It maintains consistent performance across multiple downstream tasks without retraining, with average accuracy drop under 2%.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 解决剪枝泛化问题，对多任务部署场景有重要参考意义。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝方法。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用流形学习实现跨任务共享结构识别。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 多任务平均性能下降小于2%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中缺乏准确模块重要性评估的问题。②提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差度量（MoPE），精确衡量每个模块对输出的影响。③相比基于幅度或梯度的剪枝，MoPE更直接反映模块对最终预测的贡献，剪枝更精准。④在CLIP模型上，剪枝50%参数时，零样本分类精度仅下降1.5%，优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: Introduces MoPE-CLIP with a module-wise pruning error metric to accurately assess module importance in vision-language models. This metric directly reflects contribution to predictions, achieving only 1.5% zero-shot accuracy drop at 50% pruning on CLIP.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 提出更合理的剪枝重要性度量，对VLM压缩具有方法论贡献。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 以剪枝误差而非权重幅度作为重要性标准。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: ①针对多模态数据集规模庞大、冗余样本降低训练效率的问题。②提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型生成文本描述，基于描述多样性进行数据集剪枝。③相比随机采样或基于视觉特征的剪枝，Sieve通过语义信息保留信息量大的样本。④在多个多模态数据集上，剪枝50%数据后训练性能与全量数据相当。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: Proposes Sieve, a multimodal dataset pruning method using image captioning models to generate descriptions and select diverse samples. It retains informative data, achieving comparable training performance with 50% data on multiple benchmarks.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 从数据角度提升训练效率，对大规模多模态训练有实用价值。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述的语义多样性数据集剪枝方法。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用caption模型将视觉信息转化为语义信号进行筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 剪枝50%数据后性能与全量相当。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索和稀疏度搜索分离导致次优解的问题。②提出Once for Both，在单阶段同时优化重要性权重和稀疏度分配。③相比两阶段方法，联合搜索能更好地平衡各层剪枝率，提升整体性能。④在ImageNet上，DeiT-S压缩至50% FLOPs时，精度仅下降0.8%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: Proposes a single-stage framework that jointly optimizes importance and sparsity search for vision transformer compression. This unified approach outperforms two-stage methods, achieving only 0.8% accuracy drop on DeiT-S at 50% FLOPs on ImageNet.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 简化压缩流程并提升效果，对ViT高效部署有直接帮助。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性-稀疏度搜索框架。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将两个搜索过程统一为单目标优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: ①针对数据稀缺场景下密集视觉Transformer压缩困难的问题。②提出一种仅需少量样本的压缩方法，通过知识蒸馏和正则化保持模型性能。③相比需要大量数据的压缩方法，本方法在few-shot设置下仍能有效压缩。④在ImageNet子集（每类仅10张）上，压缩DeiT-B至40% FLOPs时，精度下降小于3%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: Addresses dense vision transformer compression with few samples by combining knowledge distillation and regularization. It achieves effective compression with only 10 images per class, with accuracy drop under 3% at 40% FLOPs on DeiT-B.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 针对数据受限场景提供实用压缩方案，但方法创新性一般。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出few-shot条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 将蒸馏与正则化结合适应小样本压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 每类10样本下40% FLOPs精度降<3%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对图像压缩模型在持续学习场景下无法向后兼容旧版本的问题。②提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习框架，通过正则化和重放策略在压缩任务中保持旧版本性能。③相比传统持续学习方法，专门针对图像压缩的率失真特性设计了兼容性约束。④实验表明在多个压缩数据集上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the backward compatibility issue in continual learning for image compression models. It proposes a framework with regularization and replay to preserve old-version performance. Compared to generic continual learning, it tailors constraints to rate-distortion characteristics. Experiments show reduced catastrophic forgetting, though no specific numbers are given.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入图像压缩，领域交叉有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，影响力和实用性待验证。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将兼容性约束融入压缩任务的持续学习。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 缓解了压缩模型的灾难性遗忘。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: ①针对StyleGAN模型参数量大、推理成本高的问题。②提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法，在压缩StyleGAN时保留生成图像的多样性。③相比传统剪枝方法，引入多样性度量作为剪枝准则，避免过度压缩导致模式坍缩。④实验表明在保持生成质量的同时显著降低计算量，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of StyleGAN via diversity-aware channel pruning. It introduces a diversity metric to guide pruning, preserving output diversity unlike standard methods. Experiments show reduced computation with maintained generation quality, though specific numbers are absent.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 针对生成模型的剪枝研究较少，多样性感知思路有参考价值，但摘要缺乏定量结果。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的StyleGAN通道剪枝方法。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 将多样性度量融入剪枝准则。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在保持生成质量下降低计算量。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: ①针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离导致性能损失的问题。②提出联合训练与剪枝框架，通过可学习智能体引导和特征对齐，在训练过程中动态确定剪枝结构。③相比两阶段方法，实现了端到端优化，智能体学习剪枝策略，对齐损失保持特征一致性。④实验表明在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法，但摘要未提供具体精度数据。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance drop from separating training and pruning in CNNs. It proposes a joint framework with learnable agent guidance and feature alignment, dynamically determining pruning structure during training. Compared to two-stage methods, it enables end-to-end optimization. Experiments show superiority over existing methods, though no specific accuracy is given.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合优化思路具有实用价值，智能体引导有创新性，但摘要缺乏定量比较。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出联合训练与剪枝的可学习智能体引导框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 端到端优化剪枝策略与特征对齐。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在多个基准上优于现有剪枝方法。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下设备异构性导致剪枝模型难以适配的问题。②提出设备级联邦剪枝方法，为每个设备生成定制化剪枝模型，同时保持全局知识。③相比统一剪枝，考虑设备计算能力差异，通过联邦聚合协调个性化剪枝。④实验表明在异构设备上提升了效率与精度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper addresses device heterogeneity in federated learning for pruning. It proposes device-wise federated pruning, generating customized pruned models per device while preserving global knowledge. Unlike uniform pruning, it accounts for device capabilities via federated aggregation. Experiments show improved efficiency and accuracy on heterogeneous devices, though no numbers are given.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 联邦剪枝是新兴方向，设备级定制有实际意义，但摘要信息不足。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备级联邦剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 个性化剪枝与联邦聚合结合。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 提升异构设备上的效率与精度。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: ①针对动态剪枝与静态剪枝分离导致无法兼顾灵活性与效率的问题。②提出BilevelPruning统一框架，通过双层优化同时学习动态和静态通道剪枝策略。③相比单一剪枝模式，动态分支适应输入变化，静态分支保证推理效率，两者协同优化。④实验表明在图像分类任务上优于现有剪枝方法，但摘要未提供具体精度或FLOPs数据。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of dynamic and static pruning, which limits flexibility and efficiency. It proposes BilevelPruning, a unified framework using bilevel optimization to learn both dynamic and static channel pruning. Compared to single-mode pruning, dynamic branches adapt to inputs while static branches ensure efficiency. Experiments show superiority over existing methods, though specific metrics are absent.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一动态与静态剪枝具有理论创新，双层优化设计严谨，值得关注。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态剪枝的双层优化框架。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 双层优化协同学习两种剪枝模式。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在图像分类上优于现有剪枝方法。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: ①针对CapsNet计算复杂度高和路由机制效率低的问题。②提出OrthCaps，采用正交胶囊网络和稀疏注意力路由，并集成剪枝以压缩模型。③相比传统CapsNet，正交约束增强特征独立性，稀疏路由减少计算，剪枝进一步降低参数量。④实验表明在多个数据集上保持高精度同时显著减少计算，但摘要未提供具体数据。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses high computational cost and inefficient routing in CapsNet. It proposes OrthCaps with orthogonal capsules, sparse attention routing, and pruning. Compared to standard CapsNet, orthogonal constraints improve feature independence, sparse routing reduces computation, and pruning lowers parameters. Experiments show maintained accuracy with reduced cost, though no numbers are given.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 针对CapsNet的剪枝研究较少，正交与稀疏路由有创新，但领域相关性较低。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交胶囊网络与稀疏注意力路由及剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 正交约束与稀疏路由结合剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 保持精度同时减少计算量。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临的内存效率问题。②提出了FedMef方法，通过内存高效的联邦动态剪枝策略，在客户端本地进行剪枝并减少通信与存储开销。③相比现有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef更注重内存占用优化，适用于资源受限的客户端设备。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在内存效率和模型性能间取得了平衡。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses memory efficiency in federated dynamic pruning. It proposes FedMef, a memory-efficient pruning strategy for federated learning, reducing client-side storage and communication overhead. Compared to existing methods, it optimizes memory usage while maintaining model performance, though no specific numerical results are provided in the abstract.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 该论文对联邦学习与剪枝结合的研究有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，且与自动驾驶感知领域直接关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出了一种内存高效的联邦动态剪枝方法FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦剪枝中引入内存效率优化。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在内存效率和模型性能间取得平衡，具体数据未披露。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对大模型微调过程中计算资源消耗大的问题。②提出了资源高效的Transformer剪枝方法，用于大模型微调阶段，减少参数和计算量。③相比传统剪枝方法，该方法专门针对微调场景设计，兼顾效率和精度。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调资源效率提升。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of finetuning large models. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning method tailored for finetuning, reducing parameters and computation. Compared to generic pruning, it is specifically designed for finetuning scenarios, though specific performance metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 该论文对大模型微调优化有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性一般。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出了面向大模型微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 针对微调场景定制剪枝策略。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 提升了资源效率，具体数据未披露。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: ①针对视觉模型中彩票假设（lottery ticket）的识别问题。②提出了数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法，通过分析数据频谱特性来预测和识别重要子网络。③相比传统彩票假设方法，该方法利用数据驱动和频谱分析，提高了剪枝的准确性和泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在视觉模型上展示了有效性。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the identification of lottery tickets in vision models. It proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that leverages data spectral properties to predict important subnetworks. Compared to conventional lottery ticket approaches, it enhances pruning accuracy and generalization, though specific numerical results are not provided in the abstract.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 该论文在剪枝理论和方法上有创新，对视觉模型压缩有参考价值，与自动驾驶感知的模型优化相关。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出了数据驱动的频谱前瞻剪枝方法用于识别视觉模型中的彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 结合数据频谱分析与前瞻性剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在视觉模型上验证了有效性，具体数据未披露。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D 6DoF物体姿态估计中对应关系搜索效率低和精度不足的问题。②提出了HiPose方法，采用层次化二进制表面编码和对应关系剪枝策略，有效减少搜索空间并提高姿态估计精度。③相比现有方法，层次化编码和剪枝结合显著提升了计算效率和鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在标准基准上展示了优越性能。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and accuracy issues in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. It proposes HiPose, which uses hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning to reduce search space and improve pose accuracy. Compared to existing methods, it enhances computational efficiency and robustness, with superior performance on standard benchmarks (specific numbers not in abstract).
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 该论文对3D物体检测与姿态估计有重要贡献，与自动驾驶感知中的物体定位和姿态理解高度相关。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出了层次化二进制表面编码和对应关系剪枝的6DoF姿态估计方法。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 层次化编码与剪枝结合优化对应关系搜索。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在标准基准上展示了优越性能，具体数据未披露。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: ①针对源模型知识产权保护问题，在无源数据场景下进行模型保护。②提出了MAP方法，通过掩码剪枝实现源模型的知识产权保护，防止模型被非法复制或滥用。③相比现有模型保护方法，MAP利用剪枝技术，无需源数据即可实施保护。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在保护有效性和模型可用性间取得平衡。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: This paper addresses source-free model intellectual property protection. It proposes MAP, a mask-pruning approach to protect source models without requiring source data. Compared to existing protection methods, it leverages pruning for effective protection while maintaining model usability, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 该论文在模型安全领域有创新，但与自动驾驶感知研究领域相关性较低。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出了基于掩码剪枝的无源模型知识产权保护方法MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 将剪枝技术应用于模型知识产权保护。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 在保护有效性和模型可用性间取得平衡，具体数据未披露。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ①针对预训练Transformer中token剪枝需要微调或训练的问题。②提出了Zero-TPrune方法，利用注意力图在零样本（zero-shot）条件下进行token剪枝，无需额外训练。③相比现有剪枝方法，Zero-TPrune无需微调，直接应用于预训练模型，显著降低计算成本。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在多个视觉任务上展示了高效性。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for finetuning in token pruning of pre-trained Transformers. It proposes Zero-TPrune, a zero-shot token pruning method that leverages attention graphs, eliminating the need for training. Compared to existing methods, it reduces computational cost significantly while maintaining performance, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 该论文对Transformer高效推理有重要价值，与自动驾驶中视觉Transformer的实时处理相关。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出了零样本token剪枝方法Zero-TPrune，利用注意力图实现无需训练的剪枝。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在多个视觉任务上展示了高效性，具体数据未披露。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: ①针对传统网络剪枝方法需要预训练模型或复杂重训练流程、成本高且难以从零开始训练的问题。②提出Auto-Train-Once框架，利用控制器网络自动引导剪枝过程，实现从零开始训练的同时完成剪枝，无需预训练权重。③相比已有方法，创新性地将控制器网络与剪枝训练耦合，自动确定剪枝策略，简化了流程并降低了计算开销。④实验表明在多种网络和数据集上达到与现有方法相当的精度，同时显著减少训练时间和资源消耗。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and complexity of conventional network pruning methods that require pretrained models or elaborate retraining. It proposes Auto-Train-Once, a framework using a controller network to automatically guide pruning during training from scratch, eliminating the need for pretrained weights. Compared to prior work, it couples controller-based strategy discovery with training, simplifying the pipeline and reducing computational overhead. Experiments demonstrate comparable accuracy to existing methods on various networks and datasets, with significantly reduced training time and resources.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 该论文为剪枝领域提供了一种从零训练的新范式，对资源受限场景有实用价值，但方法细节和泛化性需进一步验证。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出无需预训练模型的自动剪枝训练框架，降低剪枝应用门槛。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 控制器网络动态引导剪枝策略，实现训练与剪枝的端到端联合优化。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在多个基准上达到与现有方法相当的精度，同时大幅减少训练开销。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: ①针对数据集剪枝中仅依赖静态样本难度或多样性、忽略训练动态导致剪枝效果不佳的问题。②提出时间双深度评分（TDDS）方法，通过追踪训练过程中样本的损失变化和梯度贡献，动态评估样本重要性，实现更精准的数据集剪枝。③相比静态评分方法，TDDS利用训练进度信息，能更好保留对模型泛化关键的样本。④实验显示在多个图像分类数据集上，TDDS在相同剪枝率下保持更高测试精度，优于现有剪枝方法。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of dataset pruning methods that rely on static sample difficulty or diversity, ignoring training dynamics. It proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which tracks loss changes and gradient contributions over training to dynamically assess sample importance for more effective pruning. Compared to static scoring, TDDS leverages training progress information to better retain samples critical for generalization. Experiments on multiple image classification datasets show TDDS achieves higher test accuracy at the same pruning ratios than existing methods.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 该论文将训练动态引入数据集剪枝，思路新颖，对高效学习有参考价值，但实验规模有限。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出基于训练动态的双深度评分机制，提升数据集剪枝的样本选择质量。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用时间维度的损失和梯度信息动态评估样本重要性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集上以相同剪枝率获得更高精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中深度传感器（如LiDAR）产生的稀疏深度图在边缘和遮挡区域不完整，影响下游感知任务的问题。②提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network），通过可学习的掩码控制信息传播，自适应处理不同稀疏度的深度图，实现鲁棒的深度细化。③相比传统空间传播方法，掩码机制能有效避免跨物体边界传播错误信息，提升细化精度。④在KITTI和NYU-Depth-v2等基准上，该方法在深度补全和细化任务中显著优于现有方法，尤其在极端稀疏输入下保持高精度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the incompleteness of sparse depth maps from sensors like LiDAR, which harms downstream perception in autonomous driving. It proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network that uses learnable masks to control information flow, adaptively refining depth across varying sparsity levels. Compared to conventional spatial propagation, the mask prevents erroneous propagation across object boundaries, improving accuracy. On benchmarks like KITTI and NYU-Depth-v2, the method significantly outperforms existing approaches in depth completion and refinement, especially under extreme sparsity.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶深度细化的关键问题，方法实用且实验充分，对感知系统有直接提升价值。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.relevance_note: 与自动驾驶感知高度相关，但非核心检测任务。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络，实现稀疏自适应深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 可学习掩码控制传播，避免跨边界错误信息扩散。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在多个深度基准上取得领先精度，尤其擅长极端稀疏输入。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: ①针对现有结构化稀疏对抗攻击需要复杂训练策略、迁移性差的问题。②提出可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗攻击方法，通过精确组稀疏训练（Exact Group Sparsity Training）生成具有结构化稀疏模式的对抗扰动，增强攻击的迁移性。③相比非结构化攻击，结构化稀疏扰动更符合硬件加速需求，且通过组稀疏约束提升跨模型迁移能力。④实验表明在多个图像分类模型上，该方法生成的对抗样本迁移成功率显著高于现有稀疏攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor transferability and complex training of existing structured sparse adversarial attacks. It proposes a transferable structured sparse attack via Exact Group Sparsity Training, generating perturbations with structured sparsity patterns to enhance cross-model transferability. Compared to unstructured attacks, the structured sparsity aligns with hardware acceleration and improves transfer through group sparsity constraints. Experiments show significantly higher attack success rates across multiple image classification models than existing sparse attacks.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 该论文将剪枝中的组稀疏技术应用于对抗攻击，交叉创新有启发性，但应用场景较窄。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构化对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 利用组稀疏训练生成结构化扰动，提升攻击迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上实现更高的对抗攻击迁移成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: ①针对N:M稀疏网络中现有方法对通道和权重的联合选择效率低、精度损失大的问题。②提出MaxQ（Multi-Axis Query）框架，通过多轴查询机制同时优化通道选择和权重分配，提升N:M稀疏网络的性能。③相比固定模式剪枝，MaxQ动态调整稀疏模式，更好适应数据分布，减少精度下降。④实验显示在多种CNN和Transformer模型上，MaxQ在相同稀疏度下比现有N:M剪枝方法获得更高精度。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and accuracy loss in joint channel and weight selection for N:M sparse networks. It proposes MaxQ, a Multi-Axis Query framework that simultaneously optimizes channel selection and weight allocation to improve N:M sparse network performance. Compared to fixed-pattern pruning, MaxQ dynamically adjusts sparsity patterns to better fit data distributions, reducing accuracy degradation. Experiments on various CNN and Transformer models show MaxQ achieves higher accuracy than existing N:M pruning methods at the same sparsity.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: 该论文针对N:M稀疏剪枝的优化问题，方法设计合理，对高效推理有参考意义。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询框架，联合优化N:M稀疏网络的通道和权重选择。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 多轴查询机制动态调整稀疏模式，提升精度保持能力。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在多种模型上以相同稀疏度获得更高精度。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: ①针对后训练稀疏化（Post-Training Sparsity）方法在不同网络和稀疏度下性能不稳定、缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出UniPTS统一框架，整合多种后训练稀疏策略，通过自适应优化实现高效且稳健的稀疏化，无需微调。③相比现有后训练剪枝方法，UniPTS能自动选择最优稀疏策略，适应不同网络结构，减少精度损失。④实验表明在多个视觉模型和数据集上，UniPTS在极低稀疏度下保持高精度，优于现有后训练稀疏方法，且计算开销低。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and lack of a unified framework in post-training sparsity methods across networks and sparsity levels. It proposes UniPTS, a unified framework that integrates multiple post-training sparsity strategies with adaptive optimization for efficient and robust sparsification without fine-tuning. Compared to existing methods, UniPTS automatically selects optimal strategies to adapt to different architectures, reducing accuracy loss. Experiments on various vision models and datasets show UniPTS maintains high accuracy at extreme sparsity, outperforming existing methods with low computational cost.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 该论文为后训练稀疏化提供了统一解决方案，实用性强，实验全面，对部署场景有重要价值。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架，实现无需微调的高效稳健剪枝。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 自适应策略选择机制，适应不同网络和稀疏度需求。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多个模型和数据集上以极低稀疏度保持高精度，优于现有方法。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer在边缘设备上的模型压缩效率问题，提出了DeepCompress-ViT方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但推测其结合了剪枝、量化和蒸馏等技术。相比已有工作，可能更注重边缘场景下的计算与内存约束。效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses model compression for Vision Transformers at the edge, proposing DeepCompress-ViT. Due to missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be assessed, but it likely integrates pruning, quantization, and distillation for efficiency.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其具体贡献，但主题与模型压缩相关，对边缘部署有一定参考价值。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘视觉Transformer的压缩方法。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 可能结合多种压缩技术提升边缘效率。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测方法依赖sRGB输入，而sRGB经ISP压缩会丢失复杂光照和天气条件下的关键信息的问题，提出了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率RAW图像和135,601个标注实例，覆盖62个类别和9种光照天气条件。方法上，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，因此直接在RAW域预训练，并通过从sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识来辅助RAW预训练，克服相机噪声带来的表示学习困难。相比已有工作，该方法无需额外预处理模块，在多样恶劣条件下取得显著改进。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in sRGB object detection under complex conditions by introducing the AODRaw dataset with 7,785 RAW images and 135,601 instances across 62 categories. It proposes direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from sRGB models to overcome domain gaps and camera noise, achieving substantial improvements without extra preprocessing.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了首个大规模RAW目标检测数据集和基准，并提出了有效的RAW预训练策略，对自动驾驶等恶劣环境感知具有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建AODRaw数据集并验证RAW域预训练结合蒸馏的有效性。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究RAW输入下的目标检测，并利用sRGB知识蒸馏辅助RAW预训练。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样恶劣条件下检测性能显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下计算效率低的问题，提出了一种基于剪枝的高效方法。方法上，引入敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例层面量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道，聚焦于不变特征。同时，提出随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪通道，避免早期剪枝风险。在三个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持性能的同时显著提升效率。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles computational inefficiency in continual test-time adaptive object detection under domain shifts by proposing a sensitivity-guided channel pruning method. It quantifies channel sensitivity at image and instance levels, applies weighted sparsity regularization, and introduces stochastic channel reactivation to mitigate early pruning risks, achieving superior efficiency on three benchmarks.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 该论文将剪枝引入CTTA-OD，兼顾效率与性能，对资源受限的自动驾驶场景具有实用价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导的剪枝策略用于高效CTTA-OD。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 结合通道敏感度量化和随机重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优越效率与性能平衡。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云属性压缩中现有高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型概率估计不准确的问题，提出了广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更精确估计潜在变量概率。同时，针对现有方法使用固定似然区间的问题，提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。实验表明，该方法在三个VAE模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广到图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate probability estimation in point cloud attribute compression by introducing a generalized Gaussian entropy model with shape parameters and a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) for dynamic likelihood intervals. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE models, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 该论文在点云压缩领域有创新，但与应用领域相关性较低，适合压缩方向研究者参考。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间机制。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 利用形状参数和MED动态调整概率估计。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 该论文针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩问题，提出了TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但推测其利用Transformer建模八叉树上下文以提升压缩效率。相比已有工作，可能更注重计算效率。效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. Due to missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be assessed, but it likely leverages Transformer for context modeling.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其具体贡献，但主题与点云压缩相关，对3D感知有一定间接关联。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的八叉树占用预测网络。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本驱动的3D场景编辑中多视图不一致和优化效率低的问题，提出了EditSplat框架，结合多视图融合引导（MFG）和注意力引导修剪（AGT）。MFG通过将多视图信息融入扩散过程，利用无分类器引导和3DGS几何结构确保一致性；AGT利用3DGS的显式表示选择性修剪和优化高斯，提升效率并支持局部编辑。实验表明，该方法在渲染质量和编辑精度上优于现有方法。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in text-driven 3D editing by proposing EditSplat, which integrates Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT). MFG ensures consistency via multi-view information in diffusion, while AGT selectively prunes Gaussians for efficiency, achieving superior rendering and editing quality.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 该论文在3D编辑领域有创新，但与应用领域相关性一般，对多模态感知有参考价值。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出EditSplat框架实现视图一致的3D场景编辑。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 结合多视图融合引导和注意力引导修剪。
2412.11520|v2.result: 在渲染质量和编辑精度上优于现有方法。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率图像输入导致视觉编码器（如ViT）计算开销大、延迟高的问题，本文提出FastVLM模型。通过分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数量和LLM大小之间的权衡，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，仅通过缩放输入图像即可在减少token数量和编码时间的同时保持性能，无需额外的token剪枝。相比现有方法，简化了模型设计并实现了延迟、模型大小和准确率之间的最优平衡。实验表明，在文本丰富的图像理解任务中，FastVLM在降低延迟的同时保持了高精度。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of vision encoders at high resolutions in VLMs, proposing FastVLM with a hybrid encoder FastViTHD that reduces token count and encoding latency by scaling input images alone. It achieves an optimal trade-off between latency, model size, and accuracy without token pruning, simplifying design. Experiments demonstrate improved efficiency in text-rich image understanding tasks.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 该论文针对VLM高分辨率输入的实际瓶颈，提供了系统性的效率分析和实用的编码器设计，对部署高效多模态系统有重要参考价值。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM和FastViTHD，实现高分辨率图像下视觉编码的高效化。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 通过混合编码器设计，仅靠图像缩放同时优化token数量和编码延迟。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在降低延迟和token开销的同时，保持了高分辨率图像理解的高精度。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉嵌入空间是否具有组合性结构的问题，本文提出Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架。该框架利用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示，以应对视觉数据的噪声和稀疏性。实验表明，预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上优于假设线性几何的方法。该工作为理解VLM的视觉表示提供了新视角。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates compositionality in the visual embedding space of VLMs, proposing Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) to approximate image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. It demonstrates that pre-trained VLM visual embeddings exhibit compositional patterns, achieving stronger performance in compositional classification and group robustness compared to linear-geometry methods.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 该论文探索了VLM视觉表示的组合性，方法新颖，对理解多模态表示结构有理论意义。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，揭示并利用VLM视觉嵌入的组合性。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 引入几何感知的组合分解方法处理视觉数据的噪声和稀疏性。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上取得优于线性几何方法的性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解基准缺乏对细粒度运动理解评估的问题，本文提出MotionBench基准，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型，数据来源多样。实验发现现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现不佳。为提升该能力，作者提出Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法，通过优化视频特征压缩架构，在有限序列长度内增强运动感知。实验表明，更高帧率输入和TE Fusion能改善运动理解，但仍有提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MotionBench, a benchmark for evaluating fine-grained motion comprehension in VLMs, revealing poor performance of existing models. It proposes Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion to enhance motion perception within limited sequence lengths, showing improvements with higher frame rates and TE Fusion, though gaps remain.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了细粒度运动理解评估的空白，提出的基准和方法对视频VLM研究有重要推动作用。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 构建MotionBench基准并提出TE Fusion方法，提升VLM的细粒度运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 通过编码器内融合机制优化视频特征压缩，增强运动信息保留。
2501.02955|v2.result: TE Fusion和更高帧率输入显著提升运动理解性能，但仍有改进空间。

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）部署时计算开销大的问题，本文提出EfficientLLaVA，一种可泛化的自动剪枝方法。该方法旨在通过自动识别和移除冗余参数，在保持模型性能的同时减少计算量。由于摘要缺失，具体技术细节未知，但推测采用基于重要性评估的剪枝策略，并强调泛化性。该方法有望提升LVLM在资源受限场景下的实用性。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientLLaVA, a generalizable auto-pruning method for large vision-language models to reduce computational costs. It aims to automatically identify and remove redundant parameters while maintaining performance, though specific details are unavailable due to missing abstract.
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM的模型压缩问题，方向重要，但摘要缺失限制了对其质量的全面评估。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.contribution: 提出EfficientLLaVA自动剪枝方法，提升LVLM的部署效率。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.innovation: 强调剪枝方法的泛化性，可能结合自动搜索或学习策略。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.result: 预期在减少计算量的同时保持模型性能，具体效果待验证。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni._arxiv_id: EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruning for Large Vision-language Models.

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中MLLM上下文长度有限和计算成本高的问题，本文提出Video-XL方法。该方法利用MLLM固有的键值（KV）稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入，引入视觉总结标记（VST）对视频间隔进行信息汇总。通过课程学习和复合数据策展策略训练VST，并采用动态压缩进一步优化。实验表明，Video-XL在小时级视频理解任务中显著提升了性能，同时降低了计算开销。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Video-XL for hour-scale video understanding, leveraging KV sparsification with a Visual Summarization Token (VST) to condense visual input. It uses curriculum learning and composite data curation for training, achieving improved performance in long-video tasks with reduced computational costs.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 该论文针对长视频理解的瓶颈，提出了创新的KV压缩机制，实验充分，对实际应用有重要价值。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL和VST机制，实现小时级视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 利用MLLM的KV稀疏化能力，通过VST动态压缩视觉信息。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务中取得显著性能提升，同时降低计算开销。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM在图像和视频处理中采用不同token压缩策略、限制多模态联合理解的问题，本文提出渐进式视觉token压缩（PVC）方法。该方法将图像扩展为静态视频，统一图像和视频的token压缩，通过逐帧渐进编码和自适应压缩补充信息，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频token。实验表明，PVC在每帧仅64个token的情况下，仍能保留空间细节和时间变化，并在多个视频理解基准上达到最先进性能。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC) to unify image and video token compression in VLMs by extending images as static videos. It progressively encodes and adaptively compresses tokens, preserving spatial and temporal details with limited tokens, achieving state-of-the-art performance on video understanding benchmarks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了图像和视频统一处理的关键问题，方法简洁高效，对多模态VLM设计有重要启示。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC统一图像和视频的token压缩策略，提升多模态理解效率。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，利用渐进压缩同时处理空间和时间信息。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在每帧64 token下保持高性能，多个视频基准上达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理加速问题，现有token剪枝方法未充分考虑重要性-冗余度权衡及剪枝与合并的协同。②提出Libra-Merging方法，作为即插即用模块，结合重要性评估与冗余度分析，动态决定剪枝或合并视觉token。③相比已有方法，首次显式建模剪枝与合并的权衡，提升token利用效率。④实验表明在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses inference acceleration for large vision-language models by proposing Libra-Merging, a plug-in module that balances importance and redundancy to decide between pruning and merging visual tokens. It improves over prior methods by explicitly modeling the trade-off, achieving efficiency gains with minimal performance loss.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 该工作为LVLM加速提供了新视角，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出剪枝-合并权衡的即插即用加速模块。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 显式建模重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并的联合优化。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 在保持性能的同时降低计算开销。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and._arxiv_id: Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and Pruning-merging Trade-off for Acceleration Plug-in in Large Vision-Language Model.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态视觉语言模型推理时视觉token冗余导致的高计算开销问题，现有方法依赖贪心启发式且与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容。②提出TopV方法，将token剪枝形式化为优化问题，在预填充阶段一次性剪枝，兼容FlashAttention并减少KV cache。③相比已有方法，无需训练或微调，通过视觉感知代价函数（考虑特征相似性、相对空间位置等）精确识别重要token。④实验显示在保持性能的同时显著降低内存和延迟，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: TopV addresses high inference costs in multimodal VLMs by formulating token pruning as an optimization problem, compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache, and performing pruning once during prefilling. It avoids training, uses a visual-aware cost function, and achieves efficient acceleration with minimal performance loss.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 该方法解决了实际部署中的兼容性问题，具有较强实用性，值得关注。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出兼容FlashAttention的优化式token剪枝方法。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 将剪枝视为优化问题并引入视觉感知代价函数。
2503.18278|v2.result: 实现快速低内存推理，性能损失小。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型中视觉token冗余导致的计算开销，现有方法使用固定剪枝比例，未考虑层间和实例间差异。②提出ATP-LLaVA，引入自适应token剪枝模块，根据输入实例动态确定每层的剪枝比例。③相比已有方法，实现了层间和实例级的自适应剪枝，平衡计算与性能。④实验表明在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: ATP-LLaVA tackles computational costs from redundant visual tokens in LVLMs by introducing an adaptive token pruning module that determines layer-wise and instance-wise pruning ratios. It improves over fixed-ratio methods, balancing efficiency and performance effectively.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 自适应剪枝策略具有创新性，对资源受限设备部署有实际意义。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出层间和实例级自适应的视觉token剪枝方法。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 基于输入实例动态计算剪枝阈值和比例。
2412.00447|v2.result: 在降低计算开销的同时保持模型性能。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型处理高分辨率图像和视频时上下文窗口和计算成本受限的问题，现有压缩方法使用外部模块导致信息损失。②提出VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token，通过引入视觉压缩token和注意力蒸馏，让LLM理解压缩token。③相比已有方法，充分利用LLM对视觉token的理解范式，减少信息损失。④实验显示在576倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: VoCo-LLaMA addresses vision compression in VLMs by using LLMs themselves to compress visual tokens via vision compression tokens and attention distillation. It leverages LLM's understanding paradigm, achieving minimal performance loss at 576x compression, with 94.8% FLOPs reduction and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地利用LLM进行压缩，效果显著，对高效VLM有重要价值。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 首次提出利用LLM自身进行视觉token压缩。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 通过注意力蒸馏将LLM的视觉理解迁移到压缩token。
2406.12275|v2.result: 高压缩比下性能损失小，计算效率大幅提升。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型在适应下游任务时遗忘通用知识的问题，LoRA微调引入冗余参数加剧灾难性遗忘。②提出LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新丢弃冗余参数，并引入冲突缓解正则化器调整更新轨迹。③相比已有方法，在理论保证下同时提升泛化和下游任务性能。④实验显示即使在5%稀疏度下，仍能同时增强泛化和下游性能。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: LoRASculpt addresses catastrophic forgetting in MLLMs during downstream adaptation by introducing sparse updates to LoRA and a conflict mitigation regularizer. It discards redundant parameters, harmonizing general and specialized knowledge, and improves both generalization and downstream performance even at high sparsity.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 该工作对LoRA微调中的知识遗忘问题提供了有效解决方案，但相关性略低。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出稀疏LoRA与冲突缓解正则化以平衡通用和专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在LoRA中引入稀疏更新和正则化减少冗余。
2503.16843|v2.result: 高稀疏度下同时提升泛化和下游性能。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型中视觉token数量庞大导致推理延迟高的问题，现有剪枝方法依赖次优重要性指标或需要大量校准。②提出DivPrune，将token剪枝形式化为最大最小多样性问题（MMDP），选择多样性最高的子集。③相比已有方法，直接最大化所选token的多样性，减少冗余。④实验表明在保持性能的同时降低冗余，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: DivPrune addresses high latency in LMMs by formulating token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem, selecting a subset with maximum diversity. It reduces redundancy among retained tokens without extensive calibration, improving efficiency while maintaining performance.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 该工作从多样性角度重新定义剪枝目标，具有理论新颖性和实用性。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于多样性最大化的视觉token剪枝方法。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将剪枝问题建模为MMDP并求解。
2503.02175|v2.result: 减少冗余，提升推理效率。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，尤其是注意力矩阵的稀疏性未被充分利用。②提出了CASP，一种基于注意力稀疏性的压缩技术，通过对Query和Key权重矩阵进行数据感知的低秩分解，并基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。③改进点在于理论证明了注意力矩阵稀疏性约束压缩误差，并兼容任意量化方法。④在图像和视频语言基准上，平均提升了最先进的2-bit量化方法（AQLM和QuIP#）21%的性能。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) by leveraging attention sparsity. It proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Query and Key matrices followed by optimal bit allocation quantization. The method theoretically bounds compression error via attention sparsity and enhances state-of-the-art 2-bit quantization methods by 21% on average across benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 该论文为多模态模型压缩提供了新视角，理论分析与实验结合，对资源受限场景有实际价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的多模态模型压缩方法CASP。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 利用注意力矩阵稀疏性约束压缩误差，实现低秩分解与量化结合。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像和视频语言基准上平均提升2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）难以同时处理时空定位的问题，源于坐标组合爆炸和视频特征压缩困难。②提出了LLaVA-ST，包含语言对齐位置嵌入（Language-Aligned Positional Embedding）和时空打包器（Spatial-Temporal Packer），分别简化坐标对齐和分离时空分辨率压缩。③改进点在于将文本坐标特殊标记嵌入视觉空间，并设计双流点-区域注意力处理。④构建了ST-Align数据集（430万样本），在细粒度时空理解任务上表现优异。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of simultaneous temporal and spatial localization in MLLMs by proposing LLaVA-ST with Language-Aligned Positional Embedding and Spatial-Temporal Packer. The method embeds textual coordinate tokens into visual space and decouples temporal/spatial feature compression. It introduces the ST-Align dataset with 4.3M samples, achieving strong performance on fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多模态时空理解的关键瓶颈，提出创新架构和数据集，具有较高研究价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型和ST-Align数据集，解决细粒度时空理解问题。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入和双流时空打包器设计。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在细粒度时空理解任务上表现优异，数据集规模达430万样本。

FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.contribution: 提出FlashSloth，通过嵌入式视觉压缩提升多模态模型效率。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer中表现不佳的问题，源于梯度流不平衡违反FullGrad完备性。②提出了LibraGrad，一种理论支撑的事后方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径来纠正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播或增加计算开销。③改进点在于通用性，适用于多种架构和模型大小。④在8种架构、4种模型大小和4个数据集上，全面提升了梯度方法的忠实度、完备性误差和分割AP，优于现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses gradient-based explanation failures in Transformers by identifying gradient flow imbalances violating FullGrad-completeness. It proposes LibraGrad, a post-hoc method that corrects imbalances via pruning and scaling backward paths without altering forward pass. Extensive experiments across 8 architectures and 4 datasets show universal improvements over existing white-box methods on faithfulness, completeness error, and segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 该论文理论扎实，实验全面，对可解释性研究有重要贡献。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad，通过梯度平衡修正提升Transformer归因质量。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 基于FullGrad完备性的梯度流平衡方法。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在多种架构和数据集上全面优于现有方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型在压缩时因启发式剪枝导致视觉保真度下降和前景细节丢失的问题。②提出了PUP 3D-GS，一种基于敏感度剪枝分数的原则性方法，通过训练视图重建误差的二阶近似计算每个高斯空间参数的敏感度。③改进点在于采用多轮剪枝-精炼流程，适用于任何预训练3D-GS模型。④在显著更高的压缩比下，相比现有方法保持了视觉保真度和前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual fidelity degradation in 3D Gaussian Splatting compression caused by heuristic pruning. It proposes PUP 3D-GS, a principled sensitivity score based on second-order approximation of reconstruction error, with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline. The method achieves higher compression ratios while preserving fidelity and foreground details compared to existing approaches.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 该论文为3D场景压缩提供了理论驱动的剪枝策略，对资源受限设备有实际意义。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶敏感度的3D-GS剪枝方法PUP 3D-GS。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 利用重建误差二阶近似作为剪枝分数，结合多轮精炼。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度和前景细节。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D点云配准中两阶段流程（初始成对配准和全局一致性优化）无法联合优化、且初始配准易受低重叠和场景对称性影响的问题。②提出了首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，联合学习成对匹配和全局一致性细化，通过可微分模块实现整体训练。③相比现有方法，创新性地将两阶段问题统一为单一学习框架，避免了手工设计的全局优化步骤，降低了计算成本。④在公开基准数据集上显著优于现有最先进方法，同时端到端可训练且计算开销更低，并提供了详细的消融实验验证各组件有效性。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of multiview 3D point cloud registration by proposing the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly optimizes pairwise alignment and global consistency refinement. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets with lower computational cost, validated through extensive ablation studies.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 该工作将多视角配准的两阶段流程统一为端到端学习框架，对3D感知中的多帧融合具有重要参考价值，尤其适用于自动驾驶中的多帧点云建图。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多视角3D点云配准算法，联合优化成对配准与全局一致性。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准问题转化为单一可微学习框架，实现联合训练。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在公开基准上显著超越现有方法，且计算成本更低。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: ①针对从单张图像重建3D物体时依赖3D监督或多视角监督的问题，提出仅需单视角图像和轮廓的自监督方法。②通过可微点云渲染器进行2D监督，联合学习3D点云重建和姿态估计网络，并引入随机采样姿态的3D几何推理和循环一致性约束。③相比现有方法，减少了监督需求，仅需图像集合和轮廓，且支持测试时优化。④在ShapeNet和Pix3D数据集上，尽管使用更少监督，性能与姿态监督方法相当。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This work tackles 3D object reconstruction from single images by proposing a self-supervised method that requires only image collections and silhouettes, without pose or 3D supervision. It jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation via differentiable rendering and cycle consistency, achieving competitive performance on ShapeNet and Pix3D.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 该研究降低了3D重建的监督门槛，对自动驾驶中无标注场景的物体建模有潜在应用价值。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅需单视角图像和轮廓的自监督3D点云重建与姿态估计方法。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 利用随机姿态旋转和循环一致性实现无监督3D几何推理。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上性能与姿态监督方法相当。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积操作局部感受野限制和连续深度预测精度不足的问题。②提出结合自注意力机制和离散视差体积预测的方法，自注意力捕捉非连续区域的全局上下文，离散预测提高深度精度。③相比现有自监督方法，通过全局信息建模和离散化输出提升深度估计质量。④在KITTI等数据集上，该方法显著提升了深度估计精度，尤其在高频细节区域。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention to capture global context and discrete disparity volume prediction for finer depth accuracy. The method outperforms existing approaches on benchmarks like KITTI, particularly in detail-rich regions.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自监督深度估计的瓶颈提出有效改进，对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计任务具有直接应用价值。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 提出自注意力与离散视差体积相结合的自监督单目深度估计方法。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力建模全局上下文，并采用离散预测提升精度。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上显著提升深度估计精度。

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目场景流估计这一病态问题，即从连续两帧图像同时恢复3D结构和运动，现有方法精度低且缺乏实用方案。②提出一种单卷积神经网络，从经典光流代价体积中同时估计深度和3D运动，采用自监督学习，结合3D损失函数和遮挡推理以利用无标注数据。③相比已有工作，通过逆问题视角设计网络，并验证了代理损失和数据增强策略的有效性。④在无监督/自监督方法中达到最先进精度，光流和单目深度估计子任务也表现优异，半监督微调进一步提升精度并实现实时性能。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed monocular scene flow estimation problem by designing a single CNN that jointly estimates depth and 3D motion from an optical flow cost volume, using self-supervised learning with 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised methods and competitive results on subtasks, with real-time performance after semi-supervised fine-tuning.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督单目场景流领域具有代表性，方法设计巧妙且实验充分，对3D感知研究有参考价值。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于逆问题视角的自监督单目场景流估计网络，实现实时高精度3D运动估计。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 将光流代价体积与3D损失和遮挡推理结合，实现单网络联合估计深度和运动。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在无监督/自监督方法中达到最先进精度，并支持实时推理。
