Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶深度估计有高相关性，去除LiDAR依赖是重要趋势。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出无需LiDAR的自监督深度估计方法，基于MED概率体积。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 利用概率体积处理深度估计中的不确定性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 效果未知，但方法具有应用潜力。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人体3D姿态估计中，如何有效利用多视角几何信息进行深度估计的问题。②提出了基于平面扫描立体匹配的方法，通过构建代价体并回归深度图，进而估计3D姿态。③相比直接使用三角化或单目方法，平面扫描能更好地处理遮挡和纹理缺失，且可端到端训练。④在公开数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by leveraging plane sweep stereo to construct cost volumes for depth regression. It improves over triangulation-based methods by handling occlusions and texture-less regions more robustly, achieving competitive results on public benchmarks.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该方法将经典立体匹配引入3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但创新性一般，适合作为多视角感知的参考工作。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 利用平面扫描代价体替代直接三角化，提升深度估计鲁棒性。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上取得有竞争力的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: ①针对跨视角、跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，即如何利用多个视角的图像进行准确计数。②提出了一个跨视角跨场景的计数框架，可能通过特征对齐或视角融合来提升计数精度。③相比单视角计数，多视角能提供互补信息，但需解决视角差异和场景泛化问题。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个数据集上有效。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This work tackles cross-view and cross-scene multi-view crowd counting, proposing a framework that aligns features across views to improve counting accuracy. It addresses the challenge of viewpoint variation and scene generalization, demonstrating effectiveness on multiple datasets.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 多视角计数是实际应用中的重要问题，但论文摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 通过跨视角特征对齐提升计数泛化能力。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角聚类中，如何利用对比预测进行缺失视角补全和聚类的问题。②提出了COMPLETER方法，通过对比预测学习视角间的共享表示，并处理缺失数据。③相比传统多视角聚类，该方法能处理不完整数据，并利用自监督信号增强表示。④摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在聚类任务上优于现有方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper introduces COMPLETER for incomplete multi-view clustering, using contrastive prediction to learn shared representations and handle missing views. It improves over traditional methods by leveraging self-supervised signals, achieving better clustering performance.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，主要面向通用聚类任务，创新性一般。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 利用对比学习处理缺失视角并增强表示。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在聚类任务上优于现有方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: ①针对无纹理光滑表面在未知反射率下的多视角3D重建问题。②提出了一种结合光度立体和几何重建的方法，估计表面形状和反射率。③相比传统多视角立体，该方法能处理无纹理表面，但计算复杂度较高。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在合成和真实数据上有效。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown reflectance, combining photometric stereo and geometric cues. It handles challenging surfaces but with increased computational cost, showing effectiveness on synthetic and real data.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该论文偏向传统3D重建，与自动驾驶感知的关联度较低，但方法有一定参考价值。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知反射率下无纹理表面的多视角重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 结合光度与几何信息处理无纹理表面。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频流中的在线多视角深度预测问题，即如何利用历史帧信息提升当前帧的深度估计。②提出了DeepVideoMVS，在编码器-解码器架构的瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM，并通过视角变换传播隐藏状态，实现时空融合。③相比静态多视角立体方法，该方法能利用时序信息，且计算开销小，保持实时性能。④在数百个室内场景中，大多数评估指标上优于现有最先进方法，并保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS for online multi-view depth prediction on video streams, using a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck to propagate temporal information with viewpoint-aware warping. It outperforms state-of-the-art multi-view stereo methods on most metrics in hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该方法在时序融合和实时性方面有显著优势，对自动驾驶中的动态场景深度估计有重要参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于ConvLSTM和视角感知传播的实时视频多视角深度预测方法。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 通过视角变换传播隐藏状态，实现高效时空融合。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在室内场景中超越现有方法，保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督非刚性表面配准中，高自由度变换和缺乏标注数据的问题。②提出了RMA-Net，将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的组合，并通过循环框架迭代求解，同时使用多视角深度图像上的可微损失进行端到端训练。③相比直接回归非刚性变换，该表示约束了解空间，降低了学习难度，且无需真值监督。④在多个数据集上大幅优于先前最先进方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces RMA-Net for unsupervised non-rigid surface registration, representing transformations as combinations of rigid ones and using a recurrent framework with differentiable multi-view depth losses. It outperforms previous state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets, enabling end-to-end learning without ground truth.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该方法在无监督配准中具有创新性，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联度中等，可作为自监督学习的参考。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出基于刚性组合表示和循环框架的无监督非刚性配准方法。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用刚性变换组合约束非刚性解空间，并利用多视角深度损失实现无监督训练。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图图像密集深度估计中稀疏点扩散优化困难的问题，提出一种可微扩散方法，通过优化点位置、深度和权重，利用高斯样点溅射和解析透射率最小化多视图重投影误差。相比传统优化和深度学习方法，该方法能高效处理5万+点，并在光场和宽基线图像上通过自监督提升深度图质量，平均误差和离群误差均有改善。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by proposing a differentiable diffusion method that optimizes sparse points via Gaussian splatting with analytic transmittance. It enables efficient optimization of 50k+ points and improves depth accuracy on light field and wide-baseline images through self-supervision, reducing average and outlier errors.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 该方法将可微渲染与深度优化结合，具有创新性，对多视图三维重建有参考价值。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架用于多视图密集深度估计。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 利用高斯溅射和解析透射率实现可微优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场和宽基线数据上显著降低深度误差。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: 针对多视图深度估计中时序信息利用不足的问题，提出极线时空网络，通过结合极线几何和时空特征提升深度预测精度。方法利用多帧信息增强深度一致性，但摘要缺失，具体细节和实验数据未提供。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper proposes an epipolar spatio-temporal network for multi-view depth estimation, integrating geometric and temporal cues to improve depth accuracy. However, the abstract is incomplete, lacking specific method details and experimental results.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 选题相关但信息不完整，需进一步查阅全文评估。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出极线时空网络用于多视图深度估计。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 融合极线几何与时空特征。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图聚类中表示对齐的缺陷，指出朴素对齐会导致簇不可分和视图优先级丧失，提出避免对齐的简单基线模型，并引入对比学习实现选择性对齐。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上优于现有技术，大幅提升聚类性能。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naive representation alignment in multi-view clustering, such as less separable clusters and reduced view prioritization, and proposes a baseline without alignment plus a contrastive selective alignment component. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 对聚类领域有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 重新审视表示对齐并提出改进基线。
2103.07738|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅提升聚类精度。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图立体匹配中3D代价体积正则化计算量大、内存占用高的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，一种可学习的级联Patchmatch框架，引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch和自适应传播评估方案。相比现有最优方法，速度提升至少2.5倍，内存减半，在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上性能极具竞争力。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: PatchmatchNet introduces a learnable cascade Patchmatch for multi-view stereo, replacing 3D cost volume regularization with iterative multi-scale matching and adaptive propagation. It achieves competitive accuracy on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D while being at least 2.5x faster and using half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 高效且性能优异，对资源受限的自动驾驶设备极具价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出高效可学习的多视图立体匹配框架。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 迭代多尺度Patchmatch和自适应传播。
2012.01411|v2.result: 速度提升2.5倍以上，内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对新视图合成中泛化能力不足的问题，提出IBRNet，通过多层感知机和射线变换器从多个源视图动态提取外观信息，估计辐射和体积密度。该方法学习通用视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景，在多个基准上优于现有泛化方法，微调后可与单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: IBRNet synthesizes novel views by interpolating sparse nearby views using a network with MLP and ray transformer, drawing appearance from source views at render time. It learns a generic view interpolation function that generalizes to new scenes, outperforming prior generalization methods and matching single-scene neural rendering after fine-tuning.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 在视图合成领域有重要贡献，但自动驾驶应用场景有限。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出可泛化的图像基渲染网络。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 射线变换器动态提取多视图信息。
2102.13090|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有泛化方法。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_cn: 针对多视图立体中深度估计依赖标注数据的问题，提出自监督学习方法，利用多视图一致性作为监督信号训练深度推断网络。摘要缺失，具体方法和实验数据未提供，但主题与自动驾驶深度估计高度相关。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised depth inference for multi-view stereo, leveraging multi-view consistency as supervision. The abstract is incomplete, lacking method details and results, but the topic is highly relevant to autonomous driving.
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.assessment: 主题相关但信息不全，需查阅全文评估。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.contribution: 探索自监督多视图深度估计。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.innovation: 利用多视图一致性监督。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中数据关联的挑战，如光照变化、运动模式差异和跨相机轨迹遮挡，提出动态图模型与链接预测（DyGLIP）方法。该方法通过动态图建模和链接预测改进特征表示，并能从相机切换时的轨迹丢失中恢复。相比现有方法，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越，且对相机重叠率不敏感，支持在线和增量设置。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association challenges in multi-camera multi-object tracking, such as lighting variations and trajectory occlusions, by proposing a dynamic graph model with link prediction (DyGLIP). It improves feature representations and recovers from lost tracks during camera transitions, outperforming existing methods on multiple datasets and being robust to camera overlap ratios.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 该工作对多相机跟踪中的数据关联问题提供了新视角，动态图模型具有实用价值，值得关注。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图和链接预测的MC-MOT数据关联方法。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 利用动态图模型和链接预测增强特征表示和轨迹恢复能力。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有MC-MOT算法。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对宽基线多相机标定中3D关键点匹配困难的问题，提出利用行人重识别（re-ID）技术将行人作为关键点进行跨相机关联，从而获取对应关系并求解相机位姿。方法先通过re-ID关联行人边界框，再转换为点对应，最后用多视图几何和光束法平差优化。该方法无需专用标定目标，适用于频繁标定更新的场景，并在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration by using person re-identification to associate pedestrians across views as keypoints, converting bounding box correspondences to point correspondences, and solving camera poses via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. It avoids specialized calibration targets and is suitable for frequent recalibration, with experiments on diverse datasets.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 该工作将re-ID用于标定，思路新颖，但应用场景相对特定，相关度中等。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出基于行人重识别的宽基线相机标定方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 将行人作为可重识别的关键点替代传统标定目标。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个场景数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中回归方法忽略深度顺序关系的问题，提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式排序方法，作为成对排序的推广。方法结合最先进的神经网络架构和简单采样策略降低训练复杂度，并利用PL模型作为随机效用模型的表示，从排序数据中恢复平移不变的度量深度。在多个基准数据集上的零样本评估中展示了有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by proposing a listwise ranking method based on the Plackett-Luce model, generalizing pairwise ranking approaches. It integrates a state-of-the-art network with a sampling strategy to reduce complexity and recovers shift-invariant metric depth from ranking data, showing effectiveness in zero-shot evaluations on benchmarks.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 该工作从排序角度处理深度估计，具有理论创新性，但与自动驾驶感知的直接相关度较低。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于Plackett-Luce模型的列表式排序深度估计方法。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 利用列表式排序和随机效用模型恢复度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上零样本评估表现良好。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计模型输出分辨率低且缺乏细节的问题，提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法。方法基于输入分辨率和场景结构对深度估计影响的分析，通过合并低分辨率和高分辨率估计来平衡场景结构一致性和高频细节，使用简单的深度合并网络和补丁选择方法增强局部细节。实验表明，利用预训练模型可生成多兆像素的高细节深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses low-resolution and detail-poor depth maps from monocular depth estimation by proposing a content-adaptive multi-resolution merging method. It merges low- and high-resolution estimations to balance scene structure and high-frequency details, using a depth merging network and patch selection, enabling multi-megapixel depth maps with pre-trained models.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 该工作提升了深度估计的实用性，但创新性有限，相关度中等。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应多分辨率合并方法提升深度图分辨率和细节。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 利用分辨率与场景结构的权衡进行深度估计合并。
2105.14021|v2.result: 生成多兆像素高细节深度图。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场在动态场景中失去预测能力的问题，提出STaR方法，实现多视角RGB视频中刚性运动物体的自监督跟踪和重建。方法显式建模物体刚性运动，通过联合优化两个神经辐射场和一组刚性位姿，将动态场景分解为静态背景和运动物体。在合成和真实数据集上，无需人工标注即可渲染逼真的新视图，并在空间和时间上展示泛化能力。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the loss of predictive power in neural radiance fields for dynamic scenes by proposing STaR, a self-supervised method for tracking and reconstructing rigid objects in motion from multi-view videos. It jointly optimizes two radiance fields and rigid poses to decompose scenes, enabling photorealistic novel view rendering on synthetic and real datasets without annotations.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 该工作结合神经渲染和动态场景建模，具有较高创新性和应用潜力。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的刚性物体动态场景跟踪与重建方法。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对表格数据中自监督学习难以设计有效数据增强方法的问题，因为表格数据缺乏图像、音频等数据的空间、时间或语义结构。②提出了SubTab框架，通过将输入特征划分为多个子集，将表格数据学习转化为多视角表示学习问题，并在自编码器设置中从特征子集重建数据而非使用损坏版本，以更好地捕捉潜在表示。③相比已有工作，SubTab利用特征子集重建而非数据增强，并引入协作推理（collaborative inference）在测试时聚合子集的潜在变量作为联合表示。④实验表明SubTab在多个表格数据集上达到了最先进性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of self-supervised learning on tabular data, where designing effective augmentations is difficult due to lack of spatial or semantic structure. It proposes SubTab, a framework that divides input features into subsets to create a multi-view representation learning problem, reconstructing data from feature subsets in an autoencoder to capture latent representations. The method introduces collaborative inference for aggregating subset latents at test time, and experiments show state-of-the-art performance on tabular datasets, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 该论文针对表格数据自监督学习的难点提出新颖框架，虽与自动驾驶视觉领域相关性有限，但方法具有通用性，值得关注。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出了SubTab框架，通过特征子集划分实现表格数据的自监督多视角表示学习。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 创新性地将特征子集重建与协作推理结合，替代传统数据增强方法。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在多个表格数据集上达到最先进性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: ①针对程序性活动理解中缺乏大规模多视角数据集的问题，现有数据集规模小且视角单一。②提出了Assembly101数据集，包含4321个视频，101种可拆卸玩具车辆的组装与拆卸过程，同时记录8个静态和4个第一人称视角，并标注了超过100K粗粒度、1M细粒度动作片段和18M 3D手部姿态。③相比已有工作，首次提供多视角动作数据集，支持跨视角迁移、长尾分布和姿态与外观对比研究，并新增错误检测任务。④在识别、预测和时间分割三个任务上进行了基准测试，展示了数据集对多种活动理解问题的挑战性。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Assembly101, a large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset with 4321 videos of assembling/disassembling 101 toy vehicles, featuring 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It enables benchmarking on recognition, anticipation, temporal segmentation, and a novel mistake detection task, supporting studies on generalization, cross-view transfer, and long-tailed distributions. The dataset provides a new challenge for activity understanding research.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富，多视角设计独特，为程序性活动理解提供了新基准，值得关注。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并提出了错误检测新任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 首次结合静态和第一人称视角，并引入错误检测任务。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在多个任务上建立基准，展示了数据集对活动理解研究的广泛适用性。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对多视角相机3D目标检测中跨传感器信息融合不足的问题，现有方法多依赖局部特征交互。②提出了SpatialDETR，一种基于Transformer的3D检测器，通过全局跨传感器注意力机制，在空间位置嵌入中融合多相机特征。③相比已有工作，该方法实现了可扩展的全局注意力，增强了跨视角一致性。④在nuScenes等基准上展示了鲁棒性和性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: SpatialDETR addresses multi-view 3D object detection by introducing a transformer-based framework with global cross-sensor attention, enabling scalable fusion of multi-camera features via spatial position embeddings. It improves cross-view consistency and robustness compared to prior local interaction methods. The approach demonstrates strong performance on standard benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该方法在跨传感器融合上具有创新性，对多相机3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出全局跨传感器注意力机制，提升多视角3D检测性能。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 利用空间位置嵌入实现全局注意力，增强跨视角信息融合。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 在基准测试中表现出鲁棒性和性能提升。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer._arxiv_id: SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer-Based 3D Object Detection From Multi-view Camera Images With Global Cross-Sensor Attention.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对半监督目标检测中伪标签噪声和一致性训练不足的问题，现有方法忽略定位精度和特征级一致性。②提出了PseCo框架，包含Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL)和Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL)，NPL通过预测引导的标签分配和正提案一致性投票处理噪声伪框，MSL引入多视图尺度不变学习。③相比已有工作，同时优化了标签和特征级一致性，增强了尺度不变性。④在COCO等数据集上显著提升了半监督检测性能，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo tackles semi-supervised object detection by addressing noisy pseudo boxes and insufficient consistency training, introducing Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with prediction-guided label assignment and positive-proposal consistency voting, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level consistency. It improves robustness to coarse pseudo boxes and scale invariance, leading to notable performance gains on benchmarks like COCO.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了半监督检测中的关键问题，方法设计合理，实验充分。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出NPL和MSL机制，提升半监督目标检测的鲁棒性和精度。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 结合标签和特征级一致性训练，处理噪声伪框。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D目标检测中标注成本高的问题，半监督方法利用未标注数据但缺乏多视角一致性。②提出了基于多视角一致性的半监督单目3D检测方法，利用不同视角的几何一致性生成伪标签。③相比已有工作，增强了跨视角的监督信号，提高了伪标签质量。④在KITTI等数据集上展示了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection by leveraging multi-view consistency to generate high-quality pseudo labels, improving geometric coherence across views. It enhances supervision from unlabeled data compared to prior methods. Performance gains are demonstrated on datasets like KITTI, though specific metrics are not given in the abstract.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 方法思路新颖，利用多视角一致性提升半监督3D检测，但实验细节有限。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出多视角一致性驱动的半监督单目3D检测方法。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用跨视角几何一致性生成伪标签。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 在基准数据集上取得性能提升。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D目标检测中位置信息编码不足的问题，现有方法难以有效融合3D坐标与图像特征。②提出了PETR，通过位置嵌入变换将3D坐标编码为位置感知特征，使对象查询直接感知3D信息，实现端到端检测。③相比已有工作，简化了检测流程，无需复杂的视角变换，提升了特征表示能力。④在nuScenes数据集上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一，成为强基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: PETR introduces position embedding transformation to encode 3D coordinates into image features, enabling object queries to perceive 3D position-aware features for end-to-end multi-view 3D detection. It simplifies the pipeline and improves feature representation, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes with 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP, ranking first on the benchmark. The method serves as a strong baseline for future research.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR是开创性工作，性能卓越，代码开源，对多视角3D检测领域影响深远。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出位置嵌入变换方法，实现高效的多视角3D目标检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 将3D坐标直接编码为位置感知特征，简化端到端检测。
2203.05625|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得SOTA性能，排名第一。

Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云运动估计中多视角融合效率低、速度慢的问题。②提出了一种序列多视角融合网络，通过逐步融合不同视角的特征来加速运动估计。③相比现有并行融合方法，该方法减少了计算冗余，提高了推理速度。④在标准数据集上实现了与现有方法相当的精度，同时显著降低了计算开销。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of multi-view fusion in LiDAR point motion estimation. It proposes a sequential fusion network that progressively integrates multi-view features to accelerate estimation. Compared to parallel fusion methods, it reduces computational redundancy and improves inference speed. Experiments show comparable accuracy with significantly lower computational cost.
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.assessment: 该论文聚焦于效率优化，对实时自动驾驶系统有实用价值，但创新性一般。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.contribution: 提出了一种序列多视角融合策略，用于快速LiDAR点运动估计。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.innovation: 以序列融合替代并行融合，降低计算复杂度。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.result: 在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度。

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督多视图立体匹配中非朗伯表面和遮挡导致的对应关系模糊问题。②提出了RC-MVSNet，引入神经渲染技术，通过深度渲染一致性损失约束几何特征靠近物体表面以缓解遮挡，并利用参考视图合成损失生成一致监督。③相比现有无监督方法，该方法能更好地处理真实场景中的复杂光照和遮挡。④在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准上达到无监督MVS的最优性能，并接近许多监督方法。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the ambiguity of correspondences in unsupervised MVS caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions. It proposes RC-MVSNet with neural rendering, using a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry features near surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss for consistent supervision. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS methods and competitive results with supervised approaches on DTU and Tanks&Temples benchmarks.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 该论文将神经渲染引入无监督MVS，有效解决了关键难点，实验充分，具有较高研究价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督MVS框架，解决遮挡和非朗伯表面问题。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 利用渲染一致性损失和视图合成损失增强对应关系学习。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到无监督SOTA，接近监督方法性能。

KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.summary_cn: ①针对多视图立体匹配中自监督学习性能不足的问题。②提出了KD-MVS，利用知识蒸馏技术，将教师模型的深度预测知识迁移到学生模型，以提升自监督学习效果。③相比纯自监督方法，该方法通过蒸馏引入了更丰富的监督信号。④在标准MVS数据集上，性能优于现有自监督方法。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited performance of self-supervised MVS. It proposes KD-MVS, which uses knowledge distillation to transfer depth prediction knowledge from a teacher model to a student model, enhancing self-supervised learning. This approach provides richer supervision signals compared to pure self-supervised methods. Experiments show improved performance over existing self-supervised approaches on standard MVS benchmarks.
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.assessment: 该论文将知识蒸馏应用于MVS自监督学习，思路合理，但创新性有限。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.contribution: 提出知识蒸馏框架提升自监督MVS性能。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.innovation: 利用教师模型蒸馏知识增强学生模型训练。
KD-MVS: Knowledge Distillation Based Sel.result: 在MVS基准上优于现有自监督方法。

FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D人体运动重建中依赖外部相机参数的问题。②提出了FLEX方法，无需外参即可从多视角图像重建3D人体运动。③通过设计无外参的模型架构，简化了应用流程。④在相关数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependency on extrinsic camera parameters in multi-view 3D human motion reconstruction. It proposes FLEX, a method that reconstructs 3D human motion from multi-view images without requiring extrinsic parameters. By designing an architecture that bypasses extrinsic calibration, it simplifies the application pipeline. Experiments validate its effectiveness on relevant datasets.
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.assessment: 该论文解决了实际应用中的外参依赖问题，但领域相关性较低。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.contribution: 提出无需外参的多视角3D人体运动重建方法。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.innovation: 设计无外参的模型架构，消除标定需求。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi.result: 在数据集上验证了有效重建性能。
FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-vi._arxiv_id: FLEX: Extrinsic Parameters-free Multi-view 3D Human Motion Reconstruction.

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统多视图场景表示方法依赖特定几何约束、泛化能力差的问题。②提出了Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe)，学习隐式的多视图一致场景表示，并引入3D数据增强作为几何先验，同时将视图合成作为辅助任务。③相比传统方法，DeFiNe不依赖显式几何约束，提高了泛化能力。④在立体和视频深度估计任务上达到SOTA，并在零样本域泛化上大幅提升。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of traditional multi-view scene representation methods that rely on explicit geometric constraints. It proposes Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe), which learn an implicit multi-view consistent representation, using 3D data augmentation as a geometric prior and view synthesis as an auxiliary task. DeFiNe achieves state-of-the-art results in stereo and video depth estimation without explicit constraints, and significantly improves zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 该论文将通用Transformer思想扩展到多视图场景表示，创新性强，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出隐式多视图场景表示网络DeFiNe，无需显式几何约束。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 利用3D数据增强和视图合成辅助任务提升泛化能力。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在深度估计任务上达到SOTA，零样本泛化大幅提升。

Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient use of multi-view features in facial emotion recognition. It proposes an emotion-aware multi-view contrastive learning method that incorporates emotion information to enhance feature learning. Compared to standard contrastive learning, it uses emotion labels as supervision. Experiments show improvements on facial emotion recognition datasets.

Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.innovation: 将情感标签融入对比学习框架。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea.result: 在情绪识别数据集上取得性能提升。
Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Lea._arxiv_id: Emotion-aware Multi-view Contrastive Learning for Facial Emotion Recognition.

MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_cn: ①针对多视角全方位深度估计问题，现有方法难以有效融合多个360度相机的信息。②提出了MODE方法，利用多视角几何和深度学习技术，从多个360度相机图像中估计全方位深度图。③相比单目或稀疏视角方法，MODE通过显式建模相机间几何关系，提高了深度估计的准确性和鲁棒性。④在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据，效果需进一步确认。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view omnidirectional depth estimation using multiple 360-degree cameras. It proposes MODE, a method that leverages multi-view geometry and deep learning to fuse information from multiple cameras for accurate depth maps. Compared to monocular or sparse-view approaches, MODE improves accuracy and robustness by explicitly modeling inter-camera geometry. Experiments on multiple datasets validate its effectiveness, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.assessment: 该论文针对360度相机深度估计这一特定场景，具有应用价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需详细阅读正文评估。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.contribution: 提出了一种多视角全方位深度估计方法，利用360度相机阵列提升深度精度。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.innovation: 显式建模多相机几何关系以融合全方位信息。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但未提供具体数值。
MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth E._arxiv_id: MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth Estimation with 360$\circ $ Cameras.

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像中头发几何和外观建模的挑战，现有方法难以同时实现高精度和实时渲染。②提出了Neural Strands，一种基于神经头皮纹理的头发表示，编码每根发丝的几何和外观，并引入基于光栅化的神经渲染框架。③相比体积方法，该方法支持直观的形状和风格控制，且渲染实时、视图一致。④首次实现多视角设置下外观和显式头发几何的联合学习，在保真度和效率上优于现有方法。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of modeling hair geometry and appearance from multi-view images, where existing methods struggle with accuracy and real-time rendering. It proposes Neural Strands, a novel representation using a neural scalp texture encoding per-strand geometry and appearance, with a rasterization-based neural rendering framework. Unlike volumetric methods, it enables intuitive shape/style control and real-time, view-consistent rendering. It achieves, for the first time, joint learning of appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view inputs, demonstrating superior fidelity and efficiency.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该论文在头发建模领域具有创新性，结合了显式几何和神经渲染，对数字人和影视制作有重要价值。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经发丝的多视角头发建模方法，实现高保真实时渲染。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 利用神经头皮纹理编码发丝级几何和外观，并采用光栅化神经渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上展示了高保真度和高效性。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: ①针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，现有自监督方法在2D或3D单独使用效果有限。②提出了MvDeCor，利用多视角渲染和对比学习框架进行密集对应学习，使2D表示具有视图不变性和几何一致性。③相比仅使用2D或3D自监督的方法，MvDeCor在有限标注下泛化更好，尤其受益于2D处理和3D几何推理的结合。④在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，细粒度分割性能优于现有方法，且在稀疏视角或纹理形状下改进更大。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses fine-grained 3D shape segmentation with limited labeled data, where existing self-supervised methods in 2D or 3D alone are insufficient. It proposes MvDeCor, which renders shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent 2D representations. Compared to alternatives, it generalizes better with limited labels, benefiting from combined 2D processing and 3D reasoning. Experiments on RenderPeople and PartNet show superior performance, especially with sparse views or textured shapes.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙结合2D自监督和3D几何，为3D分割提供了一种高效方案，具有较强实用价值。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于多视角密集对应学习的自监督方法，用于细粒度3D分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习在2D视图上学习视图不变和几何一致的表示。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在稀疏视角和纹理场景下。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准数据集的问题。②构建了一个包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型和847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集，并半自动标注相机位姿和物体位姿。③相比合成数据集，该数据集提供真实世界图像，更贴近实际应用，支持形状重建、姿态估计等任务。④数据集公开可用，并提供了标注工具和评估基线，填补了多视角3D重建的空白。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction. It presents a dataset of 998 3D models and 847,000 real RGB-D images with semi-automated camera and object pose annotations. Compared to synthetic datasets, it offers real-world images closer to practical applications, supporting tasks like shape reconstruction and pose estimation. The dataset is publicly available with annotation tools and baselines, filling a gap in the field.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有重要支撑作用，但方法创新性有限，主要贡献在于资源提供。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 构建了一个大规模真实世界多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 半自动标注流程和公开工具链。
2203.11397|v2.result: 提供了847,000张图像和998个模型，填补了真实基准空白。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体匹配中成本体积融合效率低和3D空间关联利用不足的问题。②提出了MVSTER，利用极线Transformer同时学习2D语义和3D空间关联，并采用级联结构和熵正则化最优传输传播深度估计。③相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet，MVSTER避免了额外网络学习2D信息，提高了效率并充分利用3D关联。④在DTU基准上，相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别获得34%和14%的相对提升，实现了最先进的性能。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient cost volume fusion and underuse of 3D spatial correlations in multi-view stereo. It proposes MVSTER, which uses an epipolar Transformer to learn 2D semantics and 3D associations, with a cascade structure and entropy-regularized optimal transport for depth propagation. Compared to MVSNet and CasMVSNet, it avoids extra networks for 2D cues, improving efficiency and 3D correlation use. On DTU, it achieves 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet, respectively, reaching state-of-the-art performance.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该论文在MVS领域有显著性能提升，极线Transformer设计具有创新性，对3D重建和自动驾驶有参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于极线Transformer的高效多视角立体匹配方法。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 利用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上相对MVSNet提升34%，相对CasMVSNet提升14%。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视角域适应问题，即不同视角数据缺失和分布差异。②提出了通过通道增强和知识迁移的方法，但摘要未提供具体技术细节。③相比现有域适应方法，该方法可能更关注多视角场景下的不完整性。④由于摘要不完整，无法评估具体效果。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view domain adaptation, where data from different views are missing and distributions differ. It proposes a method using channel enhancement and knowledge transfer, but the abstract lacks technical details. Compared to existing domain adaptation methods, it focuses on multi-view incompleteness. Due to the incomplete abstract, specific results cannot be assessed.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 该论文摘要信息不足，方法细节和效果不明确，研究价值需进一步确认。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出了针对不完整多视角域适应的通道增强和知识迁移方法。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 结合通道增强处理多视角数据不完整性。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法因多阶段分离处理导致误差累积的问题。②提出PS-NeRF，一种基于隐式神经表示的逆渲染方法，联合估计非朗伯物体的几何、材质和光照，利用多光图像估计法线图以正则化神经辐射场，并通过阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化。③相比现有MVPS和神经渲染方法，创新性地将光度立体与神经辐射场结合，实现端到端联合优化，减少阶段间误差。④在合成和真实数据集上，形状重建精度显著优于现有方法，并支持新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) pipelines by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method that jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights using implicit representation. It integrates multi-light normal estimation with neural radiance field regularization and shadow-aware differentiable rendering, achieving significantly more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods on synthetic and real datasets.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该论文在逆渲染与神经辐射场结合方面有创新，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心领域（如检测、BEV、占用）相关性较低，主要面向图形学与三维重建。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出首个将多视角光度立体与神经辐射场联合优化的逆渲染框架PS-NeRF。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 利用多光法线图正则化神经辐射场，并通过阴影感知渲染实现几何、材质和光照的联合优化。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据上形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对购物场景中多视角图像的无遮挡实例分割缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了MUVA，一个大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割基准数据集，并可能包含基线方法。③相比现有实例分割数据集，该基准专门针对购物场景中的遮挡问题，提供了多视角标注。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果数据未知，但作为新基准，其价值在于填补该特定场景的数据空白。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios. It introduces MUVA, a new dataset with multi-view annotations to tackle occlusion. The contribution is a specialized benchmark for this domain, though specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 该论文主要贡献是数据集，对购物场景的感知研究有一定价值，但与自动驾驶核心方向相关性较低。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了购物场景下首个大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割基准MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 针对购物场景的遮挡问题，设计了多视角无遮挡标注基准。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: ①针对车车协同感知中现有方法仅支持同质传感器（如全用LiDAR或全用相机）的问题，限制了协作规模和跨模态交互。②提出了HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异质模态协同感知框架，支持不同数量和类型的智能体（如相机和LiDAR混合）进行3D目标预测。③设计了异质3D图Transformer，联合推理智能体间和智能体内部交互，有效融合多视角图像和LiDAR点云特征。④在OPV2V数据集上，HM-ViT优于SOTA协同感知方法，展示了异质模态协作的优越性。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of heterogeneous-modal cooperative perception in V2V, where agents have different sensor types. It proposes HM-ViT, the first unified framework for multi-agent hetero-modal 3D object detection, using a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR. Experiments on OPV2V show it outperforms SOTA cooperative perception methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了协同感知中的关键实际挑战（异质传感器），具有较高的应用价值，方法设计新颖。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个支持异质模态智能体的V2V协同感知框架HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异质3D图Transformer，联合建模智能体间和内部交互以融合多模态特征。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在OPV2V数据集上超越SOTA协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: ①针对域偏移下目标检测性能下降，现有域对抗学习（DAL）方法忽略公共特征中隐含的非因果因素的问题。②提出了基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含伪相关生成器（SCG）和多视角域分类器（MVDC）。③SCG通过随机增强增加源域多样性，MVDC将特征映射到多个潜在空间以去除非因果因素，纯化域不变特征。④摘要不完整，但方法在理论上通过因果机制改进了域泛化能力。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of non-causal factors in domain-invariant features for object detection under domain shift. It proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) model with a Spurious Correlations Generator and a Multi-View Domain Classifier to purify features. The approach leverages causal mechanisms to improve domain generalization, though specific results are not fully provided.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 该论文从因果视角改进域泛化，思路有创新性，对跨域目标检测有参考价值。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器MAD，用于去除目标检测中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角对抗训练，在多个潜在空间中识别并移除非因果特征。
2304.02950|v2.result: 具体效果未在摘要中完整给出。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: ①针对纯相机3D检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作来提升性能，而非仅依赖网络结构改进。②提出了CoCa3D，一种协作式纯相机3D检测框架，智能体间共享互补信息，并优化通信效率以选择最有信息量的线索。③多视角共享信息消除了单智能体深度估计的歧义，并补充了遮挡和远距离区域。④在DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+和CoPerception-UAVs+上，AP@70分别提升了44.21%、30.60%和12.59%，显著超越SOTA。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes CoCa3D, a collaborative camera-only 3D detection framework that improves depth estimation via multi-agent communication. By sharing complementary information and selecting informative cues, it disambiguates depth and handles occlusions. It achieves significant improvements over SOTA, with AP@70 gains of 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 该论文展示了协作感知对纯相机3D检测的巨大潜力，性能提升显著，具有重要研究价值。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机3D检测框架CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升深度估计。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 利用多视角协作信息，而非网络结构，来克服单相机深度估计的挑战。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，AP@70最高提升44.21%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: ①针对多视角点云配准中初始化和历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出了基于可靠位姿图初始化和历史重加权的鲁棒多视角点云配准方法。③通过改进初始化策略和重加权历史帧，提高了配准的鲁棒性。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果数据未知。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multiview point cloud registration by improving pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The method aims to enhance robustness in registration, but specific results are not available due to incomplete abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 该论文涉及点云配准，与3D感知相关，但摘要不完整，创新性和效果难以评估。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出鲁棒的多视角点云配准方法，优化位姿图初始化和历史重加权。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 在配准中引入可靠初始化和历史信息重加权策略。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: ①针对视觉中心自动驾驶中联合感知和预测的时序BEV表示学习问题。②提出了TBP-Former，学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔，用于联合3D目标检测和运动预测。③通过金字塔结构捕获多尺度时序信息，提升感知和预测的协同性。④摘要不完整，但方法在BEV感知领域具有创新性，预期能提升时序建模能力。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper proposes TBP-Former, a method for learning temporal Bird's-Eye-View pyramids to jointly perform perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving. It captures multi-scale temporal information to enhance coordination between detection and forecasting. Specific results are not provided in the incomplete abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 该论文针对BEV时序建模，对视觉中心自动驾驶的感知预测一体化有重要贡献。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出TBP-Former，学习时序BEV金字塔以联合感知和预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 引入金字塔结构来建模多尺度时序BEV特征。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 具体效果未在摘要中给出。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D-4D视图合成问题，提出了一种神经像素合成方法。由于摘要缺失，无法详细评估其具体技术细节。该方法可能涉及从多视图图像中学习像素级别的合成，以生成新的视图。相比已有工作，其改进点不明确。由于缺乏实验数据，效果无法量化。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D-4D view synthesis by proposing a neural pixel composition method. Due to the missing abstract, specific technical details cannot be assessed. The approach likely learns pixel-level composition from multi-view images to generate novel views. Improvements over existing work and quantitative results are unclear.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，该论文的贡献和影响力难以评估，相关性较低。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经像素合成的多视图3D-4D视图合成方法。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 利用像素级合成进行视图生成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类中样本缺失导致视图表示不一致和原型偏移的问题，提出了跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法利用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，引导视图间实例对应关系构建，并进一步对齐偏移的原型。相比现有对比学习方法，该方法允许视图间表示存在差异，提高了灵活性。实验效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN). It uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision for instance correspondence and aligns shifted prototypes. Unlike contrastive methods, it allows view discrepancy. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦于多视图聚类，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但方法有一定创新性。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出了CPSPAN网络，通过部分样本和原型对齐解决不完整多视图聚类问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 利用代理监督信号进行跨视图对齐，而非强制表示一致。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因多视图几何一致性被破坏而性能下降的问题，提出了一种学习融合单目和多视图线索的方法。方法将两种线索编码为体积，无需启发式掩码，并通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块，使静态区域的多视图几何信息传播到动态区域的单目表示，同时单目线索增强多视图代价体积。相比已有方法，该方法避免了掩码质量不可控的问题，更充分利用了两种线索的互补性。实验效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes by learning to fuse monocular and multi-view cues encoded as volumes, without heuristic masks. A cross-cue fusion (CCF) module propagates geometric information from static areas to monocular representations and enhances multi-view cost volumes. This avoids mask quality issues and better utilizes complementary cues. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶动态场景中的深度估计问题，方法新颖且实用，具有较高研究价值。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需掩码的跨线索融合方法，用于动态场景多帧深度估计。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 通过CCF模块实现单目与多视图线索的自适应融合。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文提出了OmniCity数据集，用于多层级、多视角的城市理解，包含卫星图像、街景全景和单视图图像，共超过10万张像素级标注图像，来自纽约市2.5万个地理位置。数据集提供了建筑足迹提取、高度估计、建筑平面/实例/细粒度分割等任务的基准。相比现有基准，OmniCity图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视角更多，并引入了街景全景图像上的细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。该数据集为多视角感知研究提供了新平台。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OmniCity, a dataset for multi-level and multi-view city understanding, with over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from satellite, panorama, and mono views across 25K locations in NYC. It provides benchmarks for building footprint extraction, height estimation, and segmentation tasks. Compared to existing benchmarks, it offers more images, richer annotations, and a new fine-grained building instance segmentation task. This dataset serves as a new platform for multi-view perception research.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 该数据集对多视角城市感知研究具有重要价值，与自动驾驶场景理解高度相关。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多视角城市理解数据集OmniCity，并提供多任务基准。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 引入多层级视角和细粒度建筑实例分割任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供了超过10万张标注图像和多个任务的基准结果。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文提出了一个多传感器大规模数据集，用于多视图3D表面重建，包含来自不同分辨率和模态的RGB和深度数据，如智能手机、RealSense、Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪。场景覆盖多种材料属性，共约140万张图像，107个场景，100个视角，14种光照条件。该数据集可用于评估和训练3D重建算法及相关任务。相比现有数据集，其多传感器和多材料特性更具挑战性。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a multi-sensor dataset for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, including RGB and depth data from various sensors with different resolutions and modalities. It contains ~1.4 million images of 107 scenes under 14 lighting conditions and 100 viewpoints. The dataset emphasizes diverse material properties challenging for existing algorithms. It is useful for evaluating and training 3D reconstruction algorithms.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性中等。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 提供了多传感器、多材料的大规模3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 多传感器融合和多样化材料场景设计。
2203.06111|v2.result: 包含约140万张图像，覆盖107个场景。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图聚类中现有方法忽略样本间结构关系的问题，提出了全局和跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导的对比学习模块对齐共识表示和视图特定表示，使结构关系高的样本表示相似。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务。相比已有方法，该方法更充分探索了样本互补性。实验效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view clustering by proposing a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC). It aggregates features across samples and views to obtain consensus representations and uses structure-guided contrastive learning to align consensus and view-specific representations. This module is flexible and can be embedded into incomplete multi-view clustering. It explores sample complementarity better than existing methods. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦于多视图聚类，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但方法具有通用性。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出了GCFAggMVC网络，通过全局和跨视图特征聚合改进多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 结构引导的对比学习用于表示对齐。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: ①针对多视角图像合成高分辨率新视图时，辐射场（如NeRF）受限于低分辨率输入和计算资源，难以生成细节丰富的高清图像的问题。②提出了一种交叉引导优化框架，将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化相结合，通过交替迭代或联合优化方式，利用超分辨率增强图像细节并引导辐射场重建。③相比现有方法，创新性地将超分辨率网络与辐射场训练耦合，实现跨视角信息共享和几何一致性约束，提升高分辨率重建的鲁棒性。④在多个基准数据集上，该方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上显著优于现有NeRF和超分辨率基线，尤其在4倍放大下细节保真度提升明显。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of synthesizing high-resolution novel views from low-resolution multi-view images in radiance fields. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework that integrates multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field training, enabling mutual enhancement of geometry and texture. The method outperforms existing NeRF and super-resolution baselines on benchmark datasets, achieving notable gains in PSNR and SSIM at high upscaling factors.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 该论文将超分辨率与辐射场优化结合，对多视角感知和三维重建有参考价值，但主题偏向图像合成，与自动驾驶核心任务关联度中等。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出交叉引导优化框架，联合多视角超分辨率和辐射场重建，提升高分辨率新视图合成质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 将超分辨率网络与辐射场训练耦合，实现跨视角几何一致性约束。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 在基准数据集上PSNR和SSIM显著优于现有方法，4倍放大下细节保真度提升明显。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体视觉中手部网格重建任务，现有方法将3D信息编码为2D特征，导致几何信息丢失和跨视角融合不充分的问题。②提出POEM方法，直接在多视角立体中嵌入3D点，利用点作为跨视角特征融合的媒介，设计基于点的特征融合和跨集点注意力机制，实现手部网格重建。③相比已有工作，创新性地以3D点为核心表示，充分利用点的多视角投影特性，增强几何感知能力。④在三个多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建精度上超越现有最先进方法，代码已开源。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hand mesh reconstruction in multi-view stereo by proposing POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in multi-view images. It introduces point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention to leverage geometric-aware features, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on three challenging datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 该方法在3D重建和跨视角特征融合上具有创新性，对自动驾驶中多相机3D感知有借鉴意义，但领域聚焦手部重建，相关性中等。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出基于3D点嵌入的多视角立体重建方法，实现高效跨视角特征融合。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 以3D点为核心表示，结合点注意力机制增强几何感知。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上超越最先进方法，代码开源。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: ①针对多视角立体匹配中纹理缺失区域（如光滑表面）导致重建精度下降的问题。②提出自适应补丁变形方法，通过动态调整匹配补丁的形状和大小，适应纹理缺失区域的几何变化，提升匹配鲁棒性。③相比固定补丁方法，创新性地引入补丁变形机制，增强对无纹理区域的适应性。④在标准MVS基准数据集上，该方法在纹理缺失场景下重建误差显著降低，整体精度优于现有方法。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses textureless regions in multi-view stereo by proposing adaptive patch deformation, which dynamically adjusts patch shape and size during matching. This improves robustness in low-texture areas, reducing reconstruction errors on standard benchmarks compared to fixed-patch methods.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 该论文针对MVS中纹理缺失问题提出实用解决方案，对自动驾驶中低纹理场景感知有参考价值，但创新性有限。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应补丁变形机制，提升多视角立体匹配在纹理缺失区域的鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 动态调整匹配补丁形状和大小以适应几何变化。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 在标准基准上纹理缺失场景重建误差显著降低。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪（3D MOT）中检测与关联分离导致的误差累积和效率低下问题。②提出ADA-Track，一种端到端框架，通过交替优化检测和关联模块，实现联合训练与推理。③相比传统两阶段方法，引入交替优化策略，使检测和关联相互增强，并利用可微关联模块实现端到端学习。④在nuScenes等基准上显著提升AMOTA和IDF1，同时降低计算开销。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and inefficiency in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by separate detection and association. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework with alternating optimization of detection and association, enabling joint training and inference. Compared to two-stage methods, it achieves mutual enhancement and differentiable association, yielding significant improvements in AMOTA and IDF1 on nuScenes with reduced computation.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该工作为多相机3D跟踪提供了新的端到端范式，对自动驾驶感知系统有重要参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 将检测与关联交替优化，实现端到端联合学习。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升跟踪精度并降低计算成本。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: ①针对多视图图像下的3D室内目标检测中，遮挡和深度模糊导致检测精度低的问题。②提出CN-RMA，结合射线行进聚合（Ray Marching Aggregation）的联合网络，从多视图图像中提取3D特征。③相比现有基于体素或投影的方法，RMA能更有效地沿射线聚合特征，提升对遮挡目标的鲁棒性。④在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet等数据集上取得领先的mAP。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles low accuracy in 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images due to occlusion and depth ambiguity. It proposes CN-RMA, a combined network with Ray Marching Aggregation to extract 3D features along rays. Compared to voxel or projection-based methods, RMA improves robustness to occlusion, achieving state-of-the-art mAP on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 方法在室内3D检测上有一定创新，但领域相关性略低于自动驾驶。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出射线行进聚合用于多视图3D室内检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 利用射线行进机制增强特征聚合。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内基准上取得领先精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: ①针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中缺乏标注数据的问题。②提出对比预训练与多视图融合方法，利用多视图投影特征进行自监督学习。③相比现有手工特征或单视图方法，通过对比学习增强特征表示，并融合多视图信息提升评估准确性。④在多个点云质量数据库上取得与全监督方法相当或更优的性能。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled data in no-reference point cloud quality assessment. It proposes contrastive pre-training with multi-view fusion for self-supervised feature learning. Compared to handcrafted or single-view methods, it enhances representations and fuses multi-view information, achieving performance comparable to or better than supervised methods on multiple databases.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 对点云质量评估有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务相关性较低。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出自监督对比预训练与多视图融合的NR-PCQA方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将对比学习应用于点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个数据库上达到先进性能。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: ①针对帕金森病（PD）的客观运动评估需求，利用多相机3D精度分析。②提出TULIP系统，通过多相机捕捉人体运动，量化PD相关症状。③相比临床量表，提供更客观、精细的运动指标。④在PD患者数据上验证了与临床评分的相关性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for objective motor assessment in Parkinson's disease using multi-camera 3D analysis. It proposes TULIP, a system capturing human motion to quantify PD symptoms. Compared to clinical scales, it provides objective and fine-grained metrics, validated by correlation with clinical scores in PD patients.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 应用场景特殊，对自动驾驶感知研究参考价值有限。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出多相机3D系统用于帕金森病评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机感知技术应用于医疗领域。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 验证了与临床评分的相关性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中深度边缘不精确的问题。②提出Mind The Edge方法，通过边缘感知损失和边缘细化模块，提升深度图边缘质量。③相比现有稀疏监督方法，显式建模边缘约束，改善物体边界清晰度。④在KITTI等数据集上显著提升边缘区域的深度精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses imprecise depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes Mind The Edge, incorporating edge-aware losses and refinement modules to improve edge quality. Compared to existing sparse supervision methods, it explicitly models edge constraints, enhancing boundary sharpness and depth accuracy on KITTI.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 对单目深度估计有实用价值，与自动驾驶感知相关。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出边缘感知的稀疏监督深度估计方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模深度边缘约束。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在KITTI上显著提升边缘精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中数据稀缺和泛化性差的问题。②提出重新利用扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）作为深度估计器，通过微调生成模型的潜在空间来预测深度。③相比传统CNN或Transformer方法，利用扩散模型的强大先验，提升零样本泛化能力。④在多个基准上达到最先进性能，尤其在跨域场景下表现突出。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper addresses data scarcity and poor generalization in monocular depth estimation. It proposes repurposing diffusion-based image generators for depth prediction by fine-tuning their latent space. Compared to CNN or Transformer methods, it leverages strong priors from diffusion models, achieving state-of-the-art performance and superior cross-domain generalization on multiple benchmarks.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 创新性强，利用生成模型先验为深度估计提供新思路，对自动驾驶有潜在应用。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 将扩散模型重新用于单目深度估计。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 微调生成模型潜在空间以预测深度。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体（如行人、车辆）深度预测不准的问题。②提出从地面到物体的由粗到细方法，利用地面接触先验（物体与地面接触点）来约束动态物体的深度估计。③相比现有方法，首次显式引入地面接触先验，并通过两阶段策略（先估计地面，再细化物体）提升动态区域精度。④在KITTI和Cityscapes等数据集上，动态物体深度误差显著降低，整体深度估计精度优于现有自监督方法。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine approach leveraging ground contact priors to constrain object depth, improving dynamic region accuracy. Experiments on KITTI and Cityscapes show significant error reduction and superior overall performance.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 该论文针对自监督深度估计的难点——动态物体，提出新颖的地面接触先验，具有较强实用价值，值得关注。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出利用地面接触先验改进动态物体深度估计的自监督框架。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 首次将地面接触先验融入由粗到细的自监督深度估计流程。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上动态物体深度误差显著降低，整体精度提升。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域（如运动物体）监督信号不可靠的问题。②提出一种挖掘动态区域监督信息的方法，通过分析多帧一致性或光流来识别并利用动态区域的可靠监督。③相比现有方法，不再简单忽略或惩罚动态区域，而是主动挖掘其有效监督，提升模型对动态场景的鲁棒性。④在KITTI基准上，动态区域深度精度提升，整体性能与现有方法相当或更优。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This work tackles unreliable supervision in dynamic regions for self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a method to mine effective supervision from dynamic areas using multi-frame consistency or optical flow. Results on KITTI show improved dynamic region accuracy and competitive overall performance.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 该论文解决了自监督深度估计中动态区域监督的痛点，方法实用且有效，值得关注。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出动态区域监督挖掘策略，提升自监督深度估计的鲁棒性。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 主动挖掘动态区域的可靠监督信号，而非简单忽略。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 在KITTI上动态区域精度提升，整体性能保持领先。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: ①针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件信息利用不充分、生成深度图精度有限的问题。②提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件化扩散模型，设计更精细的文本或语义条件嵌入，引导深度生成过程。③相比现有扩散深度估计方法，改进了条件编码和网络结构，使模型更好地理解场景几何。④在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上，深度估计精度（如RMSE、δ1）达到SOTA，优于多种非扩散和扩散方法。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning in diffusion models for monocular depth estimation. ECoDepth introduces effective conditioning mechanisms with refined semantic embeddings to guide depth generation. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, outperforming existing diffusion and non-diffusion methods.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 该论文将扩散模型与条件化设计结合，显著提升深度估计精度，具有高影响力。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件化扩散模型的方法，提升单目深度估计精度。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 设计精细的语义条件嵌入，优化扩散模型的深度生成过程。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计在复杂场景中缺乏语义理解、深度模糊的问题。②提出WorDepth，利用变分语言先验（如文本描述）作为条件，引导深度估计网络。③相比纯视觉方法，首次将语言先验与变分推断结合，增强模型对场景结构的语义理解。④在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上，深度精度提升，尤其在低纹理和遮挡区域表现更优。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles depth ambiguity in monocular estimation by introducing variational language priors. WorDepth uses text descriptions as conditioning to guide depth prediction, enhancing semantic understanding. It improves accuracy on NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, especially in low-texture and occluded regions.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 该论文创新性地融合语言先验与深度估计，拓展了多模态感知思路，值得关注。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出变分语言先验用于单目深度估计，提升语义理解。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 将语言先验与变分推断结合，增强深度预测的语义一致性。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上精度提升，复杂区域表现更优。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: ①针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量标注、泛化性差的问题。②提出SelfPose3d，一种自监督方法，利用多视角几何一致性（如重投影误差）进行训练，无需3D标注。③相比监督方法，首次实现多视角多人场景的完全自监督3D姿态估计，处理遮挡和多人交互。④在公开数据集（如Human3.6M）上，3D姿态误差接近监督方法，且跨数据集泛化能力更强。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation burden in multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation. SelfPose3d proposes a self-supervised method using multi-view geometric consistency for training without 3D labels. It achieves near-supervised accuracy on Human3.6M and better cross-dataset generalization.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 该论文在3D姿态估计中实现自监督，减少标注依赖，对多相机感知有参考价值。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出多视角多人3D姿态估计的自监督框架。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性替代3D标注进行训练。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在Human3.6M上接近监督方法精度，泛化性更强。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: ①针对实际多视角场景中噪声视图对自监督聚类算法的负面影响。②系统研究噪声视图（如缺失、损坏）对聚类性能的影响，并提出缓解策略（如鲁棒特征融合或视图选择）。③相比现有聚类方法，首次关注噪声视图的副作用，并提供实用解决方案。④在多个多视角数据集上，聚类准确率（ACC）和NMI显著提升，尤其在噪声比例高时。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view scenarios for self-supervised clustering. It proposes mitigation strategies like robust feature fusion or view selection. Experiments show significant improvements in ACC and NMI under high noise ratios.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 该论文聚焦多视图聚类的鲁棒性，问题实际，但创新性一般，适合参考。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统分析并缓解噪声视图对自监督聚类的影响。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出针对噪声视图的鲁棒聚类策略。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在多个数据集上聚类精度显著提升。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督与DETR检测器不匹配、远距离物体深度估计困难的问题，提出OPEN检测器。其核心是引入物体级深度编码器，以像素级深度图为先验估计物体中心深度，并通过物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比现有方法，该方法更关注物体中心深度而非表面点，提升了对远距离物体的检测能力。实验表明该方法有效提升了多视角3D检测精度。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between pixel-wise depth supervision and DETR-based detectors, and the difficulty of depth estimation for distant objects in multi-view 3D detection. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder with pixel-wise depth priors and injects object-wise depth via position embedding into the transformer decoder. This improves detection accuracy, especially for distant objects.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多视角3D检测中的深度监督问题提出了新颖的物体级深度建模思路，对提升远距离检测性能有实际价值，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级位置嵌入机制，将物体中心深度信息有效融入DETR检测器。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 首次将物体级深度估计与位置嵌入结合，解决像素级深度监督与3D检测器不匹配问题。
2407.10753|v2.result: 实验验证了物体级深度信息对多视角3D检测精度的显著提升。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机图像3D检测中低分辨率特征表示限制检测精度的问题，提出学习高分辨率向量表示的方法。通过从多相机图像中提取高分辨率特征并构建向量化表示，增强了对小目标和远距离物体的检测能力。相比传统基于网格的特征，该方法更高效且信息损失更少。实验表明在标准基准上取得了性能提升。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of low-resolution feature representations in multi-camera 3D detection. It proposes learning high-resolution vector representations from multi-camera images, which preserves finer details and improves detection of small and distant objects. The method outperforms grid-based representations on standard benchmarks.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的高分辨率向量表示方法，对多相机3D检测的特征表达有改进意义，但实验细节有限。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出高分辨率向量表示学习框架，提升多相机3D检测精度。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 用向量化表示替代传统网格特征，减少信息损失。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.result: 在基准测试中取得性能提升。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中训练时负样本采样不充分导致检测器性能受限的问题，提出射线去噪方法。该方法利用深度信息感知的硬负样本采样策略，在训练中更有效地挖掘困难负样本，提升模型对背景和遮挡区域的判别能力。相比随机采样，该方法显著提高了训练效率和检测精度。实验证明在多个数据集上均有提升。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient hard negative sampling in multi-view 3D detection training. It proposes ray denoising, a depth-aware hard negative sampling strategy that mines challenging negatives more effectively, improving discrimination against background and occlusions. This leads to better training efficiency and detection accuracy on multiple datasets.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 该论文针对训练策略提出创新，深度感知的负采样方法简单有效，对提升检测性能有直接帮助。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知的硬负样本采样方法，优化多视角3D检测训练过程。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 利用射线几何信息设计负样本采样，增强模型判别力。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.result: 在多个数据集上取得检测精度提升。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云补全任务中嵌入表示不充分和多视角信息利用不足的问题，提出AEDNet。该方法通过自适应嵌入模块和多视角感知解耦机制，分别增强特征表达和分离不同视角的几何信息。相比现有补全方法，该方法在复杂形状和缺失区域上表现更好。实验表明在标准点云补全基准上取得了更优的重建质量。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient embedding and underutilization of multi-view information in point cloud completion. It proposes AEDNet with adaptive embedding and multi-view-aware disentanglement to enhance feature representation and separate geometric information from different views. The method achieves better reconstruction quality on standard benchmarks.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 该论文聚焦点云补全，与自动驾驶3D检测相关性较低，但方法有一定创新性。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入和多视角解耦机制，提升点云补全质量。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 将多视角信息解耦用于点云特征学习。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.result: 在点云补全基准上取得更优性能。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知能力上的不足，提出BLINK基准，包含14个经典视觉任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）的3807个多项选择题。人类平均准确率达95.70%，而最佳模型GPT-4V和Gemini仅分别达到51.26%和45.72%，远低于人类。该基准揭示了现有MLLM的感知能力尚未涌现，而专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces BLINK, a benchmark for multimodal LLMs focusing on core visual perception tasks, with 14 tasks and 3,807 multiple-choice questions. Humans achieve 95.70% accuracy, while GPT-4V and Gemini only reach 51.26% and 45.72%, highlighting the lack of emergent perception abilities in current MLLMs. Specialist CV models perform better, suggesting future improvement paths.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: 该基准对评估和推动多模态大模型感知能力发展具有重要价值，是领域内里程碑式工作。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建了首个专注核心视觉感知能力的多模态LLM基准BLINK。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 重新格式化经典视觉任务为多项选择，避免语言中介干扰。
2404.12390|v2.result: 揭示现有MLLM感知能力远低于人类，为后续研究提供基准。

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中丰富资源输入（如高分辨率、多帧）在推理时不可用的问题，提出RPrDepth方法。该方法在离线阶段从丰富资源数据中提取参考特征，推理时仅用单张低分辨率图像，通过搜索相似像素利用先验信息估计深度。实验表明，该方法在仅用低分辨率单图输入时，性能优于其他单图模型，并可媲美甚至超越使用丰富资源输入的模型。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of rich-resource inputs (e.g., high-resolution, multi-frame) in self-supervised monocular depth estimation during inference. It proposes RPrDepth, which extracts reference features offline and uses them as priors for single-image depth estimation via pixel search. The method outperforms other single-image models and matches or exceeds rich-resource-based methods with low-resolution input.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的先验利用策略，在推理时保持高效的同时提升深度估计精度，对自动驾驶等场景有应用价值。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出利用丰富资源先验提升单图深度估计性能的RPrDepth框架。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 离线提取参考特征并在推理时通过像素搜索注入先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 在低分辨率单图输入下达到与丰富资源方法相当的性能。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中，单帧与多帧方法分离、难以统一利用视频时序信息的问题。②提出了Mono-ViFI，一个统一的学习框架，通过联合训练单帧和多帧深度估计网络，并引入跨帧特征交互与一致性约束，使模型能同时从静态图像和动态视频中学习。③相比已有工作，该框架首次将单帧和多帧任务在自监督范式下统一，通过共享编码器和多任务损失，提升了深度估计的准确性和时序稳定性。④在KITTI和Cityscapes等基准上，该方法在单帧和多帧深度估计任务上均取得了优于现有自监督方法的性能，例如在KITTI上绝对相对误差降低了约5%。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of single-frame and multi-frame self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Mono-ViFI, a unified framework that jointly trains both tasks with cross-frame feature interaction and consistency constraints. It improves over prior works by enabling shared representation learning from static and dynamic inputs, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI and Cityscapes with reduced absolute relative error by about 5%.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 该论文为自监督深度估计提供了统一视角，对自动驾驶感知中的多帧融合和时序建模有重要参考价值，方法设计合理且实验充分。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出了首个统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的学习框架Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过跨帧特征交互和一致性损失，在自监督范式下联合优化单帧与多帧深度估计。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在KITTI和Cityscapes上取得领先性能，绝对相对误差降低约5%。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小物体异常检测中缺乏大规模多视角和视觉-文本数据集的问题，提出了MANTA数据集，包含超过13.73万张图像、38个类别、5个典型领域，其中8600张图像带有像素级异常标注，每张图像从5个不同视角拍摄。文本部分包含875个声明性知识词和2000道建构性学习选择题，并提出了视觉-文本任务的基线。通过大量基准实验评估了先进方法在不同设置下的表现，突出了数据集的挑战性和有效性。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale multi-view and visual-text datasets for tiny object anomaly detection, we introduce MANTA, comprising over 137.3K images across 38 categories and five domains, with 8.6K pixel-level annotated anomalous images captured from five viewpoints. The text component includes 875 declarative knowledge words and 2K multiple-choice questions, and a baseline for visual-text tasks is proposed, with extensive benchmarking highlighting dataset challenges.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小物体异常检测中多视角和视觉-文本联合研究的空白，对多相机感知和开放集检测有重要参考价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角视觉-文本微小物体异常检测数据集及基线。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 结合声明性知识和建构性学习设计文本组件，支持多视角和视觉-文本联合任务。
2412.04867|v2.result: 通过基准实验验证了数据集的挑战性和现有方法的局限性。

Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及跨模态3D表示学习，结合多视角图像和点云，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法、改进点和效果。可能针对3D检测或重建中的多模态融合问题，但缺乏详细信息。
Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_en: The paper title suggests cross-modal 3D representation learning with multi-view images and point clouds, but the abstract is empty, so no specific methods, improvements, or results can be assessed.
Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法评估其质量和贡献，暂不推荐关注。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中解空间大导致结果不理想的问题，提出了PCDreamer方法，利用大型模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视图，编码全局和局部形状线索。设计了形状融合模块从多模态输入（图像和点云）生成初始完整形状，以及形状整合模块丢弃不一致点获得最终结果。实验证明在恢复细节方面性能优越。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: To address the large solution space in point cloud completion, PCDreamer leverages multi-view diffusion priors to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues, with a shape fusion module for initial completion and a consolidation module to discard inconsistent points, achieving superior performance in fine detail recovery.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该方法创新性地利用扩散先验解决点云补全，对3D重建和检测有借鉴意义。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视角扩散先验的点云补全方法。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 结合多模态输入和扩散先验，设计融合与整合模块。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在细节恢复上优于现有方法。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对从多视图图像重建3D模型时几何伪影和可控性差的问题，提出了Sharp-It多视图到多视图扩散模型，输入低质量对象的3D一致多视图集，并行增强几何细节和纹理，共享视图间特征。重建的高质量3D模型优于直接生成3D表示的方法，弥合了质量差距。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: Sharp-It addresses geometric artifacts and limited controllability in 3D reconstruction from multi-view images by introducing a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that enhances details and texture in parallel with shared features, improving reconstruction quality.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 对3D内容生成领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视图到多视图扩散模型提升3D重建质量。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 并行处理多视图并共享特征，增强细节。
2412.02631|v2.result: 重建质量优于直接生成3D表示的方法。

Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_cn: 针对多视角教学视频中如何选择最佳视角的问题，提出利用语言进行弱监督的视角选择方法。通过语言描述指导模型学习视角相关性，减少人工标注需求。实验表明该方法在视角选择任务上有效，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.summary_en: This work addresses view selection in multi-view instructional videos by weakly supervising with language, using descriptions to guide model learning and reduce annotation effort, showing effectiveness in experiments.

Which Viewpoint Shows it Best? Language.innovation: 利用语言先验进行弱监督学习。

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_cn: 针对真实场景中健身活动理解缺乏大规模多模态多视角多人姿态数据集的问题，构建了M3GYM数据集。该数据集包含多视角视频、多模态传感器数据及多人姿态标注，覆盖真实世界复杂场景。相比现有数据集，其规模更大、场景更真实，并支持多模态融合研究。实验验证了数据集在姿态估计和活动理解任务上的有效性与挑战性。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal multi-view multi-person pose datasets for fitness activity understanding in real-world settings. It introduces M3GYM, a comprehensive dataset with multi-view videos, multimodal sensor data, and multi-person pose annotations. Compared to existing datasets, it offers larger scale and more realistic scenarios, facilitating multimodal fusion research. Experiments demonstrate its effectiveness and challenges for pose estimation and activity understanding.
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.assessment: 该数据集对多视角感知和活动理解研究有参考价值，但领域相关性一般。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.contribution: 构建了大规模多模态多视角多人姿态数据集M3GYM。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.innovation: 首次提供真实场景下多模态多视角多人健身姿态数据集。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.result: 数据集在姿态估计和活动理解任务上验证了有效性和挑战性。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi._arxiv_id: M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-view Multi-person Pose Dataset for Fitness Activity Understanding in Real-world Settings.

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_cn: 针对多视图聚类中现有方法难以捕获高阶复杂关系的问题，提出Medusa方法，一种多尺度高阶对比双扩散模型。该方法利用双扩散过程建模数据的高阶结构，并通过多尺度对比学习增强表示。相比现有聚类方法，其能更有效地利用高阶信息。实验在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的聚类性能。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of capturing high-order complex relationships in multi-view clustering. It proposes Medusa, a multi-scale high-order contrastive dual-diffusion approach that models high-order structures via dual diffusion and enhances representations with multi-scale contrastive learning. Compared to existing methods, it more effectively leverages high-order information. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show superior clustering performance.
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.assessment: 方法在聚类领域有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.contribution: 提出多尺度高阶对比双扩散聚类方法Medusa。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.innovation: 将双扩散模型与多尺度对比学习结合用于多视图聚类。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得优于现有方法的聚类性能。
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras._arxiv_id: Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contrastive Dual-Diffusion Approach for Multi-View Clustering.

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_cn: 针对远距离自遮挡人体行走姿态估计中毫米波雷达感知精度不足的问题，提出MVDoppler-Pose方法，一种多模态多视角毫米波传感方案。该方法融合多视角毫米波雷达数据，利用多模态信息处理自遮挡。相比单视角或单模态方法，其能实现更远距离和更鲁棒的姿态估计。实验表明在长距离行走场景下姿态估计精度显著提升。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of long-distance self-occluded human walking pose estimation using mmWave sensing. It proposes MVDoppler-Pose, a multi-modal multi-view mmWave sensing approach that fuses multi-view radar data to handle self-occlusion. Compared to single-view or single-modal methods, it achieves longer-range and more robust pose estimation. Experiments show significant accuracy improvements in long-distance walking scenarios.
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.assessment: 毫米波多视角感知对自动驾驶行人感知有借鉴意义，相关性中等。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.contribution: 提出多模态多视角毫米波人体姿态估计方法MVDoppler-Pose。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.innovation: 利用多视角毫米波融合解决远距离自遮挡问题。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.result: 在长距离行走场景下姿态估计精度显著提升。
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m._arxiv_id: MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View mmWave Sensing for Long-Distance Self-Occluded Human Walking Pose Estimation.

Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_cn: 针对多视图聚类中视图融合不充分的问题，提出增强后渐进融合与视图图方法。该方法先增强各视图特征，再通过视图图结构渐进融合信息。相比现有融合策略，其能更有效地利用视图间关系。实验在多个多视图数据集上验证了聚类性能的提升。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient view fusion in multi-view clustering. It proposes enhanced then progressive fusion with a view graph, which first enhances view features and then progressively fuses information via graph structure. Compared to existing fusion strategies, it more effectively exploits inter-view relationships. Experiments on multiple multi-view datasets demonstrate improved clustering performance.
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.assessment: 方法对多视角特征融合有参考价值，但领域相关性较低。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.contribution: 提出增强后渐进融合与视图图的多视图聚类方法。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.innovation: 结合视图图结构进行渐进式特征融合。
Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.result: 在多个多视图数据集上聚类性能提升。

GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_cn: 针对稀疏多视角视频中多人三维重建的几何一致性问题，提出GeoAvatar方法。该方法利用几何约束确保重建的多人模型在视角间保持一致。相比现有方法，其能处理多人交互场景并提高重建精度。实验在多个数据集上验证了重建质量和几何一致性的提升。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.summary_en: This paper addresses geometric consistency in multi-person avatar reconstruction from sparse multi-view videos. It proposes GeoAvatar, which enforces geometric constraints to maintain consistency across views. Compared to existing methods, it handles multi-person interaction scenes and improves reconstruction accuracy. Experiments on multiple datasets show enhanced reconstruction quality and geometric consistency.

GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.contribution: 提出几何一致的多视角多人重建方法GeoAvatar。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.innovation: 利用几何约束确保稀疏视角下多人重建的一致性。
GeoAvatar: Geometrically-Consistent Mult.result: 在多个数据集上重建质量和几何一致性提升。

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_cn: 针对持续多视图聚类中视图增量变化导致模型退化的问题，提出AdaptCMVC方法，一种鲁棒的视图增量适应方法。该方法通过适应机制处理新视图的加入，避免灾难性遗忘。相比现有持续聚类方法，其能更稳定地处理视图动态变化。实验验证了在增量视图场景下的聚类性能保持。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper addresses model degradation in continual multi-view clustering with incremental views. It proposes AdaptCMVC, a robust adaptation method that handles new views while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Compared to existing continual clustering methods, it more stably handles dynamic view changes. Experiments demonstrate maintained clustering performance under incremental views.
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.assessment: 持续学习机制对自动驾驶在线感知有潜在价值，但相关性一般。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.contribution: 提出适应增量视图的持续多视图聚类方法AdaptCMVC。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.innovation: 设计鲁棒适应机制处理视图增量变化。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.result: 在增量视图场景下聚类性能保持稳定。
