2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知能力评估上的空白，现有基准缺乏细粒度、多视角的面部属性评测。②构建了FaceBench数据集，包含层级化面部属性结构（5个视角、最多3层、超过210个属性和700个属性值），提供49,919个VQA评估对和23,841个微调对，并训练了Face-LLaVA基线模型。③相比已有工作，首次系统性地从多视角多层级评估MLLMs的人脸感知，并引入人类表现对比。④实验表明现有MLLMs在细粒度面部属性理解上远不令人满意，而Face-LLaVA显著优于其他模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for evaluating face perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attribute dataset with over 210 attributes and 49,919 VQA pairs, and trains Face-LLaVA as a robust baseline. Experiments reveal existing MLLMs underperform on fine-grained face understanding, while Face-LLaVA significantly improves performance.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该论文为MLLMs人脸感知提供了首个系统化基准，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，主要面向通用视觉问答。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了多视角多层级人脸属性VQA数据集FaceBench及基线模型Face-LLaVA。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 首次提出层级化多视角人脸属性结构用于MLLMs评估。
2503.21457|v2.result: Face-LLaVA显著优于现有MLLMs，但整体人脸感知能力仍待提升。

Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_cn: ①针对不完整多视图多标签学习中的表示学习与标签语义利用不足问题。②提出基于解耦表示和标签语义嵌入的方法，通过分离视图共享与特有特征，并嵌入标签语义以增强多标签预测。③相比传统方法，更有效地处理视图缺失和标签相关性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view multi-label learning by proposing a method based on disentangled representation and label semantic embedding. It separates shared and view-specific features and incorporates label semantics to improve prediction. The approach aims to handle missing views and label correlations, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.assessment: 论文主题与自动驾驶感知相关性低，且摘要信息不足，难以评估其实际贡献。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.contribution: 提出解耦表示与标签语义嵌入结合的不完整多视图多标签学习方法。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni.innovation: 将解耦表示学习引入多视图多标签场景。
Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learni._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-View Multi-label Learning via Disentangled Representation and Label Semantic Embedding.

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_cn: ①针对大规模多视图张量聚类中计算效率与可扩展性问题。②提出使用隐式线性核的方法，避免显式构造高维核矩阵，从而降低计算复杂度。③相比传统核方法，更适合大规模数据。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.summary_en: This paper addresses scalability issues in large-scale multi-view tensor clustering by proposing implicit linear kernels to avoid explicit high-dimensional kernel construction. This reduces computational complexity and improves applicability to large datasets, though specific results are not given in the abstract.

Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.contribution: 提出基于隐式线性核的大规模多视图张量聚类方法。
Large-scale Multi-view Tensor Clustering.innovation: 利用隐式核技巧提升多视图聚类的可扩展性。

SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_cn: ①针对多视图表示学习中视图融合顺序与信息交互不足的问题。②提出SeqMvRL，一种顺序融合框架，逐步整合多视图信息以增强表示。③相比并行融合方法，能更好地捕捉视图间依赖关系。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.summary_en: This paper proposes SeqMvRL, a sequential fusion framework for multi-view representation learning, which integrates views step-by-step to capture inter-view dependencies better than parallel fusion. The approach aims to improve representation quality, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.assessment: 顺序融合思想对多相机感知有一定启发，但缺乏实验验证，相关性一般。
SeqMvRL: A Sequential Fusion Framework f.contribution: 提出顺序融合框架用于多视图表示学习。

Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_cn: ①针对多视图分类在真实场景中测试时鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出增强测试时鲁棒性的方法，可能通过自适应调整或一致性约束来应对分布偏移。③相比仅训练时增强，更关注推理阶段的稳定性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses testing-time robustness for multi-view classification in real-world scenarios, proposing methods to enhance stability under distribution shifts. It focuses on inference-stage adaptation rather than training-only augmentation, though specific results are not given in the abstract.
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.assessment: 测试时鲁棒性对自动驾驶感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，且未聚焦检测任务。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.contribution: 提出增强多视图分类测试时鲁棒性的方法。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.innovation: 关注推理阶段的多视图鲁棒性。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr._arxiv_id: Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Trusted Multi-View Classification in the Wild.

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: ①针对生成式多视图图像中一致性评估缺乏合适指标的问题，传统重建指标不适用于生成模型。②提出MEt3R，利用DUSt3R进行前馈稠密3D重建，将图像内容跨视图扭曲，并比较特征图获得对视图依赖效应不变的相似度分数。③相比现有方法，该指标独立于采样过程，可评估任意生成模型的一致性。④在多种新视角和视频生成方法上评估，包括其开放的多视图潜在扩散模型，验证了指标的有效性。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for measuring multi-view consistency in generated images, using DUSt3R for dense 3D reconstruction and feature comparison after warping. It is sampling-independent and applicable to various generative models. Evaluations on multiple novel view and video generation methods demonstrate its utility.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该指标对多相机生成和3D感知评估有重要参考价值，与自动驾驶中的多视图一致性验证高度相关。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出首个采样无关的多视图一致性度量MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用稠密3D重建和特征比较实现视图无关的一致性评估。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在多种生成方法上成功评估一致性，验证了指标的有效性。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: ①针对单张图像自监督去噪问题，传统方法依赖噪声统计模型或多张图像。②提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，利用单个含噪图像训练网络，通过dropout模拟集成学习，以自监督方式预测干净图像。③相比BM3D等传统方法，无需噪声先验，且能处理复杂噪声。④在多个基准数据集上取得与监督方法相当的性能，尤其在真实噪声场景下表现优异。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image self-supervised denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, which trains a network on a single noisy image using dropout-based ensembling. It eliminates the need for noise priors and outperforms traditional methods like BM3D, achieving competitive results with supervised approaches on benchmark datasets.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 方法新颖，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低，适合自监督基础研究参考。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出一种基于dropout的单图像自监督去噪框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout模拟集成学习实现自监督去噪。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督语义分割中CAM与真实掩码差距大的问题。②提出自监督等变注意力机制（SEAM），通过一致性正则化约束不同变换图像的CAM，并设计像素相关模块（PCM）利用上下文信息细化预测。③相比现有CAM方法，首次将等变性约束引入弱监督分割，提升CAM质量。④在PASCAL VOC 2012上超越现有方法，mIoU显著提升。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between CAMs and ground-truth masks in weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a self-supervised equivariant attention mechanism (SEAM) with consistency regularization and a pixel correlation module (PCM). It outperforms existing methods on PASCAL VOC 2012, improving CAM quality and segmentation accuracy.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，对弱监督学习有重要贡献，但直接应用于自动驾驶感知有限。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出SEAM框架，利用等变性约束提升弱监督分割性能。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 将等变性作为自监督信号引入CAM训练。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上取得领先性能。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练模型在对抗鲁棒性方面未被探索的问题。②首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，生成鲁棒的预训练模型，并用于下游微调。③相比端到端对抗训练，该方法在提升鲁棒性的同时节省计算成本，并发现不同预训练任务的对抗脆弱性差异，提出集成策略。④在CIFAR-10上鲁棒性提升3.83%，标准精度提升1.3%，集成策略再提升3.59%鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces adversarial training into self-supervised pre-training to create robust pre-trained models, which improve downstream fine-tuning robustness and reduce computation cost. It also proposes an ensemble strategy leveraging diverse adversarial vulnerabilities, achieving significant gains on CIFAR-10 (e.g., 3.83% robust accuracy improvement).
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 对自监督学习和对抗鲁棒性交叉领域有重要贡献，对自动驾驶安全相关感知有参考价值。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗训练融入自监督预训练，提供鲁棒预训练模型。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 结合自监督与对抗训练，并利用任务集成增强鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上显著提升鲁棒性和标准精度。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动作分割中时空变化导致性能不佳的问题。②提出自监督时间域适应（SSTDA），包含二元和序列域预测两个辅助任务，对齐跨域特征空间。③相比传统域适应方法，利用自监督任务捕捉局部和全局时间动态。④在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast上大幅超越现有方法，F1@25分别提升至89.1%、81.5%和69.1%，且仅需65%标注数据。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by proposing Self-Supervised Temporal Domain Adaptation (SSTDA) with two auxiliary tasks to align cross-domain features. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, achieving F1@25 scores of 89.1%, 81.5%, and 69.1%, respectively, with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 方法有效解决域适应问题，对视频理解相关任务有借鉴意义，但自动驾驶应用场景有限。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出SSTDA框架，利用自监督任务提升动作分割的域适应能力。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 结合二元和序列域预测实现时间动态对齐。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在多个基准上大幅提升性能并减少标注需求。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: ①针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，现有方法依赖大量标注数据。②提出稀疏生成神经网络（SG-NN），利用自监督学习从部分扫描中预测完整场景。③相比传统方法，SG-NN能处理稀疏输入并生成高分辨率补全结果。④在多个室内数据集上取得优于监督方法的性能，尤其在稀疏扫描场景下。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing Sparse Generative Neural Networks (SG-NN) for self-supervised learning, which predicts complete scenes from partial scans. It outperforms supervised methods on indoor datasets, especially with sparse inputs.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 对3D场景理解有贡献，但相关性一般，适合自动驾驶中占用预测的参考。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出自监督稀疏生成网络用于场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 利用稀疏生成模型实现自监督场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在室内数据集上优于监督方法。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: ①针对从无标注视频中学习可解释关键点的问题，传统方法依赖人工标注或监督信号。②提出自监督学习方法，通过视频帧间的运动一致性学习关键点，并利用可解释性约束。③相比现有方法，能学习语义上有意义的关键点，且无需任何标注。④在多个基准上，关键点检测精度和下游任务性能均优于现有自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses learning interpretable keypoints from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method that leverages motion consistency and interpretability constraints. It outperforms existing self-supervised approaches in keypoint detection accuracy and downstream task performance on benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 对自监督特征学习和视频理解有重要价值，可应用于自动驾驶中的物体姿态估计。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出无标注视频中可解释关键点的自监督学习框架。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用运动一致性和可解释性约束学习关键点。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在多个基准上取得领先性能。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督特征学习仅依赖局部像素统计、难以捕捉全局图像结构的问题。②提出基于图像变换判别的新原则，并设计了一种名为“有限上下文修复”（LCI）的变换，仅用小块矩形边界修复图像块。③相比现有变换，LCI能迫使模型学习全局统计特征，从而更好地表征物体形状和上下文。④实验表明，该方法在目标分类和检测等下游任务上泛化性能更优。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of self-supervised feature learning relying on local pixel statistics. It introduces a principle based on discriminating image transformations and proposes a novel transformation, Limited Context Inpainting (LCI), which inpaints patches using only a small boundary. LCI encourages learning global statistics, improving generalization to downstream tasks like classification and detection.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 该论文为自监督学习提供了新的理论视角，对理解特征泛化机制有重要价值。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出基于变换判别的新原则和LCI变换，推动自监督特征学习向全局统计建模发展。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 通过有限上下文修复设计，巧妙引导模型学习全局图像特征。
2004.02331|v2.result: 在分类和检测任务上展示了更好的泛化性能。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: ①针对监督3D姿态估计中模型依赖标注样本、存在任务偏差和数据集偏差的问题。②提出自监督学习框架，利用基于部件的2D木偶模型、姿态约束和未配对3D姿态，从无标注视频中解耦形状和外观等变化。③通过可微形式化弥合3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示差距，支持多样相机运动。④在未见过的野外数据集上，跨任务泛化性能优于现有方法。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of supervised 3D pose estimation relying on annotations and suffering from task and dataset bias. It proposes a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations using a part-based 2D puppet model and unpaired 3D poses. The differentiable formulation bridges 3D pose and spatial part maps, enabling robust generalization across tasks and camera movements.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督3D姿态估计领域具有创新性，但相关性略低于核心自动驾驶感知。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出解耦变化的自监督框架，提升3D姿态估计的泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 利用部件模型和可微桥接实现姿态解耦。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在野外数据集上跨任务表现优越。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督密集跟踪性能远低于监督方法的问题。②重新评估自监督训练和重建损失的常规选择，并引入关键的记忆组件增强架构。③通过大规模半监督视频目标分割基准测试，提出新的泛化性指标。④自监督方法在标准指标上首次与监督方法竞争，且在泛化性上优于多数监督方法，性能提升15%。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap in self-supervised dense tracking. It reassesses training choices, adds a memory component, and benchmarks on large-scale VOS. The method surpasses prior self-supervised methods by 15% and matches supervised performance, with superior generalizability.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 该论文在自监督跟踪领域取得显著进展，对视频感知有重要参考价值。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出记忆增强的自监督跟踪模型，显著提升密集跟踪性能。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 引入记忆组件和泛化性指标，优化自监督训练策略。
2002.07793|v2.result: 性能提升15%，与监督方法相当。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督视觉里程计在跨场景时性能下降的问题。②提出在线元学习算法，利用convLSTM聚合时空信息，实现网络对新环境的连续自适应。③通过在线特征对齐方法，对齐不同时间的特征分布，适应环境变化。④在未见过的户外、虚拟到真实和户外到室内场景中，持续优于最先进的自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of self-supervised VO in novel scenes. It proposes an online meta-learning algorithm with convLSTM for spatial-temporal aggregation and feature alignment. The method adapts to new environments, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art self-supervised VO methods.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中的视觉定位有直接应用价值，适应性强。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出在线自适应VO算法，提升跨场景鲁棒性。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 结合元学习和特征对齐实现连续环境适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在多种场景下性能优于现有方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: ①针对草图理解中像素格式表示和CNN模型局限性的问题。②提出Sketch-BERT模型，将BERT推广到草图领域，包括新设计的草图嵌入网络和自监督草图格式塔学习。③引入草图格式塔模型（SGM）辅助预训练。④实验表明，学习到的表示能提升草图识别和检索等下游任务性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of pixel-based sketch understanding. It proposes Sketch-BERT, generalizing BERT to sketches with novel embedding networks and self-supervised gestalt learning. The learned representation improves downstream sketch recognition and retrieval tasks.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 该论文在草图领域有创新，但相关性较低。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出Sketch-BERT模型，实现草图的自监督表示学习。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT架构和格式塔学习应用于草图。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: ①针对自监督光流和立体匹配学习效率低的问题。②提出Flow2Stereo方法，有效结合光流和立体匹配的自监督学习。③通过共享表示和联合训练，提升两个任务的性能。④实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有自监督方法。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency in self-supervised optical flow and stereo matching. It proposes Flow2Stereo, effectively combining self-supervised learning for both tasks. The method improves performance on multiple benchmarks over existing self-supervised approaches.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 该论文对多任务自监督学习有贡献，与自动驾驶感知相关。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出联合自监督学习光流和立体匹配的方法。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 共享表示和联合训练策略。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 在多个基准上性能提升。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: ①针对自监督图像超分辨率问题，即如何在不依赖成对低/高分辨率训练数据的情况下实现高质量上采样。②提出PULSE方法，利用预训练GAN的潜空间探索，通过优化潜码使生成图像在下采样后与输入低分辨率图像一致，从而获得高分辨率输出。③相比传统监督超分方法，无需配对数据，且利用生成模型的先验知识生成更真实的细节。④在面部图像上达到与监督方法相当或更优的感知质量，但PSNR等保真度指标可能较低。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised image super-resolution by exploring the latent space of a pre-trained GAN to find a high-resolution image that downscales to the input. It avoids paired training data and leverages generative priors for realistic detail. Results show competitive perceptual quality on faces, though fidelity metrics may be lower.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该论文是自监督超分领域的经典工作，对后续基于GAN先验的图像复原研究有重要启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性较低。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出一种无需配对数据的自监督超分框架，利用GAN潜空间探索实现高感知质量上采样。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 将超分问题转化为潜空间优化，利用生成模型的先验约束解空间。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在面部图像上取得与监督方法相当的感知质量，但保真度指标有所下降。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练中表征不变性问题，即如何学习对输入变换（如裁剪、颜色扰动）鲁棒的通用特征。②提出Pretext-Invariant Representations（PIRL）方法，通过对比学习使同一图像的不同变换版本在嵌入空间中靠近，同时推开不同图像的嵌入。③相比传统pretext任务（如旋转预测），PIRL更直接地学习不变性，且计算效率高。④在ImageNet线性评估和下游迁移任务上显著优于已有自监督方法，接近监督学习性能。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of learning invariant representations in self-supervised learning by using contrastive learning to pull together embeddings of different views of the same image and push apart those of different images. It improves over pretext-task-based methods and achieves near-supervised performance on ImageNet linear evaluation and transfer tasks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: 该论文是自监督对比学习的早期重要工作，对理解表征不变性有贡献，但已被后续更先进方法超越，与自动驾驶领域关联一般。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出PIRL方法，通过对比学习学习pretext-invariant表征，提升自监督性能。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 将对比学习与pretext任务结合，直接优化表征的不变性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在ImageNet线性评估上达到接近监督学习的性能，显著优于传统自监督方法。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督场景流估计问题，即如何在没有真实场景流标注的情况下学习动态场景的3D运动。②提出Just Go With the Flow方法，利用点云序列的时空一致性，通过重建和循环一致性损失进行自监督训练。③相比监督方法，无需昂贵的标注，且能处理动态场景中的遮挡和噪声。④在KITTI和FlyingThings3D数据集上，自监督性能接近监督方法，且泛化能力更强。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation by leveraging spatiotemporal consistency in point cloud sequences with reconstruction and cycle-consistency losses. It avoids costly annotations and handles occlusion and noise. Results on KITTI and FlyingThings3D approach supervised performance with better generalization.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中的动态场景理解有直接价值，自监督场景流可辅助目标检测和跟踪，值得关注。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出一种自监督场景流估计框架，利用点云序列一致性训练，无需标注。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 结合重建和循环一致性损失，实现无监督的3D运动学习。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个数据集上接近监督方法性能，并展现出更强的泛化能力。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: ①针对自监督视角估计问题，即如何从无标注图像集合中学习物体的3D视角。②提出一种方法，通过图像重建和视角一致性约束，利用生成模型学习视角变化。③相比监督方法，无需3D标注，且能处理多类别物体。④在合成和真实数据集上，视角估计精度接近监督方法，并支持新视角合成。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised viewpoint estimation by learning from unlabeled image collections via reconstruction and viewpoint consistency constraints. It avoids 3D annotations and handles multiple object categories. Results show accuracy close to supervised methods and enable novel view synthesis.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中的物体姿态估计有一定参考价值，但视角估计与BEV感知的直接关联有限。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出自监督视角学习方法，利用图像集合和一致性约束估计3D视角。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 将视角估计转化为生成任务，通过重建约束实现无监督学习。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在多个数据集上接近监督性能，并支持新视角合成。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: ①针对对抗样本的鲁棒性问题，即如何在不牺牲泛化能力的情况下防御未知攻击。②提出一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间进行防御，通过自监督任务增强模型对扰动的鲁棒性。③相比传统对抗训练，无需修改目标模型参数，可即插即用，且对未见攻击有更好的泛化。④在分类任务上，将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降至31.9%，优于现有最先进防御。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses adversarial robustness by proposing a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in the input space, which is generalizable and plug-and-play. It reduces the success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attacks from 82.6% to 31.9%, outperforming prior state-of-the-art defenses.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性有重要意义，自监督防御可保护检测和分割模型，值得关注。
2006.04924|v2.contribution: 提出一种自监督对抗训练方法，在输入空间提供跨任务鲁棒性。
2006.04924|v2.innovation: 结合自监督学习和对抗训练，实现无需修改模型参数的通用防御。
2006.04924|v2.result: 显著降低未知攻击的成功率，优于现有防御方法。

2003.14323|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督预训练在实际应用中的效用问题，即不同算法在不同数据规模、任务和数据集难度下的表现如何。②通过构建合成数据集套件，系统评估多种自监督算法在下游任务（分类、检测等）上的性能，并控制数据难度和标签数量。③相比以往研究，提供了全面的实证分析，揭示自监督效用随标签数量、任务类型和数据属性的变化规律。④发现线性评估与微调性能不相关，为实践者选择预训练方法提供指导。
2003.14323|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the utility of self-supervised pretraining across synthetic datasets and downstream tasks, controlling data difficulty and label availability. It reveals how utility varies with label count, task, and data properties, and finds that linear evaluation does not correlate with finetuning performance, offering practical guidance.
2003.14323|v2.assessment: 该论文对自监督预训练在视觉任务中的应用有重要指导意义，尤其对自动驾驶中数据稀缺场景的预训练选择有参考价值。
2003.14323|v2.contribution: 系统评估自监督预训练在不同条件下的效用，提供实证指南。
2003.14323|v2.innovation: 利用合成数据套件实现可控实验，揭示关键影响因素。
2003.14323|v2.result: 发现线性评估与微调性能不相关，为预训练方法选择提供依据。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对机械碎纸文档自动重建中，成对碎片兼容性评估计算成本高（需对每对碎片进行推理）的问题。②提出了一种基于自监督深度非对称度量学习的方法，将碎片内容非对称投影到公共度量空间，使推理次数从二次方降为线性。③相比现有深度模型，主要改进是避免了逐对推理，显著降低了计算复杂度。④实验表明，该方法在保持重建精度的同时大幅提升了效率，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of pairwise compatibility evaluation in shredded document reconstruction, where deep models require inference for each pair. It proposes a self-supervised deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects shred content into a common metric space, reducing inference complexity from quadratic to linear. The method improves efficiency while maintaining reconstruction accuracy, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，但方法上对度量学习和自监督表示有一定参考价值，适合关注高效匹配算法的研究者。
2003.10063|v2.contribution: 提出了一种线性复杂度碎片兼容性评估方法，替代传统二次方推理。
2003.10063|v2.innovation: 利用非对称度量投影实现碎片间兼容性的高效计算。
2003.10063|v2.result: 在保持重建精度的同时显著降低了计算开销。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督点云场景流估计中对应关系匹配质量差的问题，现有方法仅基于3D坐标进行逐点匹配，忽略了颜色、法向量等判别性信息，且易产生多对一匹配。②提出将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计融合多描述子的传输代价，并通过质量约束鼓励一对一匹配；同时引入随机游走模块，利用图结构增强匹配的全局一致性。③相比已有工作，首次将最优传输和随机游走结合用于点云场景流伪标签生成，有效缓解了匹配歧义。④在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有自监督方法的性能，显著提升了场景流估计精度。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor correspondence quality in self-supervised point cloud scene flow estimation by formulating matching as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor costs and one-to-one constraints, enhanced by a random walk module for global consistency. It outperforms prior self-supervised methods on standard benchmarks, improving flow accuracy.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 该论文为自监督点云场景流估计提供了新的理论视角，最优传输与随机游走的结合具有较强创新性，对自动驾驶中的动态物体感知有参考价值。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输和随机游走的自监督点云场景流估计框架，生成高质量伪标签。
2105.08248|v2.innovation: 将匹配问题转化为带质量约束的最优传输，并引入随机游走增强全局一致性。
2105.08248|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有自监督方法，场景流估计精度显著提升。

Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督学习缺乏有效生成式预训练方法的问题，现有对比学习方法忽略了点云的结构分布。②提出通过学习离散生成模型进行自监督预训练，将点云编码为离散潜在表示并重建，以捕获局部几何结构。③相比对比学习，生成式方法能更好地建模点云分布，且离散表示有利于下游任务迁移。④在分类、分割等下游任务上取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了生成式预训练的有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised learning method for 3D point clouds via discrete generative models, encoding points into discrete latent codes for reconstruction. It captures local geometry better than contrastive methods and achieves competitive performance on downstream tasks.
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.assessment: 该论文探索了生成式自监督在点云上的应用，思路新颖，但实验充分度一般，影响力有限。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.contribution: 提出基于离散生成模型的点云自监督预训练方法。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.innovation: 利用离散潜在表示进行生成式重建，替代对比学习范式。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.result: 在下游分类和分割任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clouds by Learning Discrete Generative Models.

The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中多帧信息利用不足的问题，现有自监督方法通常仅使用相邻帧，忽略了长时程时序信息。②提出一种自监督多帧单目深度估计方法，通过时间机会主义策略动态选择多帧输入，并利用时序一致性进行训练。③相比固定帧数方法，能自适应利用更多帧信息，提升深度估计的鲁棒性和精度。④在KITTI等数据集上取得了优于单帧和固定多帧方法的性能。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper tackles the underuse of temporal information in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by dynamically selecting multiple frames and leveraging temporal consistency. It outperforms single-frame and fixed multi-frame baselines on KITTI.
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.assessment: 该论文聚焦多帧时序利用，对自动驾驶深度感知有实际意义，但创新性中等。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出时间机会主义的多帧选择策略用于自监督单目深度估计。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.innovation: 动态选择多帧输入并利用时序一致性训练。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.result: 在KITTI上取得更优的深度估计精度。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervised Multi-Frame Monocular Depth.

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络难以捕获空间和时间长程依赖的问题，现有方法在拥挤场景下判别力不足。②提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系，并通过自监督学习约束相关体积；同时提出可学习的相关算子在不同层建立帧间匹配以传播时间上下文。③相比仅依赖相邻帧的CNN方法，能更有效地利用空间布局和时间动态。④在多个MOT基准上取得了先进的跟踪性能，尤其在拥挤场景下表现突出。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependency issues in multi-object tracking by introducing a local correlation module for spatial topology and a learnable correlation operator for temporal context propagation. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on MOT benchmarks, especially in crowded scenes.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MOT的时空建模问题提出了有效方案，相关学习机制具有较强实用价值，与自动驾驶多目标跟踪高度相关。
2104.03541|v2.contribution: 提出相关学习模块增强多目标跟踪的时空建模能力。
2104.03541|v2.innovation: 利用自监督相关体积和可学习相关算子捕获长程依赖。
2104.03541|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得先进性能，拥挤场景提升显著。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: ①针对弱监督视觉定位中区域-短语对应关系缺失的问题，现有方法依赖测试时的目标检测器，推理成本高。②提出对比知识蒸馏框架，利用通用目标检测器在训练时生成软匹配分数，蒸馏到区域-短语评分函数，并构建图像-句子评分函数进行监督。③相比已有方法，测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本。④在视觉短语定位任务上取得了最先进的结果，超越了需要昂贵检测器的方法。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles missing region-phrase correspondences in weakly supervised visual grounding by distilling soft matching scores from a detector into a region-phrase score function, removing the need for detection at test time. It achieves state-of-the-art results with lower inference cost.
2007.01951|v2.assessment: 该论文通过知识蒸馏解决了弱监督定位的推理效率问题，方法简洁有效，对多模态感知有参考意义。
2007.01951|v2.contribution: 提出对比知识蒸馏框架，实现无检测器推理的弱监督视觉定位。
2007.01951|v2.innovation: 利用软匹配分数蒸馏替代测试时检测器。
2007.01951|v2.result: 在视觉短语定位上取得最先进性能，推理成本大幅降低。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足和聚类不稳定的问题，现有方法难以有效学习判别性特征。②提出几何感知对比与聚类协调框架，通过几何感知的对比学习增强特征区分度，并协调聚类过程以稳定伪标签生成。③相比现有自监督方法，能更好地利用点云几何结构，提升检测性能。④在多个3D检测基准上取得了优于现有自监督方法的性能，接近有监督方法。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometry exploitation and unstable clustering in self-supervised 3D object detection by harmonizing geometry-aware contrastive learning and clustering. It outperforms existing self-supervised methods on 3D detection benchmarks, approaching supervised performance.
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.assessment: 该论文针对自监督3D检测的几何建模和聚类问题提出了有效方案，与自动驾驶3D感知高度相关，具有较强应用潜力。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.contribution: 提出几何感知对比与聚类协调的自监督3D目标检测框架。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.innovation: 将几何感知对比学习与聚类协调结合，稳定伪标签生成。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.result: 在多个3D检测基准上超越现有自监督方法，接近有监督性能。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Clustering Harmonization for Self-supervised 3D Object Detection.

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: ①针对自监督目标检测中缺乏标注数据的问题，提出通过生成图像合成来训练检测器。②方法利用生成模型合成逼真的图像及其对应的边界框标签，无需人工标注。③相比传统自监督方法，该方法直接生成带标签数据，避免了依赖手工特征或对比学习的间接性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但展示了在目标检测任务上的可行性。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised object detection by synthesizing training images with generative models, providing pseudo-labels without manual annotation. It improves over prior self-supervised methods by directly generating labeled data, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 该论文思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，实用性待验证。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.contribution: 提出基于生成图像合成的自监督目标检测框架。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.innovation: 利用生成模型直接合成带标签训练数据。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Object Detection via Generative Image Synthesis.

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: ①针对对比学习在目标检测中迁移性差的问题，提出DetCo，一种无监督对比学习框架。②方法通过多层级对比损失，联合优化全局和局部特征，增强检测器对多尺度目标的感知。③相比通用对比学习（如MoCo），DetCo专门设计用于检测任务，显著提升迁移性能。④在COCO检测和实例分割上，DetCo优于MoCo v2和SimCLR，例如在1%标注数据下检测AP提升约2-3个点。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: DetCo introduces an unsupervised contrastive learning framework with multi-level losses to improve feature transfer for object detection. It outperforms general contrastive methods like MoCo v2 and SimCLR on COCO detection and segmentation, especially with limited labels.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 针对检测任务定制对比学习，实用性强，实验充分。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的多层级对比学习框架。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 多层级对比损失联合优化全局与局部特征。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在COCO上显著优于现有对比学习方法。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中LiDAR场景流估计和运动分割依赖标注的问题，提出SLIM自监督方法。②方法通过连续帧点云的一致性约束，联合学习场景流和运动分割，无需人工标注。③相比有监督方法，SLIM利用自监督信号，适应不同传感器配置。④在多个数据集上，SLIM在场景流估计和运动分割上接近甚至超越有监督基线，例如在KITTI上场景流误差降低约10%。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: SLIM proposes a self-supervised framework for LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation using temporal consistency, eliminating annotation needs. It achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on benchmarks like KITTI, with reduced flow errors.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 对自动驾驶感知有直接价值，自监督设计降低标注成本。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出自监督LiDAR场景流与运动分割联合学习框架。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 利用时序一致性实现无监督联合训练。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 在KITTI等数据集上接近有监督性能。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: ①针对半监督点云语义分割中标注稀缺的问题，提出引导点对比学习。②方法利用少量标注点引导未标注点的特征学习，通过对比损失增强类内一致性。③相比传统半监督方法，引导机制更有效利用标注信息。④在S3DIS和ScanNet上，仅用1%标注时mIoU提升约5-8%。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper introduces guided point contrastive learning for semi-supervised point cloud segmentation, using sparse labels to guide feature learning. It improves mIoU by 5-8% on S3DIS and ScanNet with only 1% labels.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 方法有效，但创新性一般，实验规模有限。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出引导式对比学习用于半监督点云分割。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 利用标注点作为引导信号增强对比学习。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在低标注率下显著提升分割精度。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督表示学习缺乏时空信息的问题，提出时空自监督方法。②方法通过预测点云序列的时空变换（如旋转、平移）来学习特征，结合对比学习。③相比仅空间自监督，该方法捕获动态场景中的时序依赖。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上，预训练模型性能优于现有自监督方法，例如在ModelNet40分类准确率提升约2%。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This work proposes spatio-temporal self-supervised learning for 3D point clouds by predicting transformations in both space and time. It outperforms spatial-only methods on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 时空结合是点云自监督的重要方向，实验较全面。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出时空自监督预训练框架。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 联合预测时空变换增强特征表达。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在多个基准上提升下游任务性能。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: ①针对无监督点云物体共分割问题，提出共对比学习和互注意力采样。②方法通过对比学习对齐不同点云中的相似物体，并用互注意力机制采样关键点。③相比传统聚类方法，该方法更鲁棒地处理形状变化。④在多个数据集上，共分割精度优于现有无监督方法，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised point cloud co-segmentation via co-contrastive learning and mutual attention sampling. It aligns similar objects across point clouds and improves robustness to shape variations, outperforming prior unsupervised methods.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 针对特定任务，方法有创新但应用范围较窄。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习与互注意力采样框架。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 利用共对比学习实现跨点云物体对齐。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在共分割任务上优于现有方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对点云数据上3D特征的自监督预训练问题，旨在减少对人工标注的依赖。②提出了一个通用的自监督预训练框架，适用于任意点云数据，通过设计代理任务学习3D特征表示。③相比已有工作，该方法不依赖特定传感器或场景，具有更好的泛化性和灵活性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多种点云任务上提升了性能。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised pretraining of 3D features on point clouds to reduce reliance on manual annotations. It proposes a general framework applicable to any point cloud data, learning 3D representations via proxy tasks. Compared to existing methods, it offers better generalization without sensor-specific assumptions, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该论文为点云自监督学习提供了通用方案，对3D感知领域有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出了一个适用于任意点云的自监督预训练框架。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计了一种不依赖特定传感器或场景的通用自监督代理任务。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多种点云任务上提升了性能（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对混合CNN-Transformer架构的神经架构搜索问题，旨在高效发现高性能网络。②提出了BossNAS方法，采用块级自监督搜索策略，通过分块训练和评估来优化架构。③相比已有NAS方法，该方法结合了自监督学习，减少了对标注数据的依赖，并提高了搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个基准上优于现有方法。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles neural architecture search for hybrid CNN-Transformer models, aiming to efficiently discover high-performance networks. It proposes BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised search strategy that optimizes architectures via block-level training and evaluation. Compared to prior NAS methods, it leverages self-supervision to reduce annotation dependence and improve search efficiency, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: 该论文创新性地将自监督学习融入NAS，对架构搜索领域有重要贡献，值得关注。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出了块级自监督NAS方法BossNAS，用于混合CNN-Transformer架构搜索。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 采用块级自监督策略，减少标注依赖并提升搜索效率。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督学习中的表示蒸馏问题，旨在提升特征学习的质量。②提出了ISD（Iterative Similarity Distillation）方法，通过迭代相似性蒸馏来优化表示。③相比已有蒸馏方法，ISD引入了迭代机制，逐步细化相似性目标，增强了学习稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个自监督基准上取得了改进。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses representation distillation in self-supervised learning to improve feature quality. It proposes ISD (Iterative Similarity Distillation), which iteratively refines similarity targets for better representation learning. Compared to existing distillation methods, ISD enhances stability via iteration, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的迭代蒸馏策略，对自监督学习有潜在价值，但效果需进一步验证。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出了迭代相似性蒸馏方法ISD，用于自监督表示学习。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 引入迭代机制逐步细化相似性目标，提升学习稳定性。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在多个自监督基准上取得了改进（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督学习表示的可泛化性理论分析问题，旨在提供严格的泛化保证。②证明了在特定条件下，自监督表示学习后接简单分类器的泛化差距趋于零，且不依赖于表示复杂度。③相比已有理论工作，该证明不假设表示学习任务的独立性，仅需自然噪声鲁棒性和理性条件，适用范围更广。④摘要未提供实验数据，但理论结果非平凡，适用于多种流行架构。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of generalization in self-supervised representation learning, proving that the generalization gap tends to zero under certain conditions, independent of representation complexity. Unlike prior work, it avoids structural independence assumptions, relying only on natural noise-robustness and rationality conditions. The bound is non-vacuous for many popular architectures, though no experimental data is included.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了重要的理论保证，对理解自监督学习的泛化性有深远意义，值得高度关注。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明了自监督表示学习后接简单分类器的泛化差距上界，且不依赖表示复杂度。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在无独立性假设下，仅基于噪声鲁棒性和理性条件推导泛化界。
2010.08508|v2.result: 理论结果非平凡，适用于多种流行架构。

2203.14221|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频自监督学习模型在不同基准下的泛化能力评估不足的问题。②作者通过超过500个实验，系统研究了领域、样本、动作和任务四个敏感性因素对模型性能的影响，并提出了SEVERE-benchmark子集。③相比以往仅关注单一基准性能的研究，该工作首次全面揭示了现有基准在评估泛化性方面的局限性。④研究发现自监督方法在领域偏移大和下游样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练，SEVERE-benchmark为未来方法评估提供了更严格的测试。
2203.14221|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the benchmark sensitivity of video self-supervised learning across domain, samples, actions, and task factors via over 500 experiments. It reveals that current benchmarks poorly indicate generalization and proposes the SEVERE-benchmark for stricter evaluation. Self-supervised methods lag behind supervised pre-training under large domain shifts and limited data.
2203.14221|v2.assessment: 该研究对视频自监督学习的评估体系提出了重要质疑，为领域内方法比较提供了更可靠的基准，值得关注。
2203.14221|v2.contribution: 提出了SEVERE-benchmark，并系统揭示了视频自监督学习对基准的敏感性。
2203.14221|v2.innovation: 首次从多因素角度全面分析视频自监督学习的泛化能力。
2203.14221|v2.result: 自监督方法在挑战性场景下性能显著下降，SEVERE-benchmark提供了更严格的评估。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云领域自适应中伪标签不可靠的问题。②提出了自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，并结合可靠的投票伪标签机制。③相比现有方法，通过全局和局部结构的一致性学习增强了特征鲁棒性。④实验表明该方法在多个点云数据集上提升了领域自适应性能。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliable pseudo-labels in point cloud domain adaptation by proposing self-supervised global-local structure modeling with reliable voted pseudo-labels. It enhances feature robustness through consistency learning, improving adaptation performance on multiple datasets.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 该工作为点云领域自适应提供了新思路，但实验细节有限，影响力中等。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出了结合全局-局部结构建模和投票伪标签的点云领域自适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督全局-局部一致性提升伪标签可靠性。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 在多个点云数据集上取得了更好的领域自适应效果。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure Modeling for Point Cloud Domain Adaptation with Reliable Voted Pseudo Labels.

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云场景流估计中缺乏监督信号的问题。②提出了RigidFlow方法，利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习。③相比现有自监督方法，通过显式建模局部刚性约束提高了流估计的准确性。④实验在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: This paper proposes RigidFlow, a self-supervised scene flow learning method on point clouds using local rigidity prior. It improves flow accuracy by explicitly modeling local rigidity constraints, validated on multiple datasets.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 该工作对自监督场景流估计有贡献，但创新性一般，实验规模有限。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督场景流学习方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性约束引入自监督场景流学习。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 在多个数据集上取得了有竞争力的场景流估计性能。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le._arxiv_id: RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Learning on Point Clouds by Local Rigidity Prior.

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对点云上采样中依赖监督数据和固定尺度因子的问题。②提出了自监督任意尺度点云上采样方法，通过隐式神经表示估计投影方向和距离。③相比现有方法，实现了自监督和尺度灵活的上采样，无需配对数据。④实验表明该方法在性能上达到或超过了有监督方法。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised arbitrary-scale point cloud upsampling method via implicit neural representation, estimating projection direction and distance. It eliminates the need for paired supervision and supports flexible scales, achieving competitive or better performance than supervised methods.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了点云上采样中的关键限制，具有实用价值，值得关注。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督任意尺度点云上采样框架。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 利用隐式神经表示实现自监督和尺度灵活的上采样。
2204.08196|v2.result: 性能达到或超过有监督方法。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对掩码图像建模中复杂设计（如块状掩码、离散VAE）的必要性问题。②提出了SimMIM，采用随机掩码、像素回归和轻量预测头的简单框架。③相比现有方法，简化了设计但性能更强，证明了简单组件即可学习良好表示。④在ImageNet-1K上，ViT-B达到83.8% top-1准确率，SwinV2-H达到87.1%，均超越先前最佳。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SimMIM, a simple masked image modeling framework with random masking, pixel regression, and a light prediction head. It shows that simple designs achieve strong representation learning, surpassing prior methods on ImageNet-1K with ViT-B and SwinV2-H.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: 该工作简化了掩码图像建模，性能卓越，对自监督视觉领域有重要影响。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出了简单高效的SimMIM框架，刷新了ImageNet-1K自监督预训练性能。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 通过系统消融证明简单设计即可实现强表示学习。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: ①该论文针对面部动作单元识别中标注数据稀缺的问题。②提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法，利用面部先验知识增强特征学习。③相比通用自监督方法，结合了领域知识以提高AU识别的准确性。④实验在多个AU数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven self-supervised representation learning method for facial action unit recognition, leveraging facial prior knowledge. It enhances feature learning compared to generic methods, validated on multiple AU datasets.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 该工作将领域知识融入自监督学习，但应用范围较窄，影响力有限。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出了知识驱动的自监督AU识别方法。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 结合面部先验知识改进自监督表示学习。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 在多个AU数据集上取得了有效性能。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe._arxiv_id: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Facial Action Unit Recognition.

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频理解（如动作识别）中的视觉隐私泄露问题，现有方法需要隐私标签，但标注成本高。提出SPAct框架，包含匿名化函数、自监督隐私移除分支和动作识别分支，通过最小最大优化和对比自监督损失，在无隐私标签下训练。相比现有监督方法，首次实现自监督隐私移除，在已知动作和隐私属性协议下达到竞争性的动作-隐私权衡。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual privacy leakage in video understanding like action recognition, where existing methods require privacy labels. It proposes SPAct, a framework with an anonymization function, self-supervised privacy removal branch, and action recognition branch, trained via minimax optimization and contrastive loss. It achieves competitive action-privacy trade-offs without privacy labels, marking the first self-supervised approach.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将自监督学习应用于隐私保护，对视频理解领域有参考价值，但实验规模有限。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需隐私标签的自监督隐私移除框架SPAct。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 利用最小最大优化和对比自监督损失实现隐私移除与动作识别的平衡。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在已知协议下达到与监督方法竞争的动作-隐私权衡。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，传统评估仅关注旧任务性能下降，忽略了表示变化。提出表示遗忘概念，通过新任务前后最优线性分类器的性能差异来度量。利用该工具重新审视标准基准，发现无显式遗忘控制的模型表示遗忘较小，在长任务序列中可与显式控制方法媲美。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, proposing representation forgetting measured by the performance difference of an optimal linear classifier before and after new tasks. It reveals that models without explicit forgetting control often exhibit small representation forgetting, comparable to explicit methods in longer sequences.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了新的评估视角，对持续学习研究有理论贡献，但应用性有限。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表示遗忘概念并重新评估持续学习基准。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用线性分类器性能差异量化表示变化。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现无显式控制模型在长序列中表现可比。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，现有方法受限于少量样本（exemplars）无法承载足够任务知识。提出利用未标注数据生成多样化的样本，通过可学习特征生成器结合语义和语义无关信息，并引入语义对比学习和语义解耦对比学习保证一致性和多样性。生成的样本有效防止遗忘，且不增加推理开销。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, proposing to diversify exemplars using unlabeled data via a learnable feature generator. It introduces semantic contrastive learning for consistency and semantic-decoupling for diversity, effectively reducing forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 该论文方法新颖，利用未标注数据增强记忆，对持续学习有实际价值。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出基于未标注数据的样本多样化生成方法。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 结合语义对比和语义解耦对比学习生成多样样本。
2204.08932|v2.result: 有效防止遗忘且无额外推理开销。

2208.07576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对弱监督目标检测（WSOD）中常见的argmax标注忽略多实例问题。提出对象发现的多实例标注方法和弱监督对比损失（WSCL），利用同类嵌入一致性构建可信相似度阈值。在MS-COCO 2014/2017和PASCAL VOC 2012上达到新SOTA，VOC 2007上结果竞争。
2208.07576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of argmax labeling ignoring instances in weakly supervised object detection. It proposes object discovery and a weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL) to construct credible similarity thresholds, achieving SOTA on MS-COCO and competitive results on PASCAL VOC.
2208.07576|v2.assessment: 该论文方法有效提升WSOD性能，对比学习应用巧妙，值得关注。
2208.07576|v2.contribution: 提出对象发现和WSCL改进弱监督目标检测。
2208.07576|v2.innovation: 在无实例级信息下利用对比学习构建相似度阈值。

2208.03062|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对低质量图像中目标检测问题，现有超分辨率预处理假设退化已知，但实际未知。提出AERIS框架，利用下采样退化作为自监督信号，探索等变表示，结合任意分辨率重建解码器，端到端联合优化表示学习和检测。该框架可应用于多种检测架构。
2208.03062|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection in degraded low-resolution images, where degradation is unknown. It proposes AERIS, a self-supervised framework using downsampling as a transformation to learn equivariant representations, jointly optimizing representation and detection end-to-end.
2208.03062|v2.assessment: 该论文对低质量检测有实际意义，但实验细节有限。
2208.03062|v2.contribution: 提出自监督框架AERIS处理未知退化下的检测。
2208.03062|v2.innovation: 利用下采样退化作为自监督信号学习等变表示。
2208.03062|v2.result: 在低质量图像检测中表现有效。

2203.16527|v2.summary_cn: 该论文探索将普通非层次ViT作为目标检测骨干，无需重新设计层次结构。发现简单特征金字塔和窗口注意力（无移位）即可有效，提出ViTDet，基于MAE预训练，在COCO上达到61.3 AP_box，仅用ImageNet-1K预训练，与层次骨干方法竞争。
2203.16527|v2.summary_en: This paper explores plain ViT backbones for object detection, showing simple feature pyramids and window attention suffice. ViTDet, with MAE pre-training, achieves 61.3 AP_box on COCO with ImageNet-1K, competing with hierarchical backbones.
2203.16527|v2.assessment: 该论文具有高影响力，简化检测架构，性能卓越，对视觉Transformer研究有重要贡献。
2203.16527|v2.contribution: 提出ViTDet，证明普通ViT可作检测骨干。
2203.16527|v2.innovation: 简化特征金字塔和窗口注意力设计。

2207.12655|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶场景中基于点云的3D目标检测器严重依赖大量精确标注、而3D标注极其耗时费力的问题，提出一种半监督学习框架以减少对大规模监督的依赖。②方法通过增强教师模型为“熟练教师”，设计了空间-时间集成（STE）模块生成足够的候选框以提高伪标签召回率，以及基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块聚合候选框投票以提高召回框的精度，并消除了复杂阈值选择伪标签的需求。③相比已有Pseudo-Labeling方法，改进点在于提升教师模型质量，同时利用软监督减少错误伪标签样本在训练中的负面影响。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著提升了半监督3D检测性能，尤其在小标注比例下效果突出。
2207.12655|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of point-cloud 3D detectors on expensive annotations in autonomous driving by proposing a semi-supervised Pseudo-Labeling framework with a proficient teacher. It introduces a Spatial-temporal Ensemble (STE) module to improve pseudo-label recall and a Clustering-based Box Voting (CBV) module to enhance precision without complex thresholds, while using soft supervision to mitigate noisy labels. Experiments show significant performance gains over baselines, especially under low annotation budgets.
2207.12655|v2.assessment: 该论文针对半监督3D检测中的伪标签质量问题提出了系统性的解决方案，设计巧妙且实验充分，对降低标注成本具有重要实际意义。
2207.12655|v2.contribution: 提出了一种增强教师模型的半监督3D检测框架，通过STE和CBV模块显著提升伪标签质量。
2207.12655|v2.innovation: 利用时空集成和聚类投票机制替代传统阈值选择，实现更鲁棒的伪标签生成。
2207.12655|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得了优于现有半监督方法的检测精度，尤其在小标注比例下提升显著。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云预训练中MAE方法因点云稀疏性和不规则性导致生成重建效果不佳的问题。②提出GD-MAE，引入生成解码器，通过生成式建模更有效地重建点云结构，增强预训练表征。③相比标准MAE，GD-MAE在解码器设计中采用生成策略，更好地适应点云特性，提升下游任务性能。④在多个LiDAR基准上（如SemanticKITTI）显著提升分割和检测精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying MAE pre-training to LiDAR point clouds, where sparsity and irregularity hinder effective reconstruction. It proposes GD-MAE with a generative decoder to better model point cloud structures, improving downstream task performance on benchmarks like SemanticKITTI.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练的关键问题，方法有针对性，对自动驾驶感知有较高参考价值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出生成解码器增强MAE在LiDAR点云上的预训练效果。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 将生成式解码策略引入点云MAE，适应点云稀疏性。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在LiDAR分割和检测任务上取得性能提升。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: ①针对运动预测任务中缺乏大规模标注数据的问题，提出自监督预训练方法。②提出Forecast-MAE，利用掩码自编码器对轨迹和场景上下文进行重建预训练，学习通用运动表征。③相比现有方法，首次将MAE应用于运动预测，并设计时空掩码策略，增强对动态场景的理解。④在Argoverse等基准上，预训练后微调显著提升预测精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of labeled data in motion forecasting by introducing Forecast-MAE, a self-supervised pre-training method using masked autoencoders to reconstruct trajectories and scene context. It improves forecasting accuracy on benchmarks like Argoverse after fine-tuning.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 将MAE成功扩展到运动预测，对自动驾驶预测模块有重要启示。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出首个面向运动预测的MAE自监督预训练框架。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 设计时空掩码策略以捕捉动态场景依赖。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在运动预测基准上提升下游任务性能。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作预测中时序信息利用不足的问题。②提出Temporal DINO，扩展DINO自监督方法到视频领域，通过时序对比学习增强动作预测。③相比图像级DINO，引入时间维度建模，捕捉动态变化。④在动作预测基准上提升准确率，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient temporal modeling in action prediction by extending DINO to video with Temporal DINO, using temporal contrastive learning. It improves action prediction accuracy on benchmarks.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 对视频理解有贡献，但创新性一般，与自动驾驶核心任务相关性中等。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出时序DINO自监督策略增强视频动作预测。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 将DINO扩展到视频并引入时序对比学习。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.result: 在动作预测任务上取得性能提升。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: ①针对掩码图像建模（MIM）主要适用于ViT而难以应用于CNN的问题。②提出架构无关的MIM方法，通过设计通用掩码和重建策略，使CNN也能受益于MIM预训练。③相比现有MIM方法，突破了架构限制，提升了CNN在多种视觉任务上的表现。④在ImageNet分类和下游任务上，CNN模型性能显著提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of masked image modeling to ViT architectures by proposing an architecture-agnostic MIM method that enables CNNs to benefit from MIM pre-training. It improves CNN performance on ImageNet and downstream tasks.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 解决了MIM架构依赖问题，对视觉预训练研究有广泛影响。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出架构无关的MIM方法，扩展至CNN。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 设计通用掩码和重建策略，打破ViT限制。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: 提升CNN在分类和下游任务上的性能。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督目标检测和实例分割中依赖人工标注的问题。②提出CutLER方法，利用自监督模型发现对象的能力，通过MaskCut生成粗掩码，并用鲁棒损失训练检测器，再通过自训练提升性能。③相比现有工作，CutLER更简单、架构兼容性强，且能检测多个对象，支持零样本检测。④在11个跨域基准上，AP50提升超过2.7倍；在COCO上仅用5%标签微调，APbox和APmask分别超过MoCo-v2 7.3%和6.6%。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection and segmentation by proposing CutLER, which uses MaskCut to generate coarse masks and trains a detector with a robust loss, followed by self-training. It achieves over 2.7x AP50 improvement on 11 benchmarks and surpasses MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask on COCO with 5% labels.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 方法简单高效，显著推进无监督检测，对自动驾驶开放场景感知有重要价值。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出无监督检测框架CutLER，实现多对象检测和零样本能力。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 利用自监督模型发现能力结合MaskCut和自训练。
2301.11320|v2.result: 在多个基准上大幅提升检测性能，低样本场景超越对比方法。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测在场景分布变化下性能下降的问题。②提出自监督场景适应方法，通过利用未标注目标场景数据调整检测器。③相比传统域适应，无需源域标注，更灵活。④在多个场景适应基准上提升检测精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation in object detection under scene distribution shifts by proposing a self-supervised scene adaptation method that adjusts detectors using unlabeled target data. It improves detection accuracy on adaptation benchmarks.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 对自动驾驶场景泛化有参考意义，但方法细节和效果需进一步验证。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出自监督场景适应策略提升检测器泛化能力。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 利用未标注数据实现无源域依赖的适应。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.result: 在场景适应基准上提升检测性能。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模LiDAR点云地图优化中全局配准收敛慢、缺乏闭环和精确对应点的问题。②提出DeepMapping2，通过基于闭环的地图拓扑组织训练批次，并引入自监督局部到全局点一致性损失，利用成对配准增强全局优化。③相比DeepMapping，改进了训练策略和损失设计，显著提升大规模数据集的收敛性和精度。④在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula数据集上的实验和消融研究验证了方法的有效性。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of large-scale LiDAR map optimization, including slow convergence and lack of loop closures. It proposes DeepMapping2 with topology-aware batch organization and a self-supervised local-to-global consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate improved accuracy and convergence.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶高精地图构建有直接价值，方法创新且实验充分，值得关注。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出DeepMapping2，通过拓扑感知训练和局部-全局一致性损失提升大规模LiDAR地图优化性能。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 利用闭环拓扑组织训练批次并引入自监督局部到全局点一致性损失。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在多个公开数据集上显著提升地图优化精度和收敛速度。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中缺乏有效掩码策略和重建目标的问题。②提出MV-JAR，结合掩码体素拼图任务和重建任务，增强模型对空间结构的理解。③相比现有MAE方法，引入体素级拼图预测，提升预训练特征的判别力。④在多个下游任务上验证了预训练模型的有效性。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised pre-training for LiDAR point clouds by proposing MV-JAR, which combines masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction tasks. It improves feature learning by predicting voxel arrangements, and experiments show enhanced downstream performance.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 对3D感知预训练有重要贡献，方法新颖，实验扎实。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出掩码体素拼图与重建结合的LiDAR自监督预训练框架。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 引入体素级拼图任务作为自监督信号。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.result: 在多个下游任务上提升预训练模型性能。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: ①针对点云视频自监督学习中的时空特征提取问题。②提出PointCMP，利用对比掩码预测方法，在点云视频上学习时空表示。③相比静态点云方法，引入时序信息增强特征鲁棒性。④实验显示在动态场景理解任务上优于基线。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised learning on point cloud videos by proposing PointCMP, a contrastive mask prediction method. It leverages temporal information to learn robust spatiotemporal features, outperforming baselines in dynamic scene tasks.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 对动态点云理解有参考价值，但实验规模有限。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出点云视频的对比掩码预测自监督学习框架。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 结合对比学习与掩码预测处理时序点云。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.result: 在动态场景任务上优于现有基线。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全任务中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出ACL-SPC，自适应闭环系统，通过自监督方式优化点云补全。③相比传统监督方法，减少标注需求并提升泛化能力。④实验表明在多种缺失场景下补全效果良好。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation dependency in point cloud completion by proposing ACL-SPC, an adaptive closed-loop self-supervised system. It reduces supervision needs and improves generalization, showing good performance in various missing scenarios.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 对自监督点云补全有贡献，但方法复杂度较高。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出自适应闭环自监督点云补全系统。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 闭环反馈机制增强自监督补全效果。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.result: 在多种缺失场景下实现有效补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大的问题。②提出ToThePoint，通过回收利用特征实现高效对比学习，减少计算资源消耗。③相比现有对比方法，提升训练效率而不牺牲性能。④在多个基准数据集上验证了效率和效果。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of contrastive learning on 3D point clouds by proposing ToThePoint, which recycles features for efficiency. It reduces resource usage while maintaining performance, validated on multiple benchmarks.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 对资源受限场景下的自监督学习有实用价值。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出特征回收的高效3D点云对比学习方法。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 通过特征复用降低计算开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.result: 在多个基准上实现高效且有效的学习。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中预测目标选择的问题，现有方法仅预测坐标或占用率。②提出GeoMAE，基于几何特征重建，预测质心、法线和曲率，结合占用率预测。③相比MAE方法，利用点云特有几何属性增强特征学习。④实验显示在多个下游任务上优于现有自监督方法。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the choice of prediction targets in point cloud self-supervised learning by proposing GeoMAE, which predicts geometric features like centroid, normal, and curvature. It improves feature learning over MAE methods, with superior downstream performance.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 对点云自监督学习有重要理论贡献，实验充分，值得关注。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何目标预测的点云自监督预训练框架。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 引入质心、法线和曲率预测作为自监督信号。
2305.08808|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上超越现有自监督方法。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云语义分割中自监督学习未充分利用LiDAR数据时间维度的问题，提出了一种结合空间与时间域正样本对的SSL策略。方法包括点-簇学习策略聚合空间信息以区分物体，以及基于无监督目标跟踪的簇-簇学习策略利用时间对应关系。相比仅使用单帧增强的现有方法，该方法在多个大规模LiDAR数据集上预训练并迁移到其他分割基准，实验表明性能优于现有最先进方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing self-supervised learning methods for point cloud segmentation that ignore temporal information. It proposes a spatiotemporal SSL strategy with point-to-cluster and cluster-to-cluster learning, leveraging unsupervised tracking for temporal correspondences. Extensive experiments on large-scale LiDAR datasets demonstrate superior transfer performance over state-of-the-art SSL methods.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 该工作有效挖掘了LiDAR数据的时空特性，为点云自监督学习提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知中的3D分割任务有重要参考价值。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出了首个利用时空正样本对进行点云自监督学习的方法。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 将无监督目标跟踪引入点云SSL，实现跨帧簇级特征对齐。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在多个点云分割基准上超越现有自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: 针对4D点云序列自监督表示学习未充分利用动态场景几何信息的问题，提出Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation方法。核心思想是将4D自监督学习建模为教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，学生模型在教师指导下学习有用的4D表示。相比仅考虑静态快照或图像空间流的方法，该方法在室内外多个4D点云序列理解任务上显著优于现有预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the under-exploitation of dynamic geometry in 4D point cloud self-supervised learning. It proposes a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework, Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, where the student learns representations guided by the teacher. Experiments show significant improvements over prior pre-training methods across diverse indoor and outdoor 4D understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏引入4D点云自监督学习，有效利用了序列动态信息，对自动驾驶中的动态场景理解具有启发意义。
2212.05330|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于完整到部分蒸馏的4D点云序列自监督预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.innovation: 利用教师-学生框架从完整序列蒸馏知识到部分观测，增强4D表示学习。
2212.05330|v2.result: 在多个4D点云任务上显著超越现有方法。

2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角视频中3D关键点发现需要人工标注的问题，提出BKinD-3D方法，在无2D/3D关键点或边界框监督下进行自监督3D关键点发现。方法采用编码器-解码器架构，使用3D体积热图，训练目标包括重建多视角时空差异和关节长度约束。在人类和大鼠视频上验证了有效性，展示了3D关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for manual annotations in 3D keypoint discovery from multi-view videos. BKinD-3D uses an encoder-decoder with 3D volumetric heatmaps, trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences and enforce joint length constraints, without any keypoint or box supervision. Experiments on human and rat videos demonstrate its potential for behavior analysis.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 该工作为行为分析提供了无监督3D姿态估计方案，虽与自动驾驶直接相关性较低，但方法具有跨领域参考价值。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无需任何监督的多视角视频3D关键点自监督发现方法。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合3D体积热图和关节长度约束实现无监督3D骨架学习。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频上成功发现3D关键点。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中自监督方法发展不一致的问题，提出DeepMVC统一框架，涵盖多种现有方法。通过理论分析证明对比对齐可能损害簇可分性，且视图越多影响越严重。基于此开发新实例，实验表明对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，所有方法受益于某种自监督，新实例在多个数据集上优于先前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistencies in self-supervision for deep multi-view clustering by proposing DeepMVC, a unified framework encompassing many recent methods. It theoretically proves contrastive alignment can harm cluster separability, worsening with more views. New instances are developed, and experiments show contrastive alignment hurts performance on many-view datasets, while new instances outperform prior methods.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 该工作对多视图聚类中的自监督设计提供了理论洞见和实证指导，虽非自动驾驶核心领域，但对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出了统一框架DeepMVC并揭示了对比对齐在多视图聚类中的负面影响。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 理论证明对比对齐对簇可分性的损害，并据此设计新的自监督形式。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新实例在多个数据集上取得最优性能。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中CNN与Transformer架构结合时计算效率与精度平衡的问题，提出Lite-Mono轻量级架构。方法结合CNN的局部特征提取与Transformer的全局上下文建模，设计高效模块降低计算量。相比现有方法，在保持高精度的同时显著减少参数量和推理时间，在KITTI等基准上验证了有效性。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Lite-Mono, a lightweight CNN-Transformer hybrid. It efficiently combines local and global features with reduced parameters and inference cost. Experiments on benchmarks like KITTI demonstrate competitive accuracy with significantly lower computational overhead.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 该工作为自监督深度估计提供了高效架构，对自动驾驶中的实时感知系统具有实用价值。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出了一种轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 通过高效模块设计在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算复杂度。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 在KITTI等基准上以更低计算量达到竞争性精度。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: 针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模基准和有效方法的问题，该论文提出一个通过3D异常合成生成的基准，并设计了一个自监督学习网络。方法利用合成异常数据训练网络，以学习正常与异常模式的区分。相比现有2D异常检测方法，该工作扩展至3D领域，并提供了可扩展的基准。实验表明，该网络在合成基准上取得了较好的检测与定位性能。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks and effective methods for 3D anomaly detection and localization by proposing a benchmark via 3D anomaly synthesis and a self-supervised learning network. The method trains on synthetic anomalies to distinguish normal and abnormal patterns, extending 2D approaches to 3D. Experiments demonstrate promising detection and localization performance on the synthetic benchmark.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 该工作为3D异常检测提供了新基准和自监督方法，对工业检测等应用有参考价值，但合成数据与真实场景的差距需进一步验证。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 提出了首个基于合成策略的3D异常检测基准和配套自监督网络。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 利用3D异常合成实现自监督训练，无需真实异常标注。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 在合成基准上实现了有效的异常检测与定位。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an._arxiv_id: Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection and Localization: A Benchmark via 3D Anomaly Synthesis and A Self-Supervised Learning Network.

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: 针对自监督关键点估计中对应关系不准确的问题，该论文提出SCE-MAE，结合选择性对应增强与掩码自编码器。方法通过选择性增强关键点对应关系，提升特征学习的判别性。相比标准MAE，该方法更关注关键点区域的语义一致性。实验表明，在多个关键点估计基准上取得了显著提升。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper proposes SCE-MAE, integrating selective correspondence enhancement with masked autoencoders to improve correspondence accuracy in self-supervised landmark estimation. The method selectively enhances keypoint correspondences to boost discriminative feature learning. Experiments show significant improvements on multiple landmark estimation benchmarks.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 该工作针对关键点估计的对应关系问题提出了有效改进，对下游任务有实用价值，但创新性有限。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出选择性对应增强机制，提升MAE在关键点估计中的性能。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 在MAE框架中引入关键点对应选择与增强策略。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 在多个关键点估计基准上取得显著性能提升。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc._arxiv_id: SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhancement with Masked Autoencoder for Self-Supervised Landmark Estimation.

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: 针对点云表示学习中时间信息利用不足的问题，该论文提出T-MAE，一种时间掩码自编码器。方法在掩码自编码框架中引入时间维度的掩码与重建，以学习时空特征。相比仅处理静态点云的方法，T-MAE能捕捉动态场景中的时序依赖。实验表明，在多个点云下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得了优于现有自监督方法的性能。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper proposes T-MAE, a temporal masked autoencoder for point cloud representation learning, addressing insufficient temporal information utilization. The method introduces temporal masking and reconstruction to capture spatiotemporal features. Experiments show superior performance on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation compared to existing self-supervised methods.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 该工作将MAE扩展至时间维度，对自动驾驶动态点云理解有重要价值，方法设计合理且实验充分。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出时间掩码自编码器，实现点云时空表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 在MAE中引入时间掩码策略，建模时序依赖。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 在点云分类和分割任务上取得领先性能。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for._arxiv_id: T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Representation Learning.

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: 针对图像和视频联合表示学习中的模态差异问题，该论文提出ViC-MAE，结合对比学习与掩码自编码器。方法通过对比损失对齐图像与视频特征，同时利用MAE重建增强表征。相比单一模态的自监督方法，ViC-MAE能学习跨模态共享表示。实验表明，在视频和图像下游任务上均取得了性能提升。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper proposes ViC-MAE, combining contrastive learning with masked autoencoders for joint image and video representation learning. The method aligns image and video features via contrastive loss and enhances representations through MAE reconstruction. Experiments show improvements on both video and image downstream tasks.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 该工作有效融合了对比学习与MAE，对多模态感知有参考价值，实验设计较全面。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出对比掩码自编码器，实现图像与视频的联合自监督学习。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 将对比学习与掩码重建结合，处理跨模态对齐。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 在视频和图像任务上取得一致性能提升。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation._arxiv_id: ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation Learning from Images and Video with Contrastive Masked Autoencoders.

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: 针对神经辐射场（NeRF）的3D表示学习缺乏自监督方法的问题，该论文提出NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF特征空间。方法通过掩码重建NeRF的隐式表示，学习可迁移的3D特征。相比基于体素或点云的方法，NeRF-MAE直接处理连续场景表示。实验表明，在3D分类和分割任务上取得了有竞争力的性能。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper proposes NeRF-MAE, applying masked autoencoders to NeRF feature spaces for self-supervised 3D representation learning. The method reconstructs masked implicit representations to learn transferable 3D features. Experiments show competitive performance on 3D classification and segmentation tasks.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 该工作将MAE引入NeRF领域，为3D表示学习提供了新思路，但实际应用场景有限。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 首次将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF表示学习。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.innovation: 在NeRF隐式特征上执行掩码重建。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 在3D分类和分割任务上取得有竞争力结果。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s._arxiv_id: NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields.

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: 针对单视频中无监督点跟踪的挑战，该论文提出DINO-Tracker，利用DINO预训练特征进行自监督点跟踪。方法通过特征匹配和时序一致性实现无需标注的跟踪。相比传统光流或监督方法，DINO-Tracker无需训练数据即可泛化。实验表明，在多个视频跟踪基准上取得了与监督方法相当的性能。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper proposes DINO-Tracker, leveraging DINO pre-trained features for self-supervised point tracking in a single video. The method uses feature matching and temporal consistency without annotations. Experiments show performance comparable to supervised methods on multiple tracking benchmarks.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 该工作展示了预训练视觉特征在点跟踪中的潜力，方法简洁有效，对视频理解有参考价值。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出基于DINO特征的自监督点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用预训练特征实现无需训练的点跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 在多个基准上达到与监督方法相当的性能。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super._arxiv_id: DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-supervised Point Tracking in a Single Video.

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样任务中依赖密集标注和几何先验的问题。②提出SPU-PMD，通过渐进网格变形实现自监督点云上采样，无需真实密集点云标签。③相比现有监督方法，首次将自监督与网格变形结合，利用多尺度特征和变形一致性约束。④在多个基准数据集上达到与监督方法相当的性能，显著减少标注成本。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations in point cloud upsampling by proposing SPU-PMD, a self-supervised method using progressive mesh deformation. It eliminates the need for ground-truth dense point clouds, achieving performance comparable to supervised baselines while reducing annotation overhead.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 为点云上采样提供自监督新思路，对3D感知数据增强有参考价值。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出首个自监督点云上采样框架，结合渐进网格变形。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 自监督与网格变形的创新结合，避免密集标注。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个数据集上性能接近监督方法，标注成本大幅降低。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups._arxiv_id: SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Upsampling via Progressive Mesh Deformation.

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中对象依赖导致特征泛化差的问题。②提出对象交换策略，在训练中交换不同场景中的对象以破坏对象间相关性，增强模型对独立对象的表征。③相比现有对比学习方法，通过显式解耦对象依赖提升下游任务迁移能力。④在多个3D感知任务上（如分类、分割）取得显著性能提升，尤其在跨域场景下。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This work tackles object dependencies in point cloud self-supervised learning by introducing an object exchange strategy that swaps objects across scenes during training. This decouples object correlations, improving feature generalization and downstream task performance, especially in cross-domain settings.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 针对自监督学习中的关键瓶颈，方法简洁有效，对3D感知预训练有重要启示。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出对象交换策略，缓解点云自监督中的对象依赖问题。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过场景间对象交换实现特征解耦。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在分类和分割任务上性能显著提升，跨域泛化增强。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin._arxiv_id: Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improving Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning Through Object Exchange.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出自监督多目标跟踪方法，利用路径一致性约束，在无标注视频序列上学习跟踪特征。③相比监督方法，首次将路径一致性用于自监督跟踪，有效处理遮挡和ID切换。④在MOT17等基准上达到接近监督方法的性能，显著降低标注需求。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation burden in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised approach based on path consistency, learning tracking features from unlabeled videos. It effectively handles occlusions and ID switches, achieving near-supervised performance on benchmarks like MOT17.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 为跟踪任务提供自监督范式，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接应用潜力。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出路径一致性自监督跟踪框架，减少标注依赖。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 将路径一致性约束引入自监督跟踪。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT17上性能接近监督方法，标注成本大幅降低。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D场景理解中模型无法识别未知类别的问题。②提出RegionPLC，通过区域级点-语言对比学习，将3D区域特征与文本嵌入对齐，实现开放词汇分类。③相比现有方法，利用区域级对比学习增强细粒度语义理解，支持任意类别查询。④在ScanNet等数据集上，开放词汇分割和检测性能显著优于SOTA，mAP提升明显。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D scene understanding by proposing RegionPLC, which aligns regional point features with language embeddings via contrastive learning, enabling open-vocabulary classification. It outperforms SOTA in open-vocabulary segmentation and detection on ScanNet, with notable mAP gains.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 开放世界3D理解的重要突破，对自动驾驶未知物体识别极具价值。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域级点-语言对比学习，实现开放词汇3D理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 区域级对比学习与语言模型结合。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在ScanNet上开放词汇任务性能显著提升。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: ①针对多模态大语言模型中的幻觉问题，即生成内容与视觉输入不一致。②提出幻觉增强对比学习，通过构造幻觉样本并对比学习，增强模型区分真实与幻觉内容的能力。③相比现有缓解方法，首次将幻觉样本用于对比学习，提升模型鲁棒性。④在多个VQA和图像描述基准上，幻觉率显著降低，生成质量提升。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses hallucination in multimodal large language models by proposing hallucination-augmented contrastive learning, which uses hallucinated samples to train the model to distinguish real from false content. It significantly reduces hallucination rates and improves generation quality on VQA and captioning benchmarks.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 针对多模态模型核心缺陷，方法创新且实用，对自动驾驶视觉语言交互有参考。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习，缓解多模态模型幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 将幻觉样本融入对比学习框架。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 在多个基准上幻觉率显著降低，生成质量提升。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: ①针对多模态对比学习模型（如CLIP）的安全漏洞，即后门攻击。②提出BadCLIP，通过双嵌入引导的后门攻击，在图像和文本嵌入中注入触发器，实现高效攻击。③相比现有攻击方法，首次利用双嵌入协同增强攻击隐蔽性和成功率。④在多个数据集上攻击成功率接近100%，且不易被检测。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper exposes vulnerabilities in multimodal contrastive models by proposing BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack that injects triggers into both image and text embeddings. It achieves near-100% attack success with high stealth, outperforming existing attacks.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 揭示多模态模型安全风险，对自动驾驶感知系统的鲁棒性设计有警示意义。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 攻击成功率接近100%，隐蔽性强。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D占用预测依赖昂贵3D标注的问题。②提出SelfOcc，一种自监督框架，利用视频序列的时序一致性，通过可微渲染将3D占用预测与2D观测对齐，无需3D标签。③相比现有自监督方法，首次将占用预测与自监督深度估计统一，并引入稀疏化与正则化提升效率。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上，自监督占用预测性能显著优于基线，且在下游任务中表现优异。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive 3D annotations for 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving. It proposes SelfOcc, a self-supervised framework that leverages temporal consistency in videos and differentiable rendering to align 3D occupancy with 2D observations without 3D labels. Compared to existing methods, it unifies occupancy prediction with self-supervised depth estimation and introduces sparsification and regularization for efficiency. It achieves superior performance on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, demonstrating strong generalization.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该论文是自监督3D占用预测的开创性工作，对降低自动驾驶感知标注成本具有重要意义。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个无需3D标注的自监督3D占用预测框架SelfOcc。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 将可微渲染与自监督深度估计统一用于占用预测。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得领先的自监督性能。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos, which typically requires dense annotations. It proposes a self-supervised method that uses narrated instructions as weak supervision to learn correspondences between video segments and text, enabling action localization. Compared to existing work, it eliminates the need for manual action boundaries and improves generalization via cross-modal alignment. It demonstrates effectiveness on multiple benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该论文在视频理解领域有一定创新，但与自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出利用叙述指令进行自监督时空定位的方法。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 以弱监督跨模态对齐替代密集标注。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个基准上验证了有效性。

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: ①针对超分辨率模型在低分辨率输入上泛化能力差的问题。②提出自监督学习方法，利用低分辨率图像作为引导，增强模型对未知退化类型的适应性。③相比现有监督方法，通过自监督预训练提升跨域泛化。④在多个超分辨率基准上取得改进，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models on low-resolution inputs. It proposes a self-supervised learning approach that uses low-resolution images as guidance to enhance adaptability to unknown degradation types. Compared to supervised methods, it improves cross-domain generalization via self-supervised pretraining. It achieves improvements on multiple super-resolution benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 该论文对图像超分领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出利用低分辨率图像进行自监督预训练以提升超分泛化。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 以低分辨率引导自监督学习。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在多个超分基准上取得改进。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.
