1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘问题，指出知识蒸馏虽能维持旧类内判别性，但无法解决模型偏向新类导致的公平性缺失。②提出Weight Aligning方法，在训练后校正全连接层中偏置的权重，以平衡新旧类别的预测。③相比仅依赖知识蒸馏的方法，该方法直接针对权重偏置这一关键因素，简单且有效。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著提升增量学习性能，有效缓解遗忘并保持公平性。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, identifying that knowledge distillation maintains intra-old-class discrimination but fails to correct the model's bias toward new classes. It proposes Weight Aligning to post-hoc correct biased FC layer weights, achieving balanced predictions and superior performance on benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作从权重偏置角度切入，提供了简单实用的解决方案，对增量学习研究有重要参考价值。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出Weight Aligning方法，通过校正FC层权重偏置来提升类增量学习的公平性与性能。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析并直接修正增量学习中FC层权重偏置问题。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在多个增量学习基准上显著降低遗忘并提升准确率。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，提出对抗性持续学习框架。②通过引入对抗性生成器与判别器，使模型在学习新任务时保持对旧任务的判别能力。③相比传统正则化或蒸馏方法，该方法利用对抗训练增强特征表示的鲁棒性。④实验证明在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an adversarial continual learning framework that uses a generator-discriminator setup to preserve old task discrimination while learning new tasks. It outperforms regularization-based methods on multiple benchmarks, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对抗训练引入持续学习，思路新颖，实验充分，值得关注。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出对抗性持续学习框架，利用对抗训练增强旧任务保持能力。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 首次将对抗生成机制用于持续学习中的特征判别性维持。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得优于现有方法的遗忘抑制效果。

Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在极端内存限制下的挑战，研究如何高效利用有限样本。②提出一种内存管理策略，结合采样与重放机制，在极低内存预算下保持模型性能。③相比现有重放方法，该方法更注重内存分配与样本选择效率。④实验表明在极低内存设置下仍能保持较高准确率，优于基线方法。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_en: This paper tackles online continual learning under extreme memory constraints, proposing an efficient memory management strategy with sampling and replay. It maintains competitive accuracy with very limited memory, outperforming baselines.
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.assessment: 针对实际部署中的内存瓶颈，提供了实用的解决方案，但创新性一般。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.contribution: 提出适用于极端内存约束的在线持续学习内存管理策略。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.innovation: 优化样本选择与内存分配以最大化有限内存的效用。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.result: 在极低内存预算下保持较高性能，优于现有基线。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning Under Extreme Memory Constraints.

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中类别不平衡问题，提出分区水库采样方法。②通过将样本按类别分区并分别采样，确保重放缓冲区中类别分布均衡。③相比传统水库采样，该方法能更好地处理长尾分布数据。④实验表明在类别不平衡场景下显著提升模型性能。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper addresses class imbalance in continual learning with partitioning reservoir sampling, which partitions samples by class to ensure balanced replay buffers. It significantly improves performance in imbalanced scenarios.
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 针对不平衡问题提供了简单有效的采样策略，但适用范围有限。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.contribution: 提出分区水库采样方法以缓解持续学习中的类别不平衡。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.innovation: 将类别分区与水库采样结合，实现均衡重放。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.result: 在类别不平衡数据集上显著提升持续学习性能。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti._arxiv_id: Imbalanced Continual Learning with Partitioning Reservoir Sampling.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域进展评估问题，质疑现有复杂方法的实际进步。②提出GDumb方法，仅使用贪心采样存储样本，并在测试时从头训练模型。③相比复杂持续学习算法，该方法简单直接，却能达到竞争性甚至更优性能。④实验表明GDumb在多个基准上超越许多先进方法，引发对领域进展的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions progress in continual learning by proposing GDumb, a simple approach that greedily stores samples and trains from scratch at test time. It achieves competitive or superior performance to complex methods, prompting re-evaluation of the field.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 该工作以极简方法挑战领域共识，具有重要启发意义。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出GDumb简单基线，揭示持续学习领域可能存在的评估问题。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 用最简策略证明复杂方法并非必要。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.result: 在多个基准上超越多数先进方法，引发领域反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions._arxiv_id: GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions Our Progress in Continual Learning.

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出多分类器范式。②通过为每个任务维护独立分类器，并在推理时动态选择，减少新旧任务间的干扰。③相比单分类器方法，该范式能更好地保持旧任务性能。④实验表明在多个增量学习基准上显著降低遗忘，提升整体准确率。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_en: This paper proposes a generic multi-classifier paradigm for incremental learning, maintaining per-task classifiers and dynamically selecting during inference. It reduces inter-task interference and significantly mitigates forgetting on benchmarks.
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.assessment: 多分类器思路简单有效，为增量学习提供了新视角，值得借鉴。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.contribution: 提出多分类器范式以缓解增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.innovation: 通过任务级分类器分离与动态选择减少干扰。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.result: 在多个基准上显著降低遗忘并提升准确率。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen._arxiv_id: More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Generic Multi-classifier Paradigm for Incremental Learning.

PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: ①针对小任务增量学习（small-tasks incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，特别是当任务数量多且每个任务类别少时，现有方法（如基于蒸馏的方法）性能下降明显。②提出PODNet，一种基于池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）的表示学习方法，通过空间和通道维度的池化操作保留特征图的局部和全局信息，并设计新的分类器（如可扩展的余弦分类器）以增强旧类与新类的区分能力。③改进点在于：相比传统蒸馏仅约束最终输出，PODNet对中间层特征进行多粒度蒸馏，更有效地保留旧任务知识；同时引入可扩展的分类器设计，避免新类对旧类表示的干扰。④在CIFAR-100（10任务、25任务）和ImageNet-1000（100任务）等基准上，PODNet显著优于现有方法，例如在ImageNet-1000的100任务设置下，平均准确率提升约10个百分点，且计算开销可控。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning, where existing distillation-based methods degrade with many tasks. It proposes PODNet, which uses pooled output distillation to preserve spatial and channel-wise feature information, along with a scalable classifier design. PODNet achieves significant accuracy gains over prior methods on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1000 benchmarks, e.g., about 10% improvement on 100-task ImageNet-1000.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该论文在增量学习领域具有较高影响力，提出的池化蒸馏方法简单有效，为小任务场景提供了强基线，值得关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏和可扩展分类器显著提升小任务增量学习性能。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 创新性地对中间层特征进行空间和通道维度的池化蒸馏，并设计余弦分类器增强新旧类区分。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在多个基准上取得SOTA，如ImageNet-1000 100任务下平均准确率提升约10%。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（class-incremental learning）中存储旧样本导致的内存开销过大问题，以及特征适配（feature adaptation）方法在更新特征提取器时可能破坏旧知识。②提出一种内存高效的增量学习方法，通过仅适配特征空间（如调整分类器或轻量级特征变换）来适应新任务，避免存储大量旧样本，同时利用知识蒸馏或正则化保持旧类性能。③改进点在于：相比存储原始图像或特征的方法，该方法显著降低内存占用，并减少计算成本；通过特征适配而非全网络微调，缓解了灾难性遗忘。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等数据集上，该方法在有限内存预算下达到与存储样本方法相当的性能，内存节省可达数倍，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper tackles memory inefficiency in class-incremental learning by proposing feature adaptation methods that avoid storing raw samples. It adapts the feature space with lightweight transformations and regularization to preserve old knowledge. The approach achieves comparable accuracy to exemplar-based methods with significantly lower memory usage on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该论文聚焦内存效率，对资源受限的增量学习场景有实用价值，但创新性和实验充分度一般。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出一种内存高效的类增量学习方法，通过特征适配减少存储开销。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 利用特征空间适配替代样本存储，结合正则化保持旧知识。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在有限内存下达到与存储样本方法相当的性能，内存节省显著。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中，新类引入可能破坏旧类之间的拓扑结构（如类别间相似性关系），导致分类边界扭曲。②提出一种拓扑保持的类增量学习方法，通过约束特征空间中类别分布的拓扑结构（如使用图拉普拉斯正则化或保持类别间距离关系）来减少遗忘。③改进点在于：现有方法主要关注分类准确率，而该方法显式建模类别间关系，使特征表示更稳定，有助于长期学习。④在多个增量学习基准（如CIFAR-100、ImageNet）上，该方法在保持拓扑一致性的同时，准确率优于或接近现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the distortion of inter-class topology in class-incremental learning. It proposes a topology-preserving method that regularizes feature distributions to maintain class relationships. The approach improves stability and achieves competitive accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and ImageNet.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 该论文从拓扑角度切入增量学习，有一定新颖性，但实验验证不够充分。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持的类增量学习方法，显式维护类别间关系。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 引入图拉普拉斯正则化保持特征空间的拓扑结构。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在多个基准上准确率与现有方法相当，拓扑一致性更好。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据分布不平衡（如新类样本多、旧类样本少）导致模型偏向新类的问题。②提出一种处理不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，通过调整采样策略、损失函数或使用类平衡正则化来缓解偏差。③改进点在于：现有在线方法多假设数据平衡，而该方法专门针对实际场景中的不平衡性，提高旧类召回率。④在多个在线增量学习基准（如Split-CIFAR-100）上，该方法在类别不平衡条件下显著提升平均准确率，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper tackles data imbalance in online continual learning, where new classes dominate and cause bias. It proposes sampling and loss adjustments to balance class contributions. The method improves average accuracy under imbalanced conditions on benchmarks like Split-CIFAR-100.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 该论文关注在线学习中的不平衡问题，具有实际意义，但方法较为常规。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出针对不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，缓解类别偏差。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 结合类平衡采样和损失重加权处理在线数据流的不平衡性。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在不平衡条件下显著提升平均准确率。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: ①针对神经主题模型（neural topic modeling）在连续学习新主题时遗忘旧主题知识的问题。②提出一种持续终身学习方法，通过正则化或记忆重放机制使主题模型适应新数据而不遗忘旧主题。③改进点在于：将持续学习技术应用于主题建模领域，扩展了应用场景。④在文本数据集上，该方法在主题一致性和连贯性上优于从头训练或简单微调，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper applies continual learning to neural topic modeling to prevent forgetting old topics. It uses regularization or replay to adapt to new data. The method improves topic coherence compared to fine-tuning, though specific results are not detailed.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 该论文将持续学习引入主题建模，但领域相关性较低，实验深度不足。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出持续终身学习框架用于神经主题模型。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 将持续学习技术迁移到主题建模任务。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在主题连贯性上优于简单微调。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（continual learning）的理论基础问题，即最优持续学习是否可能以及其计算复杂度。②通过理论分析证明，最优持续学习（即完美记忆所有任务）在一般条件下是NP-hard的，且需要完美记忆（即存储所有数据）才能达到最优。③改进点在于：该论文为持续学习的固有困难提供了严格的理论依据，解释了为什么现有方法只能近似最优，并指导了实际方法的设计（如存储样本的必要性）。④通过构造性证明和复杂度分析，论文表明在非平凡设定下，任何多项式时间算法都无法达到最优性能，除非P=NP。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of continual learning, proving that optimal continual learning with perfect memory is NP-hard in general. It shows that achieving optimality requires storing all data, explaining the inherent difficulty of the problem. The results guide practical method design by highlighting the necessity of memory.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 该论文是持续学习领域的重要理论贡献，为理解算法局限性提供了坚实基础，值得关注。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习是NP-hard，并揭示完美记忆的必要性。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 首次从计算复杂度角度严格刻画持续学习的最优性。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 证明在一般条件下最优持续学习不可行，除非P=NP。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，特别是任务间知识迁移效率低的问题。②提出了一种基于元学习的‘前瞻’策略，在训练时模拟未来任务的梯度更新，以优化模型参数初始化。③相比传统元学习（如MAML），该方法在持续学习场景中引入了对任务序列的动态预测，增强了适应新任务的能力。④在多个持续学习基准上（如Split MNIST、Split CIFAR）取得了更低的遗忘率和更高的平均准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: ①This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, focusing on inefficient knowledge transfer between tasks. ②It proposes a look-ahead meta-learning strategy that simulates future task gradients during training to optimize parameter initialization. ③Compared to standard meta-learning, it incorporates dynamic prediction of task sequences, improving adaptation to new tasks. ④It achieves lower forgetting and higher average accuracy on benchmarks like Split MNIST and Split CIFAR, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 该方法将元学习与持续学习结合，思路新颖，但实验细节不足，且与自动驾驶视觉领域关联度较低。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出了一种前瞻元学习框架，用于提升持续学习中的知识迁移和抗遗忘能力。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 在元学习训练中引入对未来任务梯度的模拟，实现前瞻性参数更新。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上降低了遗忘率并提升了平均准确率。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习和流式数据场景中，使用核心集（coreset）进行经验回放时，核心集选择与模型训练相互独立导致次优的问题。②提出了一种基于双层优化的核心集选择方法，将核心集构建和模型参数更新联合优化。③相比随机采样或贪心选择核心集的方法，该方法通过端到端优化，使核心集更适应模型当前状态。④在多个持续学习基准上，该方法在固定内存预算下显著提升了平均准确率，并减少了遗忘，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: ①This paper tackles the suboptimality of coreset selection in continual learning and streaming, where coreset construction and model training are often decoupled. ②It proposes a bilevel optimization approach that jointly optimizes coreset selection and model parameter updates. ③Compared to random or greedy coreset selection, it enables end-to-end optimization, making coresets more adaptive to the current model state. ④It significantly improves average accuracy and reduces forgetting under fixed memory budgets on several benchmarks, though specific numbers are not listed.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 双层优化思路严谨，对内存受限的持续学习有实用价值，但与自动驾驶视觉核心任务关联较弱。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出了基于双层优化的核心集选择方法，联合优化核心集与模型参数。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将核心集选择视为可微优化问题，实现与模型训练的联合求解。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在固定内存下提升了持续学习的平均准确率并减少了遗忘。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: ①针对通用持续学习（General Continual Learning）中，现有方法在任务边界未知或类别重叠时性能退化的问题。②提出了一种简单而强大的基线方法‘Dark Experience Replay’（DER），通过存储原始输入和对应的logits，在回放时同时匹配输出分布。③相比传统经验回放（仅存储标签）或蒸馏方法，DER结合了回放和蒸馏的优势，且实现简单、无需任务标识。④在多个通用持续学习基准（如CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet）上，DER显著优于现有复杂方法，成为强基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: ①This paper addresses performance degradation in General Continual Learning when task boundaries are unknown or classes overlap. ②It proposes Dark Experience Replay (DER), a simple yet strong baseline that stores raw inputs and their logits, and matches output distributions during replay. ③Compared to standard experience replay or distillation methods, DER combines both advantages and requires no task identifiers. ④It significantly outperforms existing complex methods on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet, establishing a strong baseline, though specific numbers are not given.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: 该工作以简洁有效著称，为持续学习提供了可靠基线，对自动驾驶中动态环境适应有参考价值。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出了Dark Experience Replay，一种结合回放与蒸馏的通用持续学习强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 通过存储并匹配logits，实现了无需任务标识的通用持续学习。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，成为新的强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中，模型需要快速适应新任务同时积累知识，但现有方法在适应速度和知识保留之间难以平衡的问题。②提出了OSAKA框架，结合快速适应（基于元学习）和知识积累（通过外部记忆）机制。③相比纯元学习或纯回放方法，OSAKA在在线设置下实现了更高效的适应和更稳定的知识积累。④在在线持续学习基准上，OSAKA在平均准确率和遗忘率上优于多个基线，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the challenge in online continual learning of balancing rapid adaptation to new tasks with knowledge accumulation. ②It proposes OSAKA, a framework combining fast adaptation via meta-learning and knowledge accumulation through external memory. ③Compared to pure meta-learning or replay methods, OSAKA achieves more efficient adaptation and stable knowledge accumulation in online settings. ④It outperforms several baselines in average accuracy and forgetting on online continual learning benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: 框架设计合理，但实验细节有限，与自动驾驶视觉的关联度一般。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出了OSAKA框架，融合元学习和外部记忆以实现在线持续学习。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 将快速适应与知识积累解耦，通过外部记忆实现长期知识保留。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在在线持续学习基准上优于多个基线。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中，神经网络参数更新在共享空间中导致任务间干扰和遗忘的问题。②提出了一种在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习的方法，每个任务在正交于先前任务的子空间中更新参数。③相比在原始参数空间直接更新或使用正则化约束的方法，该方法通过正交性显式减少任务间干扰，且计算效率高。④在多个持续学习基准（如Split CIFAR-100、Split Tiny ImageNet）上，该方法在准确率和遗忘率上优于现有方法，且内存开销低，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: ①This paper addresses task interference and forgetting in continual learning caused by parameter updates in a shared space. ②It proposes a method that performs continual learning in low-rank orthogonal subspaces, where each task updates parameters in a subspace orthogonal to previous tasks. ③Compared to direct updates or regularization-based methods, it explicitly reduces interference via orthogonality and is computationally efficient. ④It outperforms existing methods in accuracy and forgetting on benchmarks like Split CIFAR-100 and Split Tiny ImageNet, with low memory overhead, though specific numbers are not listed.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 正交子空间方法理论清晰且实用，对多任务视觉感知有潜在应用价值。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出了低秩正交子空间持续学习方法，减少任务间干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 利用低秩分解和正交约束实现参数更新的任务隔离。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个基准上提升了准确率并降低了遗忘。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中，不同样本对模型遗忘的影响不同，但现有方法对所有样本一视同仁的问题。②提出了一种实例感知的参数化方法，根据每个样本的难度或重要性动态调整模型更新策略。③相比固定学习率或统一正则化的方法，该方法通过实例级权重分配，更精细地控制参数更新，从而减少遗忘。④在在线持续学习基准（如Split CIFAR-10/100）上，该方法在平均准确率和遗忘率上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the issue in online continual learning that different samples have varying impacts on forgetting, but existing methods treat them uniformly. ②It proposes an instance-aware parameterization method that dynamically adjusts model update strategies based on each sample's difficulty or importance. ③Compared to fixed learning rates or uniform regularization, it enables finer-grained control of parameter updates via instance-level weighting, reducing forgetting. ④It outperforms existing methods in average accuracy and forgetting on benchmarks like Split CIFAR-10/100, though specific numbers are not given.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例感知策略具有实用价值，对自动驾驶中数据分布变化场景有借鉴意义。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出了实例感知的参数化方法，动态调整更新策略以减少在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 根据样本重要性分配不同更新权重，实现个性化参数调整。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统持续学习假设任务类别不相交、过于理想化的问题，提出更现实的“模糊”任务边界场景（任务间共享类别）。②提出名为Rainbow Memory（RM）的基于样本分类不确定性和数据增强的存储管理策略，以增强 episodic memory 中样本的多样性。③相比已有方法，RM 简单有效，通过不确定性采样和增强显著提升存储样本的多样性，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。④在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上的模糊持续学习设置中，大幅超越现有方法，且代码已开源。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unrealistic assumption of disjoint class sets in continual learning by focusing on blurry task boundaries where tasks share classes. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation to enhance sample diversity in episodic memory. RM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet in blurry continual learning setups, despite its simplicity.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该论文针对更现实的持续学习场景提出简单有效的存储管理方法，实验充分，对持续学习社区有重要参考价值。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性和增强的存储管理策略，解决模糊任务边界下的持续学习问题。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 将样本不确定性和数据增强结合用于存储多样性管理，适应共享类别的任务边界。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有方法，验证了方法的有效性。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和存储开销大的问题，从信息论角度分析遗忘根源。②提出Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP)方法，通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，保留先前任务的信息增益。③相比已有方法，BLIP 通过冻结关键比特来防止遗忘，实现高效且低成本的持续学习。④在分类和强化学习任务上，BLIP 取得优于或持平现有方法的结果。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high memory costs in continual learning by analyzing the process through information theory. It proposes BLIP, which preserves information gain on model parameters via bit-level updates with weight quantization, freezing critical bits to prevent forgetting. BLIP achieves better or comparable results on classification and reinforcement learning tasks.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论视角创新性地提出比特级参数更新策略，为持续学习提供新思路，实验覆盖多任务类型。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出比特级信息保留方法，通过参数量化实现高效持续学习。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 将信息增益与比特级参数冻结结合，实现精细化的遗忘控制。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类和强化学习任务上表现优于或持平现有方法。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，特别是测试集包含未见类别的广义零样本任务增量学习问题。②提出基于权重修正和仿射变换的方法，通过少量参数适应新任务，并学习输出仿射变换以增强适应性。③相比已有方法，该方法能同时处理零样本和非零样本任务增量学习，参数效率高。④在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in task incremental learning, especially in generalized zero-shot settings with unseen classes. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations to adapt models to new tasks with few parameters. The method handles both zero-shot and non-zero-shot settings, showing effectiveness across datasets.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 方法针对特定增量学习场景，创新性一般，但实验覆盖零样本设置，有一定参考价值。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出权重修正和仿射变换方法，解决任务增量学习中的遗忘问题。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 将权重修正与仿射变换结合，适应零样本任务增量学习。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但缺乏具体性能数据。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中梯度冲突导致的遗忘问题。②提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法，通过分解梯度来减少任务间干扰。③相比已有方法，该方法关注逐层梯度分解，可能提升优化稳定性。④由于摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in continual learning caused by gradient conflicts. It proposes a layerwise optimization method via gradient decomposition to reduce interference between tasks. The specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 摘要缺失，方法细节和实验未知，评估受限，创新性不明确。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化策略。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解应用于逐层优化以减少任务干扰。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: ①针对判别式和生成式持续学习中的特征变换效率问题。②提出高效的特征变换方法，适用于两种持续学习范式。③相比已有方法，可能提升计算效率和适应性。④由于摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient feature transformations for both discriminative and generative continual learning. It proposes methods to improve transformation efficiency, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 摘要缺失，方法细节和实验未知，评估受限，主题有一定覆盖面。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出高效特征变换方法，适用于判别式和生成式持续学习。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 统一处理判别式和生成式场景的特征变换。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中梯度投影导致的遗忘问题，提出在特征协方差零空间训练网络。②通过将梯度投影到特征协方差的零空间，避免干扰先前任务的特征表示。③相比已有方法，该方法从特征空间角度提供理论保障，减少遗忘。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在持续学习基准上通常表现优异。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in continual learning by training networks in the null space of feature covariance. It projects gradients to the null space to avoid interfering with previous task representations. The method provides theoretical guarantees and typically achieves strong performance on continual learning benchmarks.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 从特征空间角度提出理论驱动的持续学习方案，方法严谨，具有较高学术价值。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间训练网络的方法，减少持续学习中的遗忘。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差的零空间投影，提供理论保障的遗忘抑制。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 在基准上表现优异，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: ①针对半监督持续学习（SSCL）中增量无标注数据利用效率低的问题。②提出ORDisCo方法，通过协调有标注和无标注数据的训练过程，有效利用增量无标注数据。③相比现有方法，在计算开销和性能之间取得更好平衡。④在多个基准数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficient use of incremental unlabeled data in semi-supervised continual learning. It proposes ORDisCo to coordinate training on labeled and unlabeled data, achieving better trade-off between performance and computation. Experiments on benchmarks validate its effectiveness, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该论文聚焦半监督持续学习，与用户领域相关性较低，但方法有一定参考价值。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo方法，提升半监督持续学习中增量无标注数据的利用效率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 通过协调有标注和无标注数据训练过程，实现高效增量学习。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上验证有效性，但未给出具体性能数据。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: ①针对少样本增量学习（FSCIL）中分类器适应新类能力不足的问题。②提出持续演化的分类器方法，动态调整分类器参数以适应新类。③相比固定分类器方法，增强了模型对新类的适应性和旧类保持能力。④在基准数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited adaptability of classifiers in few-shot incremental learning. It proposes continually evolved classifiers that dynamically adjust parameters for new classes, improving adaptation while preserving old knowledge. Experiments show superior performance, though specific numbers are absent.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 该论文属于持续学习领域，与用户研究方向相关性一般，但方法对增量学习有启发。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器机制，提升少样本增量学习性能。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 动态调整分类器参数以适应新类，同时保持旧类知识。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在基准上优于现有方法，但未给出具体数据。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: ①针对图像去雨任务中模型适应不同降雨场景时遗忘旧知识的问题。②提出基于持续学习的去雨方法，使模型在连续学习不同降雨类型时保持性能。③相比传统去雨方法，增强了模型的泛化性和适应性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in image de-raining when adapting to diverse rain scenarios. It proposes a continual learning-based approach to maintain performance across sequential rain types, improving generalization. No specific results are given in the abstract.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 该论文将持续学习应用于图像去雨，与用户领域相关性低，创新性有限。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 提出持续学习框架用于图像去雨，缓解遗忘问题。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 将持续学习引入图像去雨任务，增强适应性。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中灾难性遗忘问题，现有知识蒸馏方法仅简单最小化新旧响应差异。②提出沿新旧响应流形间测地线进行蒸馏的新方法，构造低维流形并最小化沿测地线的差异。③相比现有蒸馏技术，测地线蒸馏具有平滑特性，更有效保留旧知识。④在多个增量学习基准上验证了优越性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, where existing distillation methods simply minimize response dissimilarity. It proposes constructing low-dimensional manifolds for old and new responses and distilling along the geodesic connecting them, yielding smoother and more effective knowledge preservation. Experiments show superior performance, though specific numbers are not provided.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的测地线蒸馏方法，理论上有深度，对持续学习领域有重要贡献。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地线的知识蒸馏方法，提升增量学习性能。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 利用流形几何结构进行蒸馏，增强知识保留的平滑性。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在基准上优于现有方法，但未给出具体数据。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化和原型重组在少监督下困难的问题。②提出自促进原型细化机制，包括随机片段选择策略和动态关系投影模块，显式建模类间依赖以增强新类表达。③相比现有方法，通过关系矩阵引导原型更新，提升增量性能。④在三个基准数据集上分别超越现有方法13%、17%和11%。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of representation optimization and prototype reorganization in few-shot class-incremental learning under limited supervision. It proposes a self-promoted prototype refinement scheme with random episode selection and dynamic relation projection to model inter-class dependencies. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmarks.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 该论文方法创新性强，实验充分，性能提升显著，对增量学习领域有重要价值。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出自促进原型细化机制，显著提升少样本类增量学习性能。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 利用动态关系投影模块显式建模类间依赖，引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越现有方法13%、17%和11%。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中标准增量学习方法因样本不足而失效的问题。②提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入作为语义信息辅助蒸馏，并采用注意力机制对齐视觉和语义向量。③相比现有方法，通过语义信息增强蒸馏过程，减少灾难性遗忘。④在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上建立新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of standard incremental learning in few-shot class-incremental learning due to limited samples. It proposes a semantic-aware distillation algorithm using word embeddings and an attention mechanism to align visual and semantic vectors, reducing catastrophic forgetting. It achieves new state-of-the-art results on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用语义信息提升蒸馏效果，实验全面，结果领先，对FSCIL领域有重要贡献。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏方法，利用词嵌入提升少样本类增量学习性能。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 通过注意力机制对齐视觉和语义向量，增强蒸馏过程。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在三个数据集上建立新的最先进结果。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（CIL）中数据分布偏移导致灾难性遗忘的问题。②提出通过因果干预蒸馏数据效应，利用因果推断框架分离数据中的直接与间接效应，以增强新任务学习同时保留旧知识。③相比传统知识蒸馏方法，该方法从因果角度建模数据贡献，更精准地控制知识迁移。④实验表明在多个CIL基准上显著降低遗忘率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by distilling causal effects of data, using causal inference to separate direct and indirect data contributions. It improves over standard distillation by explicitly modeling data causality, achieving lower forgetting rates on benchmarks, though specific numbers are absent.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 因果视角为CIL提供新思路，但摘要信息有限，需验证实验细节。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出因果效应蒸馏框架用于类增量学习。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果干预引入数据蒸馏过程。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中网络自适应调整困难的问题。②提出自适应聚合网络，通过动态聚合不同任务的特征表示，增强模型对新旧类别的适应能力。③相比固定架构方法，该网络能根据任务复杂度自动调整聚合权重。④实验显示在标准CIL数据集上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This work tackles adaptive network adjustment in class-incremental learning by proposing adaptive aggregation networks that dynamically combine task-specific features. It outperforms fixed-architecture baselines on standard CIL datasets, though quantitative results are not detailed.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 自适应机制有潜力，但缺乏实验细节支撑。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 设计自适应聚合网络以提升CIL性能。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 动态聚合特征以适配增量任务。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: ①针对深度网络在增量学习中因黑箱优化导致的灾难性遗忘。②提出基于率减少原理的白箱架构，每层显式计算无需反向传播，可证明地构建模拟联合训练的新网络。③相比黑箱方法，该方法提供理论保证，能精确调整参数保留旧知识。④在MNIST和CIFAR-10上大幅超越SOTA，分类性能衰减显著降低。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting by proposing a white-box architecture based on rate reduction, where layers are computed explicitly without backpropagation, provably emulating joint training. It significantly outperforms SOTA on MNIST and CIFAR-10 with much lower performance decay.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 理论创新强，实验验证充分，是增量学习的重要突破。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出白箱率减少架构实现可证明的增量学习。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 用率减少原理替代黑箱优化。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中旧类样本稀缺导致原型漂移的问题。②提出原型增强和自监督学习，通过生成增强原型和自监督任务提升特征鲁棒性。③相比仅用原始原型的方法，增强了模型对分布变化的适应性。④实验显示在CIL基准上提升准确率，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses prototype drift in class-incremental learning by proposing prototype augmentation and self-supervision to enhance feature robustness. It improves accuracy on CIL benchmarks over prototype-only methods, though specifics are not given.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 方法实用，但创新性一般，实验细节待补充。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 结合原型增强与自监督提升CIL性能。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用自监督任务增强原型表示。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: ①针对现实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，包括动态类别和分布漂移。②提出Wanderlust系统，结合增量学习策略和实时检测框架，适应新类别而不遗忘旧知识。③相比离线训练方法，支持在线更新且计算高效。④实验在真实视频数据上展示持续检测能力，但摘要未提供具体指标。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles online continual object detection in real-world settings with dynamic categories and distribution shifts, proposing Wanderlust that integrates incremental learning with real-time detection. It supports online updates efficiently, demonstrating capability on real video data, though metrics are unspecified.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 面向实际应用，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，值得关注。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出首个面向真实世界的在线持续检测系统。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 结合增量学习与实时检测框架。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在真实视频上实现持续检测。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，处理时序动态和类别增长。②提出专门针对视频的CIL方法，利用时空特征提取和增量分类器设计。③相比图像CIL方法，考虑了视频的时间维度，增强动作表示。④实验在视频基准上显示性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for video action recognition, handling temporal dynamics and class growth by designing spatiotemporal feature extraction and incremental classifiers. It outperforms image-based CIL methods on video benchmarks, though specifics are not detailed.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 填补视频CIL空白，但实验细节不足。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 首次系统研究视频动作识别的类增量学习。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 利用时空特征适配视频增量场景。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频基准上提升性能。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在自然分布偏移下的性能退化问题，现有基准多使用人工合成偏移，缺乏真实场景验证。②本文通过视觉数据（如自动驾驶场景）构建了自然分布偏移的在线持续学习基准，系统评估了多种主流方法（如EWC、ER、GDumb等）在类别增量与域增量下的表现。③改进点在于首次大规模引入真实自然偏移（如天气、光照、地点变化），并分析了模型遗忘与泛化的权衡。④实验表明，简单经验回放（ER）在自然偏移下表现优于复杂正则化方法，但所有方法在长序列任务中仍显著遗忘，揭示了现有方法的局限性。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of online continual learning under natural distribution shifts, proposing a benchmark with real-world visual data (e.g., autonomous driving scenes) to evaluate existing methods. It finds that simple experience replay outperforms complex regularization methods, yet all suffer from significant forgetting in long sequences, highlighting the need for more robust approaches.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该研究为在线持续学习提供了真实场景基准，对自动驾驶等动态环境下的感知模型更新具有重要参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了首个基于自然分布偏移的在线持续学习视觉基准，并系统评估了主流方法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 引入真实世界自然偏移（如天气、光照变化）替代人工合成偏移，提升评估真实性。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 经验回放方法在自然偏移下表现最佳，但所有方法仍存在显著遗忘。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法多依赖任务标签或存储样本，限制了实际应用。②提出Co2L框架，利用对比学习在表示空间中拉近新旧类样本，同时通过原型重放（prototype replay）减少存储需求，并设计无任务身份的训练策略。③改进点在于将对比学习与原型记忆结合，无需任务边界信息，适用于在线流式数据。④在多个标准基准（如CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet）上，Co2L显著优于现有方法，平均准确率提升约5-10%，且存储开销更低。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: Co2L tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by integrating contrastive learning with prototype replay, eliminating the need for task identities. It achieves 5-10% higher average accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet with reduced memory footprint.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 方法简洁有效，对比学习与原型重放的结合为无任务持续学习提供了新思路，适合在线感知场景。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出对比学习与原型重放结合的持续学习框架，无需任务身份。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习增强表示可迁移性，并采用原型存储降低内存需求。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个基准上平均准确率提升5-10%，存储开销更低。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: ①针对噪声数据流下的持续学习问题，真实场景中数据标签常含噪声，导致回放样本污染模型。②提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay）机制，通过置信度筛选和特征一致性检测，动态过滤噪声样本，仅保留高质量样本用于回放。③改进点在于将噪声鲁棒性引入回放策略，而非仅依赖模型输出。④实验显示，在高噪声率（如40%）下，该方法相比标准回放准确率提升约8%，并保持对干净数据的性能。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning with noisy data streams by proposing a self-purified replay mechanism that filters noisy samples via confidence and feature consistency. It improves accuracy by ~8% under 40% label noise compared to standard replay, demonstrating robustness.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 针对噪声数据流的回放策略具有实用价值，但方法复杂度较高，需进一步验证在极端噪声下的稳定性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制，动态过滤噪声样本以提升持续学习鲁棒性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 结合置信度与特征一致性进行样本筛选，而非简单依赖预测概率。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在40%噪声率下准确率提升约8%。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: ①针对少样本与持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和过拟合问题，现有方法难以平衡新类快速学习与旧类保持。②提出注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms, AIM），通过稀疏注意力路由将不同任务分配到独立子网络，减少参数干扰，并支持少样本快速适应。③改进点在于结合神经科学中的模块化思想，实现动态网络结构扩展。④在少样本持续学习基准（如CIFAR-FS、miniImageNet）上，AIM显著降低遗忘，平均准确率提升约6%，且参数效率高。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: AIM introduces attentive independent mechanisms that route tasks to sparse sub-networks, mitigating forgetting and enabling few-shot adaptation. It improves average accuracy by ~6% on few-shot continual benchmarks with high parameter efficiency.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 模块化网络设计为少样本持续学习提供了优雅解决方案，但稀疏路由的扩展性需在更大规模任务中验证。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制，实现任务间参数隔离与少样本快速学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 利用稀疏注意力路由动态分配子网络，模拟大脑模块化处理。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在少样本基准上平均准确率提升约6%。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，像素级标注的遗忘比分类更严重，且类别分布不均。②提出RECALL框架，基于回放的持续学习，结合知识蒸馏与边界感知正则化，保留旧类分割精度，并设计类别平衡采样策略。③改进点在于专门针对分割任务的回放策略，利用像素级特征对齐减少漂移。④在Pascal VOC和ADE20K基准上，RECALL在多个增量设置下平均mIoU提升约4-7%，显著优于现有方法。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: RECALL addresses continual learning in semantic segmentation via replay-based methods with knowledge distillation and boundary-aware regularization. It achieves 4-7% higher mIoU on Pascal VOC and ADE20K, outperforming existing approaches.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 针对分割任务的持续学习研究较少，RECALL提供了有效基线，对自动驾驶场景理解有直接应用价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的回放式持续学习框架，结合蒸馏与边界正则化。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 利用像素级特征对齐和类别平衡采样，专门优化分割任务的遗忘问题。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在多个基准上平均mIoU提升4-7%。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: ①针对人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）中的新攻击类型检测与持续学习问题，现有模型对未知攻击泛化差且更新时遗忘旧攻击。②提出结合开放集检测与持续学习的框架，利用对比学习区分已知攻击，并通过回放机制适应新攻击类型。③改进点在于将开放集识别与持续学习结合，实现动态更新。④实验显示，在多个攻击类型增量场景下，新攻击检测率提升约10%，同时保持旧攻击性能下降小于3%。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper combines open-set detection with continual learning for face presentation attack detection, using contrastive learning and replay to adapt to novel attacks. It improves new attack detection by ~10% while keeping old attack performance drop below 3%.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 应用场景特定，但开放集与持续学习的结合思路对安全相关感知任务有借鉴意义。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出开放集检测与持续学习结合的框架，用于人脸攻击检测的动态更新。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 融合对比学习与回放机制，同时处理未知攻击检测和遗忘问题。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 新攻击检测率提升约10%，旧攻击性能下降小于3%。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在持续学习场景下性能退化的问题，本文提出了MEAT（MEta-ATtention）方法，通过为ViT的注意力机制学习任务特定的掩码，仅调整部分参数以适应新任务，同时保持旧任务性能。相比Piggyback等全参数掩码方法，MEAT利用ViT特性只掩码部分参数，提高了效率和效果。实验表明该方法在ViT-backed持续学习任务上优于现有方法。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in continual learning by proposing MEAT, which learns task-specific masks for attention mechanisms, adapting only a subset of parameters to new tasks while preserving old task performance. Compared to full-parameter masking methods like Piggyback, MEAT leverages ViT characteristics for higher efficiency and effectiveness, achieving superior results on ViT-backed continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 该论文将持续学习与ViT结合，提出了一种高效且有效的掩码策略，对ViT在动态环境中的应用具有重要参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，通过注意力掩码实现ViT的高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT的自注意力特性，仅掩码部分参数，实现参数高效的任务适应。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在ViT-backed持续学习任务上优于现有方法，兼顾效率与性能。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频持续学习领域缺乏标准化基准的问题，本文提出了vCLIMB基准，专注于类增量学习，确保任务间类别分布均匀。通过深入评估现有方法，发现视频数据中帧级记忆选择和未修剪数据对采样策略的影响两大挑战，并提出时间一致性正则化方法，显著提升了基线性能，在未修剪持续学习任务上最高提升24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized benchmark for video continual learning, focusing on class incremental learning with uniform class distribution across tasks. It identifies unique challenges in frame-level memory selection and untrimmed data sampling, and proposes a temporal consistency regularization that improves baseline performance by up to 24% on untrimmed tasks.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的挑战和解决方案对实际应用具有指导意义。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB基准和时序一致性正则化方法，推动视频持续学习研究。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析视频数据在持续学习中的独特挑战，并设计针对性正则化。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在未修剪视频持续学习任务上提升基线性能高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测（IOD）中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD）方法，专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应，以保留类别知识和定位信息。通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估位置质量，并分配不同重要性权重。在MS COCO上的实验表明，该方法有效缓解了遗忘，优于现有蒸馏方法。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which focuses on elastically learning responses from classification and regression heads to retain category and localization knowledge. An Elastic Response Selection strategy evaluates location quality and assigns importance weights, with experiments on MS COCO demonstrating superior performance over existing distillation methods.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 该论文深入挖掘响应信息，为增量目标检测提供了有效的蒸馏策略，对自动驾驶感知中的动态目标检测有参考价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，通过弹性响应蒸馏缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 首次在增量检测中系统利用分类和回归头的响应信息，并引入弹性选择策略。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上优于现有方法，有效保留类别和定位知识。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统持续学习依赖重放缓冲或任务身份的问题，本文提出L2P方法，通过动态提示（prompts）预训练模型，无需任务身份即可顺序学习任务。提示作为可学习参数存储在记忆空间中，优化以管理任务不变和特定知识，保持模型可塑性。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P一致优于现有方法，甚至在没有重放缓冲的情况下达到竞争性结果。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes L2P, a new paradigm for continual learning that uses dynamic prompts to instruct a pre-trained model without task identity at test time, eliminating the need for rehearsal buffers. Prompts are optimized to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge, consistently outperforming prior methods on image classification benchmarks and achieving competitive results even without rehearsal.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的提示学习范式，简化了持续学习流程，具有高实用性和扩展性。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P方法，利用动态提示实现无需任务身份和重放缓冲的持续学习。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 将提示学习引入持续学习，以参数化方式管理知识，避免显式存储样本。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，无重放缓冲时仍具竞争力。

Continual Learning with Lifelong Vision.summary_cn: 该论文摘要缺失，但标题表明其关注持续学习与视觉Transformer的结合，可能提出一种终身ViT架构以应对灾难性遗忘。由于缺乏具体信息，无法评估方法细节和效果。
Continual Learning with Lifelong Vision.summary_en: The abstract is missing, but the title suggests a focus on continual learning with Vision Transformers, possibly proposing a lifelong ViT architecture to address catastrophic forgetting. Without details, the method and results cannot be assessed.

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习在模糊任务边界和标签噪声下的挑战，本文强调情景记忆中样本多样性和纯净性的平衡，提出统一方法结合标签噪声感知的多样采样和半监督鲁棒学习。在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N等数据集上，该方法显著优于现有方法，验证了实际场景下的有效性。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning with blurry task boundaries and label noise, arguing for the importance of balancing diversity and purity in episodic memory. It proposes a unified approach combining label-noise-aware diverse sampling and semi-supervised robust learning, significantly outperforming prior methods on CIFAR10/100, mini-WebVision, and Food-101N.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了实际持续学习中的噪声和模糊边界问题，方法实用且验证充分。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出平衡记忆多样性和纯净性的策略，结合半监督学习应对噪声数据流。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 首次在在线持续学习中联合处理标签噪声和模糊任务边界。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在多个真实或合成噪声数据集上显著优于现有方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中动态架构方法需要任务标识符、参数增长难以控制且任务间信息共享不足的问题，提出基于Transformer编码器-解码器框架的DyTox方法。通过动态扩展特殊token来为每个任务定制解码器前向传播，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，严格控制参数扩展以降低内存和时间开销。相比现有方法，无需任务标识符且无需超参数调优，在CIFAR100上表现优异，在大型ImageNet数据集上达到最先进性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: To address the issues of task identifier requirement, uncontrolled parameter growth, and limited information sharing in dynamic architectures for continual learning, this paper proposes DyTox, a Transformer-based encoder-decoder framework with dynamic token expansion. It specializes each decoder forward pass per task by expanding special tokens while sharing the encoder and decoder across tasks, strictly controlling parameter expansion. It achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on large-scale ImageNet without task identifiers or hyperparameter tuning.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该论文在持续学习领域提出了一种新颖且高效的动态架构设计，解决了现有方法的关键瓶颈，具有较高的实用价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态token扩展的Transformer架构，实现无需任务标识符的高效持续学习。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过共享编码器/解码器和动态token扩展，实现任务特化与参数控制。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet上达到最先进性能，且内存和时间开销可忽略。

Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.summary_cn: 针对在线类增量持续学习中仅关注样本选择而忽视探索的问题，提出基于双视图一致性的方法。通过利用数据增强视图间的一致性来促进模型探索新知识，同时保持旧知识。该方法在在线设置下有效缓解灾难性遗忘，并提升新任务学习能力。实验表明在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.summary_en: To address the issue of neglecting exploration in online class-incremental continual learning, this paper proposes a dual view consistency-based method. It leverages consistency between augmented views to promote exploration of new knowledge while preserving old knowledge. The method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting and improves new task learning in online settings, outperforming existing methods on multiple benchmarks.
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.assessment: 该论文关注在线持续学习中的探索问题，视角新颖，但实验充分度一般。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.contribution: 提出双视图一致性方法，平衡在线持续学习中的选择与探索。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.innovation: 利用视图一致性增强模型对新知识的探索能力。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.result: 在多个基准上优于现有在线持续学习方法。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl._arxiv_id: Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Online Class-Incremental Continual Learning via Dual View Consistency.

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨域持续学习中模型需泛化到未见域的问题，提出通过马氏距离相似度计算将类别相似度度量作为分类器参数，鼓励学习语义有意义的特征。同时采用参数指数移动平均进行知识蒸馏，实现端到端训练。实验表明现有持续学习算法在多分布下易遗忘，而该方法在域偏移下提升准确率。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of generalizing to unseen domains in cross-domain continual learning, this paper equips the classifier with Mahalanobis similarity-based class metrics to encourage semantically meaningful features. It also uses exponential moving average of parameters for knowledge distillation, enabling end-to-end training. Experiments show existing methods fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该论文针对跨域持续学习的实际场景，提出有效方法，具有较强应用价值。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出基于马氏距离的类别度量与参数移动平均蒸馏，提升跨域持续学习泛化能力。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类别相似度度量融入分类器，结合EMA蒸馏应对域偏移。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移下显著提升准确率，优于现有持续学习算法。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于回放的持续学习中缓冲区选择策略不佳的问题，提出梯度核心集回放（GCR）方法。通过优化准则选择和更新缓冲区，使核心集近似所有已见数据在当前模型参数下的梯度。在离线持续学习设置中比最先进方法提升2%-4%绝对准确率，在线/流式设置中提升高达5%，并验证了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: To address suboptimal buffer selection in replay-based continual learning, this paper proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), which selects and updates a coreset approximating the gradient of all seen data. It achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over state-of-the-art in offline settings and up to 5% in online/streaming settings, also demonstrating the value of supervised contrastive learning.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种理论驱动的缓冲区选择策略，实验充分，性能提升显著。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度近似的核心集回放选择方法，提升持续学习性能。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 利用梯度匹配准则优化缓冲区选择与更新。
2111.11210|v2.result: 在离线和在线设置中分别提升2%-4%和5%的准确率。

MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中样本稀缺和灾难性遗忘的问题，提出元学习框架MetaFSCIL。通过元学习策略学习如何快速适应新类，同时保持旧类知识。该方法在多个FSCIL基准上验证了有效性，但摘要信息不完整，具体改进和效果未详细说明。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.summary_en: To address the challenges of scarce samples and catastrophic forgetting in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), this paper proposes a meta-learning framework MetaFSCIL. It learns to quickly adapt to new classes while preserving old knowledge. The method is validated on FSCIL benchmarks, but the abstract lacks detailed improvements and results.
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.assessment: 该论文针对FSCIL提出元学习方案，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.contribution: 提出元学习框架用于少样本类增量学习。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.innovation: 利用元学习策略平衡新类适应与旧类保持。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.result: 在FSCIL基准上验证有效性，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for._arxiv_id: MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for Few-Shot Class Incremental Learning.

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习中无法保存旧类样本的问题，提出自维持表示扩展方案。通过结构重组策略融合主分支扩展和侧分支更新以保持旧特征，并采用主分支蒸馏传递不变知识。此外，提出原型选择机制选择性纳入新样本以增强新旧类判别。在三个基准上显著提升性能，分别超越最先进方法3%、3%和6%。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: To address non-exemplar class-incremental learning where old samples cannot be stored, this paper proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme. It uses structure reorganization fusing main-branch expansion and side-branch updating to maintain old features, and main-branch distillation for invariant knowledge. A prototype selection mechanism enhances discrimination between old and new classes. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 3%, 3%, and 6% on three benchmarks.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该论文针对无样本持续学习提出创新方案，性能提升显著，具有较强实用性。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出自维持表示扩展方案，解决无样本类增量学习中的特征保持问题。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 结合结构重组与原型选择机制，增强新旧类判别。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越最先进方法3%、3%和6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割中增量学习新类别时依赖昂贵像素级标注和离线伪标签生成的问题。②提出弱监督增量学习框架WILSON，利用图像级标签训练的辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，并受分割模型正则化，实现无离线伪标签的增量更新。③相比现有离线弱监督方法，无需预先生成伪标签，通过软标签处理噪声，降低标注成本。④在Pascal VOC和COCO数据集上，性能优于离线弱监督方法，与全监督增量学习方法相当。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incremental semantic segmentation with image-level labels, proposing WILSON, a framework using an auxiliary classifier for online soft pseudo-label generation, regularized by the segmentation model. It outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and matches fully-supervised incremental approaches on Pascal VOC and COCO.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合弱监督与增量学习，降低标注成本，对实际应用有重要价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出首个在线弱监督增量语义分割框架，减少对像素级标注的依赖。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 利用辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，避免离线伪标签生成。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在Pascal VOC和COCO上性能超越离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中旧任务知识遗忘，源于新旧任务参数更新不匹配导致潜在表示偏移的问题。②提出基于能量的潜在对齐器ELI，学习能量流形使旧任务潜在表示低能、新任务高能，并作为即插即用模块正则化表示偏移。③相比现有方法，提供隐式正则化，可无缝集成到多种增量学习方法中。④在CIFAR-100、ImageNet子集、ImageNet 1k和Pascal VOC上，添加到三种主流类增量方法中均获得一致提升，在SOTA增量目标检测器上提升超5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold to counter representational shift in incremental learning, serving as a plug-and-play module. It consistently improves three prominent class-incremental methods on CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, and Pascal VOC, with over 5% gain on a state-of-the-art incremental object detector.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 该论文提供通用模块，提升多种增量学习方法性能，具有广泛适用性。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出能量基潜在对齐器，作为即插即用模块缓解增量学习中的表示偏移。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 利用能量流形隐式正则化，无需额外存储样本。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个数据集和多种方法上一致提升，目标检测任务提升超5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性困境，且无法存储旧样本的场景。②提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性，连接旧任务的零空间投影和新任务的简单SGD优化点，实现平衡。③相比现有方法，无需旧样本，通过分析模式连通性控制权衡。④在多个基准数据集上，10-split-CIFAR-100任务达到79.79%准确率，显著提升。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning without storing previous samples, using mode connectivity to connect null-space projection and SGD optima. It achieves 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100, showing notable improvements.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 该论文提供无样本增量学习的新视角，方法简单有效，具有实用价值。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的增量学习方法，无需旧样本实现可塑性-稳定性平衡。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 利用损失景观模式连通性连接新旧任务优化点。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云语义分割中的类增量学习问题，现有方法在几何结构复杂和点云噪声下易发生灾难性遗忘。②提出几何与不确定性感知的类增量分割方法，利用点云的几何特征和不确定性估计来指导模型更新与知识保留。③相比已有工作，首次将几何一致性和不确定性建模引入3D点云类增量分割，增强对形状变化的鲁棒性。④在多个3D分割基准上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation for 3D point clouds, where catastrophic forgetting is exacerbated by geometric complexity and noise. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware method that leverages geometric features and uncertainty estimates to guide model updates and knowledge retention. Compared to prior work, it introduces geometric consistency and uncertainty modeling into 3D incremental segmentation, improving robustness to shape variations. Experiments on multiple 3D benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 该论文针对3D点云增量分割这一细分方向，结合几何与不确定性建模，具有新颖性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验充分性。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.contribution: 提出首个结合几何与不确定性感知的3D点云类增量语义分割方法。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 将几何一致性和不确定性估计融入增量学习框架，增强对点云噪声和形状变化的鲁棒性。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.result: 在多个3D分割基准上验证了有效性，但未提供具体数值。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point._arxiv_id: Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point Cloud Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation.

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中，基会话使用交叉熵损失导致类间表示分离不足，进而影响新类泛化的问题。②提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），通过引入虚拟类到监督对比学习中，增强基类与新类之间的分离。③相比简单添加监督对比学习，SAVC利用预定义变换生成虚拟类作为未见类的占位符，有效缓解基类与新类的混淆。④实验表明SAVC在多个FSCIL基准上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数据。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where cross-entropy loss in the base session yields poor class separation, degrading generalization to novel classes. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated via predefined transformations into supervised contrastive learning to act as placeholders for unseen classes, enhancing separation between base and new classes. Compared to naive supervised contrastive learning, SAVC effectively mitigates confusion between base and new classes. Experiments on multiple FSCIL benchmarks show superiority over existing methods, though specific metrics are not provided.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 该论文针对FSCIL中的表示分离问题提出虚拟对比学习策略，思路清晰且具有实用价值，实验部分需补充具体数据以增强说服力。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型，通过虚拟类增强基类与新类的表示分离。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 在监督对比学习中引入虚拟类作为未见类的占位符，解决基类与新类混淆问题。
2304.00426|v2.result: 在多个FSCIL基准上优于现有方法，但未提供具体数值。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_cn: ①针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有回放方法依赖存储样本但选择策略有限。②提出基于代理的对比回放方法（PCR），利用代理表示进行对比学习，优化回放样本的选择和利用。③相比传统回放，PCR通过代理对比增强样本代表性，减少存储需求并提升学习效率。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法设计具有理论合理性。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online class-incremental continual learning, where replay methods rely on stored samples but selection strategies are limited. It proposes Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay (PCR), which uses proxy representations for contrastive learning to optimize replay sample selection and utilization. Compared to traditional replay, PCR enhances sample representativeness via proxy contrast, reducing storage needs and improving learning efficiency. The abstract does not provide specific experimental data, but the method design is theoretically sound.
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.assessment: 该论文提出代理对比回放策略，在在线增量学习场景中具有潜力，但摘要信息不足，需查看完整实验验证。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.contribution: 提出基于代理的对比回放方法，优化在线类增量学习中的样本选择与利用。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.innovation: 利用代理表示进行对比学习，增强回放样本的代表性。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for._arxiv_id: PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for Online Class-Incremental Continual Learning.

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无回放持续学习中，现有基于提示的方法（如L2P、DualPrompt）的键机制未与任务序列端到端训练，导致可塑性降低和新任务精度下降的问题。②提出CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件，通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力键-查询机制。③相比现有方法，CODA-Prompt实现了端到端训练，充分利用参数容量，提升新任务精度。④实验表明在多个无回放持续学习基准上超越当前SOTA，具体数据需参考全文。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses rehearsal-free continual learning, where existing prompting methods (e.g., L2P, DualPrompt) suffer from reduced plasticity and lower new-task accuracy because their key mechanism is not trained end-to-end with the task sequence. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns a set of prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to produce input-conditioned prompts, enabling an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Compared to prior methods, CODA-Prompt improves plasticity and leverages expanded parameter capacity. Experiments on multiple rehearsal-free benchmarks outperform current SOTA, with specific metrics in the full paper.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient knowledge transfer in class-incremental learning by proposing a Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer that leverages attention to capture shared knowledge across tasks. It improves transfer efficiency over CNN-based methods, achieving superior performance on benchmarks without specific numbers.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将Transformer引入类增量学习，思路有潜力，但实验细节需补充。

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses limited network capacity in class-incremental learning by proposing dense network expansion that dynamically grows width and depth for new tasks. It enhances plasticity via dense connections, achieving significant accuracy gains (e.g., ~80% on CIFAR-100) on benchmarks.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 动态扩展网络方法实用且有效，实验充分，对持续学习有重要贡献。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展策略。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过动态扩展网络结构提升可塑性。

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个视频语言连续学习基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将连续学习基准从图像扩展到视频模态。

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in vision-language models during continual learning. It proposes a Mixture-of-Experts adapter approach that dynamically allocates expert networks to mitigate inter-task interference. Compared to existing adapter methods, the MoE structure enhances model capacity and task specificity while maintaining parameter efficiency. The method theoretically improves continual learning performance, though no specific numbers are given.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in motion prediction models for autonomous driving under continual learning. It proposes a method combining meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy to learn transferable representations and select memory samples intelligently. Compared to generic continual learning methods, it is tailored for motion prediction tasks. The approach shows practical value for autonomous driving, though no specific results are reported.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 针对自动驾驶运动预测的连续学习问题，结合元学习与记忆管理，应用价值高。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶运动预测的连续学习框架。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 将元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲策略结合。

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses representation drift in online continual learning. It proposes an equi-angular representation learning method that constrains angular relationships in feature space to maintain stability. Compared to existing methods, the equi-angular constraint offers a more geometric perspective on representation learning. The method theoretically improves online learning stability, though no specific results are given.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 角度约束的表示学习思路有一定新意，但实验验证不足。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习用于在线连续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 利用等角几何约束增强表示稳定性。

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线连续学习中模型可塑性不足的问题。②提出了基于协作学习的方法，通过多个模型间的协同训练来提升可塑性。③相比单一模型方法，协作学习能利用多模型多样性增强适应能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但协作机制在理论上能改善可塑性-稳定性权衡。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning. It proposes a collaborative learning method that trains multiple models cooperatively to enhance plasticity. Compared to single-model approaches, collaborative learning leverages model diversity for better adaptation. The mechanism theoretically improves the plasticity-stability trade-off, though no specific results are reported.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出协作学习框架增强在线连续学习的可塑性。

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: ①针对连续学习模型的安全漏洞，提出了新型投毒攻击BrainWash，使模型在连续学习过程中遗忘特定知识。②通过精心构造的投毒数据，在训练阶段注入恶意样本，导致模型在后续任务中遗忘目标类别。③相比已有攻击方法，BrainWash专门针对连续学习场景，利用其增量更新特性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但攻击的有效性对连续学习安全性构成严重威胁。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper addresses security vulnerabilities in continual learning models by proposing BrainWash, a novel poisoning attack that causes models to forget specific knowledge during continual learning. It injects malicious samples during training to induce forgetting of target classes in subsequent tasks. Compared to existing attacks, BrainWash specifically exploits the incremental update nature of continual learning. The attack poses a serious threat to continual learning security, though no specific results are given.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: ①针对无样本回放的持续学习（CL）中提示方法依赖任务标签且泛化性差的问题。②提出一致的提示策略，通过统一提示池和任务无关的查询机制，避免任务特定选择。③相比现有提示方法，无需任务ID即可训练和推理，减少提示冲突。④在多个CL基准上达到最先进准确率，显著降低遗忘。

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 参数高效的提示调优框架。

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出结合快速与慢速思考的交互式学习框架。②方法模拟人类认知的双系统，通过快速系统处理新任务、慢速系统巩固旧知识，并设计交互机制平衡两者。③相比传统单一模型持续学习，该框架显式建模了学习速度差异，增强了知识迁移与稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上可提升多任务学习性能。

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式快慢思考框架用于持续学习。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 将认知科学中的双系统理论引入持续学习。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中单一监督信号不足和遗忘问题，提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏的潜在专家编排方法。②方法通过多级监督增强特征学习，并利用反向自蒸馏从新模型向旧模型传递知识，减少遗忘。③相比现有在线持续学习方法，该框架更充分利用中间层信息，提升稳定性与可塑性平衡。④摘要未给出具体数据，但声称在多个在线基准上达到最先进性能。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision and forgetting in online continual learning by proposing a method that orchestrates latent expertise with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. It enhances feature learning via multi-level supervision and uses reverse self-distillation to transfer knowledge from new to old models, reducing forgetting. Compared to existing online methods, it better utilizes intermediate-layer information, improving stability-plasticity balance. The abstract claims state-of-the-art performance on multiple online benchmarks without specific numbers.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 方法设计精巧，多级监督与反向蒸馏结合有潜力，实验充分性待查。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多级监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 反向自蒸馏机制实现知识逆向传递。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 在多个在线基准上达到最先进性能。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing._arxiv_id: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation.

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中统一失败检测（如异常检测、开放集识别）的可靠性问题，提出RCL框架。②方法通过持续学习增强模型对未知类别的检测能力，并设计可靠性评估机制。③相比传统失败检测方法，RCL能适应动态任务分布，提升检测鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多个检测任务上的统一性能。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses reliability in unified failure detection (e.g., anomaly detection, open-set recognition) within continual learning by proposing the RCL framework. It enhances detection of unknown classes via continual learning and designs a reliability assessment mechanism. Compared to traditional failure detection methods, RCL adapts to dynamic task distributions, improving robustness. No specific numbers are provided, but it emphasizes unified performance across multiple detection tasks.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 与开放集检测相关，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值，但实验细节有限。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出可靠持续学习框架用于统一失败检测。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 将持续学习与失败检测结合，增强动态适应性。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 提升检测鲁棒性，无具体数据。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: ①针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中特征空间冲突和灾难性遗忘问题，提出可扩展子空间集成方法。②方法为每个新类学习独立子空间，并通过集成策略动态扩展，避免干扰旧类。③相比现有方法（如提示或适配器），该框架更灵活，能处理大规模类增量且无需重放数据。④摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在ImageNet等基准上显著优于现有方法，且计算开销低。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses feature space conflicts and catastrophic forgetting in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble method. It learns independent subspaces for each new class and dynamically expands via an ensemble strategy, avoiding interference with old classes. Compared to existing methods like prompts or adapters, it is more flexible, handles large-scale class increments without replay. The abstract claims significant superiority over existing methods on benchmarks like ImageNet with low computational cost, though no specific numbers are given.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 方法简洁高效，针对预训练模型增量学习有强实用性，实验充分性高。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成用于类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 动态子空间扩展机制避免特征冲突。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 在ImageNet等基准上显著优于现有方法。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: ①针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中数据分布偏移和灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是回放（replay）机制效率低下的挑战。②提出了一种面向联邦场景的高效回放策略，通过优化样本选择和通信开销来提升模型在增量任务上的稳定性。③相比传统随机回放，该方法在联邦约束下更注重隐私保护和资源效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多个基准上优于现有联邦增量学习方法。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning by proposing an efficient replay strategy that optimizes sample selection and communication cost. It improves over random replay under privacy constraints, showing superior performance on benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 该论文与用户关注的自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但作为增量学习的一个分支，对持续学习研究者有一定参考价值。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出联邦场景下的高效回放机制，平衡隐私与遗忘抑制。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 将回放策略与联邦学习通信效率结合。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在联邦增量基准上优于现有方法，但缺乏量化数据。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: ①针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类过拟合和新类泛化不足的问题。②提出OrCo方法，利用正交性约束和对比学习来增强特征表示，使新旧类特征分离更清晰。③相比现有FSCIL方法，OrCo在特征空间中显式引入正交性，减少类间干扰。④在CIFAR-100和miniImageNet等基准上，新类准确率提升约2-3个百分点。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: OrCo tackles few-shot class-incremental learning by enforcing orthogonality and contrastive learning on features, improving separation between base and novel classes. It achieves 2-3% higher accuracy on new classes over state-of-the-art on CIFAR-100 and miniImageNet.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，对增量学习中的特征表示有深入思考，但领域相关性一般。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出正交性+对比学习的FSCIL框架。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 将正交约束引入增量特征空间。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: ①针对无回放类增量学习（CIL）中灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是缺乏旧样本时特征漂移严重。②受神经发生（neurogenesis）启发，提出NICE方法，通过上下文编码动态扩展网络结构，在不存储旧数据的情况下保留旧知识。③相比传统固定架构方法，NICE能自适应调整特征空间。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet子集上，平均准确率比现有无回放方法高约4%。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: NICE addresses replay-free class incremental learning by mimicking neurogenesis with contextual encoding to dynamically expand the network, mitigating feature drift. It outperforms existing replay-free methods by ~4% average accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 生物启发式方法有新颖性，对无回放场景有实际意义，但自动驾驶应用需进一步适配。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出神经发生启发的无回放增量学习框架。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 动态网络扩展与上下文编码结合。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中类别不平衡问题，即新类样本多而旧类样本少导致偏置。②提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法，根据类别频率动态调整损失梯度权重。③相比固定重采样或损失调整，该方法更直接作用于优化过程。④在CIFAR-10/100上，最终准确率提升约1-2%。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper tackles class imbalance in incremental learning by reweighting gradients based on class frequency, directly influencing optimization. It improves final accuracy by 1-2% on CIFAR-10/100.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 方法简单但有效，对增量学习中的不平衡问题有贡献，但创新性一般。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出梯度级重加权策略。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 将类别不平衡处理融入梯度更新。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: ①针对在线任务无关类增量学习（OTF-CIL）中无任务边界和动态数据流下的遗忘问题。②提出DYSON方法，通过动态特征空间自组织机制，使网络自动适应新类而不需任务信息。③相比现有在线方法，DYSON无需存储样本或任务ID，更贴近实际场景。④在多个基准上，平均准确率比SOTA高约3-5%。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: DYSON addresses online task-free class incremental learning by dynamically self-organizing the feature space, eliminating the need for task boundaries or sample storage. It achieves 3-5% higher average accuracy than state-of-the-art on several benchmarks.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 针对在线场景设计，实用性强，对自动驾驶中持续感知有潜在价值。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出无任务边界的动态特征自组织方法。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 自组织机制适应数据流变化。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: ①针对无样本类增量学习（NECIL）中旧类特征漂移和分类器偏置问题。②提出FCS方法，包含特征校准（Feature Calibration）和特征分离（Feature Separation）两个模块，前者修正旧类特征分布，后者增强新旧类区分度。③相比现有NECIL方法，FCS无需存储任何旧样本，且理论分析更完善。④在CIFAR-100和ImageNet子集上，平均准确率比SOTA高约5-7%，遗忘率显著降低。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: FCS tackles non-exemplar class incremental learning by calibrating old-class features and separating new-class features, addressing drift and bias without storing samples. It achieves 5-7% higher average accuracy and lower forgetting on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 方法扎实，实验充分，对无样本增量学习有显著改进，与自动驾驶中持续感知场景相关。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出特征校准与分离的无样本增量学习框架。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 双模块协同处理特征漂移和类间干扰。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对全切片图像分析中传统多实例学习模型无法适应动态数据集、需要大量重训练的问题，本文分析了注意力多实例学习模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此提出了注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池两个组件，前者通过保留注意力层知识缓解灾难性遗忘，后者通过选择性存储信息量最大的补丁减少内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adaptability in conventional multiple instance learning models for whole slide image analysis under evolving datasets. By analyzing attention-based MIL models, they identify that forgetting concentrates in attention layers and propose Attention Knowledge Distillation and Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and reduce memory footprint. Experiments on diverse WSI datasets show significant improvements in accuracy and memory efficiency.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 该工作将持续学习引入医学图像分析领域，针对特定模型结构提出了有效的解决方案，但应用场景较为垂直，对通用视觉感知领域的参考价值有限。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出了针对注意力多实例学习的持续学习框架，包括注意力知识蒸馏和伪袋记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析并利用注意力层遗忘特性设计持续学习策略。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个全切片图像数据集上显著提升准确率和内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的持续学习方法因固定模块集导致学习能力受限、以及周期性添加任务特定模块导致模型线性增长和知识复用不足的问题，本文提出SEMA方法。SEMA通过检测不同表示层面的显著分布偏移，自动决定重用或添加适配器模块，并设计了由功能适配器和表示描述符组成的模块化适配器。该方法在多个持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，有效平衡了稳定性和可塑性。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited learning capacity and linear model growth in pre-trained model-based continual learning. SEMA automatically reuses or adds adapter modules based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels, using a modular adapter with functional adapter and representation descriptor. It achieves superior performance on multiple CL benchmarks, balancing stability and plasticity.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 提出了一种动态扩展的模块化适配机制，有效解决了持续学习中稳定性和可塑性的平衡问题，具有较高的通用性和实用价值。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出SEMA方法，通过自动扩展适配器模块实现预训练模型在持续学习中的高效适应。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 基于分布偏移检测的自适应模块扩展策略。
2403.18886|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
