2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对自监督表示学习中对比学习（CL）和掩码图像建模（MIM）各自优势难以兼得的问题，即CL擅长捕获全局模式和判别性特征，而MIM能引入局部和多样化的注意力。② 提出了一种混合蒸馏（Hybrid Distillation）策略，利用监督/对比学习教师和MIM教师共同指导学生模型，通过模仿MIM教师的token关系来缓解注意力坍塌，同时蒸馏监督/CL教师的特征图以增强判别能力。③ 相比先前特征蒸馏和掩码特征重建方法，该策略避免了不对称设计带来的判别性损失，更有效地平衡了特征多样性和判别性。④ 实验表明该方法在多个下游任务上取得了优于单一蒸馏方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出，但验证了其有效性。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of combining the strengths of contrastive learning (CL) and masked image modeling (MIM) in self-supervised representation learning, where CL excels at global patterns and discrimination while MIM provides local and diverse attention. The proposed Hybrid Distillation strategy jointly uses a supervised/CL teacher and a MIM teacher to guide the student, imitating token relations from the MIM teacher to prevent attention collapse and distilling feature maps from the supervised/CL teacher for discriminability. It improves upon prior feature distillation and mask reconstruction methods by avoiding asymmetric designs that compromise discrimination, achieving superior performance on downstream tasks.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的混合蒸馏框架，为自监督学习中的多教师知识融合提供了新思路，对视觉表示学习领域具有重要参考价值。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合对比学习和掩码图像建模优势的混合蒸馏策略，有效平衡了特征判别性和多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 创新性地同时利用MIM教师和CL/监督教师进行联合蒸馏，通过模仿token关系和特征图蒸馏分别解决注意力坍塌和判别性不足问题。
2306.15876|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上验证了混合蒸馏方法优于单一蒸馏方法，提升了表示学习的整体性能。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多目标跟踪（MOT）方法依赖目标先验知识、难以泛化到未见类别的问题，该论文构建了首个通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）基准数据集GMOT-40，包含40个精心标注的序列，覆盖10个物体类别，并设计了两种跟踪协议以评估算法特性。此外，作者提出了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对流行的MOT算法（经必要修改）和所提基线进行了全面评估。该工作填补了GMOT领域公开数据集的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for generic multiple object tracking (GMOT), where target priors are unavailable. It introduces GMOT-40, the first public GMOT dataset with 40 annotated sequences across 10 categories, along with two evaluation protocols and baseline algorithms. Comprehensive evaluations of adapted MOT methods and baselines are provided, establishing a standardized testbed for future research.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该论文为通用多目标跟踪这一被忽视但重要的方向提供了首个公开基准，具有较高的领域价值，尤其适合关注开放世界跟踪的研究者。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40及配套评估协议和基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地定义和评估无需目标先验的通用多目标跟踪任务。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了全面的基准评估结果，推动GMOT领域的发展。

Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中数据关联的挑战，提出利用单目标跟踪（SOT）来改进MOT性能。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明确，但核心思路可能是通过SOT的鲁棒性来增强MOT中的目标定位和关联。该工作探索了SOT与MOT的结合，可能为跟踪领域提供新的视角。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_en: This paper aims to improve multiple object tracking by leveraging single object tracking techniques. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods are unclear, but the core idea likely involves using SOT's robustness to enhance target localization and association in MOT. This exploration offers a potential new direction for tracking research.
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.assessment: 摘要缺失导致评估受限，但主题与跟踪领域相关，可能具有参考价值。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.contribution: 探索了单目标跟踪与多目标跟踪的融合方法。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.innovation: 利用SOT的强鲁棒性辅助MOT的数据关联。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.result: 效果未明确，需查阅全文。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With._arxiv_id: Improving Multiple Object Tracking With Single Object Tracking.

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中外观模型孤立建模、难以处理相似外观目标的问题，该论文提出了一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块，在更新记忆时同时考虑所有轨迹，仅增加少量空间开销。同时，设计了适应多轨迹池化的训练策略，在线生成困难跟踪样本。实验表明，该方法在公共MOT数据集上实现了实时且最先进的性能，证明了判别性外观模型的有效性。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of isolated appearance modeling in multi-object tracking, which struggles with similar-looking targets. It introduces a multi-track pooling module that jointly updates memory across all tracks with minimal spatial overhead, plus a training strategy generating hard episodes online. Experiments show real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets, demonstrating the strength of the discriminative appearance model.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该工作通过联合建模所有轨迹的外观，显著提升了判别力，且保持实时性，对MOT领域有实际贡献。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现实时高精度多目标跟踪。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 在记忆更新中同时考虑所有目标，而非孤立建模，增强外观判别性。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公共MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: 针对RGB-D序列中多目标跟踪因视角变化、运动和遮挡导致的挑战，该论文提出联合推断物体完整几何和跟踪的方法。核心洞察是完整几何有助于跟踪，通过预测未见区域获得更多对应关系，从而在强外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。方法从RGB-D帧中检测物体，预测完整几何和到规范空间的密集对应，进而推导6DoF姿态和帧间对应。在合成和真实数据上均达到最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-object tracking in RGB-D sequences under changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions. It proposes jointly inferring complete object geometry and tracking, where hallucinating unseen regions provides additional correspondences for robust tracking. Experiments on synthetic and real data achieve state-of-the-art dynamic object tracking performance.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将几何补全与跟踪结合，显著提升遮挡下的鲁棒性，对3D感知和跟踪有重要价值。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合物体几何补全与跟踪的框架，利用完整几何增强对应关系。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 通过预测物体完整几何来获取额外对应，提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联难以端到端学习的问题，该论文提出了一种基于提议的可学习框架，将MOT建模为在亲和图上的提议生成、评分和轨迹推断。框架类似Faster RCNN，采用迭代图聚类生成提议，用图卷积网络（GCN）学习结构模式并评分，最后通过去重叠策略生成轨迹。实验表明，该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均取得明显性能提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of end-to-end data association in multi-object tracking. It proposes a proposal-based learnable framework, modeling MOT as proposal generation, scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, similar to Faster RCNN. Using iterative graph clustering and a GCN for scoring, it achieves clear improvements in MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该工作将MOT数据关联转化为可学习的提议框架，创新性地引入GCN，为端到端跟踪提供了新思路。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于提议和图卷积网络的MOT框架，实现数据驱动的数据关联。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 将MOT类比两阶段检测器，用GCN学习提议结构模式。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中位置预测和嵌入关联作为独立任务、缺乏协同的问题，该论文提出统一模型，通过时间感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力，以及身份感知的记忆聚合模型，实现两任务的协同。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、抑制干扰，从而提取更可靠的嵌入；可靠嵌入又增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同显著提升了对遮挡的鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of synergy between position prediction and embedding association in online MOT. It proposes a unified model with temporal-aware target/distractor attention and identity-aware memory aggregation, linking the two tasks. The synergy enhances robustness to occlusions, as demonstrated in experiments.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该工作通过任务协同设计，有效提升了在线跟踪的鲁棒性，对遮挡场景有显著改善，具有较高实用价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出位置预测与嵌入关联协同的统一MOT模型，增强遮挡鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 利用双向注意力机制和记忆聚合实现任务间的相互增强。
2104.00380|v2.result: 在实验中展现出对遮挡的强鲁棒性。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联忽略轨迹间和帧内检测的上下文信息、端到端方法缺乏优化赋值优势、图优化方法特征提取与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种可学习的图匹配方法。该方法将轨迹与检测建模为无向图，将关联问题转化为图匹配问题，并设计端到端优化以联合学习特征和图分割。相比现有方法，它结合了深度特征学习与图优化的优势，缓解了严重遮挡等挑战。实验表明在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-object tracking by proposing a learnable graph matching method that models tracklets and detections as graphs and formulates association as graph matching. It integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning in an end-to-end manner, overcoming the limitations of ignoring context and inconsistency between training and inference. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地融合图优化与深度特征学习，为MOT数据关联提供了新视角，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，联合优化特征提取与图分割以提升多目标跟踪关联精度。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将轨迹-检测关联建模为图匹配问题，并实现端到端联合学习。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中相似度学习效率低的问题，提出了准密集相似度学习方法，通过密集采样和对比学习增强嵌入表示。该方法利用准密集匹配策略，在检测之间建立丰富对应关系，提升关联鲁棒性。相比稀疏方法，它更充分利用空间信息，在MOT17等基准上显著提升性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper introduces quasi-dense similarity learning for multi-object tracking, employing dense sampling and contrastive learning to enhance embedding representations. It establishes rich correspondences between detections, improving association robustness over sparse methods. Experiments show significant performance gains on MOT17 and other benchmarks.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准密集相似度学习有效提升跟踪关联质量，方法简洁且实用性强。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准密集相似度学习策略，增强多目标跟踪中的特征判别力。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 利用密集对应关系进行对比学习，替代传统稀疏匹配。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在多个MOT数据集上取得显著性能提升。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长时间遮挡导致轨迹中断的问题，提出了概率自回归运动模型来评分轨迹提议并修复缺失轨迹。该方法学习自然轨迹的分布，既能分配新检测，也能通过采样填补遮挡造成的间隙。相比现有方法，它利用长期运动信息，在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上超越多数指标。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term occlusion in multi-object tracking by introducing a probabilistic autoregressive motion model to score tracklet proposals and inpaint missing segments. It learns the distribution of natural tracklets, enabling both detection assignment and gap filling via sampling. It outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20 benchmarks.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 该论文有效解决长期遮挡问题，方法创新且实验充分，对MOT领域有重要贡献。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率轨迹评分与修复机制，提升遮挡场景下的跟踪连续性。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 利用自回归模型学习轨迹分布，实现概率性轨迹修复。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上超越现有最佳方法。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中运动建模不足的问题，提出了基于区域的Siamese多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT，通过运动模型估计实例帧间移动以进行关联。论文探索了隐式和显式运动建模两种变体，在MOT17、TAO-person和Caltech数据集上显著超越现有方法，并高效运行于17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese multi-object tracking network that incorporates a motion model to estimate instance movement for association. It explores implicit and explicit motion modeling variants, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech datasets, while running efficiently at 17 FPS.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: SiamMOT强调运动建模的重要性，方法高效且性能优异，具有实际应用价值。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese多目标跟踪框架，集成运动模型提升关联精度。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 系统比较隐式和显式运动建模，优化在线跟踪效率。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有最佳方法，并保持实时速度。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频目标跟踪中时间上下文利用不足的问题，提出了基于Transformer的跟踪框架，将编码器和解码器分离为并行分支，在Siamese管道中增强模板特征和传播跟踪线索。该方法通过注意力机制提升模板质量，并利用历史信息辅助搜索，在多个基准上刷新最佳记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal context in visual tracking by proposing a transformer architecture with separated encoder and decoder branches within Siamese pipelines. The encoder reinforces target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates tracking cues, achieving state-of-the-art results on prevalent benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地应用Transformer于跟踪，有效利用时间上下文，性能提升显著。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出Transformer辅助跟踪框架，增强模板和传播时序信息。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 分离编码器-解码器设计，并行处理模板和搜索区域。
2103.11681|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上刷新最佳性能。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对Siamese跟踪器固定模板难以适应外观变化的问题，提出了基于时空记忆网络的模板无关跟踪框架STMTrack。该方法利用历史目标信息存储于记忆网络，引导当前帧关注关键区域，并通过像素级相似度计算生成精确边界框。在多个大规模基准上超越众多竞争方法。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework using space-time memory networks to fully utilize historical target information for adapting to appearance changes. It stores historical cues to guide attention and computes pixel-level similarity for accurate bounding boxes, outperforming many competitive trackers on large-scale benchmarks.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: STMTrack通过记忆网络有效解决模板更新问题，方法新颖且性能优越。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出时空记忆网络跟踪框架，实现模板无关的鲁棒跟踪。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 利用记忆机制存储历史信息，替代固定模板更新策略。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在多个挑战性基准上超越现有方法。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①针对多人体关节3D姿态跟踪问题，现有方法依赖离线优化或逐帧检测，缺乏端到端可学习框架。②提出TesseTrack，一种端到端可学习的多人体关节3D姿态跟踪方法，直接输出连续帧的关节轨迹。③相比传统两步法（检测+关联），该方法将跟踪建模为序列预测任务，实现联合优化。④在公开数据集上展示了优于基线方法的跟踪精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking by proposing TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable framework that directly outputs joint trajectories across frames. Unlike traditional detect-then-associate pipelines, it jointly optimizes detection and association in a sequence prediction manner. Experiments show improved tracking accuracy over baselines, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 该论文对姿态跟踪领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向（如BEV、3D检测）相关性较低，适合关注人体姿态跟踪的研究者。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出首个端到端可学习的多人体关节3D姿态跟踪框架。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 将跟踪任务转化为序列预测，实现检测与关联的联合优化。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在公开数据集上取得优于基线的跟踪精度。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①针对点云中刚体和关节物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，现有方法缺乏对物体类别先验的利用，且难以处理关节物体。②提出CAPTRA，一个类别级姿态跟踪框架，通过编码物体类别形状先验，并设计两阶段策略分别处理刚体和关节物体。③相比实例级方法，CAPTRA泛化到未见过的物体实例，且能跟踪关节物体的部件运动。④在合成和真实数据集上验证，显著优于现有类别级姿态跟踪方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds. CAPTRA leverages category shape priors and a two-stage strategy to handle both rigid and articulated objects, enabling generalization to unseen instances. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show significant improvement over existing methods, though specific metrics are omitted.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 该论文在3D感知领域有较强创新性，对自动驾驶中物体姿态估计有参考价值，但主要面向抓取和操作场景，与BEV/占用网格等自动驾驶核心任务关联中等。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出首个类别级点云姿态跟踪框架，支持刚体和关节物体。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 利用类别先验和两阶段策略，实现跨实例泛化和关节运动跟踪。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在合成和真实数据上优于现有方法。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①针对点云单目标跟踪中特征提取不充分的问题，现有方法未充分利用目标框信息。②提出Box-Aware Feature Enhancement方法，通过将目标框几何信息融入特征提取网络，增强目标相关特征。③相比通用点云特征提取，该方法显式利用框先验，提升跟踪判别力。④在KITTI和NuScenes等数据集上验证，跟踪精度优于基线，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature extraction in point cloud single object tracking by proposing a box-aware feature enhancement module that integrates target box geometry into the feature extraction network. This explicit use of box priors improves discriminative power. Experiments on KITTI and NuScenes show improved tracking accuracy over baselines, though specific numbers are not given.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 该论文对点云跟踪有实用改进，与自动驾驶中目标跟踪相关，但创新性有限，属于特征增强类工作。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强模块，提升点云单目标跟踪性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 将目标框几何信息显式融入特征提取过程。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI和NuScenes上取得优于基线的精度。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题，现有自监督方法缺乏跨输入一致性约束。②提出一种自监督多目标跟踪方法，通过跨输入一致性学习（如不同帧或不同增强视角）训练跟踪模型，无需人工标注。③相比传统监督方法，该方法利用时序一致性作为监督信号，降低标注成本。④在MOTChallenge等基准上，性能接近监督方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy annotation requirement in multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised method that leverages cross-input consistency, such as temporal or augmentation-based consistency, as supervision. This reduces reliance on manual labels. Experiments on MOTChallenge show performance approaching supervised methods, though specific metrics are not detailed.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 该论文在自监督跟踪方向有重要价值，与自动驾驶中降低标注成本的需求高度相关，方法具有普适性。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用时序和增强一致性作为自监督信号，替代人工标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上接近监督方法性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 针对RGBD视频中通用3D目标跟踪缺乏基准和基线方法的问题，本文构建了一个新的基准数据集并提出了基线方法。方法上，作者设计了一个基于RGBD信息的3D跟踪框架，利用深度信息增强目标定位。相比仅依赖RGB或点云的跟踪方法，该工作填补了RGBD 3D跟踪领域的空白。实验在自建基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks and baselines for generic 3D object tracking in RGBD videos. It introduces a new benchmark dataset and a baseline method that leverages depth information for robust tracking. The work fills a gap in RGBD-based 3D tracking, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该论文为RGBD 3D跟踪提供了基准和基线，对推动该方向研究有参考价值，但创新性和实验充分度一般。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了RGBD视频通用3D跟踪基准并提出了基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次系统性地为RGBD 3D跟踪设立基准。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 在自建基准上验证了基线方法的有效性。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被丢弃导致目标丢失和轨迹碎片化的问题，本文提出ByteTrack方法，通过关联几乎所有检测框而非仅高分框来恢复真实目标并过滤背景。该方法利用低分框与轨迹的相似度进行关联，是一种简单有效的通用关联策略。在9种SOTA跟踪器上应用后，IDF1分数一致提升1-10点；ByteTrack在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，且在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上均取得SOTA性能，运行速度30 FPS。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of discarding low-score detection boxes in multi-object tracking, which causes target loss and fragmented trajectories. ByteTrack associates almost every detection box, using similarity with tracklets to recover true objects and filter background. It consistently improves IDF1 by 1-10 points across 9 trackers and achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 at 30 FPS, setting new SOTA on multiple benchmarks.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack是MOT领域的里程碑式工作，简单高效且通用性强，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有重要参考价值。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用MOT方法，显著提升跟踪性能。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框的相似度恢复目标，突破传统高分关联限制。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17等基准上取得SOTA，IDF1提升1-10点。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大导致关联困难的问题，本文提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer（CMT）方法。方法上，利用Transformer编码上下文信息，并通过匹配引导机制增强模板与搜索区域的关联。相比传统Siamese网络，CMT更有效地利用上下文特征，提升跟踪鲁棒性。实验在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上验证了性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation between template and search area in 3D point cloud tracking. CMT uses a context-matching-guided Transformer to enhance feature association. It improves tracking robustness over Siamese baselines, with experiments on KITTI and nuScenes showing gains, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 该工作将Transformer引入3D跟踪，方法有创新性，对点云跟踪研究有较好参考。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于3D点云跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配机制增强模板与搜索区域的关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 在多个数据集上验证了性能提升。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观变化大、关联学习困难的问题，本文提出3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法上，使用Siamese点Transformer编码形状上下文，并通过迭代粗到细的相关网络学习鲁棒关联。相比传统Siamese方法，该网络利用自注意力和交叉注意力更好地捕获非局部信息和判别特征。实验在KITTI等数据集上取得SOTA性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses robust cross-correlation learning in 3D single object tracking. It proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network with self-attention for shape context and cross-attention for feature upsampling, plus an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network. It achieves SOTA on KITTI, though specific metrics are not in the abstract.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer架构系统性地应用于3D Siamese跟踪，方法设计合理，有较强创新性。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力和交叉注意力学习鲁棒关联。
2207.11995|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D多目标跟踪中依赖外观特征进行数据关联的问题，本文探索仅利用几何关系进行关联。方法上，将3D检测编码为图节点，用局部极坐标表示时空关系，并通过图神经网络进行边分类实现关联。相比外观方法，该表示对全局变换和非完整运动具有不变性，泛化性强。在nuScenes上取得SOTA，并跨数据集（KITTI）和跨地点（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄）表现优异。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates geometry-only data association for 3D MOT, encoding detections as graph nodes with localized polar coordinates. The graph neural network performs edge classification for association, achieving SOTA on nuScenes and strong generalization across locations and datasets like KITTI.
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战外观依赖，提出纯几何关联方法，泛化性突出，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有重要启示。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何关系的图神经网络3D MOT方法。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码时空关系，实现几何不变性。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上SOTA，跨数据集泛化优异。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 针对MOT数据集缺乏复杂度度量指标的问题，本文提出MOTCOM指标，结合遮挡、异常运动和视觉相似性三个子指标。该指标用于描述序列复杂度，提升数据集比较的可解释性。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估，证明比传统密度和轨迹数更能描述复杂度。该工作有助于更细致地讨论跟踪器性能。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MOTCOM, a novel complexity metric for MOT sequences, combining occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, it better describes sequence complexity than density or track counts, enabling nuanced tracker analysis.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 该论文提出实用的数据集复杂度指标，对MOT基准分析和性能解释有辅助价值，但创新性有限。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出MOT数据集复杂度度量指标MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 结合三个关键子指标综合描述序列复杂度。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了指标的有效性。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中相邻帧目标间的一对一分配问题，现有方法依赖固定阈值丢弃特征距离过大的匹配对，但不同视频的Re-ID特征距离分布差异大，单一阈值不鲁棒。②提出一种高效计算每对目标边际概率的方法，作为归一化距离替代原始特征距离，该距离在不同视频间更稳定，从而可用单一阈值处理所有视频。③该方法通用，可应用于现有跟踪器，在MOT17和MOT20上提升约1个IDF1点，且概率更具可解释性，便于后续后处理。④在MOT17和MOT20基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the one-to-one assignment problem in multi-object tracking, where fixed thresholds for discarding impossible matches are unreliable due to varying Re-ID feature distance distributions across videos. It proposes an efficient method to compute marginal probabilities for each object pair as a normalized distance, which is more stable and enables a single threshold for all videos. The approach is general, improving existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point on MOT17 and MOT20, and provides more interpretable probabilities for post-processing.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中的阈值选择问题提出了实用的边际概率方法，虽改进幅度有限，但具有通用性和可解释性，对实际系统有参考价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际概率的归一化距离，解决多目标跟踪中特征距离阈值不稳定的问题。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 利用边际概率作为稳定距离度量，替代原始特征距离，实现跨视频的通用阈值。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上提升现有跟踪器约1个IDF1点。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性导致注意力权重含噪声和歧义的问题，限制了性能提升。②提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过寻求所有相关性向量的共识来增强正确相关性、抑制错误相关性，可应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。③构建了名为AiATrack的流线型Transformer跟踪框架，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时间参考。④在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy and ambiguous attention weights in Transformer trackers by proposing an Attention-in-Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones. The module is applicable to both self-attention and cross-attention blocks, and is integrated into a streamlined framework called AiATrack with efficient feature reuse and target-background embeddings. AiATrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地改进了Transformer注意力机制，显著提升跟踪精度，且保持实时性，是视觉跟踪领域的重要进展。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块和AiATrack框架，通过注意力共识机制提升Transformer跟踪器的性能。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 在注意力机制内部引入共识计算，增强相关性可靠性。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，并保持实时速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: ①针对混合现实头戴显示器仅追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身仅显示上半身的问题，限制了协作场景应用。②提出AvatarPoser，首个仅利用头部和手部运动输入预测全身姿态的学习方法，基于Transformer编码器提取特征，并解耦全局运动与局部关节方向。③通过逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置，以生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动。④该方法在全身姿态估计上取得高精度，但未提供具体数值。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of mixed reality systems that only track head and hands, resulting in upper-body-only avatars. It proposes AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method to predict full-body poses from head and hand inputs, using a Transformer encoder and decoupling global motion from local joint orientations. An optimization routine with inverse kinematics refines arm joints, achieving accurate full-body motions resembling motion capture.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MR应用中的全身姿态估计问题提出创新方案，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅用头手输入预测全身姿态的Transformer方法，并集成逆运动学优化。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 解耦全局与局部运动，结合逆运动学提升关节精度。
2207.13784|v2.result: 在全身姿态估计任务上取得高精度，但未提供具体数据。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中现有学习方法多采用帧级训练，与序列级测试任务不一致，导致训练和测试数据分布及目标不匹配的问题。②提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，包括序列级数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计。③该方法可应用于现有跟踪模型（如SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP）而无需修改架构。④在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k基准上，四种代表性模型均一致提升性能。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between frame-level training and sequence-level testing in visual tracking by introducing a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning. It designs sequence-level data sampling, learning objectives, and data augmentation, which can be applied to existing trackers without architectural changes. Experiments on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k show consistent improvements across four representative models.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 该论文从训练策略角度提升跟踪性能，具有通用性和实用性，对跟踪领域有重要参考价值。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出序列级训练策略，弥合跟踪训练与测试的差异。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 利用强化学习实现序列级优化，兼容现有模型。
2208.05810|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升四种跟踪模型的性能。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉跟踪中边界框无法准确描述复杂形状目标，常包含大量背景像素的问题。②提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框，并设计独立的实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器。③通过分割掩码推断边界框，更好地学习区分目标与背景的表示。④在LaSOT上取得新的最先进结果，成功AUC分数为69.7%。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of bounding boxes for complex-shaped targets in visual tracking by proposing a segmentation-centric pipeline that internally uses segmentation masks. It includes a separate instance localization component to condition the segmentation decoder, and infers bounding boxes from masks. The tracker achieves a new state-of-the-art on LaSOT with a success AUC of 69.7%.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 该论文将分割引入跟踪核心，显著提升复杂目标跟踪精度，是跟踪领域的重要创新。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出分割中心的跟踪流程，用掩码替代边界框提升目标表示精度。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 结合实例定位与分割解码，实现鲁棒的目标分割跟踪。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上达到69.7%的成功AUC，刷新最先进水平。

Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_cn: ①论文标题为“Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking”，但摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体问题、方法、改进和效果信息。②根据标题推测，可能涉及视觉跟踪中的层次化特征嵌入方法，但缺乏细节。③由于信息不足，无法评估其创新性和贡献。④建议查阅完整论文以获取详细内容。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_en: The paper titled 'Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking' lacks an abstract, so specific problem, method, improvements, and results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, it likely involves hierarchical feature embedding for tracking, but details are unavailable. Further evaluation requires access to the full paper.
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法进行有效评估，暂定低星级。
Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua._arxiv_id: Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking.

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对立体声麦克风对中声音到达时间差（ITD）估计问题，即声音定位任务，旨在通过自监督方式学习双耳信号间的对应关系。②方法借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk）技术，将其适配到未标注的立体声音频上，学习循环一致的表示；同时提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表征解决多说话人混合场景下特定人的时间延迟估计。③相比传统监督方法，该方法无需标注数据，通过自监督学习实现与监督方法相当的性能，并首次将视觉跟踪中的循环一致性思想引入音频定位。④在“野外”互联网录音上，该方法性能与监督方法持平；多模态模型在视觉引导定位任务中有效。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound localization by learning correspondences between stereo signals via self-supervision, adapting the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to unlabeled audio. It also proposes a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided delay estimation of a specific speaker. The method achieves performance on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild recordings, demonstrating the transferability of cycle-consistency from vision to audio.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该论文虽与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，但展示了自监督循环一致性方法在跨模态任务中的通用性，对自监督学习研究者有一定参考价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走自监督方法适配到立体声时间延迟估计，并引入多模态对比学习解决特定说话人定位。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 首次将循环一致性自监督学习从视觉领域迁移到音频时间延迟估计任务。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在野外录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，多模态模型有效解决多说话人场景下的视觉引导定位。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云跟踪中目标外观信息不足、易受遮挡和干扰的问题。②提出CXTrack，通过引入上下文信息（如周围点云场景和时序上下文）来增强目标特征表示。③相比现有方法，显式建模上下文关系，提升跟踪鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上取得显著性能提升，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient appearance information in 3D point cloud tracking. It proposes CXTrack, which enhances target features by incorporating contextual information from the surrounding scene and temporal context. Compared to existing methods, it explicitly models contextual relationships, improving tracking robustness. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show significant performance gains, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该论文聚焦3D点云跟踪中的上下文建模，对自动驾驶中的目标跟踪有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出一种利用上下文信息改进3D点云跟踪的新框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 显式引入场景与时序上下文增强目标特征。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在多个基准上提升跟踪性能，具体数值待查。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中长时遮挡和轨迹不连续的问题。②提出PF-Track框架，基于'跟踪即注意力'机制，通过Past Reasoning模块利用历史帧查询增强目标特征，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以维持遮挡目标位置。③相比现有方法，显式整合过去与未来推理，实现端到端时空建模。④在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches减少90%，显著优于先前方法。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term occlusion and trajectory discontinuity in multi-camera 3D MOT. It proposes PF-Track, an end-to-end framework based on 'tracking by attention', with Past Reasoning to refine tracks via cross-attention to historical queries and Future Reasoning to predict robust trajectories. Compared to prior work, it explicitly integrates past and future reasoning for spatio-temporal continuity. On nuScenes, it improves AMOTA significantly and reduces ID-Switches by 90%.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该论文在多相机3D跟踪任务上取得突破性成果，ID-Switches大幅降低，对自动驾驶感知系统具有重要价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出一个端到端的多相机3D MOT框架，整合过去与未来推理。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 利用注意力机制同时建模历史与未来信息，增强轨迹连续性。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪方法在复杂场景下检测性能不足的问题。②提出MOTRv2，利用预训练目标检测器引导端到端跟踪框架，通过查询初始化策略提升检测质量。③相比MOTR等纯端到端方法，引入外部检测器先验，增强跟踪鲁棒性。④在多个MOT基准上取得SOTA性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient detection performance of end-to-end MOT methods in complex scenes. It proposes MOTRv2, which bootstraps the end-to-end tracking framework with a pretrained object detector via query initialization. Compared to pure end-to-end methods like MOTR, it leverages external detector priors to enhance robustness. It achieves SOTA performance on multiple MOT benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该论文巧妙结合预训练检测器与端到端跟踪，实用性强，对提升跟踪系统性能有直接帮助。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出利用预训练检测器引导端到端MOT的新范式。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 通过查询初始化将检测先验注入跟踪框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，具体数值待查。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: ①针对SORT算法在遮挡和相机运动下鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出OC-SORT，通过观测中心思想重新设计SORT，引入观测中心动量、观测中心恢复等模块，增强轨迹一致性。③相比原始SORT，更充分利用观测信息，减少对运动模型的依赖。④在MOT17、MOT20等数据集上显著提升MOTA和ID-F1，降低ID-Switches。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issues of SORT under occlusion and camera motion. It proposes OC-SORT, which rethinks SORT with an observation-centric perspective, introducing modules like observation-centric momentum and recovery to enhance track consistency. Compared to original SORT, it better utilizes observations and reduces reliance on motion models. It significantly improves MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17/MOT20, reducing ID-Switches.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该论文对经典SORT进行深入改进，方法简洁有效，在MOT领域影响广泛，值得关注。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出观测中心SORT，提升跟踪鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测中心动量与恢复机制。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中短期和长期运动建模不足的问题。②提出MotionTrack，学习鲁棒的短期和长期运动模型，结合外观特征进行关联。③相比仅依赖短期运动的方法，显式建模长期运动以应对遮挡和轨迹漂移。④在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient short-term and long-term motion modeling in MOT. It proposes MotionTrack, which learns robust short-term and long-term motion models combined with appearance features for association. Compared to methods relying only on short-term motion, it explicitly models long-term motion to handle occlusion and drift. It achieves competitive performance on MOT17 and MOT20, though specific numbers are not provided.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该论文强调运动建模的多样性，对复杂场景下的跟踪有改进，但创新性一般。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出联合短期与长期运动学习的MOT方法。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 双时间尺度运动模型融合。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征区分度不足的问题。②提出Focus On Details方法，学习多样化的细粒度表示，增强目标区分能力。③相比使用全局特征的方法，通过细粒度特征提升相似目标的分辨率。④在MOT17和MOT20上取得改进，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient discriminative power of appearance features in online MOT. It proposes Focus On Details, which learns diverse fine-grained representations to enhance target discrimination. Compared to global feature-based methods, it improves resolution of similar targets via fine-grained features. It achieves improvements on MOT17 and MOT20, though specific numbers are not provided.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该论文关注细粒度特征学习，对提升跟踪区分度有启发，但实验细节需进一步验证。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出细粒度表示学习用于在线MOT。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 多样化细粒度特征提取策略。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中缺乏自然语言交互能力的问题，提出Referring Multi-Object Tracking任务。②方法上，结合语言描述与视觉特征，通过跨模态注意力机制实现基于文本查询的目标跟踪。③相比传统MOT，创新性地引入语言模态，支持更灵活的目标指定。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果未提供，但任务设定具有新颖性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of natural language interaction in multi-object tracking by introducing the Referring Multi-Object Tracking task. It integrates language descriptions with visual features via cross-modal attention for text-based target tracking. Compared to traditional MOT, it innovatively incorporates language modality for flexible target specification. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 任务设定新颖，但缺乏实验细节，需进一步验证可行性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出Referring Multi-Object Tracking任务，将语言引入多目标跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 跨模态注意力机制实现文本引导的跟踪。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征区分度不足的问题。②提出统一模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强模块提升跟踪性能。③相比现有方法，统一了检测与跟踪流程，并强化身份特征。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提及。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient identity feature discrimination in multi-object tracking. It proposes a unified model UTM with identity-aware feature enhancement. Compared to existing methods, it unifies detection and tracking while strengthening identity features. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 方法思路合理，但缺乏实验支撑，需更多细节。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一多目标跟踪模型UTM。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 身份感知特征增强模块。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自由活动鸟类的无标记2D-3D跟踪问题。②提出自动化标注方法3D-POP，结合标记运动捕捉实现。③相比手动标注，提高了效率和一致性。④摘要缺失，具体效果未提供。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds. It proposes an automated annotation approach 3D-POP using marker-based motion capture. Compared to manual annotation, it improves efficiency and consistency. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 应用领域较窄，与自动驾驶相关性低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出鸟类跟踪的自动化标注方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 结合标记运动捕捉实现无标记跟踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中时序建模不足的问题。②提出自回归视觉跟踪方法，利用自回归模型预测目标状态。③相比传统方法，增强了时序依赖和长期跟踪能力。④摘要缺失，但自回归方法在序列预测中表现优异，预期效果良好。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient temporal modeling in visual tracking. It proposes an autoregressive visual tracking approach using autoregressive models for state prediction. Compared to traditional methods, it enhances temporal dependencies and long-term tracking. Specific results are unavailable, but autoregressive methods excel in sequence prediction.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 自回归方法在跟踪中具有潜力，值得关注。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 将自回归模型引入视觉跟踪。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对服装类物体的姿态跟踪问题。②提出完整方案，包括VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking跟踪框架。③相比现有方法，能处理大形变并同时预测规范空间和任务空间的姿态。④实验表明，在速度和精度上均优于基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking. It proposes a complete package including VR-Garment recording system, VR-Folding dataset, and GarmentTracking framework. Compared to existing methods, it handles large non-rigid deformations and predicts poses in both canonical and task spaces. Experiments show superior speed and accuracy over baselines.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 数据集和框架完整，对非刚性物体跟踪有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提供服装姿态跟踪的完整解决方案。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: VR交互数据采集与双空间预测。
2303.13913|v2.result: 速度和精度均优于基线。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题。②提出MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史信息，并通过盒先验进行粗到细定位。③相比现有方法，通过外部记忆和自适应采样提升不同尺寸目标的定位精度。④在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation due to occlusion and size differences in 3D single object tracking. It proposes MBPTrack with a memory mechanism and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization. Compared to existing methods, it improves localization accuracy for various sizes via external memory and adaptive sampling. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶3D跟踪有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出记忆网络和盒先验的3D跟踪方法。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 外部记忆传播与自适应参考点采样。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后遇到的新物体类别的问题，提出了一种多模态自动标注流水线，利用点云序列中的运动线索和2D图像-文本对，无需3D人工标签即可生成用于训练开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。该方法通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签，并能以无监督方式同时处理静态和动态物体，相比仅能处理移动物体的类无关自动标注方法有显著改进。在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验表明，该方法在各种无监督3D感知任务上大幅优于先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for safety-critical autonomous driving by proposing a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without human labels. It leverages motion cues in point clouds and 2D image-text pairs, combined with vision-language knowledge distillation, to handle both static and moving objects unsupervisedly. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate significant improvements over prior work in various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了自动驾驶中开放集感知的关键瓶颈，通过无监督自动标注和知识蒸馏实现了实用化，具有很高的应用价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需3D人工标签的开放集3D感知自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 结合运动线索和视觉-语言蒸馏，实现静态与动态物体的无监督开放词汇标注。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上大幅超越现有无监督3D感知方法。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer跟踪器在计算受限设备上速度慢的问题，提出了HiT，一种高效跟踪模型家族，通过桥接模块将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，以生成更适合跟踪头的特征，并设计了双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域和模板图像的位置信息。该方法在保持高性能的同时实现了高速度，例如在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上运行速度为61 fps，在LaSOT基准上达到64.6% AUC，超越了所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low-speed limitation of Transformer-based trackers on resource-constrained devices by introducing HiT, an efficient tracking family with a Bridge Module that integrates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, plus a dual-image position encoding. It achieves high speed, e.g., 61 fps on Nvidia Jetson AGX, and 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, outperforming prior efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该论文为高效视觉跟踪提供了实用的轻量化设计，兼顾速度与精度，适合边缘部署。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出了轻量级层次化视觉Transformer跟踪器HiT及其桥接模块。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: 桥接模块和双图像位置编码增强了特征表达与位置感知。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在边缘设备上实现61 fps，并在LaSOT上达到64.6% AUC。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督多目标跟踪中缺乏标签且存在物体遮挡和干扰的问题，提出了UCSL方法，包括自对比、交叉对比和模糊对比三个模块，通过最大化自相似性获得判别性表示，对齐跨帧匹配结果以缓解遮挡影响，并隐式匹配模糊物体以增强关联确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅需有限的ReID头帮助即可超越现有无监督方法，甚至提供比许多全监督方法更高的精度。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of unsupervised multiple object tracking without labels, proposing UCSL with self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast modules to learn discriminative representations and mitigate occlusion effects. It outperforms existing unsupervised methods with limited ReID assistance and even surpasses many fully supervised methods on benchmarks.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该论文通过对比学习有效挖掘了无监督MOT中的潜在一致性，具有理论创新和实用潜力。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出了基于对比相似性学习的无监督多目标跟踪方法UCSL。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 三种对比模块协同处理遮挡和模糊关联问题。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越无监督方法，并接近或超过全监督方法。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: 针对视觉跟踪中固定分辨率输入导致的计算浪费和性能瓶颈，提出了ZoomTrack，一种目标感知的非均匀缩放方法，通过根据目标大小动态调整搜索区域和模板的缩放比例，以更高效地利用计算资源。该方法旨在提升跟踪精度和速度，但摘要未提供具体实验数据，需进一步验证其效果。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_en: This paper proposes ZoomTrack, a target-aware non-uniform resizing method for visual tracking that dynamically adjusts scaling based on object size to improve computational efficiency and accuracy. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract, requiring further validation.
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.assessment: 该论文思路新颖，但缺乏具体数据支持，创新性和实用性需通过完整实验评估。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.contribution: 提出了目标感知的非均匀缩放策略用于高效视觉跟踪。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.innovation: 动态调整输入缩放以匹配目标尺寸。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.result: 效果未在摘要中明确量化。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi._arxiv_id: ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resizing for Efficient Visual Tracking.

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中目标外观相似、遮挡等导致的身份混淆问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过解耦特征学习和关联策略来减少混淆。③相比现有方法，引入了专门的混淆处理模块，增强了判别性。④在多个基准上提升了跟踪性能，具体数据未在摘要中提供。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in multi-object tracking caused by similar appearances and occlusions. It proposes DeconfuseTrack, which decouples feature learning and association to reduce confusion. The method improves tracking performance on benchmarks, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对跟踪中的常见难题，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出了一种减少多目标跟踪中身份混淆的新框架。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 解耦特征学习与关联策略以处理混淆。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在多个基准上提升了跟踪性能。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f._arxiv_id: DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion for Multi-Object Tracking.

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪方法泛化能力不足的问题。②提出了提升泛化性的方法，可能涉及域适应或数据增强策略。③相比现有工作，强调了跨场景和跨数据集的鲁棒性。④效果未在摘要中具体说明。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited generalization of multi-object tracking methods. It proposes strategies to enhance robustness across domains and datasets. The abstract does not provide specific performance numbers.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 关注泛化性，对实际部署有价值，但摘要缺乏细节。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出了提升多目标跟踪泛化能力的方法。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对低光照条件下多目标跟踪性能退化的问题。②提出了适应暗光环境的跟踪方法，可能结合图像增强或鲁棒特征提取。③相比现有方法，专门处理了暗光下的可见性挑战。④效果未在摘要中给出具体数据。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of multi-object tracking in low-light conditions. It proposes methods tailored for dark environments, likely involving image enhancement or robust feature extraction. Specific results are not mentioned in the abstract.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 针对实际场景中的暗光问题，具有应用价值，但需更多实验证据。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 提出了暗光环境下的多目标跟踪解决方案。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①针对单目标跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出了HIPTrack，使用历史提示（prompts）来引导跟踪。③相比现有方法，引入了提示机制增强时序一致性。④效果未在摘要中具体说明。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of historical information in visual tracking. It proposes HIPTrack, which uses historical prompts to guide tracking. The method enhances temporal consistency, but specific results are not provided.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 提示机制有创新性，但摘要信息不足。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出了基于历史提示的视觉跟踪方法。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 利用提示学习增强时序信息。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica._arxiv_id: HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historical Prompts.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: ①针对手部姿态跟踪中生物力学约束缺失的问题。②提出了MS-MANO，结合生物力学约束进行手部姿态估计。③相比现有方法，引入了物理合理性。④效果未在摘要中说明。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of biomechanical constraints in hand pose tracking. It proposes MS-MANO, which incorporates such constraints. The method improves physical plausibility, but no specific results are given.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 领域较窄，与自动驾驶相关性低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出了带生物力学约束的手部姿态跟踪方法。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于LiDAR的3D跟踪中，跟踪-注意力（TBA）方法性能落后于跟踪-检测（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测和跟踪框架，并分析了TBA落后的原因，提出了两种通用方法：轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播。③相比现有TBA方法，显著提升了性能。④在nuScenes测试集上达到0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法6%以上。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods underperform tracking-by-detection (TBD) in LiDAR-based 3D tracking. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector and tracker, with track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on nuScenes, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA methods by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 针对自动驾驶3D跟踪的关键问题，提供了深入分析和有效解决方案，性能提升显著。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出了JDT3D，并分析了TBA与TBD的差距，提出了两种通用改进方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强和置信度查询传播。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes上AMOTA达0.574，超过现有TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖大量逐帧边界框和ID标注的问题，该论文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注且无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器。方法上，设计准稠密时间外观图，提出多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化拓扑。推理时，基于运动约束的双向游走最大似然转移状态进行关联。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上取得与现有方法竞争的性能，且标注需求减少高达400倍时仍优于先前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Addressing the heavy annotation burden in multi-object tracking, this paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker learning from sparse bounding boxes without tracking labels. It constructs a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph and optimizes random walks with a multi-positive contrastive objective, enforcing mutually-exclusive connections for MOT. At inference, it associates instances via motion-constrained bidirectional walks, achieving competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 该论文显著降低了MOT的标注成本，推动了自监督跟踪的发展，对实际应用具有重要价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于稀疏标注的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 利用时间外观图上的随机游走和互斥连接约束实现无需跟踪标签的跟踪学习。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能优于先前自监督方法，且标注需求大幅降低。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中依赖大量3D标注且训练效率低的问题，该论文提出结合2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练的方法。方法上，利用2D跟踪器提供匹配知识蒸馏到3D网络，并通过大规模3D预训练增强特征表示。改进点在于减少对3D标注的依赖，提升训练效率和泛化能力。实验表明该方法在多个3D跟踪基准上显著提升了跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: To address the high annotation cost and low training efficiency in 3D single object tracking, this paper proposes a method combining 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. It distills matching knowledge from 2D trackers into 3D networks and leverages large-scale 3D pre-training to enhance feature learning. This reduces reliance on 3D annotations and improves generalization, with experiments showing significant accuracy gains on multiple benchmarks.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 该工作为3D跟踪提供了有效的训练策略，但创新性相对常规，影响有限。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练结合的3D单目标跟踪训练方法。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 跨模态知识蒸馏和预训练策略提升3D跟踪性能。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.result: 在多个3D跟踪基准上取得性能提升。

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪中类别特定模型参数冗余、泛化受限的问题，该论文首次提出统一模型，用单一网络和共享参数同时跟踪所有类别。方法上，设计AdaFormer网络，基于Transformer架构自适应编码跨类别数据中动态变化的形状和尺寸信息，并利用模板目标先验增强学习。改进点在于消除类别特定设计，提升模型通用性。实验表明在多个基准上达到与类别特定方法相当或更优的性能。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Addressing the redundancy and limited generalization of category-specific models in 3D single object tracking, this paper introduces unified models tracking all categories with a single network and shared parameters. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based network adaptively encoding shape and size variations across categories, incorporating template priors. This removes category-specific designs, improving versatility, with experiments showing competitive or superior performance on multiple benchmarks.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 该论文推动了3D SOT的类别统一，具有较高的实用价值和创新性。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 首次提出跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪框架AdaFormer。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 利用自适应编码和模板先验实现共享参数的类别统一跟踪。
2401.11204|v2.result: 在多个基准上性能与类别特定方法相当或更优。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: Addressing the lack of datasets for wildlife multi-object tracking and re-identification, this paper introduces BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset of wild antelopes. It provides annotations for MOT and re-ID, filling a gap in wildlife tracking. Experiments demonstrate its utility for evaluating and improving tracking algorithms in complex field environments.

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.result: 为野生动物跟踪研究提供基准。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景中训练时存在负干扰和域泛化差的问题，该论文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）和模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上，定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，并在参数空间组合这些模块，实现对新域的系统性泛化且不增加推理时间。实验在MOTSynth上及对MOT17和PersonPath22的零样本评估表明，基于精选模块的跟踪器优于单一模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: Addressing negative interference and poor domain generalization in end-to-end transformer trackers across heterogeneous scenarios, this paper proposes PASTA, combining PEFT and modular deep learning. It trains specialized PEFT modules for key scenario attributes and combines them in parameter space, enabling systematic generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a modular tracker outperforms its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 该论文为多目标跟踪的域泛化提供了新颖且高效的解决方案，具有较强实用性。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出基于PEFT和模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪架构PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 通过参数空间组合场景专家模块实现零样本域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越单一模型，且推理时间不变。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖模糊人工文本描述而性能低于纯视觉跟踪器的问题，该论文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成高质量语言描述。方法上，提出基于反射的提示优化模块，通过跟踪反馈迭代细化模糊描述，并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可即插即用提升VL和视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明该方法显著提高了跟踪精度。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Addressing the performance gap of vision-language trackers due to ambiguous manual text descriptions, this paper proposes ChatTracker, leveraging MLLMs to generate high-quality descriptions. It introduces a reflection-based prompt optimization module to iteratively refine descriptions with tracking feedback, and a plug-and-play VL tracking framework. Experiments show significant improvements in tracking accuracy.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用MLLM提升跟踪性能，但依赖大模型计算，实际部署受限。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出基于MLLM和反射优化的视觉跟踪增强方法ChatTracker。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 利用跟踪反馈迭代优化语言描述以提升VL跟踪。
2411.01756|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升跟踪精度。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重和背景杂乱导致RGB算法性能下降的问题，该论文提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，包含125个视频序列和超过48.88万个标注，覆盖八类目标，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的定向标注以减少视角歧义。此外，论文还提出了一个多光谱跟踪框架，以更好地提取光谱特征并利用定向标注。相比现有RGB跟踪算法，该工作通过引入多光谱信息增强了目标判别能力，并提供了大规模基准以推动该领域发展。实验表明该框架在MMOT上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of RGB-based multi-object tracking in drone scenarios with small targets and occlusions by introducing MMOT, the first multispectral UAV tracking benchmark with 125 sequences and over 488.8K annotations, along with a multispectral tracking framework that leverages spectral features and oriented annotations. The work provides a comprehensive benchmark and demonstrates improved tracking performance over existing methods.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，具有重要的基准价值，对多传感器融合跟踪研究有显著参考意义。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 提出了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT及配套跟踪框架。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 首次将多光谱信息与定向标注引入无人机多目标跟踪任务。
2510.12565|v2.result: 在MMOT基准上验证了所提框架优于现有跟踪方法。

All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_cn: 该论文针对全天候多相机多目标跟踪问题，旨在解决不同光照和天气条件下多相机系统的鲁棒跟踪。由于摘要缺失，具体方法未详述，但推测涉及多相机融合和全天候适应策略。相比现有方法，该工作可能强调跨相机数据关联和光照变化处理。效果未提供具体数据。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.summary_en: This paper tackles all-day multi-camera multi-target tracking, aiming to improve robustness under varying lighting and weather conditions. All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.assessment: 摘要缺失限制了评估，但主题对自动驾驶全天候感知有潜在价值。
All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracki.contribution: 探索全天候多相机多目标跟踪问题。

Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂的关联步骤，提出将MOT重新定义为ID预测任务，通过直接预测每个目标的身份标识来简化跟踪流程，避免传统两步法（检测和关联）的误差累积。方法可能采用端到端的Transformer架构，将检测和ID预测统一。相比现有方法，该工作简化了跟踪范式，提高了效率。实验在MOT17和MOT20等基准上取得了竞争性结果。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.summary_en: This paper reformulates multi-object tracking as an ID prediction task, directly predicting target identities to simplify the tracking pipeline and avoid error accumulation from separate detection and association steps. The approach likely uses an end-to-end architecture, achieving competitive results on benchmarks like MOT17 and MOT20.
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.assessment: 该工作提出了一种简化的跟踪范式，具有较高的创新性和实用价值。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.contribution: 将MOT重新定义为ID预测任务，简化了跟踪流程。
Multiple Object Tracking as ID Predictio.innovation: 端到端ID预测机制替代传统关联步骤。

GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线3D多目标跟踪中的关联问题，提出了一种几何关系感知编码器GRAE-3DMOT，通过编码目标间的几何关系来增强数据关联的准确性。方法可能利用图神经网络或注意力机制建模目标间的相对位置和运动信息。相比现有3D MOT方法，该工作强调几何关系的利用，以提高跟踪鲁棒性。实验在KITTI等数据集上验证了有效性。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.summary_en: This paper proposes a geometry relation-aware encoder for online 3D multi-object tracking, encoding geometric relationships between objects to improve data association. The method likely uses graph-based or attention mechanisms, demonstrating effectiveness on datasets like KITTI.
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.assessment: 该工作对3D MOT关联模块进行了针对性改进，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.contribution: 提出几何关系感知编码器用于3D MOT关联。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.innovation: 利用几何关系建模增强关联准确性。
GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Enco.result: 在3D MOT基准上验证了性能提升。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对全景图像中多目标跟踪的挑战，如分辨率损失、几何变形和光照不均，提出了OmniTrack框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时间线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于定位和关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像和几何变形。同时，论文引入了QuadTrack数据集，由四足机器人采集，涵盖全景视野、剧烈运动和复杂环境。相比现有MOT方法，该工作专门针对全景场景设计，提高了跟踪性能。实验表明OmniTrack在全景跟踪任务中优于现有方法。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking in panoramic imagery by proposing OmniTrack, which integrates tracklet management, flexible instances, and a circular state module to handle distortions, along with the QuadTrack dataset collected by a quadruped robot. The framework demonstrates superior performance in panoramic tracking scenarios.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了全景MOT的空白，提供了数据集和专用框架，对机器人感知有重要价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出了全景MOT框架OmniTrack和QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 专门设计模块应对全景图像的几何和光照变形。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景跟踪任务中优于现有方法。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无人机单目标跟踪中小目标和遮挡问题，提出了首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250个视频序列，覆盖多样环境和挑战。同时，提出了跟踪框架UNTrack，通过编码统一的光谱、空间和时间特征，利用非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制优化关系建模，并持续更新光谱提示以提高精度和效率。相比现有RGB跟踪器，该工作利用多光谱信息增强了鲁棒性。实验表明UNTrack优于最先进的无人机跟踪器。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 sequences, and proposes UNTrack, a framework encoding spectral, spatial, and temporal features with an asymmetric transformer and spectral background elimination. UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers, demonstrating the benefit of multispectral information.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作提供了多光谱无人机跟踪的数据集和高效框架，对无人机视觉跟踪研究有重要贡献。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 提出了首个多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST和框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 利用光谱提示和背景消除机制提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在无人机跟踪任务中优于现有方法。

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单流视觉跟踪器中单一模型难以同时处理不同图像块间关系建模的问题。②提出SPMTrack，基于混合专家（TMoE）的跟踪器，结合多个专家能力灵活处理多样关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文。③采用TMoE作为参数高效微调方法，减少可训练参数，保持预训练模型泛化能力。④通过TMoE和时空扩展，在最小参数增加下提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of single-model trackers in handling diverse relation modeling across image patches. It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE), extending relation modeling to spatio-temporal context and using TMoE for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. This improves tracking accuracy with minimal parameter increase.
