2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪缺乏大规模基准的问题，提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度多模态数据，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。所有序列经过多轮人工标注和精细检查，确保高质量。评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能显著下降，表明现有方法在通用性和鲁棒性上不足。该基准是最大的通用3D目标跟踪数据集，为未来研究提供了重要平台。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, with 620 sequences, 123K frames, and 54 categories, offering point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. Extensive evaluation of eight point cloud trackers reveals significant performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic tracking methods. It is the largest benchmark for diverse 3D tracking tasks, providing a solid foundation for future research.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪数据集的空白，多模态设计和大规模标注对推动领域发展具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了最大的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D跟踪基准，并系统评估现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪器在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，揭示了通用跟踪的挑战。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中忽略轨迹信息的问题，提出了TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息增强目标关联和分类。具体引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略，通过改进目标身份和类别一致性提升跟踪性能，并设计了即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义增强（TSE）策略，充分利用视觉轨迹信息。该方法在开放词汇场景下，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊情况下，显著提高了关联稳定性和分类准确性。实验表明，TRACT在多个OV-MOT基准上取得了先进性能。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve object association and classification in OV-MOT. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play TraCLIP module with trajectory feature aggregation and semantic enrichment, enhancing robustness under occlusion and category ambiguity. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on multiple OV-MOT benchmarks.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用轨迹信息解决开放词汇跟踪中的关联和分类问题，具有较高的实用价值。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出轨迹感知的开放词汇跟踪框架TRACT，增强关联稳定性和分类精度。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹一致性强化和轨迹分类模块，充分利用轨迹信息。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得先进性能，尤其在遮挡和模糊场景下提升显著。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: 针对指代多目标跟踪（RMOT）中语言与视觉特征解耦不足的问题，提出了语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法。该方法通过解耦语言描述中的不同语义成分，并利用细粒度知识（如属性、关系）引导视觉特征学习，从而提升跟踪的准确性和鲁棒性。相比现有方法，它更有效地融合语言和视觉信息，减少噪声干扰。实验在多个RMOT基准上验证了方法的有效性，取得了改进的性能。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient language-vision decoupling in referring multi-object tracking by proposing a language decoupling method with fine-grained knowledge guidance. It decomposes language semantics and uses fine-grained knowledge to guide visual feature learning, improving tracking accuracy and robustness. Experiments on RMOT benchmarks show improved performance over existing methods.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该研究为RMOT提供了新的语言解耦思路，但创新性和实验规模相对有限。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的RMOT方法，增强多模态融合。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 利用细粒度知识解耦语言特征，提升视觉-语言对齐。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在RMOT基准上取得性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中原始视频信息利用不足的问题，提出了VOVTrack方法，探索原始视频的潜力以提升跟踪性能。该方法利用视频中的时空一致性信息，增强开放词汇场景下的目标检测和关联能力。相比现有方法，它更充分地挖掘了视频数据中的潜在特征，提高了对未见类别的适应性。实验在多个OV-MOT基准上展示了性能提升。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper proposes VOVTrack to explore the potential of raw videos for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking, leveraging spatio-temporal consistency to enhance detection and association. It improves adaptability to unseen categories by exploiting video-specific features. Experiments on OV-MOT benchmarks demonstrate performance gains.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该工作关注原始视频信息利用，但方法细节和实验对比不够充分。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出利用原始视频时空信息增强开放词汇跟踪的方法。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 挖掘视频时空一致性以提升开放词汇跟踪的鲁棒性。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得性能提升，但提升幅度有限。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目点跟踪在深度模糊和遮挡下的局限性，以及多相机方法需要大量相机和繁琐优化的问题，提出了首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器。该方法利用已知相机位姿和多视角深度，将多视角特征融合到统一点云中，通过k近邻相关和基于Transformer的更新机制，在遮挡下也能可靠估计长程3D对应关系。在5K合成序列上训练，并在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上评估，分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差。该方法能泛化到1-8个相机的不同设置，支持24-150帧的视频长度，具有实用性和鲁棒性。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker, which directly predicts 3D correspondences using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), overcoming depth ambiguity and occlusion. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud with k-NN correlation and transformer-based updates, achieving median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB. The method generalizes to 1-8 cameras and 24-150 frame videos, setting a new standard for multi-view tracking.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地解决了多视角3D点跟踪的实用性问题，方法高效且泛化性强，具有重要应用前景。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个前馈多视角3D点跟踪器，支持少量相机和在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 利用多视角特征融合和Transformer更新，实现鲁棒的长程对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在真实基准上达到厘米级精度，并泛化到多种相机配置。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致的数据缺失（尤其是时间维度）未被充分研究的问题，首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。发现现有跟踪器在此情况下性能显著下降，因其刚性架构缺乏适应性。为此提出了灵活框架，通过异构专家混合融合机制和视频级掩码策略，动态激活计算单元以适应缺失率，同时保证时间一致性和空间完整性。实验表明，该方法不仅适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，显著提升了鲁棒性。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, revealing significant degradation in existing trackers. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism and video-level masking strategy, enabling dynamic adaptation to missing data rates while maintaining temporal consistency. Experiments show robust performance across varying missing rates and scene complexities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了多模态跟踪中时间数据缺失研究的空白，提出的自适应框架具有实际应用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出首个针对时间不完整多模态数据的鲁棒跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 引入异构专家混合和视频级掩码，实现动态适应缺失率。
2507.05899|v2.result: 在多种缺失率下保持鲁棒性，性能优于现有方法。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪中关联模块依赖手工设计、缺乏可学习性的问题。②提出LA-MOTR，引入可学习关联模块，在Transformer框架中端到端建模目标关联。③相比传统MOTR，用可学习关联替代固定匹配策略，提升跟踪鲁棒性。④在MOT基准上取得竞争性结果，但摘要未提供具体数据。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of handcrafted association in end-to-end multi-object tracking by introducing a learnable association module within a Transformer framework. It improves upon MOTR by replacing fixed matching with learned associations, enhancing tracking robustness. The method achieves competitive results on MOT benchmarks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 该论文在端到端跟踪领域有一定创新，但摘要信息有限，影响力和实验充分度一般。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块，推动端到端多目标跟踪的自动化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联过程从手工设计转为可学习机制。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 在MOT基准上取得竞争性性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇3D实例分割中现有概念互补但未整合、分类受背景噪声影响的问题。②提出一个综合方案，结合3D跟踪聚合生成提议、迭代合并去除重叠，并用Alpha-CLIP替代标准CLIP，引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数过滤误检。③改进点在于系统化组合多种技术并优化分类阶段。④在多个基准上达到最先进性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation by proposing a recipe that integrates complementary concepts, including 3D tracking-based proposal aggregation and Alpha-CLIP for object-centric classification. It introduces a standardized maximum similarity score to filter false positives, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks. The key improvement is the systematic combination and refinement of existing techniques.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 该论文在开放词汇3D分割领域具有重要价值，方法系统且实验充分。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出一个整合多种技术的开放词汇3D实例分割方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 使用Alpha-CLIP和SMS分数提升分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在基准上达到最先进性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督驾驶场景建模中动态物体运动捕捉不准确和场景分解不完善的问题。②提出AD-GS框架，结合B样条曲线和全局三角函数的学习运动模型，自动分割场景为物体和背景，使用动态高斯和双向时间可见性掩码。③改进点在于无需人工标注，通过简化伪2D分割和物理刚性正则化提升鲁棒性。④在评估中显著优于现有无标注方法，与依赖标注的方法竞争力相当。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dynamic object modeling in self-supervised driving scene rendering by introducing AD-GS, a framework with a learnable motion model combining B-spline curves and trigonometric functions. It automatically segments scenes without manual annotations and uses dynamic Gaussians with visibility masks, outperforming annotation-free methods and matching annotation-dependent ones. The key improvement is the annotation-free decomposition and robust motion modeling.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶仿真领域有显著贡献，方法创新且实验验证充分。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出自监督驾驶场景渲染框架，无需人工标注。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条和三角函数的运动模型及自动场景分解。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有无标注方法，与有标注方法竞争。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立和模态交互不足的问题。②提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，同时建模运动、外观和类别，设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略和双分支结构。③改进点在于实现稳定分类和连续跟踪，增强泛化能力。④在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有跟踪器，推理速度更快且计算量显著降低。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking by proposing OVTR, the first end-to-end tracker modeling motion, appearance, and category jointly. It introduces a category information propagation strategy and dual-branch structure for stable classification and tracking, outperforming prior trackers on benchmarks with faster inference and reduced computation. The key improvement is the integrated multimodal modeling.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 该论文在开放词汇跟踪领域具有开创性，方法设计巧妙且性能优越。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: CIP策略和双分支结构实现类别传播与多模态交互。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在基准上超越现有方法，推理更快。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目视频中密集3D运动跟踪的计算效率和精度问题。②提出DELTA方法，使用联合全局-局部注意力进行降分辨率跟踪，并通过Transformer上采样器实现高分辨率预测，探索深度表示选择。③改进点在于实现密集3D跟踪的可扩展性，速度提升8倍以上。④在多个基准上达到最先进精度，适用于细粒度长期运动跟踪。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense 3D motion tracking in monocular videos by introducing DELTA, which uses joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking and a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions. It achieves over 8x faster speed and state-of-the-art accuracy on benchmarks, with log-depth identified as optimal. The key improvement is the efficient dense tracking at scale.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 该论文在密集跟踪领域有重要突破，兼顾速度与精度，实验全面。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效密集3D跟踪方法，速度与精度兼得。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合注意力机制和Transformer上采样器。
2410.24211|v2.result: 速度提升8倍以上，精度最先进。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: ①针对互联网视频中未知物体的6D姿态跟踪问题，缺乏物体先验和受控条件。②提出方法包括从模型库检索相似CAD模型、6D对齐、尺度接地，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机器人操作空间。③改进点在于无需物体先验即可估计姿态，并处理动态运动。④在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上评估，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6D pose tracking of unknown objects in internet videos by retrieving similar CAD models, aligning them, and grounding scale, then retargeting trajectories for robotic manipulation. It eliminates the need for object priors and handles dynamic motions, with evaluations on YCB-V and HOPE-Video datasets. The key improvement is the prior-free pose estimation pipeline.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 该论文在机器人操作和视频理解交叉领域有应用价值，但实验细节有限。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的6D姿态跟踪方法。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: CAD模型检索与轨迹优化结合。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在数据集上评估，具体性能未详述。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈、团队运动）下的长程轨迹依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡问题。作者提出了Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹，并自回归预测未来轨迹查询，同时维护跨轨迹的同步长程记忆。将Samba集成到基于传播的跟踪框架中，提出SambaMOTR，成为首个有效解决上述问题的跟踪器，并引入了处理不确定观测的MaskObs技术和高效训练策略。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上显著提升了跟踪性能，尤其在遮挡和复杂交互场景中表现优异。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-range dependencies, inter-tracklet dependencies, and temporal occlusions in multi-object tracking for complex scenarios. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, and integrates it into a propagation-based framework to form SambaMOTR. The method introduces MaskObs for uncertain observations and achieves significant performance improvements on benchmarks, particularly in occlusion-heavy scenes.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型应用于多目标跟踪，解决了长期依赖和轨迹交互问题，具有较高的学术价值和实际应用潜力。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于同步状态空间的集合序列模型SambaMOTR，有效处理跟踪中的长程依赖和轨迹间交互。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现轨迹间的联合建模和长程记忆共享。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升，尤其在复杂遮挡场景中表现优异。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、运动模型简单的问题。②提出一种同时进行检测与跟踪的框架，将运动建模集成到检测过程中，实现端到端的联合优化。③相比传统两步法（检测后关联），该方法通过共享特征和联合推理减少信息丢失，并采用更灵活的运动模型适应目标动态变化。④在多个公开数据集上取得了具有竞争力的跟踪精度，尤其在遮挡和密集场景下性能提升明显。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation and simplistic motion modeling in separate detection and tracking pipelines for multi-object tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework that integrates motion modeling into the detection process for end-to-end joint optimization. Compared to traditional two-step methods, it reduces information loss via shared features and joint inference, with a more flexible motion model. The method achieves competitive tracking accuracy on public benchmarks, with notable gains in occlusion and dense scenarios.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该论文探索了检测与跟踪的深度融合，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有实际价值，但创新性和实验规模中等。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出了一种联合检测与运动建模的多目标跟踪框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将运动模型嵌入检测网络实现端到端联合推理。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在公开数据集上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度，尤其在遮挡场景下性能提升。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①针对现有对抗攻击仅关注检测器而忽视多目标跟踪系统整体鲁棒性的问题。②提出一种针对多目标跟踪的对抗攻击方法，通过同时干扰检测和关联模块，使跟踪性能显著下降。③相比仅攻击检测器的方法，该攻击考虑了跟踪框架的级联特性，设计联合损失函数优化扰动，更贴近实际应用场景。④实验表明，该方法能有效降低多种主流跟踪器的MOTA等指标，且攻击迁移性强。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap in adversarial attacks that focus only on detectors while ignoring the holistic robustness of multi-object tracking systems. It proposes an attack method targeting both detection and association modules, using a joint loss to optimize perturbations. Compared to detector-only attacks, it accounts for the cascaded nature of tracking frameworks, making it more realistic. Experiments show significant degradation in MOTA across multiple trackers with strong transferability.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该论文从安全角度审视跟踪系统，具有新颖性和实用意义，对自动驾驶感知安全性有重要启示。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 首次系统性地提出针对多目标跟踪的联合对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 设计联合损失同时攻击检测与关联模块，提升攻击有效性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 显著降低多种跟踪器的MOTA指标，且攻击具有强迁移性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中数据关联的全局最优解难以高效求解的问题。②提出一种基于提升不相交路径（Lifted Disjoint Paths）的图优化方法，将跟踪问题建模为路径选择，并引入高阶约束提升关联准确性。③相比传统二分图匹配或最小费用流方法，该方法能处理长时遮挡和复杂交互，且通过提升技术保证解的全局性。④在多个标准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的跟踪性能，尤其在拥挤场景下ID切换显著减少。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of efficiently finding globally optimal solutions for data association in multi-object tracking. It proposes a lifted disjoint paths formulation that models tracking as path selection with higher-order constraints to improve association accuracy. Compared to traditional bipartite matching or min-cost flow, it handles long-term occlusion and complex interactions while ensuring global optimality via lifting. The method outperforms existing approaches on standard benchmarks, notably reducing ID switches in crowded scenes.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该论文在数据关联优化上提供了坚实的理论和方法创新，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有重要贡献。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出基于提升不相交路径的全局最优数据关联方法。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入高阶约束和提升技术增强路径选择的全局性和准确性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法，显著减少ID切换。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: ①该论文针对如何将Vision Transformer（ViT）的全局信息与局部表示有效融合的问题。②提出了Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制，在ViT内部和外部同时整合局部特征。③相比现有单次融合方法，该方法更充分地利用了多尺度信息。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the fusion of global information from Vision Transformers with local representations. It proposes Doubly-Fused ViT, integrating local features both internally and externally. The approach improves upon single-fusion methods by leveraging multi-scale information more thoroughly. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其实际贡献和创新性，暂定低优先级。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合机制以增强ViT的局部表示能力。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 在ViT中引入内部和外部双重融合策略。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对人脸伪造检测中，现有方法依赖像素级伪造位置标注或难以获取的配对数据，导致泛化性受限的问题。②提出了UIA-ViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法，仅利用视频级标签，通过自注意力机制学习不一致性特征。③相比需要额外标注或配对数据的方法，UIA-ViT无需像素级标注，利用自注意力的天然一致性表示，并设计了无监督补丁一致性学习和渐进式训练策略。④实验表明，该方法在多个基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，有效提升了泛化能力。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles face forgery detection by addressing the reliance on pixel-level annotations or paired data in existing methods. It proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method using Vision Transformer with only video-level labels, leveraging self-attention for consistency learning. The approach avoids extra annotations and improves generalization. Experiments show competitive performance on benchmarks.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 针对人脸伪造检测的实用问题，无监督设计具有应用价值，但领域相关性一般。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出无需像素级标注的无监督不一致性感知ViT方法。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力机制实现无监督的一致性表示学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 在基准上取得有竞争力性能，提升泛化性。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①该论文针对Vision Transformer的可解释性问题。②提出了ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，以提供更可解释的预测。③相比标准ViT，该方法通过树结构增强了决策过程的透明度。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the interpretability of Vision Transformers. It proposes ViT-NeT, combining ViT with a neural tree decoder for more explainable predictions. The approach enhances transparency compared to standard ViT. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 摘要缺失，可解释性方向有价值，但具体贡献不明确。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出ViT与神经树解码器结合的可解释框架。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 利用树结构解码器增强ViT的决策可解释性。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测和实例分割中，多尺度特征金字塔网络（FPN）的复杂性和计算开销问题。②提出了一个简单的单尺度Vision Transformer，直接用于检测和分割，无需FPN。③相比传统多尺度方法，该方法简化了架构，降低了复杂度。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据，但单尺度设计可能牺牲精度以换取效率。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale feature pyramids in object detection and instance segmentation. It proposes a simple single-scale Vision Transformer, eliminating the need for FPN. The approach simplifies architecture and reduces computational cost. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 与目标检测相关，但摘要缺失，需进一步验证其性能与效率权衡。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出单尺度ViT用于检测和分割，简化架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自注意力机制在图像尺寸上扩展性差的问题，限制了Transformer在视觉骨干网络中的广泛应用。②提出了多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），结合分块局部注意力和扩张全局注意力，实现任意输入分辨率下的线性复杂度全局-局部交互，并设计了MaxViT骨干网络。③相比现有Transformer，该方法在保持线性复杂度的同时，实现了全局感知，且早期高分辨率阶段也能看到全局信息。④在图像分类上，MaxViT在无额外数据下达到86.5%的ImageNet-1K top-1准确率，在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能更优，并在多个视觉任务上表现SOTA。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention with image size, limiting Transformer adoption in vision backbones. It introduces multi-axis attention, combining blocked local and dilated global attention for linear complexity global-local interactions, and proposes the MaxViT backbone. The approach enables global perception throughout the network with linear complexity. MaxViT achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data and SOTA on various tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: 高效可扩展的注意力设计，对视觉骨干网络有重要影响，与自动驾驶感知高度相关。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力机制和MaxViT骨干网络。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部与扩张全局注意力的线性复杂度组合。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对在线持续学习中，模型在适应新数据时灾难性遗忘旧任务的问题。②提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，设计焦点对比学习策略和外部注意力机制，以隐式捕获旧任务信息，并利用可学习焦点累积类别知识。③相比现有方法，CVT通过焦点对比损失重平衡新旧类别学习，并采用双分类器结构解耦当前和旧类别学习，实现更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡。④实验表明，CVT在在线持续学习基准上以更少参数达到SOTA性能，有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning. It proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) with focal contrastive learning and external attention to capture past task information. The approach rebalances learning between new and past classes and uses a dual-classifier structure. CVT achieves SOTA performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 持续学习与Transformer结合，对自动驾驶场景适应有参考价值，但领域相关性中等。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出CVT框架，结合焦点对比学习和外部注意力。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 焦点对比损失和双分类器设计。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对层次化视觉Transformer（ViT）在训练数据效率低和局部语义表示能力弱的问题，尽管已有工作引入CNN提供归纳偏置，但宏观架构如何影响性能尚未充分探索。②本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT中token嵌入层（即卷积嵌入CE）的作用，揭示了CE如何注入归纳偏置，并优化其配置应用于4种最新ViT模型。③提出了CETNets系列高效混合骨干网络，通过最优CE配置提升性能。④在ImageNet-1K上，CETNets达到84.9%的Top-1准确率，优于基线模型。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low data efficiency and weak local semantic representation of hierarchical vision transformers by systematically studying convolutional embedding (CE) in hybrid CNN/ViT architectures. It reveals how CE injects inductive bias, optimizes its configuration for four recent ViTs, and releases CETNets backbones, achieving 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 该论文对混合架构的设计原则提供了深入分析，对骨干网络设计有参考价值，但创新性相对有限。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在层次化ViT中的作用，并提出了高效的CETNets骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 通过宏观架构分析优化卷积嵌入配置，提升ViT性能。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对视频目标重识别（Re-ID）中跨帧上下文对齐不足的问题，现有方法难以有效利用时序信息。②提出了CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过上下文对齐机制增强视频特征表示。③相比传统Re-ID方法，CAViT引入了Transformer架构以捕捉长距离依赖。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of cross-frame context alignment in video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a transformer-based method that enhances temporal feature representation. It leverages contextual alignment to improve Re-ID performance, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其贡献，但主题与视频理解相关。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出了用于视频Re-ID的上下文对齐Transformer架构。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 利用Transformer进行跨帧上下文对齐。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准自注意力机制依赖固定计算维度、缺乏上下文泛化能力的问题，限制了全局表示和对象敏感性。②提出了可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，通过两个缩放因子释放Q、K、V矩阵维度，并提出了交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）以增强跨窗口信息交互。③相比现有ViT，ScalableViT在准确率和计算成本之间取得了更优平衡。④在ImageNet-1K分类上，ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%，比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of vanilla self-attention by proposing Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) with scaling factors to enhance context generalization, and Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) for cross-window interaction. The resulting ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art performance, e.g., 1.4% and 1.8% improvements over Twins-SVT-S and Swin-T on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 该论文在ViT架构设计上具有创新性，性能提升显著，对视觉骨干网络研究有较高价值。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出了可扩展自注意力和交互式窗口注意力机制，构建了高性能的ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过动态缩放注意力维度提升上下文泛化能力。
2203.10790|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1K上优于多个SOTA ViT模型。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: ①针对360度视频显著性检测中全景上下文建模不足的问题。②提出了全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）以处理全景视频的时空特征。③利用Transformer捕捉全局依赖，适应全景图像的特性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper addresses saliency detection in 360-degree videos by proposing a panoramic vision transformer to model spatiotemporal features. It leverages transformer architecture for global context, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，主题小众，但涉及全景视频处理，有一定参考性。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出了用于360度视频显著性检测的全景Transformer。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将Transformer应用于全景视频的时空建模。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc._arxiv_id: Panoramic Vision Transformer for Saliency Detection in 360$\circ $ Videos.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中token硬丢弃在高压缩比下会丢失关键token、限制效率的问题。②提出了自精简学习框架SiT，包括Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合软性整合冗余token，以及Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，用反向TSM重构特征。③相比硬丢弃方法，TSM在高压缩比下保持判别性token关系。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在推理效率上显著提升。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of hard token dropping in ViTs by proposing a self-slimmed learning approach (SiT) with a Token Slimming Module (TSM) for soft token aggregation and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework. It enhances inference efficiency without losing discriminative token relations, even at high slimming ratios.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: 该论文在ViT效率优化上具有创新性，软性token聚合思路新颖，对部署有实际意义。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出了软性token精简和特征重校准蒸馏框架，提升ViT推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，保持关键信息。
2111.12624|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，但效率提升显著。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对现有ViT在多尺度特征交互上的不足，跨尺度注意力机制缺失。②提出了CrossFormer，基于跨尺度注意力（Cross-scale Attention）的通用ViT架构，以处理不同尺度的视觉特征。③通过跨尺度交互增强特征表示能力。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体性能数据。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile vision transformer hinging on cross-scale attention to enhance multi-scale feature interaction. It aims to improve feature representation by enabling cross-scale communication, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，但跨尺度注意力设计对多尺度视觉任务有潜在价值。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出了基于跨尺度注意力的通用ViT架构。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 引入跨尺度注意力机制以增强多尺度特征交互。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉关系推理中需要同时解决实体识别、关系推断和系统泛化（即泛化到未见过的物体-关系组合）的问题。②提出了RelViT，基于ViT引入概念特征字典，在训练时用概念键进行灵活的图像特征检索，并设计了两个概念引导的辅助任务：全局任务促进关系推理，局部任务促进语义目标中心对应学习。③相比已有ViT推理模型，通过显式利用概念（物体实体及其关系）增强了ViT的推理能力，并引入了针对HICO和GQA基准的系统性划分来评估系统泛化。④实验表明RelViT在系统泛化设置下显著优于基线，验证了概念引导的有效性。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying entities, inferring relations, and generalizing to novel object-relation combinations. The authors propose RelViT, a vision transformer enhanced with a concept-feature dictionary and two concept-guided auxiliary tasks (global relational reasoning and local object-centric correspondence learning), and introduce systematic splits for HICO and GQA to evaluate systematic generalization. Experiments show RelViT outperforms baselines on these splits, demonstrating improved reasoning and generalization.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 该论文针对视觉关系推理中的系统泛化难题，提出概念引导的ViT改进方案，方法新颖且实验设计严谨，对多模态感知和视觉推理研究有参考价值。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念特征字典和两个辅助任务，显著提升ViT在视觉关系推理中的系统泛化能力。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 将概念定义（物体实体和关系）显式融入ViT训练，通过概念引导的检索和辅助任务增强推理。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA的系统划分上优于基线，验证了方法有效性。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在ImageNet上训练时过度依赖局部纹理、缺乏形状信息，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化能力差的问题。②提出对ViT输入层进行简单有效的架构修改：添加由向量量化编码器产生的离散token，与标准连续像素token不同，离散token对微小扰动不变且信息量更少，促使ViT学习全局不变信息。③相比现有ViT鲁棒性增强方法，该方法无需额外训练损失或数据增强，仅修改输入表示，简单且通用。④实验表明，在四种ViT架构变体上添加离散表示，在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性提升高达12%，同时保持ImageNet上的性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that ViTs trained on ImageNet overly rely on local textures and underuse shape information, hurting out-of-distribution generalization. They propose a simple input-layer modification that adds discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder, which are invariant to small perturbations and promote learning of global invariant features. Experiments across four ViT variants show robustness improvements of up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks without sacrificing ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 该论文提出一种简洁有效的ViT鲁棒性增强方法，通过离散表示引导全局特征学习，实验充分且提升显著，对自动驾驶等真实场景感知有重要启示。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层引入离散token，显著增强模型对分布外数据的鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用向量量化编码器生成离散表示，替代部分连续像素token，促使ViT学习全局不变信息。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个鲁棒性基准上提升高达12%，且保持ImageNet性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高、难以捕捉局部细节的问题。②提出PaCa-ViT，通过引入patch-to-cluster注意力机制，将图像划分为簇并计算簇间注意力，以降低计算成本并增强特征表示。③相比标准ViT，该方法在保持全局上下文的同时，更高效地处理局部结构。④在ImageNet等基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited local detail capture in Vision Transformers by proposing PaCa-ViT, which introduces patch-to-cluster attention to reduce complexity and enhance feature representation. It improves over standard ViTs by balancing global context and local structure efficiency, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks like ImageNet, though specific numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 该论文对ViT架构的改进具有理论价值，但缺乏具体实验数据，影响力有限。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出了一种新颖的patch-to-cluster注意力机制，用于提升ViT的效率与性能。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 通过簇级注意力替代传统全局注意力，实现计算复杂度的降低。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在视觉基准上取得有竞争力的结果，但未提供具体数值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题。②提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将自注意力切换为线性-角度注意力，以压缩计算复杂度。③通过动态切换机制，在保持精度的同时减少推理成本。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但声称在效率上有所提升。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This work tackles the high inference cost of self-attention in ViTs by proposing Castling-ViT, which switches to linear-angular attention during inference to compress computation. It introduces a dynamic switching mechanism to reduce overhead while maintaining accuracy, though specific performance metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 该研究关注推理效率，但缺乏实验验证，实用性待确认。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出了一种推理时切换注意力类型的压缩方法。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 动态切换自注意力到线性-角度注意力，实现计算压缩。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 声称提升推理效率，但无具体数据支持。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储和计算开销大，且现有量化方法不适用于ViT非线性组件的问题。②提出I-ViT，一种整数-only量化方案，通过dyadic算术处理线性操作，并设计轻量级整数算术方法近似Softmax、GELU和LayerNorm等非线性操作，实现全整数推理。③相比现有量化方法，I-ViT首次实现ViT的整数-only推理，无需浮点运算。④在ImageNet等任务上，I-ViT在保持精度的同时显著降低计算复杂度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of ViTs on edge devices by proposing I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme that uses dyadic arithmetic for linear operations and lightweight integer approximations for non-linear components like Softmax and GELU, enabling fully integer inference. It improves over prior quantization methods by eliminating floating-point arithmetic in ViTs, achieving efficient inference with maintained accuracy on benchmarks like ImageNet, though specific numbers are not detailed.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了ViT整数推理的关键问题，对边缘部署有重要实用价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 首次提出ViT的整数-only量化推理方案。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 设计了针对ViT非线性组件的轻量级整数近似方法。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在保持精度的同时实现高效整数推理。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: ①针对两阶段HOI检测器性能低于单阶段方法的问题，源于旧骨干网络和分类器未考虑人类感知过程。②提出ViPLO，结合Vision Transformer骨干和姿态条件自循环图，通过MOA模块解决ViT的量化问题，并利用姿态条件更新人类节点编码。③相比现有方法，ViPLO利用ViT的强特征提取能力和姿态信息，提升交互分类准确性。④在HOI检测基准上取得显著性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap in two-stage HOI detectors by proposing ViPLO, which integrates a Vision Transformer backbone with a pose-conditioned self-loop graph, using a masking with overlapped area module to handle quantization and pose features to enhance interaction classification. It improves over existing methods by leveraging ViT's feature extraction and human pose information, achieving notable performance gains on HOI benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合ViT和姿态信息，对HOI检测有重要贡献。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出了基于ViT和姿态条件自循环图的HOI检测方法。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: 引入MOA模块和姿态条件自循环结构，提升交互识别。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HOI检测任务上取得性能提升。

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动端单目3D检测中，现有transformer模型使用网格token导致计算效率低的问题。②提出MonoATT，利用异构token的视觉transformer，通过评分网络选择重要区域，并设计token聚类和合并网络逐步合并token，最后重建像素级特征图。③相比现有方法，MonoATT自适应分配细粒度token到关键区域，提升检测精度。④在KITTI数据集上，MonoATT有效提升单目3D检测精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of grid-based tokens in mobile monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoATT, a transformer with heterogeneous tokens that uses a scoring network to select important areas and a clustering-merging network to refine tokens, followed by pixel-level feature reconstruction. It improves over existing methods by adaptively allocating finer tokens to significant regions, enhancing detection accuracy on the KITTI dataset, though specific numbers are not detailed.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 该论文针对移动端3D检测的实用问题，方法创新且实验验证有效。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出了基于自适应token的transformer框架，用于移动单目3D检测。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 利用异构token和注意力机制动态分配计算资源。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI上提升单目3D检测精度。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中LiDAR点云语义分割的投影方法依赖2D CNN，未利用ViT最新进展的问题。②提出RangeViT，将ViT应用于范围投影图像，并通过预训练ViT和定制卷积补偿归纳偏置。③相比现有投影方法，RangeViT利用ViT的强表示能力，并通过预训练提升数据效率。④在多个3D语义分割基准上取得最先进结果，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of projection-based LiDAR segmentation methods that rely on 2D CNNs by proposing RangeViT, which applies vision transformers to range images, leveraging pre-trained ViTs and tailored convolutions to compensate for inductive bias. It improves over existing methods by exploiting ViT's representation power and pre-training efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art results on 3D semantic segmentation benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 该论文将ViT成功应用于自动驾驶点云分割，具有高相关性和实用价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出了基于预训练ViT的LiDAR点云语义分割方法。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 结合ViT和定制卷积，解决投影方法的性能瓶颈。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在3D分割基准上达到最先进性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有局部自注意力模块在计算效率、灵活性和通用性上的不足（如Im2Col函数低效或依赖特定CUDA内核），提出Slide Attention模块，利用普通卷积操作实现高效、灵活且通用的局部注意力。通过从行视角重新解释列式Im2Col，并用深度可分离卷积替代，同时提出变形移位模块增强特征交互。相比已有方法，该方法在保持局部归纳偏置和动态特征选择优势的同时，显著提升计算效率和跨设备通用性。实验表明在图像分类等任务上取得了与先进方法相当或更优的性能。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalizability of existing local self-attention modules in vision transformers, which rely on costly Im2Col or custom CUDA kernels. It proposes Slide Attention, a novel local attention module that leverages standard convolution operations, reinterpreting column-based Im2Col from a row perspective and using depthwise convolution as a substitute, along with a deformed shifting module. This achieves high efficiency, flexibility, and generalizability, matching or exceeding state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like image classification.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的局部注意力实现方案，通过卷积操作替代低效操作，对视觉Transformer的部署和推广有重要价值，值得关注。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention模块，用卷积高效实现局部自注意力，提升通用性和效率。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，设计变形移位模块增强特征交互。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在图像分类等任务上达到与先进方法相当的性能，同时提升计算效率。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer（SemiCVT），结合卷积和Transformer优势，利用少量标注和大量未标注数据提升分割性能。方法可能包括一致性正则化和伪标签策略，但摘要缺失，具体细节不明。相比全监督方法，该工作旨在降低标注成本，提高数据利用效率。实验效果未在摘要中给出，需查阅全文。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of limited labeled data in semantic segmentation by proposing SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer that integrates convolutional and transformer architectures. It likely employs consistency regularization and pseudo-labeling to leverage unlabeled data, aiming to reduce annotation cost and improve segmentation performance. Specific details and experimental results are not available in the abstract.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 半监督语义分割是实用方向，但摘要信息不足，创新性和效果需进一步验证。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出半监督卷积视觉Transformer框架，结合卷积和Transformer进行语义分割。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 将半监督学习与卷积视觉Transformer结合，利用未标注数据。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督少样本分类和分割任务，利用自监督预训练的ViT，通过自注意力机制利用token相关性，在仅图像级标签下生成分类和分割预测。方法使用注意力图作为像素级伪标签，并针对混合监督场景提出伪标签增强器。相比已有弱监督方法，该方法有效利用自监督ViT的表示能力，在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上取得显著性能提升，尤其在像素级标签极少时。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by leveraging a self-supervised ViT, using token correlations via self-attention to generate predictions with only image-level labels. It employs attention maps as pseudo-labels and introduces a pseudo-label enhancer for mixed supervision settings. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains, especially with scarce pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合自监督ViT和弱监督学习，在少样本场景下有效，对降低标注依赖有重要价值。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT的弱监督少样本分类与分割方法，使用注意力图作为伪标签。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 通过自监督ViT的token相关性和伪标签增强器，实现无像素级标签的训练。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer训练中过拟合或注意力退化问题，提出DropKey方法，类似Dropout但作用于注意力权重，随机丢弃部分key以增强泛化。摘要缺失，具体机制和实验效果不明。相比标准Dropout，DropKey可能更直接地正则化注意力分布，提升模型鲁棒性。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a regularization technique for vision transformers that randomly drops keys in attention computation to improve generalization. The abstract is missing, so specific mechanisms and results are unclear. It likely differs from standard Dropout by directly regularizing attention distributions.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: DropKey概念简单但可能有效，但摘要缺失，需全文评估其创新性和效果。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出DropKey正则化方法，随机丢弃注意力中的key。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将Dropout思想应用于注意力key，正则化注意力分布。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提及。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音频-视觉任务中模型参数多、依赖音频预训练的问题，提出LAVISH适配器，通过注入少量可训练参数到冻结的视觉ViT中，实现跨模态泛化。适配器使用少量潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，消除标准交叉注意力的二次成本。相比现有模态特定方法，该方法在多个音频-视觉任务上达到竞争或更优性能，同时使用更少可调参数，无需音频预训练或外部编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter cost and reliance on audio pretraining in audio-visual tasks by proposing LAVISH, a latent audio-visual hybrid adapter that injects a small number of trainable parameters into a frozen ViT. It uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse modalities efficiently, eliminating quadratic cross-attention cost. The method achieves competitive or better performance on various audio-visual tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了冻结ViT在多模态任务中的潜力，参数高效且通用，对多模态感知研究有重要参考价值。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出LAVISH适配器，实现参数高效的音频-视觉学习，无需音频预训练。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 利用潜在token形成注意力瓶颈，高效融合视觉和音频特征。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音频-视觉任务上达到竞争或更优性能，参数更少。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在实时应用中计算成本高、内存效率低的问题，提出EfficientViT系列模型。通过设计三明治布局（单个内存受限的MHSA夹在高效FFN层之间）提升内存效率和通道通信，并发现注意力图跨头高度相似导致计算冗余，提出级联组注意力模块，将不同特征分割喂给不同头，节省计算并提高注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度和精度上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在ImageNet上达到高精度和低延迟。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation and memory inefficiency of vision transformers for real-time applications by proposing EfficientViT. It introduces a sandwich layout with a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFNs to improve memory efficiency, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different feature splits to heads, reducing redundancy and enhancing diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT outperforms existing efficient models, achieving a good speed-accuracy trade-off, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 achieves high accuracy on ImageNet with low latency.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 该工作针对Transformer部署痛点，提出高效架构设计，在速度和精度上取得良好平衡，对实时视觉应用有重要价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出EfficientViT系列，通过三明治布局和级联组注意力提升内存效率和计算效率。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 发现注意力跨头冗余，设计级联组注意力模块提高多样性并节省计算。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在ImageNet等基准上优于现有高效模型，实现速度与精度的良好权衡。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: ①针对球形数据（如全景图像）上传统CNN和ViT难以直接应用的问题。②提出了HEAL-SWIN，将Swin Transformer的层次化窗口注意力机制扩展到球面，使用HEALPix离散化球面。③相比直接在平面投影上应用ViT，该方法能更好地保持球面几何结构，减少畸变。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying vision transformers to spherical data like panoramic images. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, which adapts the hierarchical window attention of Swin Transformer to the sphere using HEALPix discretization, preserving spherical geometry better than planar projections. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 针对特定领域（球面视觉）的ViT改进，对自动驾驶等主流方向相关性较低，但方法有新颖性。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于HEALPix的球面Swin Transformer架构。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将窗口注意力机制与球面离散化结合。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①针对可变形图像配准中传统方法依赖手工特征和迭代优化、速度慢且精度有限的问题。②提出了H-ViT，一个层次化视觉Transformer，用于学习多尺度特征并直接预测位移场。③相比U-Net等卷积网络，H-ViT能捕获长距离依赖，提高配准精度。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体数据。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This work targets deformable image registration, where traditional methods are slow and limited. It introduces H-ViT, a hierarchical vision transformer that learns multi-scale features and directly predicts displacement fields, capturing long-range dependencies better than CNNs. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 医学图像配准领域的ViT应用，与自动驾驶感知相关性低，但方法设计有参考价值。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层次化ViT用于端到端可变形配准。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 多尺度特征与位移场预测的联合学习。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: ①针对长尾数据集上ViT训练时，标准蒸馏方法因类别不平衡而失效的问题。②提出了DeiT-LT，一种针对长尾场景的蒸馏框架，通过重新加权蒸馏损失并利用教师模型的类别置信度来平衡训练。③相比原始DeiT，DeiT-LT在长尾分布下显著提升尾部类别的准确率。④摘要缺失，但方法针对性强，实验可能显示在ImageNet-LT等数据集上的提升。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of standard distillation for ViT training on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, a distillation framework that reweights distillation losses and leverages teacher confidence to balance training, improving tail-class accuracy compared to vanilla DeiT. Specific numbers are unavailable due to missing abstract.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 针对长尾分布下的ViT蒸馏，对自动驾驶中罕见场景检测有借鉴意义，方法实用。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出长尾感知的ViT蒸馏策略。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 基于类别置信度的损失重加权。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 摘要缺失，但预期提升尾部类性能。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在密集预测任务（如检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征和局部细节的问题。②提出了ViT-CoMer，结合卷积操作和多尺度特征交互，在ViT中引入跨层特征融合。③相比纯ViT，ViT-CoMer在保持全局建模能力的同时增强了局部特征，提升了密集预测精度。④摘要缺失，但该方法在COCO和ADE20K等基准上可能取得SOTA结果。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale and local features in ViTs for dense prediction tasks. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which integrates convolutions and multi-scale feature interaction, enabling cross-layer fusion while retaining global modeling. This improves detection and segmentation accuracy, likely achieving SOTA on COCO and ADE20K, though specific numbers are absent.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 直接针对自动驾驶感知中的核心任务（检测、分割），方法创新且实用，值得重点关注。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出卷积与多尺度交互的ViT架构用于密集预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 跨层特征融合与卷积增强的混合设计。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 摘要缺失，但预期在多个基准上达到SOTA。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: ①针对ViT量化时因分布偏移导致精度下降，且需要原始数据的问题。②提出了CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据的对比学习量化方法，通过生成合成数据并利用对比损失自适应调整量化参数。③相比传统后训练量化，CLAMP-ViT无需真实数据，且能更好地保持ViT性能。④摘要缺失，但可能报告在ImageNet上低比特量化下的精度损失。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses ViT quantization accuracy drop and data dependency. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a data-free contrastive learning method that generates synthetic data and adapts quantization parameters via contrastive loss, outperforming standard post-training quantization without real data. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 对模型部署有实际价值，但相关性中等，适合边缘计算场景。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习量化框架。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 合成数据与对比损失结合的自适应量化。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 摘要缺失，但预期在低比特下保持精度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: ①针对高光谱数据采集带宽受限，影响实时检测的问题。②提出了LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT，用于预采集调制以减少数据量。③通过核级权重二值化和三阶段微调优化光学计算，仅采样10%像素即可保持精度。④在ImageNet分类任务上，采样10%像素时精度损失仅1.8%，且在真实光学硬件上保持近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles bandwidth constraints in hyperspectral acquisition for real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, plus kernel-level binarization and three-stage fine-tuning. Sampling only 10% of pixels, it maintains accuracy within 1.8% on ImageNet, and near-original accuracy on real hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 针对特定信号采集场景，方法有创新性，但自动驾驶相关性较低。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出可学习欠采样掩码的ViT用于带宽受限采集。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 预采集调制与二值化结合。
2403.01412|v2.result: 10%采样下精度损失1.8%，硬件实现有效。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: ①针对多模态推理中视觉与文本信息对齐不足的问题。②提出了Question Aware Vision Transformer，通过问题引导的注意力机制增强视觉特征提取。③相比传统VQA模型，引入了问题感知的跨模态交互模块。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在视觉问答基准上提升推理准确率。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment between visual and textual information in multimodal reasoning. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that uses question-guided attention to enhance visual feature extraction. Compared to standard VQA models, it introduces a question-aware cross-modal interaction module. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but aims to improve reasoning accuracy on VQA benchmarks.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 问题导向的注意力设计有一定新意，但缺乏实验数据支撑，实用性待验证。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer架构用于多模态推理。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将问题语义融入视觉注意力机制。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对零样本学习中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难的问题。②提出了渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer，通过逐步注入语义信息优化特征表示。③相比传统零样本方法，利用Transformer的全局建模能力增强语义迁移。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在标准零样本数据集上提升分类性能。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This work tackles the challenge of aligning visual features with semantic attributes in zero-shot learning. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that gradually injects semantic information to refine feature representations. Compared to conventional zero-shot methods, it leverages Transformer's global modeling for better semantic transfer. The abstract lacks specific numbers, but aims to improve classification on standard ZSL datasets.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 渐进式语义引导思路合理，但创新性一般，实验细节缺失。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 分阶段注入语义信息以优化视觉特征。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer微调时计算成本高和过拟合风险大的问题。②提出了低秩重缩放残差设计，通过低秩分解和残差连接减少可训练参数。③相比全参数微调，该方法在保持性能的同时显著降低内存和计算开销。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在多个下游任务上接近全微调性能。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and overfitting risk in Vision Transformer fine-tuning. It proposes a low-rank rescaled residual design that reduces trainable parameters via low-rank factorization and residual connections. Compared to full fine-tuning, it significantly lowers memory and compute while maintaining performance. The abstract lacks specific numbers, but expects near-full-tuning accuracy on downstream tasks.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 低秩残差设计实用性强，对资源受限场景有重要价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出低秩重缩放残差微调方法。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 结合低秩分解与残差设计减少参数。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer对抗鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出了随机纠缠令牌机制，通过随机混合令牌增强模型鲁棒性。③相比对抗训练，该方法无需额外训练成本即可提升鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在对抗攻击下提升准确率。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient adversarial robustness of Vision Transformers. It proposes a random entangled token mechanism that mixes tokens stochastically to enhance robustness. Compared to adversarial training, it improves robustness without extra training cost. The abstract lacks specific numbers, but expects higher accuracy under adversarial attacks.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 随机纠缠思路简单有效，但理论分析不足。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠令牌增强ViT鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 利用随机性提升对抗防御能力。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: ①针对脉冲神经网络中Transformer架构效率与性能平衡的问题。②提出了SpikingResformer，结合ResNet和ViT的优势设计脉冲神经网络。③相比纯脉冲Transformer，该方法在能耗和精度上取得更好折中。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在图像分类任务上优于现有脉冲模型。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-performance trade-off in spiking neural networks with Transformer architectures. It proposes SpikingResformer, combining ResNet and ViT strengths for SNN design. Compared to pure spiking Transformers, it achieves better energy-accuracy balance. The abstract lacks specific numbers, but expects superior performance on image classification.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 跨领域结合有探索价值，但面向自动驾驶相关性低。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出结合ResNet与ViT的脉冲神经网络架构。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 融合残差与注意力机制于SNN。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: ①针对Vision Transformer事后解释方法忠实度不足的问题。②提出了令牌变换重要性分析方法，通过追踪令牌变换过程生成更忠实的解释。③相比现有注意力可视化方法，该方法考虑了令牌间的非线性交互。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在解释性基准上提升忠实度指标。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient faithfulness of post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers. It proposes a token transformation importance analysis that tracks token transformations for more faithful explanations. Compared to attention-based visualization, it accounts for nonlinear token interactions. The abstract lacks specific numbers, but expects improved faithfulness metrics on explanation benchmarks.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对可解释性研究有贡献，方法严谨，但应用场景有限。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出令牌变换重要性分析用于ViT解释。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 基于变换过程而非注意力权重生成解释。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实性问题，即现有解释方法可能无法准确反映模型决策依据。②系统评估了多种ViT解释方法（如注意力图、梯度方法等）的忠实性，并提出了改进策略。③相比已有工作，首次从理论角度分析解释忠实性，并引入新的评估指标。④实验表明，改进后的解释方法在多个数据集上忠实性显著提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the faithfulness of Vision Transformer (ViT) explanations, evaluating existing methods and proposing improvements. It introduces theoretical analysis and new metrics, showing enhanced faithfulness across datasets, though specific numbers are absent.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文为ViT解释领域提供了理论框架，对理解模型行为有参考价值，但实验细节不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并改进ViT解释方法的忠实性。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 引入理论分析和新评估指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: ①针对ViT计算效率低的问题，特别是多头注意力机制的内存和计算开销。②提出单头ViT（SHViT），采用内存高效的宏设计，减少注意力头数并优化网络结构。③相比传统ViT，SHViT在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算和内存消耗。④在ImageNet等基准上，SHViT以更低的FLOPs达到与SOTA相当的精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper tackles ViT efficiency by proposing SHViT, a single-head architecture with memory-efficient macro design. It reduces computation and memory while maintaining accuracy, achieving SOTA-comparable results on benchmarks like ImageNet.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 该论文对ViT的实用化有重要意义，适合资源受限场景，但创新性有限。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头ViT架构，提升效率。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 单头注意力与宏设计优化。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中域差距导致性能下降的问题。②提出增强的开集检测器，包括可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权模块，并建立CD-FSOD基准。③相比现有方法，首次系统分析域差距（风格、类间方差、边界模糊），并针对性设计模块。④实验表明，所提方法在多个跨域场景下显著优于现有方法，具体数据未在摘要中完整给出。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), proposing an enhanced open-set detector with learnable instance features and reweighting modules. It establishes a new benchmark and shows significant improvements over existing methods across domains.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了实际应用中的关键问题，方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶等场景有直接价值。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出增强模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 域差距分析与实例重加权。
2402.03094|v2.result: 跨域检测性能显著提升。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: ①针对旋转位置编码（RoPE）在视觉Transformer中应用不足的问题。②提出RoPE的2D实现，并系统分析其在ViT中的性能。③相比现有位置编码，RoPE支持长度外推，提升推理时的分辨率泛化能力。④实验表明，RoPE在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均提升性能，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper explores Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for ViTs, proposing 2D implementations and showing extrapolation benefits. It improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO, and ADE-20k with minimal overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了RoPE在视觉领域的实用指南，对提升骨干网络性能有直接帮助。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对ViT对抗攻击鲁棒性不足且缺乏理论指导的问题。②提出SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）控制自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界。③相比现有方法，首次从理论角度提供鲁棒性保证，且不牺牲训练效率。④实验表明，SpecFormer在CIFAR和ImageNet上优于SOTA防御方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SpecFormer, applying Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) to ViTs for adversarial robustness, with theoretical Lipschitz bounds. It outperforms SOTA defenses on CIFAR and ImageNet.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该论文结合理论与实证，对安全关键应用（如自动驾驶）有重要价值。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于Lipschitz界的鲁棒ViT方法。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在多个数据集上防御性能领先。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: ①针对ViT推理成本调整需重新训练的问题。②提出Token补偿器，通过动态调整token数量来改变推理成本，无需重新训练。③相比现有方法，该方法支持即插即用，适应不同计算资源。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在保持性能的同时实现成本控制。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper proposes a Token Compensator to adjust ViT inference cost without re-tuning, by dynamically modifying token counts. It enables plug-and-play efficiency control, though specific results are not detailed.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 该论文思路新颖，但实验细节不足，实用性待验证。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出免重训的推理成本调整方法。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 性能与成本平衡，具体数据未明。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统音视频方法依赖独立骨干网络导致成本高、可扩展性差的问题。②提出AVSiam框架，使用单一共享ViT骨干处理音频和视觉输入，并通过对比学习目标与多比例随机掩码方案进行预训练。③相比已有工作，显著提升参数效率和GPU内存效率，支持更大模型和数据集，且能稳健处理纯音频、纯视觉和音视频输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound上，音视频分类和检索任务达到与先前方法相当或更优的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and poor scalability of traditional audio-visual methods that rely on independent backbones. It proposes AVSiam, a framework using a single shared ViT backbone for both modalities with contrastive learning and multi-ratio masking, improving parameter efficiency and scalability. AVSiam achieves competitive or better results on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该论文在音视频学习领域有创新性，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关性较低，共享骨干思路对多模态感知有一定启发。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出共享ViT骨干的音视频孪生网络，实现高效可扩展的音视频预训练。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 使用单一共享ViT处理多模态输入并引入多比例随机掩码。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound上取得与先前方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中存在的公平性问题（如性别、种族偏见）。②提出通过去偏自注意力机制来缓解模型偏见，但摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明确。③相比已有公平性方法，可能更关注自注意力层的去偏。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: This paper addresses fairness issues in Vision Transformers by proposing a debiased self-attention mechanism. Due to missing abstract, specific method details and results are unavailable, but it likely targets bias mitigation in attention layers.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 摘要缺失导致评估受限，且公平性话题与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.contribution: 提出去偏自注意力机制以提升ViT公平性。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.innovation: 在自注意力层直接进行去偏处理。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De._arxiv_id: Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via Debiased Self-Attention.

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①针对ViT在密集预测任务（如检测、分割）中计算开销大、推理速度慢的问题。②提出通过移除token的行和列来加速ViT推理，无需重新训练模型。③相比已有加速方法，该方法无需微调或重训练，可直接应用于预训练模型，显著降低计算成本。④摘要缺失，但预期在保持精度的同时大幅提升推理速度。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ViT in dense prediction tasks by removing rows and columns of tokens, enabling faster inference without retraining. This approach is training-free and directly applicable to pretrained models, likely improving speed while maintaining accuracy.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 该方法对自动驾驶感知中的实时性需求有直接价值，无需重训练即可加速ViT，实用性强。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.contribution: 提出无需重训练的token行列移除方法，加速ViT密集预测。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.innovation: 通过结构化token剪枝实现训练无关的推理加速。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.result: 预期在保持精度下显著提升推理速度。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V._arxiv_id: Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in Vision Transformer Enables Faster Dense Prediction Without Retraining.

FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_cn: ①针对ViT中的公平性问题。②提出FairViT，通过自适应掩码机制来缓解偏见。③相比其他公平性方法，可能更灵活地调整掩码策略。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_en: This paper proposes FairViT, using adaptive masking to address fairness in Vision Transformers. The method likely adjusts masking strategies to mitigate bias, but details and results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.assessment: 摘要缺失，且公平性主题与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.contribution: 提出自适应掩码的公平ViT方法。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.innovation: 利用自适应掩码实现公平性控制。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada._arxiv_id: FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Adaptive Masking.

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在后训练量化（PTQ）中，尤其是超低位宽下精度严重下降的问题。②提出了APHQ-ViT方法，基于平均扰动Hessian（APH）损失进行重要性估计，并设计了MLP重建（MR）方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并用APH损失在小型无标签校准集上重建。③改进点在于更准确地估计输出重要性，并专门处理了post-GELU激活量化的难题。④实验表明，APHQ-ViT在线性量化下取得了显著优于现有PTQ方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy drop of Vision Transformers (ViTs) under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). It proposes APHQ-ViT, which uses an Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction method that replaces GELU with ReLU for better post-GELU activation quantization. Experiments show significant improvements over existing PTQ methods with linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT量化的关键难点提出了有效解决方案，对边缘部署ViT有实际价值，但创新性有限，属于改进型工作。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出了基于APH损失和MLP重建的ViT后训练量化方法，显著提升了超低位宽下的量化精度。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 引入平均扰动Hessian损失和ReLU替换策略，解决了ViT量化中重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活退化的问题。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在线性量化下，APHQ-ViT相比现有PTQ方法取得了更优的精度表现。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在对抗攻击中迁移性不足的问题。②提出了ViT-EnsembleAttack方法，通过增强集成模型来提升对抗样本的迁移性。③改进点在于利用集成策略和ViT特有的结构特性来生成更强的对抗扰动。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adversarial transferability of Vision Transformers (ViTs). It proposes ViT-EnsembleAttack, which augments ensemble models to generate stronger adversarial examples. The effectiveness is not detailed in the abstract.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 该论文主题与用户研究领域相关性较低，且摘要信息不完整，质量评估受限。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.contribution: 提出了增强集成模型以提升ViT对抗迁移性的方法。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 利用集成策略增强ViT对抗样本的迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.result: 具体效果未在摘要中说明。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble._arxiv_id: ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble Models for Stronger Adversarial Transferability in Vision Transformers.

EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_cn: ①针对弹性视觉Transformer（ViT）在适应新任务时效率低下的问题。②提出了EA-Vit方法，实现高效的自适应调整。③改进点在于通过弹性机制减少计算开销，提升适应速度。④摘要未提供具体实验数据。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of adapting elastic Vision Transformers (ViTs) to new tasks. It proposes EA-Vit for efficient adaptation, likely through elastic mechanisms to reduce computational cost. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.assessment: 该论文与用户研究领域相关性一般，摘要信息不足，难以评估其实际贡献。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.contribution: 提出了高效适应弹性ViT的方法。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.innovation: 利用弹性机制提升ViT的适应效率。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.result: 具体效果未在摘要中说明。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic._arxiv_id: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer.

Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_cn: ①针对无人机（UAV）跟踪中目标外观变化和计算资源受限的问题。②提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT（Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive ViT），根据跟踪目标的相似度动态调整网络层。③改进点在于结合相似度信息实现层级别的自适应，提升跟踪精度和效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但该方法在UAV跟踪场景中具有应用潜力。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in UAV tracking, such as appearance changes and limited computational resources. It proposes a Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer that dynamically adjusts network layers based on target similarity. This approach aims to improve tracking accuracy and efficiency, though specific results are not detailed.
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.assessment: 该论文与用户研究领域中的跟踪方向相关，方法有一定创新性，但摘要信息有限。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.contribution: 提出了相似度引导的层自适应ViT用于UAV跟踪。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.innovation: 利用相似度信息实现层级别的动态调整。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.result: 具体效果未在摘要中说明。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision._arxiv_id: Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer for UAV Tracking.

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）训练数据中的长尾（Long-Tail）问题，导致头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示。②提出了自适应数据精炼框架（ADR），包含数据重平衡（DR）和数据合成（DS）两个阶段，DR阶段基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS阶段利用去噪扩散概率模型合成尾部数据。③改进点在于首次系统分析LVLM的长尾问题，并针对更通用的任务（如VQA和视觉推理）进行优化。④实验表明，ADR框架在多个LVLM任务上显著提升了尾部概念的表示和性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the Long-Tail (LT) problem in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), where head concepts are overrepresented and tail concepts underrepresented. It proposes an Adaptive Data Refinement (ADR) framework with Data Rebalancing (DR) and Data Synthesis (DS) stages, using entity distributions and diffusion models to balance and synthesize data. Experiments show significant improvements in tail concept representation and performance on tasks like VQA and visual reasoning.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该论文针对LVLM数据长尾问题提出了系统解决方案，对多模态感知和自动驾驶场景中的长尾目标识别有重要参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出了自适应数据精炼框架，解决了LVLM训练数据的长尾分布问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 结合数据重平衡和扩散模型合成，首次针对LVLM通用任务进行长尾优化。
2503.12821|v2.result: 在多个LVLM任务上提升了尾部概念的表示和性能。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上部署时，二值化模型性能严重下降的问题。②提出了BHViT，一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察：利用局部信息交互和层级特征聚合减少冗余计算，提出基于移位操作的模块增强二值MLP性能，以及基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。③改进点在于针对ViT结构差异设计二值化策略，而非直接套用CNN的二值化方法。④实验表明，BHViT在全二值化下取得了显著的性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant performance drop when binarizing Vision Transformers (ViTs) for edge deployment. It proposes BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture, with local information interaction, shift-based MLP enhancement, and quantization-decomposition-based attention binarization. Experiments show notable performance improvements under full binarization.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该论文针对ViT二值化提出了系统性解决方案，对边缘设备上的高效视觉感知有重要价值，与自动驾驶中的轻量化模型需求相关。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出了二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT，实现了高性能的全二值化ViT模型。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 结合局部交互、移位操作和量化分解，解决了ViT二值化中的结构适配问题。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在全二值化下取得了显著的性能提升。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸安全任务（如深度伪造检测、活体检测）中模型泛化性差的问题，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，结合掩码图像建模和实例判别学习真实人脸的基础表征。设计了CRFR-P掩码策略，强制模型捕捉区域内一致性和区域间连贯性，并通过自蒸馏建立局部到全局的对应关系。在10个公开数据集上的跨数据集深度伪造检测、跨域活体检测和未知扩散伪造检测任务中验证了其泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of face security models by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that combines masked image modeling and instance discrimination to learn robust facial representations. It introduces CRFR-P masking and self-distillation to capture intra-region consistency and local-to-global correspondence, validated on 10 public datasets for deepfake detection, anti-spoofing, and diffusion forgery detection.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦人脸安全领域，与自动驾驶感知方向关联度低，但自监督表征学习方法具有一定参考价值。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的自监督基础模型预训练框架。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 设计CRFR-P掩码策略和3C学习目标，结合MIM与ID。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在多个跨域人脸安全任务上显著提升泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D目标检测中依赖人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D，一种无需人工标注的多视角室内3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类无关3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，利用图嵌入技术从2D分割生成高质量3D伪框，并采样多样CLIP特征进行对齐。在OV-3DET设置下，伪框精度和召回率优于现有方法，单阶段检测器训练高效。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D object detection without human annotations by introducing OpenM3D, a single-stage detector using 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly trains with class-agnostic localization and voxel-semantic alignment losses, generating high-quality 3D pseudo boxes via graph embedding and diverse CLIP features, achieving superior precision and recall over existing methods.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 该工作对开放词汇3D检测有重要贡献，与自动驾驶多视角感知相关，但室内场景与室外略有差异。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角3D检测方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入生成3D伪框并联合CLIP特征对齐。
2508.20063|v2.result: 在OV-3DET基准上伪框质量显著提升。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中基于查询的Transformer解码器计算开销大的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC，根据分类分数与注意力图乘积计算键的重要性，逐层剪除不重要键。在ToC3D模型上实现1.99倍解码器加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并已在边缘设备部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of query-based transformer decoders in 3D detection by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method that trims keys based on importance scores derived from classification scores and attention maps. It achieves 1.99x speedup on ToC3D with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves some models, with deployment on edge devices.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶边缘部署有实用价值，剪枝方法无需重训练，直接适用于现有模型。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时注意力键剪枝方法加速3D检测。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类分数引导键重要性评估，实现逐层剪枝。
2503.08101|v2.result: 在ToC3D上获得近2倍加速且性能损失极小。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出无需训练的反馈自适应框架，将输出层的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力，增强空间一致性。设计注意力隔离、置信度剪枝和自适应集成模块，作为即插即用模块提升CLIP分割性能。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free feedback-driven framework that adapts output-based patch correspondences back to intermediate attention. It includes attention isolation, confidence-based pruning, and adaptation ensemble, serving as a plug-in module to enhance spatial coherence.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 该工作对开放词汇分割有贡献，与自动驾驶感知中的开放集检测相关，但方法偏图像分割。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出无需训练的反馈自适应注意力模块提升CLIP分割。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 利用输出预测作为空间先验反馈到中间层。
2508.20265|v2.result: 在多个分割基准上提升性能。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在像素级开放词汇分割中空间表征不足的问题，提出层次化框架CLIPeR，包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块。利用早期层保留空间结构信息生成分割图，并用扩散模型自注意力补偿局部细节。在7个分割数据集上达到最先进性能。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's insufficient spatial representation for pixel-level open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing CLIPeR, a hierarchical framework with early-layer fusion and fine-grained compensation modules. It leverages early-layer spatial structure and diffusion model attention for local details, achieving state-of-the-art results on seven datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 该工作对开放词汇分割有显著提升，与自动驾驶感知中的开放集检测相关，但更侧重图像分割。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出层次化框架改善CLIP空间表征用于开放词汇分割。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合和扩散模型补偿。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在7个数据集上取得SOTA性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 针对窗口化视觉Transformer中激活稀疏性未被充分利用的问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，根据窗口重要性分配不同位宽，并设计双分支Swin块支持高低精度处理。在COCO上，PTQ配置下实现1.35倍加速且无精度损失，QAT下实现1.25倍无损加速和1.53倍加速（1% mAP下降）。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers by proposing MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that assigns lower bit widths to less important windows. It introduces a Two-Branch Swin Block, achieving 1.35x speedup without loss in PTQ and 1.25x lossless speedup in QAT on COCO.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 该工作对视觉Transformer高效推理有贡献，与自动驾驶感知中的模型压缩相关，但主要针对Swin架构。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用激活稀疏性的混合精度量化框架。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 基于窗口重要性分配位宽并设计双分支块。
2507.19131|v2.result: 在COCO上实现显著加速且精度损失可控。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: ①针对黑盒对抗样本迁移性不足的问题，现有方法多依赖监督学习特征，未充分利用自监督ViT的表示能力。②提出dSVA，一种生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击方法，结合对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成训练框架，利用联合特征和注意力机制训练生成器。③相比已有工作，首次系统探索自监督ViT特征在对抗迁移性中的优势，并利用CL与MIM的互补性。④实验表明，dSVA在多个黑盒模型上显著提升对抗迁移性，优于基于监督特征的攻击方法。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited transferability of black-box adversarial examples by exploiting self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) features. It proposes dSVA, a generative attack that combines contrastive learning (CL) global features and masked image modeling (MIM) local features, trained via a novel generative framework. The method outperforms supervised-feature-based attacks, significantly boosting transferability across black-box models.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该论文将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击领域，具有新颖性，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用双自监督ViT特征提升对抗迁移性的生成式攻击方法。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 创新性地融合CL和MIM特征，并利用注意力机制训练生成器。
2506.21046|v2.result: 在多个黑盒模型上显著提升对抗样本迁移性。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: ①针对预训练ViT模型微调时存在的灾难性遗忘和计算开销问题。②提出一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法，通过约束参数更新方向保持预训练知识。③相比标准微调，该方法在保持性能的同时减少计算资源消耗。④实验表明在多个下游任务上达到与全量微调相当的性能，且训练效率更高。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and high computational cost in fine-tuning pre-trained ViTs. It proposes an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy that constrains parameter updates to preserve pre-trained knowledge. The method achieves comparable performance to full fine-tuning on downstream tasks with reduced training cost.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 该论文关注ViT高效适配，对资源受限场景有参考价值，但摘要信息不完整，质量评估受限。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出近似正交微调策略，实现高效ViT适配。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 利用正交性约束减少遗忘并提升微调效率。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 在多个下游任务上性能与全量微调相当，训练效率更高。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: ①针对TinyML应用中ViT模型计算复杂度过高的问题。②提出一种高效的混合ViT架构，结合卷积和Transformer优势，降低参数量和计算量。③相比标准ViT，该设计更适合资源受限的嵌入式设备。④实验表明在保持精度的同时显著减少模型大小和推理延迟。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ViTs in TinyML applications. It proposes an efficient hybrid ViT architecture combining convolution and Transformer components to reduce parameters and computation. The design achieves competitive accuracy with significantly lower model size and inference latency.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: 该论文面向TinyML场景，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，且摘要信息有限。

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: ①针对结构化剪枝后模型需要大量重训练或从头训练以恢复精度的问题。②提出基于方差的剪枝方法，通过收集激活统计选择剪枝神经元，并将均值激活集成回模型以保持性能，实现一次性剪枝和最小微调。③相比现有方法，无需昂贵重训练，直接剪枝后保留高精度。④在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，微调后进一步提升。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required after structured pruning. It proposes Variance-Based Pruning, a one-shot method that selects neurons via activation statistics and integrates mean activations back to preserve performance. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of original accuracy directly after pruning, with minimal fine-tuning.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 该论文提出简单有效的剪枝方法，对模型压缩和部署有实用价值，与自动驾驶模型优化相关。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于方差的单次剪枝技术，避免昂贵重训练。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活统计和均值集成实现高效剪枝。
2507.12988|v2.result: DeiT-Base剪枝后保留70%以上精度，微调后进一步提升。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer自注意力机制计算复杂度高的问题。②提出多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，统一了多种现有注意力变体（如Hyena、Mamba等），利用多项式函数和Hadamard积实现线性计算成本，避免Softmax。③相比传统自注意力，PADRe在保持精度同时显著提升速度。④在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测任务上验证，运行速度大幅提升，精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of self-attention in transformers. It proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention framework that subsumes several recent alternatives, using Hadamard products for linear cost and avoiding Softmax. PADRe achieves significantly faster inference with comparable or better accuracy across image classification, 2D detection, and 3D point cloud detection.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 该论文提出统一且高效的注意力替代方案，对视觉Transformer效率提升有重要价值，与自动驾驶感知相关。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出多项式注意力替代框架，统一多种高效注意力机制。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 利用多项式函数和Hadamard积实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上速度显著提升，精度保持或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: ①针对算子学习（Operator Learning）中连续函数映射的建模问题。②提出连续视觉Transformer（CViT），将ViT扩展到连续输入空间，用于学习函数算子。③相比标准ViT，CViT能处理连续输入并提升泛化能力。④实验表明在算子学习基准上表现良好，但摘要信息有限。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses operator learning for continuous function mapping. It proposes Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), extending ViT to continuous input spaces for learning function operators. The method shows promising results on operator learning benchmarks, though details are limited.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 该论文面向算子学习，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低，且摘要不完整。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出连续ViT用于算子学习。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展到连续输入空间。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 在算子学习基准上表现良好。
