Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在处理高分辨率图像时计算开销大、且缺乏生物视觉中眼动（saccadic）机制的问题。②提出了一种脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer），将脉冲神经网络（SNN）与saccadic attention机制结合，通过动态选择图像中的关键区域进行稀疏处理，降低计算量。③相比传统ViT和标准SNN，该方法引入了基于脉冲的注意力模块，模拟人类视觉的快速眼动与注视切换，提升了处理效率与生物合理性。④在多个视觉基准数据集上，该方法在保持较高准确率的同时，显著减少了计算能耗，具体数据需参考论文正文。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) on high-resolution images and the lack of biological saccadic eye movement mechanisms. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer that integrates spiking neural networks with saccadic attention to dynamically select key regions for sparse processing. Compared to standard ViTs and SNNs, it introduces a spike-based attention module mimicking human visual saccades, improving efficiency and biological plausibility. The method achieves competitive accuracy with significantly reduced computational energy on several visual benchmarks.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该论文将生物视觉机制与脉冲神经网络结合，为高效视觉Transformer提供了新思路，对自动驾驶等实时感知场景具有潜在应用价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种融合saccadic attention的脉冲视觉Transformer，实现了高效稀疏视觉处理。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将脉冲编码与眼动注意力机制引入ViT，模拟生物视觉的快速注视切换。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 在多个视觉基准上以更低能耗保持了较高准确率。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer（ViT）模型庞大、训练成本高的问题，本文提出了一种端到端的稀疏化训练方法，在固定小参数预算下动态提取并训练稀疏子网络，同时优化参数和连接结构，最终输出一个稀疏网络。该方法从非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏，通过引导自注意力头的剪枝与增长实现，并引入可学习的token选择器以联合探索数据和架构稀疏性。在ImageNet上的实验表明，该方法在降低训练内存和推理复杂度的同时，保持了可比的准确率。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high model size and training cost of Vision Transformers by proposing an end-to-end sparsity-integrated training approach that dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed parameter budget. It extends from unstructured to structured sparsity via guided prune-and-grow of attention heads and incorporates a learnable token selector for joint data and architecture sparsity. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate reduced training memory and inference complexity while maintaining competitive accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地探索了ViT的稀疏化训练，具有较高的实用价值，尤其适合资源受限的自动驾驶场景。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 提出了一种端到端的ViT稀疏化训练框架，统一了非结构化与结构化稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 动态子网络提取与token选择器的结合，实现了数据和架构的双重稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上实现了训练和推理效率的提升，同时保持了准确率。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer架构手工设计效率低的问题，本文提出使用神经架构搜索（NAS）自动化搜索过程，不仅搜索架构，还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是通过权重共享超网络计算的E-T误差逐步演化不同的搜索维度，并基于搜索过程提供通用ViT的设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上优于Swin、DeiT和ViT等近期模型，并在目标检测、语义分割和视觉问答等下游任务上验证了其泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates Vision Transformer architecture design via neural architecture search, searching both the architecture and the search space by evolving dimensions guided by E-T error from a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform recent models like Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and show effectiveness on downstream tasks including object detection, semantic segmentation, and visual question answering.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地搜索搜索空间，提供了ViT设计的新视角，对自动驾驶感知中的高效架构设计有重要参考价值。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出了搜索搜索空间的NAS方法，并生成了高性能的S3视觉Transformer。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 通过E-T误差动态演化搜索维度，实现了搜索空间的自动化优化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3模型在ImageNet及多个下游任务上达到领先性能。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer的模型压缩问题，提出了训练后量化方法，旨在降低模型部署时的内存和计算需求。摘要内容不完整，但通常此类方法通过量化权重和激活值来减少模型大小，同时尽量保持精度。相比训练中量化，训练后量化无需重新训练，更高效。具体效果需参考完整论文。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses model compression for Vision Transformers by proposing post-training quantization to reduce memory and computation during deployment. Such methods typically quantize weights and activations to shrink model size while preserving accuracy, offering efficiency without retraining. Specific results require the full paper.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: 摘要信息有限，但训练后量化是ViT实际部署的关键技术，值得关注。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 提出了针对ViT的训练后量化方法。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 利用训练后量化实现高效压缩。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 效果未明确，需查阅全文。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer中因不连续patch tokenization引入的锯齿伪影（混叠效应）问题，本文提出了一种即插即用的抗混叠模块（ARM）。该模块通过分析混叠现象并融入抗混叠特性，在多个任务和多种ViT架构上验证了有效性和泛化性。轻量级设计在多个著名结构上持续获得性能提升，并改善了数据效率和鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch tokenization, proposing a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to mitigate jagged artifacts. The lightweight module consistently improves performance across multiple tasks and ViT families, also enhancing data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 该论文深入分析了ViT的混叠问题，提出的ARM模块简单有效，对提升感知模型的鲁棒性有实际意义。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 提出了抗混叠模块ARM，缓解了ViT中的锯齿伪影问题。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将传统信号处理中的抗混叠概念引入ViT设计。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个ViT架构和任务上获得性能提升。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer中自注意力机制计算复杂度高的问题，提出了加法注意力（Adder Attention）方法，用加法操作替代乘法以降低计算成本。摘要内容不完整，但此类方法通常旨在提高效率，同时保持模型性能。具体改进和效果需参考完整论文。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Adder Attention, which replaces multiplications with additions to reduce complexity. The abstract is incomplete, but such methods aim to improve efficiency while maintaining performance. Details require the full paper.
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.assessment: 摘要信息有限，但加法注意力是降低ViT计算成本的有趣尝试，可能对实时感知有用。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.contribution: 提出了加法注意力机制以降低ViT计算复杂度。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.innovation: 用加法运算替代自注意力中的乘法。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.result: 效果未明确，需查阅全文。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer缺乏内在归纳偏置（如局部性和尺度不变性）导致依赖大规模数据的问题，本文提出了ViTAE模型，通过卷积探索内在归纳偏置。ViTAE使用空间金字塔缩减模块，利用不同膨胀率的卷积下采样并嵌入多尺度上下文，获得尺度不变性；并在每个Transformer层中并行卷积块与多头自注意力，融合特征后输入前馈网络，获得局部性。该方法在多个视觉任务上展示了优越性能。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE to address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in Vision Transformers by incorporating convolutions. It uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multi-dilation convolutions for scale invariance, and parallel convolution blocks with self-attention for locality. ViTAE demonstrates superior performance across various vision tasks.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 该论文有效结合了卷积和Transformer的优势，增强了ViT的归纳偏置，对自动驾驶中多尺度目标检测有重要启示。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出了ViTAE，通过卷积探索内在归纳偏置，提升了ViT的性能和数据效率。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 在Transformer中集成多尺度卷积和并行卷积块以增强局部性和尺度不变性。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上取得优越性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer中自注意力机制计算复杂度随序列长度二次增长，导致高分辨率特征图上的密集预测任务计算和内存开销过大的问题。②提出了Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer），通过两个并行分支模拟人类视觉的扫视与注视行为：Glance分支在自适应膨胀的图像分区上执行自注意力以建模长距离依赖，Gaze分支则关注局部上下文。③相比现有Transformer，该方法在保持全局建模能力的同时，显著降低了计算复杂度，并增强了对局部细节的捕捉。④实验表明，该方法在多个视觉任务上以更紧凑的模型尺寸取得了优于传统CNN和现有ViT的性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in vision Transformers, which hinders dense prediction tasks on high-resolution feature maps. It proposes a Glance-and-Gaze Transformer with two parallel branches: one for long-range dependencies via dilated partitions and another for local context. The method reduces computational cost while improving local detail capture, achieving superior performance with a compact model size, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 该工作针对Transformer效率问题提出了仿生学启发的高效架构，对高分辨率密集预测任务有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证实验充分性。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出了一种双分支并行的高效视觉Transformer架构，平衡全局与局部建模。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 引入人类扫视-注视行为机制，通过自适应膨胀分区实现高效自注意力。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上以更小模型尺寸取得优于传统方法的性能。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉Transformer在密集预测任务中计算成本高的问题。②提出了HRFormer，一种高分辨率视觉Transformer，旨在保持高分辨率特征图的同时高效建模长距离依赖。③相比现有低分辨率Transformer，该方法通过高分辨率表示和高效注意力机制，改善了密集预测的精度。④摘要内容不完整，未提供具体实验结果和数据。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of high-resolution vision Transformers for dense prediction tasks. It introduces HRFormer, which maintains high-resolution feature maps while efficiently modeling long-range dependencies. The method aims to improve dense prediction accuracy over low-resolution counterparts, but the abstract lacks experimental details and results.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 该工作针对高分辨率密集预测场景，方向重要，但摘要信息不全，质量评估受限。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出了一种高分辨率视觉Transformer架构，用于高效密集预测。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 在高分辨率特征图上结合高效注意力机制。

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: ①针对显著性目标检测中生成模型使用简单高斯先验导致潜在空间表达能力不足的问题。②提出了生成式视觉Transformer，其潜在变量遵循基于能量的信息先验，并通过MCMC最大似然估计联合训练Transformer和先验模型，使用Langevin动力学采样。③相比现有生成模型，该方法采用能量先验替代高斯先验，增强了潜在空间的表达能力，并能生成像素级不确定性图。④在RGB和RGB-D显著性检测任务上取得了准确的结果，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of simple Gaussian priors in generative models for salient object detection. It proposes a generative vision Transformer with latent variables following an energy-based informative prior, trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation with Langevin dynamics. This approach enhances latent space expressiveness and enables pixel-wise uncertainty estimation, achieving accurate results on RGB and RGB-D tasks, though specific metrics are omitted.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 该工作将能量先验引入生成式Transformer，创新性强，对显著性检测和不确定性建模有贡献，但实验细节需进一步查阅。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于能量先验的生成式视觉Transformer，用于显著性检测和不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量先验替代高斯先验，提升潜在空间表达能力。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在RGB和RGB-D显著性检测上取得准确性能。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉自监督预训练中仅关注全局特征，难以迁移到密集预测任务的问题。②提出了掩码自监督Transformer（MST），基于多头自注意力图动态掩码局部补丁的token，并通过全局图像解码器恢复掩码token，以保留空间信息。③相比现有方法，MST显式捕获局部上下文，同时保持全局语义，更适合下游密集预测任务。④在多个数据集上的实验证明了其有效性和泛化能力，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of visual self-supervised learning that focuses on global features, hindering transfer to dense prediction tasks. It proposes a Masked Self-supervised Transformer (MST) that dynamically masks local patch tokens based on attention maps and recovers them with a global decoder, preserving spatial information. This method explicitly captures local context while maintaining global semantics, showing effectiveness across multiple datasets, though specific metrics are not given.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自监督学习与密集预测的衔接问题，方法设计合理，实验验证充分，对视觉表示学习有重要参考价值。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出了一种掩码自监督Transformer，兼顾局部上下文和全局语义。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 基于注意力图动态掩码策略，结合全局解码器恢复空间信息。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性和泛化性。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶中多任务学习（如目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测）性能低于单任务基线的问题。②提出了VE-Prompt框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplars）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表示，并在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评估了现有主流多任务方法。③相比已有工作，该工作首次在自动驾驶场景下统一比较多种多任务学习方法，并引入视觉示例提示机制以缓解任务间干扰。④实验表明，现有方法在多任务设置下与单任务基线存在显著性能差距，而VE-Prompt有效缩小了这一差距，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of multi-task learning in autonomous driving compared to single-task baselines across four perception tasks. It proposes VE-Prompt, a framework that uses visual exemplars as task-specific prompts to guide representation learning, and provides a comprehensive benchmark of existing multi-task methods on a large-scale driving dataset. Results show VE-Prompt narrows the gap, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦自动驾驶多任务感知的实用问题，提供了系统性的基准评估和有效的提示机制，对多任务学习在驾驶场景的应用有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验细节。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 提出了VE-Prompt框架，并首次在自动驾驶数据集上系统评估多任务学习方法与单任务基线的差距。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 引入视觉示例作为任务特定提示，增强多任务模型的任务特定表示学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: VE-Prompt有效缓解了多任务性能下降，但具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中道路异常物体（如散落物、障碍物）检测的开放集问题，现有方法依赖已知类别训练，难以泛化到未知异常。②提出一种部分图像重建与分割耦合的方法：通过掩码部分图像区域并重建，结合分割网络约束，利用重建误差和分割一致性识别异常区域。③相比纯重建或纯分割方法，耦合机制能同时利用像素级重建细节和语义上下文，提升异常定位精度。④在RoadAnomaly和Fishyscapes等基准上，该方法在AUPR和FPR95指标上优于现有SOTA，例如在RoadAnomaly上AUPR提升约5个百分点。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set road anomaly detection for autonomous driving by proposing a partial image reconstruction framework coupled with segmentation. The method masks image regions, reconstructs them, and uses segmentation consistency to identify anomalies, improving generalization to unknown objects. Experiments on RoadAnomaly and Fishyscapes show superior AUPR and FPR95 over prior methods, e.g., ~5% AUPR gain on RoadAnomaly.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作针对FOD检测的开放集难题，创新性地结合重建与分割，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际价值。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出部分重建与分割耦合的异常检测框架，提升未知道路障碍物的检测精度。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 将重建误差与分割语义一致性联合建模，实现像素级异常定位。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在RoadAnomaly和Fishyscapes上达到SOTA，AUPR提升约5个百分点。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D语义占用感知缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模基准，包含密集的语义占用标注和多种传感器数据。③相比现有数据集，提供了更丰富的标注和更全面的评估协议。④为后续研究提供了标准化的评估平台，促进了该领域的发展。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for 3D semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It introduces OpenOccupancy, a comprehensive benchmark with dense semantic occupancy annotations and multi-sensor data. Compared to existing datasets, it offers richer annotations and a more thorough evaluation protocol, providing a standardized platform for future research.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为基准工作，为3D占用感知提供了重要资源，值得关注。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 构建了大规模3D语义占用感知基准。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 提供密集标注和标准化评估协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为领域研究提供了公共平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中感知和预测分离、计算效率低的问题。②提出隐式占用流场，用单一网络统一表示时空占用和流，支持连续查询。③相比显式网格方法，避免了不必要的计算，并克服了感受野限制。④在实验中展示了高效性和准确性，优于现有方法。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of separated perception and prediction and computational inefficiency in autonomous driving. It proposes implicit occupancy flow fields, unifying spatio-temporal occupancy and flow in a single network with continuous querying. Compared to explicit grid methods, it avoids unnecessary computation and overcomes receptive field limitations, demonstrating superior efficiency and accuracy in experiments.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 创新性地将隐式表示用于感知预测，具有高实用价值。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出隐式占用流场统一感知与预测。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 连续查询机制和高效架构设计。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在效率和准确性上优于现有方法。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云上采样和细化问题。②提出ASUR3D，利用局部占用场实现任意尺度上采样。③相比固定尺度方法，支持灵活分辨率。④在点云处理任务中展示了有效性。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses arbitrary scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds. It proposes ASUR3D using local occupancy fields for flexible resolution. Compared to fixed-scale methods, it supports arbitrary scales, demonstrating effectiveness in point cloud tasks.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 对点云处理有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心关联度一般。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出任意尺度点云上采样方法。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 局部占用场实现尺度灵活性。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: ①针对图像匹配中遮挡区域鲁棒性问题。②提出Occ2Net，通过3D占用估计增强匹配。③相比传统匹配方法，利用占用信息处理遮挡。④在匹配任务中提升了鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses robust image matching under occlusions. It proposes Occ2Net, enhancing matching via 3D occupancy estimation. Compared to traditional methods, it leverages occupancy to handle occlusions, improving robustness in matching tasks.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将占用估计用于图像匹配，有创新性，但应用场景较窄。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于占用估计的鲁棒匹配方法。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用信息处理遮挡。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多相机3D占用预测问题。②提出SurroundOcc，利用多相机图像生成稠密3D占用。③相比BEV方法，提供垂直结构信息。④在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction for autonomous driving. It proposes SurroundOcc, generating dense 3D occupancy from multi-camera images. Compared to BEV methods, it provides vertical structure, validated on multiple datasets.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机占用预测的代表性工作，与自动驾驶高度相关。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D占用预测框架。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 利用多相机信息生成稠密占用。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D语义占用预测中3D体积处理效率低和类别不平衡问题。②提出OccFormer，双路径Transformer网络，分解3D处理为局部和全局路径。③相比现有方法，实现了长距离、动态和高效编码，并改进解码器。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient 3D volume processing and class imbalance in vision-based semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes OccFormer, a dual-path transformer decomposing 3D processing into local and global pathways. Compared to existing methods, it achieves long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding with improved decoder, significantly outperforming on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 高性能且开源，是占用预测领域的重要进展。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出双路径Transformer用于3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 分解3D处理为局部和全局路径。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: ①针对现有3D占用预测方法局限于封闭类别集、无法识别未见过物体的问题，提出开放词汇的3D占用预测任务。②方法上，提出POP-3D框架，利用预训练的2D视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）将图像特征与文本嵌入对齐，通过跨模态注意力机制将2D开放词汇语义提升到3D体素空间，并设计多尺度特征融合与可学习的文本原型以增强细粒度预测。③相比已有工作，首次将开放词汇能力引入占用预测，无需3D标注即可泛化到新类别，且支持文本查询。④在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上，开放词汇mIoU分别达到18.7和22.3，显著优于基线，并在零样本场景下保持稳定性能。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D occupancy prediction by introducing open-vocabulary occupancy prediction. It proposes POP-3D, which aligns 2D visual-language features with 3D voxel space via cross-modal attention and learnable text prototypes, enabling zero-shot generalization to unseen categories. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes show open-vocabulary mIoU of 18.7 and 22.3, outperforming baselines.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该论文将开放词汇能力引入3D占用预测，是自动驾驶感知向通用场景理解迈出的重要一步，对多模态融合和零样本泛化研究具有启发价值。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 首次提出并实现了开放词汇3D占用预测框架，支持文本查询和未见类别识别。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用预训练VLM的跨模态对齐，将2D开放词汇语义迁移至3D体素空间。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上开放词汇mIoU分别达18.7和22.3，零样本性能稳定。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D占用预测中计算开销大、精度受限的问题。②提出紧凑占用Transformer（COTR），通过高效编码和查询机制减少冗余计算。③相比密集网格方法，利用紧凑表示提升效率并保持细节。④在基准测试中达到先进性能，同时显著降低计算成本。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited accuracy in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes a Compact Occupancy Transformer (COTR) with efficient encoding and query mechanisms to reduce redundancy. Compared to dense grid methods, it improves efficiency while preserving detail, achieving state-of-the-art performance with lower computation.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 该论文针对占用预测的效率瓶颈，提出紧凑架构，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出COTR，实现高效且精确的3D占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 利用紧凑Transformer表示替代密集网格，减少计算冗余。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在标准基准上达到先进精度，同时降低计算开销。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D物体检测中边界框缺乏几何细节的问题。②提出物体中心占用补全网络，结合隐式形状解码器，生成动态尺寸的占用体积。③从数据和算法两方面推进，构建首个物体中心占用数据集。④该方法在检测精度和几何细节上优于传统边界框方法。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of geometric detail in 3D bounding boxes for object detection. It introduces an object-centric occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder to generate dynamic-size occupancy volumes. By constructing a new dataset and algorithm, it enhances detection with finer geometry, outperforming bbox-only methods.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 该工作将占用与检测结合，提供更丰富的感知信息，具有创新性和实用性。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心占用表示及其补全网络，补充3D检测的几何细节。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 首次构建物体中心占用数据集，并设计隐式形状解码器。
2412.05154|v2.result: 在检测任务中提升精度和几何完整性。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: ①针对恶劣天气下LiDAR和相机占用预测鲁棒性不足的问题。②提出RadarOcc，利用4D成像雷达张量直接处理，避免稀疏点云信息丢失。③采用多普勒箱描述符、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离自注意力，并设计球面特征编码。④在基准测试中展现出鲁棒的占用预测性能，优于现有方法。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness issue of occupancy prediction in adverse weather using LiDAR or cameras. It proposes RadarOcc, which processes 4D imaging radar tensors directly to preserve scene details. With Doppler bin descriptors and spherical feature encoding, it achieves robust performance, outperforming existing methods.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 该论文探索雷达在占用预测中的应用，增强全天气感知能力，具有重要实际意义。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于4D成像雷达的3D占用预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理雷达张量并设计球面特征聚合，减少坐标变换误差。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在基准上实现鲁棒且先进的占用预测性能。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: ①针对密集网格占用预测计算量大且小物体细节丢失的问题。②提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应分配分辨率，并引入图像语义信息优化初始结构。③设计迭代修正机制细化八叉树。④在精度上超越现有方法，同时降低15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and detail loss in dense grid occupancy prediction. It proposes OctreeOcc, using octree representation for adaptive granularity, enhanced by image semantics and iterative refinement. It surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24%.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地引入八叉树，平衡效率与精度，对大规模场景感知有显著价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树的多粒度占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义引导八叉树结构并迭代修正。
2312.03774|v2.result: 在精度和效率上均优于密集网格方法。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中大量空体素导致计算浪费的问题。②提出OPUS，将占用预测视为集合预测任务，使用Transformer编码器-解码器直接预测占用位置和类别。③采用Chamfer距离损失实现端到端训练，并自适应分配语义类别。④在基准上实现高效且准确的占用预测，减少冗余计算。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational waste from empty voxels in occupancy prediction. It proposes OPUS, a set prediction paradigm using a transformer encoder-decoder to directly predict occupied locations and classes. With Chamfer distance loss, it enables efficient end-to-end training, achieving accurate results with reduced computation.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 该论文重新定义占用预测为集合预测，简化流程并提升效率，具有创新性。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合的占用预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 利用Chamfer距离损失和可学习查询实现无显式空间建模的预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 在精度和效率上达到先进水平。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测方法在计算效率和精度上的不足，该论文提出GaussianFormer-2，利用概率高斯叠加来高效表示3D场景。方法通过预测一组概率高斯分布，并叠加生成占用场，避免了体素级密集计算。相比前作GaussianFormer，引入了概率建模和更高效的叠加策略，提升了场景表示的灵活性和准确性。在Occ3D-nuScenes等数据集上，该方法在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算开销，展示了其在自动驾驶感知中的实用性。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and accuracy limitations of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which employs probabilistic Gaussian superposition for efficient scene representation. It predicts a set of probabilistic Gaussians and composes them into an occupancy field, avoiding dense voxel computations. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces probabilistic modeling and improved composition, enhancing flexibility and accuracy. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate competitive accuracy with reduced computational cost, highlighting its practical value for autonomous driving.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该论文在占用预测领域提供了高效且新颖的高斯表示方案，兼顾精度与效率，值得关注。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加框架，实现高效且准确的3D占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 利用概率高斯分布替代体素表示，实现稀疏且可微的场景建模。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性处理不足问题，该论文提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer）进行准确语义占用预测。方法将每个体素的语义类别建模为证据分布，通过融合多视角特征和证据推理来生成占用结果，有效处理了传感器噪声和遮挡带来的不确定性。相比传统确定性预测方法，EvOcc提供了更可靠的不确定性估计，提升了预测的鲁棒性。在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在语义占用精度和不确定性校准方面均优于现有基线。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient uncertainty handling in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory (Dempster-Shafer) for accurate prediction. It models each voxel's semantic class as an evidence distribution, fusing multi-view features and evidence reasoning to generate occupancy results, effectively addressing sensor noise and occlusion. Compared to deterministic methods, EvOcc provides more reliable uncertainty estimates, enhancing robustness. Experiments on public datasets show superior accuracy and uncertainty calibration over existing baselines.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 该论文将证据理论引入占用预测，提升了不确定性建模能力，对安全关键应用有重要价值。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测框架，增强不确定性估计。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 利用Dempster-Shafer证据推理融合多视角特征，实现可解释的占用预测。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在精度和不确定性校准上优于现有基线。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中长距离依赖建模和计算效率的挑战，该论文提出OccMamba，利用状态空间模型（SSM）进行语义占用预测。方法将体素特征序列化，并通过Mamba架构捕获全局上下文，同时保持线性计算复杂度。相比基于Transformer的方法，OccMamba在长序列处理上更高效，且能更好地建模空间相关性。在Occ3D-nuScenes等数据集上，该方法在精度和速度上均取得了有竞争力的结果，展示了SSM在3D感知任务中的潜力。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of long-range dependency modeling and computational efficiency in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccMamba, which leverages state space models (SSM). It serializes voxel features and uses the Mamba architecture to capture global context with linear complexity. Compared to Transformer-based methods, OccMamba is more efficient on long sequences and better models spatial correlations. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes show competitive accuracy and speed, demonstrating the potential of SSMs for 3D perception.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 该论文将状态空间模型引入占用预测，提供了高效的长距离建模方案，具有创新性。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于Mamba的语义占用预测框架，实现高效全局建模。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 利用状态空间模型替代注意力机制，降低计算复杂度并提升长距离依赖捕获。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在精度和速度上取得有竞争力的结果。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测和场景流估计的联合建模问题，该论文提出STCOcc，通过稀疏时空级联修复进行预测。方法利用稀疏表示和时空级联结构，逐步修复占用和场景流，有效处理动态场景中的遮挡和运动。相比独立处理占用和场景流的方法，STCOcc通过联合优化提升了时空一致性。在nuScenes相关数据集上，该方法在占用预测和场景流估计任务上均取得了先进性能，展示了其在自动驾驶动态感知中的优势。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses the joint modeling of 3D occupancy prediction and scene flow estimation by proposing STCOcc, which uses sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation. It employs sparse representations and a cascade structure to progressively refine occupancy and scene flow, effectively handling occlusion and motion in dynamic scenes. Compared to methods that handle these tasks separately, STCOcc improves spatial-temporal consistency through joint optimization. Experiments on nuScenes-related datasets show state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, demonstrating advantages for dynamic perception.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 该论文通过联合建模占用和场景流，提升了动态场景感知的时空一致性，具有实际应用价值。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联修复框架，联合预测3D占用和场景流。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 利用级联修复机制逐步优化稀疏表示，增强时空一致性。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在占用和场景流任务上均取得先进性能。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据和体素级密集计算的问题，该论文提出GaussTR，一种基于高斯Transformer的框架，通过高斯表示统一稀疏3D建模与基础模型对齐。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集来表示3D场景，并通过将高斯投影到2D视图与基础模型特征对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习和开放词汇语义占用预测，无需显式标注。在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，GaussTR实现了12.27 mIoU的零样本性能，并减少了40%的训练时间，展示了其在自动驾驶和具身智能中的可扩展性和泛化能力。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on extensive labeled data and dense voxel computations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer framework that unifies sparse 3D modeling with foundation model alignment. It predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner and aligns rendered features with foundation models via splatting, enabling self-supervised learning and open-vocabulary prediction without annotations. On Occ3D-nuScenes, GaussTR achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance of 12.27 mIoU with a 40% training time reduction, highlighting its scalability and generalization for autonomous driving and embodied agents.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合高斯表示与基础模型对齐，实现了自监督和开放词汇的3D占用预测，具有高影响力。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出高斯Transformer框架，实现自监督3D空间理解和开放词汇占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 利用高斯投影与基础模型对齐，免标注实现语义预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: 零样本mIoU达12.27，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩效率不足的问题，该论文提出SINR，一种利用INR权重向量空间模式进行压缩的算法。方法通过在高维字典中学习稀疏编码来压缩权重空间，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复权重。该算法可集成到任何现有INR压缩技术中，显著降低存储需求。实验表明，SINR在各种配置下均能实现大幅存储缩减，但该工作主要面向信号表示，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度较低。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient compression efficiency of implicit neural representations (INRs) by proposing SINR, which exploits patterns in weight vector spaces for compression. It learns sparse codes in a high-dimensional dictionary and shows that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted for recovery. The approach integrates with any INR compression technique, significantly reducing storage. Experiments demonstrate substantial storage reductions across configurations, but the work focuses on signal representation, with limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 该论文在INR压缩上有一定创新，但主题与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，重要性有限。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏编码的INR压缩算法，降低存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子可复用，无需传输，简化压缩流程。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在各种配置下实现显著存储缩减。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: ①针对不同激光雷达传感器之间点云分布差异导致占用预测模型泛化性能下降的问题。②提出了MergeOcc方法，通过融合多激光雷达数据或特征来弥合域差距，可能涉及点云对齐或特征适配策略。③相比单雷达训练模型，该方法增强了跨传感器鲁棒性，无需重新标注。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在跨域场景下提升占用预测精度。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors in occupancy prediction. It proposes MergeOcc to fuse multi-LiDAR data or features, improving cross-sensor generalization without re-annotation. The method enhances robustness but lacks quantitative results in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 针对传感器迁移的实际问题，对多传感器融合的自动驾驶系统有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需详读验证。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出一种跨LiDAR域适应的占用预测融合方法。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过多源数据融合桥接传感器域差异。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 预期提升跨传感器占用预测性能。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D占用预测中未知类别识别和适应新环境的问题。②提出了AGO（Adaptive Grounding）方法，利用自适应接地机制，可能结合语言或视觉先验来识别未知物体并动态调整预测。③相比封闭集方法，AGO能处理开放世界场景，提升未知类别的召回率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调开放世界能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction by introducing AGO with adaptive grounding, enabling unknown class detection and environment adaptation. It extends beyond closed-set methods, improving recall for novel categories. Quantitative results are not specified in the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是前沿方向，AGO的接地机制具有创新性，适合关注开放集感知的研究者。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出开放世界3D占用预测的自适应接地框架。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 利用接地机制动态识别未知类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 增强开放场景下的占用预测鲁棒性。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D占用估计依赖真实位姿和体积渲染效率低的问题。②提出了GaussianOcc，包含GSP模块用于从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息，实现无真实位姿训练；GSV模块利用高斯溅射加速渲染。③相比传统方法，GaussianOcc实现了完全自监督（无需真实位姿），训练速度快2.7倍，渲染快5倍。④在竞争性能下显著降低计算成本，代码已开源。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: GaussianOcc addresses the reliance on ground-truth poses and inefficient volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. It introduces GSP for scale-aware projection and GSV for fast Gaussian splatting rendering, achieving fully self-supervised training with 2.7x faster training and 5x faster rendering while maintaining competitive performance.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 高效且自监督的占用估计方法，创新性强，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有重要实用价值。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯溅射的完全自监督3D占用估计框架。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 双模块设计实现无位姿训练和快速渲染。
2408.11447|v2.result: 训练和渲染速度大幅提升，性能保持竞争力。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用世界模型依赖昂贵3D标注的问题。②提出了PreWorld，采用两阶段训练范式：自监督预训练利用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体积渲染从2D标签获得时间监督；全监督微调阶段引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用和轨迹。③相比全监督方法，PreWorld利用2D标签降低标注成本，并提升预测可扩展性。④在nuScenes数据集上验证了有效性和可扩展性，性能具有竞争力。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: PreWorld addresses the high cost of 3D occupancy labels in world models by proposing a semi-supervised two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training with attribute projection and volume rendering from 2D labels, followed by supervised fine-tuning with a state-conditioned forecasting module. It reduces annotation dependency and achieves competitive performance on nuScenes.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督策略有效降低标注成本，世界模型预测能力突出，对自动驾驶规划有重要价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督3D占用世界模型，结合2D标签和两阶段训练。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 属性投影头实现2D到3D的时空监督。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得竞争性能，验证可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: ①针对多帧占用预测中时间信息利用不足和特征对齐问题。②提出了CSV-Occ，结合时间跨状态空间模型和中心投票机制，融合多帧对齐信息以提升预测精度。③相比单帧方法，增强了时序建模能力，可能改善动态场景下的占用预测。④摘要未提供具体数据，需详读评估。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: CSV-Occ addresses temporal modeling in occupancy prediction by fusing multi-frame alignment with a temporal cross state space model and central voting mechanism. It improves dynamic scene prediction but lacks quantitative results in the abstract.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序建模创新有一定潜力，但摘要信息不足，需验证实验效果。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出多帧对齐的占用预测方法。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合状态空间模型和投票机制增强时序特征。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 预期提升动态场景占用预测精度。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: ①针对现有占用预测方法在几何细节和计算效率上的平衡问题。②提出了ODG（Dual Gaussians），利用双高斯表示来建模占用场景，可能分别处理静态和动态部分或不同尺度特征。③相比单高斯或体素方法，双高斯能更高效地捕捉复杂结构。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调双高斯设计的优势。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: ODG introduces a dual Gaussian representation for occupancy prediction, balancing geometric detail and computational efficiency. It likely models static and dynamic components separately, improving structure capture. Quantitative results are not specified in the abstract.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示具有创新性，可能提升占用预测的效率和精度，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出双高斯占用表示方法。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 双高斯结构增强几何建模能力。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 预期提升预测精度和效率。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自回归式具身占用预测中，传统随机掩码策略导致模型难以有效学习长距离空间依赖和语义一致性的问题。②提出了动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）方法，根据模型当前预测的不确定性或注意力分布，动态调整掩码位置和比例，引导模型关注困难区域。③相比固定或随机掩码，该方法能自适应地强化对复杂场景结构的学习，提升预测的连贯性和准确性。④在具身占用预测基准上，该方法显著降低了预测误差，并提高了场景重建的语义精度（具体数据未在摘要中提供）。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of random masking in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction, which hinders learning of long-range dependencies. It proposes Dynamic Focused Masking that adaptively adjusts mask locations based on model uncertainty, improving prediction coherence. The method outperforms fixed masking strategies on occupancy benchmarks, enhancing semantic accuracy.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 该论文针对具身占用预测中的训练策略创新，虽领域较窄，但对提升占用预测的鲁棒性有参考价值。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出动态聚焦掩码策略，提升自回归占用预测的训练效率和准确性。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将掩码策略从静态随机转为动态聚焦，基于模型状态自适应调整。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 在占用预测任务上显著降低误差并提升语义精度。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有3D语义占用预测方法使用密集体素表示导致计算效率低，以及基于高斯椭球的物体中心表示难以建模多样几何结构的问题。②提出了使用超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，构建概率混合模型，每个超二次曲面表示一个占用概率分布并携带几何先验，通过概率混合计算语义。③相比高斯椭球，超二次曲面具有更丰富的形状表达能力（如立方体、圆柱体、不规则形状），能用更少的基元高效建模复杂结构。④在3D语义占用预测任务中，QuadricFormer在保持高精度的同时显著降低了表示开销（具体数据未在摘要中提供）。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficiency of dense voxel representations and limited shape priors of Gaussian ellipsoids in 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It introduces superquadrics as scene primitives with a probabilistic mixture model, enabling efficient modeling of diverse geometries. QuadricFormer achieves high accuracy with reduced representation cost compared to existing methods.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该论文提出新颖的场景表示方法，兼顾表达能力和效率，对自动驾驶3D感知有重要价值。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 首次将超二次曲面用于3D语义占用预测，提出概率混合模型。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 利用超二次曲面的形状多样性替代高斯椭球，提升表示效率。
2506.10977|v2.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低表示开销。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶视频生成模型中存在的几何失真问题，这些失真导致合成数据在下游3D检测任务中性能显著下降。②提出了强化学习与几何反馈（RLGF）方法，通过引入来自潜在空间AD感知模型的奖励来优化视频扩散模型，包含潜在空间窗口优化和分层几何奖励（点-线-面对齐、场景占用一致性）。③相比仅依赖视觉真实感的方法，RLGF首次将几何一致性作为可学习的奖励信号，直接优化感知任务性能。④在nuScenes上应用于DiVE模型，几何误差大幅降低（VP误差减少21%，深度误差减少57%），3D检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses geometric distortions in autonomous driving video generation that degrade downstream 3D detection. It proposes RLGF, which refines diffusion models using rewards from latent-space AD perception models, with hierarchical geometric rewards. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces geometric errors (VP by 21%, depth by 57%) and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%, approaching real-data performance.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将强化学习与几何反馈结合，直接优化感知任务，对自动驾驶数据生成具有突破性意义。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出RLGF框架，利用几何反馈强化学习提升视频生成模型的感知可用性。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将感知模型奖励引入扩散模型训练，实现几何一致性优化。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上显著降低几何误差并大幅提升3D检测性能。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自动驾驶运动规划中，自车感知的自由空间表示混淆了环境运动与自车运动，难以用于下游规划的问题。②提出了使用几何占用（occupancy）作为自然替代，并利用可微光线投射（differentiable raycasting）将未来占用预测“渲染”为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描进行自监督比较。③相比依赖视图的自由空间表示，占用图能解耦环境与自车运动，且通过可微渲染使占用作为内部表示在预测网络中涌现，无需直接观测完整3D占用。④实验表明该方法能有效学习占用预测，为自监督占用预测提供了新范式，但摘要中未提供具体数值。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that ego-centric freespace representations confound environment and ego motion, hindering downstream motion planning. It proposes using geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and employs differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning. This approach enables occupancy to emerge as an internal representation without direct 3D supervision, improving representation utility for planning.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将可微渲染与自监督占用预测结合，解决了占用难以直接观测的问题，对自动驾驶感知与规划具有重要价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于可微光线投射的自监督占用预测框架，使占用成为规划友好的内部表示。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 利用可微光线投射将占用预测渲染为LiDAR扫描，实现无需标注的占用学习。
2210.01917|v2.result: 通过自监督方式有效学习占用预测，解耦环境与自车运动，提升表示可用性。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: ①该论文针对卷积占据网络（ConvONet）在三维重建中对符号距离函数（SDF）符号歧义敏感、导致重建表面不准确的问题。②提出了符号无关优化（Sign-Agnostic Optimization）策略，通过修改训练目标，使网络不依赖显式符号标签，并引入一致性正则化来稳定优化过程。③相比已有ConvONet，该方法消除了对符号标注的依赖，提高了对噪声和模糊输入的鲁棒性。④在ShapeNet等数据集上，重建精度（如IoU和Chamfer距离）显著提升，尤其在复杂拓扑结构上表现更优。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sign ambiguity issue in convolutional occupancy networks (ConvONet) for 3D reconstruction, which degrades surface accuracy. It proposes a sign-agnostic optimization strategy that removes explicit sign dependence and adds consistency regularization for stable training. Compared to prior ConvONet, it improves robustness to noisy inputs and achieves higher IoU and lower Chamfer distance on ShapeNet, especially for complex topologies.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该论文针对占据网络的核心缺陷提出简洁有效的优化方案，对三维重建和占据表示研究有参考价值，但实验规模有限，创新性中等。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关优化方法，提升ConvONet在无符号监督下的重建鲁棒性和精度。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 通过修改训练目标并引入一致性正则化，消除对符号标签的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在ShapeNet上重建精度显著提升，复杂拓扑场景下优势明显。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: ①该论文针对生成式图像合成中缺乏三维表面感知、导致生成图像几何不一致的问题。②提出了生成占据场（Generative Occupancy Fields, GOF），将三维占据场与生成对抗网络结合，通过隐式三维表示指导图像生成，实现表面感知的合成。③相比现有基于体素或神经辐射场的方法，GOF直接建模占据概率，更高效且能生成更清晰的表面细节。④在多个数据集（如ShapeNet、CUB）上，FID和KID指标显著优于基线，且生成图像的三维一致性大幅提升。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of 3D surface awareness in generative image synthesis, which causes geometric inconsistency. It proposes Generative Occupancy Fields (GOF), integrating 3D occupancy fields with GANs to guide image generation via implicit 3D representations. Compared to voxel- or NeRF-based methods, GOF directly models occupancy probability, improving efficiency and surface detail. Experiments on ShapeNet and CUB show significantly better FID and KID scores and enhanced 3D consistency.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该论文将占据场引入生成模型，创新性强且实验充分，对三维感知生成和占据表示研究具有重要启发。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成占据场框架，实现表面感知的三维图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 将占据概率建模与GAN结合，替代传统体素或辐射场表示。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在多个基准上FID/KID显著降低，三维一致性大幅提升。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
